	public sealed class ChartDesigner
	{
		private ChartControl userChart;

		private IModelItem chartModelItem;

		private ChartControl designerChart;

		private Window designerWindow;

		private IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider;

		internal ChartControl UserChart => userChart;

		internal ChartControl DesignerChart => designerChart;

		internal bool IsDesignTime => chartModelItem != null;

		internal IModelItem ChartModelItem => chartModelItem;

		internal IDesignTimeProvider DesignTimeProvider => designTimeProvider;

		internal ChartDesigner(ChartControl chartControl, IModelItem chartModelItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
			: this(chartControl)
		{
			this.chartModelItem = chartModelItem;
			this.designTimeProvider = designTimeProvider;
		}

		public ChartDesigner(ChartControl chartControl)
		{
			userChart = chartControl;
		}

		private void AssignDataSource(ChartControl chartToAssign)
		{
			chartToAssign.DataSource = userChart.DataSource;
			Diagram diagram = userChart.Diagram;
			Diagram diagram2 = chartToAssign.Diagram;
			if (diagram2 == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				if (diagram2.Series.Count == diagram.Series.Count)
				{
					for (int i = 0; i < diagram.Series.Count; i++)
					{
						diagram2.Series[i].DataSource = diagram.Series[i].DataSource;
						diagram2.Series[i].Style = diagram.Series[i].Style;
					}
				}
				if (diagram.SeriesTemplate != null && diagram2.SeriesTemplate != null)
				{
					diagram2.SeriesTemplate.Style = diagram.SeriesTemplate.Style;
				}
			}
			if (diagram2.SeriesTemplate == null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(diagram2.SeriesDataMember))
			{
				diagram2.SeriesDataMember = string.Empty;
			}
		}

		private void AssignChart(out ChartControl chartToAssign, bool setIsInDesigner = false)
		{
			using MemoryStream memoryStream = new MemoryStream();
			userChart.SaveToStream(memoryStream);
			memoryStream.Position = 0L;
			chartToAssign = new ChartControl();
			if (setIsInDesigner)
			{
				ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.SetIsInDesigner(chartToAssign);
			}
			chartToAssign.LoadFromStream(memoryStream);
			AssignDataSource(chartToAssign);
			ThemeTreeWalker treeWalker = ThemeManager.GetTreeWalker((DependencyObject)userChart);
			if (treeWalker == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string themeName = treeWalker.ThemeName;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(themeName))
			{
				Theme val = Theme.FindTheme(themeName);
				if (val != null)
				{
					ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)chartToAssign, val);
				}
			}
		}

		internal void PrepareChart()
		{
			AssignChart(out designerChart, setIsInDesigner: true);
		}

		[SecurityCritical]
		internal void DesignTimeShow(Theme theme)
		{
			PrepareChart();
			designerWindow = (Window)(object)new ChartDesignerWindow(this, designTime: true, theme);
			designTimeProvider.ShowDialog(designerWindow);
			((IDesignerWindow)designerWindow).SaveLayoutToRegistry();
		}

		public bool? Show(Window owner, Theme theme = null, DesignerWindowKind windowKind = DesignerWindowKind.Bar)
		{
			PrepareChart();
			switch (windowKind)
			{
			case DesignerWindowKind.Bar:
				designerWindow = (Window)(object)new ChartDesignerWindow(this, designTime: false, theme);
				break;
			case DesignerWindowKind.Ribbon:
				designerWindow = (Window)(object)new ChartDesignerRibbonWindow(this, designTime: false, theme);
				break;
			}
			designerWindow.Owner = owner;
			bool? result = designerWindow.ShowDialog();
			((IDesignerWindow)designerWindow).SaveLayoutToRegistry();
			return result;
		}

		public void Close()
		{
			designerWindow.Close();
		}

		public string NetDesignTimeShow(string designerData, Func<Window, bool?> showDialog = null)
		{
			FillChartForDesigner();
			FillChartForSerialization(out var chart);
			InitializeDesigner(chart, designerData, showDialog);
			return SerializeDesignerResult(ShowDesigner(), chart);
		}

		private void FillChartForDesigner()
		{
			PrepareChart();
		}

		private void FillChartForSerialization(out ChartControl chart)
		{
			AssignChart(out chart);
			NetDesignTimeSerializationPreparer.CreateSerializeHelper = (object x, bool y) => (NetDesignTimeSerializeHelper)(object)new ChartSerializeHelper(x, y);
			NetDesignTimeSerializationPreparer.SetAdditionalPropertiesForSerialization((object)userChart, (object)chart);
		}

		private void InitializeDesigner(ChartControl chartForSerialization, string designerData, Func<Window, bool?> showDialog = null)
		{
			chartModelItem = (IModelItem)(object)new ChartModelItem((EditingContextBase)(object)new ChartEditingContext(chartForSerialization), chartForSerialization, null);
			designTimeProvider = new ChartDesignTimeProvider(showDialog);
			NetDesignerData val = NetDesignerData.ProcessDesignerData(designerData);
			Theme existingTheme = DesignTimeThemeHelper.GetExistingTheme((DependencyObject)userChart);
			designerWindow = (Window)(object)new ChartDesignerWindow(this, designTime: false, existingTheme);
			DesignTimeDialogHelper.SetWindowOwner(designerWindow, val.ProcessID);
		}

		private bool? ShowDesigner()
		{
			bool? result = designTimeProvider.ShowDialog(designerWindow);
			((IDesignerWindow)designerWindow).SaveLayoutToRegistry();
			return result;
		}

		private string SerializeDesignerResult(bool? showDialogResult, ChartControl chartForSerialization)
		{
			if (!(NetDesignTimeSerializationHelper.Serializer is ChartXmlSerializer))
			{
				NetDesignTimeSerializationHelper.Serializer = (NetDesignTimeSerializer)(object)new ChartXmlSerializer();
			}
			return NetDesignTimeSerializationHelper.Serialize(showDialogResult, (object)chartForSerialization, (string)null);
		}
	}

	public class AddIndicatorCommand : ChartObjectCommandBase
	{
		public AddIndicatorCommand(ChartControl chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter is Type || parameter is Indicator)
			{
				return base.ChartControl.Commands.ActiveSeries is XYSeries2D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			Indicator indicator = null;
			if (parameter is Type)
			{
				indicator = Activator.CreateInstance(parameter as Type) as Indicator;
			}
			else if (parameter is Indicator)
			{
				indicator = parameter as Indicator;
			}
			PropertyGridPopupWindow propertyGridPopupWindow = new PropertyGridPopupWindow(indicator, ThemeManager.GetTheme((DependencyObject)base.ChartControl));
			if (((ThemedWindow)propertyGridPopupWindow).ShowDialog() == true)
			{
				ChartCommandHelper.AddAnimatedIndicator(base.ChartControl, base.ChartControl.Commands.ActiveSeries as XYSeries2D, indicator);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ShowElementPropertiesCommand : ChartObjectCommandBase
	{
		private const double hitTestRadius = 2.0;

		public ShowElementPropertiesCommand(ChartControl chart)
			: base(chart)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(parameter is ChartElement))
			{
				return parameter is Point;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			ChartElement chartElement = parameter as ChartElement;
			if (chartElement == null && parameter is Point)
			{
				ChartHitInfo hitInfo = base.ChartControl.CalcHitInfo((Point)parameter, 2.0);
				chartElement = HitTestingHelper.GetSelectedObject(hitInfo) as ChartElement;
			}
			if (chartElement != null)
			{
				ChartElement chartElement2 = Activator.CreateInstance(chartElement.GetType()) as ChartElement;
				ChartCommandHelper.CopyProperties(chartElement2, chartElement);
				PropertyGridPopupWindow propertyGridPopupWindow = new PropertyGridPopupWindow(chartElement2, ThemeManager.GetTheme((DependencyObject)base.ChartControl));
				if (((ThemedWindow)propertyGridPopupWindow).ShowDialog() == true)
				{
					ChartCommandHelper.CopyProperties(chartElement, chartElement2);
				}
			}
		}
	}

		public ChartDesignerWindow(ChartDesigner designer, bool designTime, Theme forceTheme)
		{
			this.designer = designer;
			InitializeComponent();
			layout = new DesignerWindowLayout();
			InitializeFormByLayout();
			ChartModel = new WpfChartModel(designer.DesignerChart, commandManager, DesignerBehavior.Bar);
			ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			designerViewModel = new DesignerViewModelBar(ChartModel, this);
			((FrameworkElement)this).DataContext = designerViewModel;
			DesignerProperties.SetIsInDesignMode(gridSeriesData, value: false);
			DesignerProperties.SetIsInDesignMode(chartStructureTree, value: false);
			if (forceTheme == null)
			{
				if (designTime)
				{
					try
					{
						ActualTheme = defaultTheme;
						ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, ActualTheme);
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						ChartDebug.WriteWarning("Unable to set the MetropolisLight theme. Exception occurred: " + ex.Message);
						return;
					}
				}
				try
				{
					ActualTheme = ThemeManager.GetTheme((DependencyObject)designer.UserChart);
					ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, ActualTheme);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ActualTheme = forceTheme;
			ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, ActualTheme);
		}

		private void InitializeFormByLayout()
		{
			if (layout.Size != Size.Empty)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)this).Width = layout.Size.Width;
				((FrameworkElement)this).Height = layout.Size.Height;
			}
			((Window)this).WindowState = (layout.Maximized ? WindowState.Maximized : WindowState.Normal);
		}

		private void ChartDesignerWindowClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (commandManager.Commands.Count != 0 && showSaveDialog)
			{
				string text = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartDesignerWindowTitle);
				string text2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SaveAndExitWindowText);
				MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult = CompatibilityMessageBox.Show((FrameworkElement)(object)this, text2, text, MessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel);
				if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
				{
					ChartDesignerHelper.ApplyCommands(designer, commandManager, shouldClearCommands: false);
					((Window)this).DialogResult = true;
				}
				e.Cancel = messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Cancel;
			}
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				layout.Size = ((Window)this).RestoreBounds.Size;
				designerViewModel.CleanUp();
			}
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{

			((Window)this).Close();
		}

		private void btnSaveAndExit_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool value = false;
			if (commandManager.Commands.Count > 0)
			{
				value = true;
			}
			ChartDesignerHelper.ApplyCommands(designer, commandManager, shouldClearCommands: true);
			if (setDialogResult)
			{
				((Window)this).DialogResult = value;
			}
			((Window)this).Close();
		}

					val2.IsChecked = (int)((ICalculatedField)platformInstance).FieldType == (int)value;
					((BarItem)val2).Command = new SetCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand(ChartModel, (ChartCalculatedField)platformInstance);
					((BarItem)val2).CommandParameter = new PropertyGridCommandParameter("FieldType", value, null);
					((Collection<IBarItem>)(object)items).Add((IBarItem)(object)val2);
				}
				((Collection<IBarManagerControllerAction>)(object)e.Customizations).Add((IBarManagerControllerAction)(object)val);
			}
		}

	public abstract class ChartElementCollectionModelBase : ChartModelElement
	{
		public delegate void ChartCollectionUpdateEvent(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args);

		private readonly ObservableCollection<ChartModelElement> modelCollection;

		private int nameIndexer;

		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => modelCollection;

		public IList<ChartModelElement> ModelCollection => modelCollection;

		public event ChartCollectionUpdateEvent CollectionUpdated;

		public ChartElementCollectionModelBase(ChartModelElement parent, object chartElement)
			: base(parent, chartElement)
		{
			modelCollection = new ObservableCollection<ChartModelElement>();
			nameIndexer = 0;
		}

		protected abstract ChartModelElement CreateModel(object chartElement, int index);

		protected virtual IEnumerable<object> GetSourceObjects()
		{
			return (IEnumerable<object>)base.ChartElement;
		}

		protected string GetNameIndexer()
		{
			int num = ++nameIndexer;
			return num.ToString();
		}

		protected void OnCollectionUpdated(IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> removedItems, IEnumerable<InsertedItem> addedItems)
		{
			if (this.CollectionUpdated != null)
			{
				this.CollectionUpdated(new ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs(this, removedItems, addedItems));
			}
		}

		[SkipOnPropertyChangedMethodCall]
		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			List<ChartModelElement> list = new List<ChartModelElement>(modelCollection);
			List<InsertedItem> list2 = new List<InsertedItem>();
			IEnumerable<object> sourceObjects = GetSourceObjects();
			int num = 0;
			foreach (object item in sourceObjects)
			{
				ChartModelElement chartModelElement = PerformChildSearch(item);
				if (chartModelElement == null)
				{
					ChartModelElement chartModelElement2 = CreateModel(item, num);
					if (chartModelElement2 != null)
					{
						list2.Add(new InsertedItem(num, chartModelElement2));
					}
				}
				else
				{
					list.Remove(chartModelElement);
				}
				num++;
			}
			foreach (ChartModelElement item2 in list)
			{
				modelCollection.Remove(item2);
			}
			foreach (InsertedItem item3 in list2)
			{
				modelCollection.Insert(item3.Index, item3.Item);
			}
			if (list.Count > 0 || list2.Count > 0)
			{
				OnCollectionUpdated(list, list2);
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Children");
		}

		public int IndexOf(ChartModelElement childElement)
		{
			return modelCollection.IndexOf(childElement);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ChartModelElement : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		private readonly object chartElement;

		private readonly ChartModelElement parent;

		private PropertyGridModelBase propertyGridModel;

		public object ChartElement => chartElement;

		public abstract IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children { get; }

		public ChartModelElement Parent => parent;

		public PropertyGridModelBase PropertyGridModel
		{
			get
			{
				return propertyGridModel;
			}
			protected set
			{
				if (propertyGridModel != value)
				{
					propertyGridModel = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("PropertyGridModel");
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartModelElement Root
		{
			get
			{
				if (parent == null)
				{
					return this;
				}
				return parent.Root;
			}
		}

		public virtual ChartModelElement SelectionOverride => this;

		public ChartModelElement(ChartModelElement parent, object chartElement)
		{
			this.chartElement = chartElement;
			this.parent = parent;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateChildren()
		{
		}

		protected void WriteUnsupportedPropertySetWarning(string propertyName, string className)
		{
			ChartDebug.Fail("Attempt to set unsupported property: '" + propertyName + "' in a class: '" + className + "'.");
		}

		protected string GetDataMemberName(object dataSource, string dataMember)
		{
			//IL_0000: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0006: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataContext val = new DataContext();
			try
			{
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember))
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return val.GetDataMemberDisplayName(dataSource, string.Empty, dataMember);
			}
			finally
			{
				((DataContextBase)val).Dispose();
			}
		}

		public T GetParent<T>() where T : ChartModelElement
		{
			for (ChartModelElement chartModelElement = Parent; chartModelElement != null; chartModelElement = chartModelElement.Parent)
			{
				if (chartModelElement is T)
				{
					return (T)chartModelElement;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public ChartModelElement PerformChildSearch(object chartElement)
		{
			ChartModelElement result = null;
			if (chartElement != null)
			{
				foreach (ChartModelElement child in Children)
				{
					if (child.chartElement == chartElement)
					{
						result = child;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		public ChartModelElement PerformFullSearch(object chartElement)
		{
			if (chartElement != null)
			{
				if (this.chartElement == chartElement)
				{
					return this;
				}
				ChartModelElement chartModelElement = null;
				if (Children != null)
				{
					foreach (ChartModelElement child in Children)
					{
						if (child != null)
						{
							chartModelElement = child.PerformFullSearch(chartElement);
							if (chartModelElement != null)
							{
								break;
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return chartModelElement;
			}
			return null;
		}

		public void RecursivelyUpdateChildren()
		{
			UpdateChildren();
			if (Children == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ChartModelElement child in Children)
			{
				child?.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			}
		}

		public void InvalidatePropertyGridModel()
		{
			if (propertyGridModel != null)
			{
				propertyGridModel.Update();
				PropertyGridModelBase propertyGridModelBase = PropertyGridModel;
				PropertyGridModel = null;
				PropertyGridModel = propertyGridModelBase;
			}
		}

		public void UpdatePropertyGridModel(PropertyGridModelBase propertyGridModel)
		{
			this.propertyGridModel = propertyGridModel;
		}

		public object GetChartElementProperty(string propertyName)
		{
			return string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyName) ? ChartElement : CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(ChartElement, propertyName);
		}

		public object SetChartElementProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			object objectProperty = CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(ChartElement, propertyName);
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(ChartElement, propertyName, value);
			return objectProperty;
		}
	}

		public IEnumerable<BarItemViewModelBase> CreateToolBarModels(ChartDesignerWindow window)
		{
			List<BarItemViewModelBase> list = new List<BarItemViewModelBase>();
			BarSplitButtonItemViewModel barSplitButtonItemViewModel = new BarSplitButtonItemViewModel
			{
				Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AddChartElement),
				SmallGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetBarGlyphByPath("ToolBarImages/Add")
			};
			List<BarItemMenuHeaderViewModel> list2 = CreateAddElementsMenuModels(window);
			foreach (BarItemMenuHeaderViewModel item in list2)
			{
				barSplitButtonItemViewModel.Items.Add(item);
			}
			list.Add(barSplitButtonItemViewModel);
			list.Add(new BarButtonItemViewModel(new OpenChangeChartTypeDialogCommand(this, window))
			{
				Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChangeChartType),
				SmallGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetBarGlyphByPath("ToolBarImages/ChangeChartSeriesType"),
				IsEnabled = true
			});
			list.Add(new BarButtonItemViewModel(new UndoCommand(this))
			{
				Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Undo),
				SmallGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetBarGlyphByPath("ToolBarImages/Undo"),
				KeyGesture = new KeyGesture(Key.Z, ModifierKeys.Control)
			});
			list.Add(new BarButtonItemViewModel(new RedoCommand(this))
			{
				Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Redo),
				SmallGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetBarGlyphByPath("ToolBarImages/Redo"),
				KeyGesture = new KeyGesture(Key.Y, ModifierKeys.Control)
			});
			return list;
		}

		private void CreateButtons_AxisInterlaced(RibbonPageGroupViewModel pageGroup)
		{
			BarCheckButtonViewModel item = new BarCheckButtonViewModel(new AxisX2DInterlacedCommand(this), this, "SelectedModel", new AxisOptionsConverter(), new HideBehavior());
			pageGroup.BarItems.Add(item);
			BarCheckButtonViewModel item2 = new BarCheckButtonViewModel(new AxisY2DInterlacedCommand(this), this, "SelectedModel", new AxisOptionsConverter(), new HideBehavior());
			pageGroup.BarItems.Add(item2);
			BarCheckButtonViewModel item3 = new BarCheckButtonViewModel(new AxisX3DInterlacedCommand(this), this, "SelectedModel", new AxisOptionsConverter(), new HideBehavior());
			pageGroup.BarItems.Add(item3);

		private RibbonPageViewModel CreateConstantLineRibbonPageModel()
		{
			RibbonPageViewModel ribbonPageViewModel = new RibbonPageViewModel(this, "ConstantLineOptionsPage");
			ribbonPageViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ConstantLinePageCategoryTitle);
			RibbonPageGroupViewModel ribbonPageGroupViewModel = new RibbonPageGroupViewModel();
			ribbonPageViewModel.Groups.Add(ribbonPageGroupViewModel);
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ConstantLine_GeneralGroupTitle);
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateTextEditor_Value());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateTextEditor_Thickness());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateTextEditor_ConstantLineLegendText());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateColorEditor_ConstantLineColor());
			RibbonPageGroupViewModel ribbonPageGroupViewModel2 = new RibbonPageGroupViewModel();
			ribbonPageViewModel.Groups.Add(ribbonPageGroupViewModel2);
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel2.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ConstantLine_TitleGroupTitle);
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel2.BarItems.Add(CreateConstantLineTitleGallery());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel2.BarItems.Add(new BarStaticTextViewModel(ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ConstantLine_TitleText)));
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel2.BarItems.Add(CreateTextEditor_ConstantLineTitleText());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel2.BarItems.Add(CreateColorEditor_ConstantLineTitleForeground());
			ConstantLineTitleFontFamilyCommand familyCommand = new ConstantLineTitleFontFamilyCommand(this);
			ConstantLineTitleFontSizeCommand sizeCommand = new ConstantLineTitleFontSizeCommand(this);
			ConstantLineTitleFontBoldCommand boldCommand = new ConstantLineTitleFontBoldCommand(this);
			ConstantLineTitleFontItalicCommand italicCommand = new ConstantLineTitleFontItalicCommand(this);
			RibbonPageGroupViewModel item = CreateFontGroup("SelectedModel", familyCommand, sizeCommand, boldCommand, italicCommand);
			ribbonPageViewModel.Groups.Add(item);
			return ribbonPageViewModel;
		}

		private void FillPaletteInRibbonGallery(InRibbonGalleryViewModel inRibbonGalleryPalette)
		{
			Size colorElementSize = new Size(32.0, 54.0);
			GalleryGroupViewModel galleryGroupViewModel = new GalleryGroupViewModel();
			inRibbonGalleryPalette.Groups.Add(galleryGroupViewModel);
			IEnumerable<PaletteImage> enumerable = PaletteUtils.GeneratePaletteImages(3.0, colorElementSize);
			foreach (PaletteImage item in enumerable)
			{
				BarButtonViewModel barButtonViewModel = new BarButtonViewModel(new ChangeChartPaletteCommand(this, item.Palette));
				barButtonViewModel.Caption = item.Palette.PaletteName;
				barButtonViewModel.LargeGlyph = item.Image;
				galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(barButtonViewModel);
			}
		}

		private RibbonItemViewModelBase CreateLegendPositionGalleryDropDownButton(string caption, string glyphName)
		{
			BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel = new BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel();
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.Caption = caption;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.ImageName = "BarItemImages/" + glyphName;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.InitialVisibleColCount = 5;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.InitialVisibleRowCount = 5;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.ItemCheckMode = (GalleryItemCheckMode)1;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.AllowToolTips = false;
			GalleryGroupViewModel galleryGroupViewModel = new GalleryGroupViewModel();
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.Groups.Add(galleryGroupViewModel);
			for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
			{
				VerticalPosition vertPos = (VerticalPosition)i;
				for (int j = 0; j < 5; j++)
				{
					HorizontalPosition horizPos = (HorizontalPosition)j;
					ChartCommandBase command = new ChangeLegendPositionCommand(this, horizPos, vertPos);
					BarEditValueItemViewModel item = new BarEditValueItemViewModel(command, this, "SelectedModel", new LegendPositionToBoolConverter());
					galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(item);
				}
			}
			return barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel;
		}

		public WpfChartModel(ChartControl chart, CommandManager commandManager, DesignerBehavior behavior)
			: base(null, chart)
		{
			SelectedObject = chart;
			this.commandManager = commandManager;
			designerBehavior = behavior;
			dataEditorPointCollectionModel = new ChartDataEditorPointCollectionModel(this);
			titleCollectionModel = new WpfChartTitleCollectionModel(this, chart.Titles);
			annotationCollectionModel = new WpfChartAnnotationCollectionModel(this, chart.Annotations);
			legendCollectionModel = new WpfChartLegendCollectionModel(this, chart.Legends);
			deleteCommand = new RemoveElementCommand(this);
			predefinedDataSource = chart.DataSource;
			base.PropertyGridModel = new WpfChartPropertyGridModel(this);
			legendDockTargets = new ObservableCollection<ChartModelElement>();
		}

		[SkipOnPropertyChangedMethodCall]
		private void UpdateRibbonBindings()
		{
			string[] array = new string[2] { "DiagramModel", "SelectedModel" };
			string[] array2 = array;
			foreach (string propertyName in array2)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
			}
		}

		private void OnSelectedModelChanged()
		{
			if (selectedModel is WpfChartIndicatorModel)
			{
				SelectedIndicatorAcceptedValueLevels = ((WpfChartIndicatorModel)selectedModel).ValueLevels;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLegendDockTargets()
		{
			legendDockTargets.Clear();
			legendDockTargets.Add(this);
			if (DiagramModel == null || DiagramModel.AllPanes == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ChartModelElement allPane in DiagramModel.AllPanes)
			{
				legendDockTargets.Add(allPane);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			if (TitleCollectionModel == null)
			{
				TitleCollectionModel = new WpfChartTitleCollectionModel(this, Chart.Titles);
			}
			if (AnnotationCollectionModel == null)
			{
				AnnotationCollectionModel = new WpfChartAnnotationCollectionModel(this, Chart.Annotations);
			}
			if (LegendCollectionModel == null)
			{
				LegendCollectionModel = new WpfChartLegendCollectionModel(this, Chart.Legends);
			}
			if (Chart.Diagram == null)
			{
				DiagramModel = null;
			}
			else if ((DiagramModel != null && DiagramModel.Diagram != Chart.Diagram) || (DiagramModel == null && Chart.Diagram != null))
			{
				DiagramModel = new WpfChartDiagramModel(this, Chart.Diagram);
				UpdateLegendDockTargets();
			}
		}

		public IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryViewModel> CreateCategoryModels()
		{
			categories.Add(CreateDefaultCategoryModel());
			categories.Add(CreateSeriesCategoryModel());
			categories.Add(CreateAxisCategoryModel());
			categories.Add(CreateLegendCategoryModel());
			categories.Add(CreateChartTitleCategoryModel());
			categories.Add(CreateSeriesTitleCategoryModel());
			categories.Add(CreateConstantLineCategoryViewModel());
			categories.Add(CreateStripOptionsCategory());
			categories.Add(CreateScaleBreakOptionsCategory());
			categories.Add(CreateIndicatorOptionsCategory());
			categories.Add(CreateAnnotationCategoryModel());
			return categories;
		}

		public void DeleteSelectedObject()
		{
			DeleteCommand.Execute(SelectedObject);
		}

		public void RegisterCommand(ChartCommandBase command)
		{
			commandsRepository.Add(command);
		}

		public void RegisterToolBarCommand(ToolBarCommandBase command)
		{
			toolBarCommandsRepository.Add(command);
		}

		public void UpdateCommandsCanExecute()
		{
			foreach (ChartCommandBase item in commandsRepository)
			{
				item.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
			foreach (ToolBarCommandBase item2 in toolBarCommandsRepository)
			{
				item2.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
			}
		}

		public void UpdateModelProperties()
		{
			UpdateRibbonBindings();
			UpdateLegendDockTargets();
			if (SelectedModel != null)
			{
				SelectedModel.InvalidatePropertyGridModel();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.TreeChart);
		}

		private RibbonPageCategoryViewModel CreateScaleBreakOptionsCategory()
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryViewModel ribbonPageCategoryViewModel = new RibbonPageCategoryViewModel(this, typeof(WpfChartScaleBreakModel));
			ribbonPageCategoryViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ScaleBreak_CategoryCaption);
			RibbonPageViewModel ribbonPageViewModel = new RibbonPageViewModel(this, "ScaleBreakOptionsPage");
			ribbonPageViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ScaleBreak_PageCaption);
			ribbonPageCategoryViewModel.Pages.Add(ribbonPageViewModel);
			RibbonPageGroupViewModel ribbonPageGroupViewModel = new RibbonPageGroupViewModel();
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ScaleBreak_GeneralGroupCaption);
			ribbonPageViewModel.Groups.Add(ribbonPageGroupViewModel);
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateTextEditor_Edge1());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateTextEditor_Edge2());
			return ribbonPageCategoryViewModel;
		}

		private SetSeriesPropertyCommand setSeriesPropertyCommand;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setSeriesPropertyCommand;

		protected internal SidePoint SidePoint { get; }

		[Category("Presentation")]
		public SidePointDisplayMode LabelDisplayMode
		{
			get
			{
				return SidePoint.LabelDisplayMode;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("LabelDisplayMode", value);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public WpfChartSeriesLabelPropertyGridModel Label
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesLabel;
			}
			set
			{
				SeriesLabel value2 = ((value != null) ? new SeriesLabel() : null);
				SetProperty("Label", value2);
			}

		}

		public WpfChartSidePointPropertyGridModel(WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel, WpfChartXYSeries2DPropertyGridModel seriesPropertyGridModel, SidePoint sidePoint, string propertyPath)
			: base(seriesModel, propertyPath)
		{
			this.seriesPropertyGridModel = seriesPropertyGridModel;
			this.propertyPath = propertyPath;
			SidePoint = sidePoint;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (SidePoint != null && SidePoint.Label != null)

				if (seriesLabel == null || SidePoint.Label != seriesLabel.Label)
				{
					seriesLabel = seriesPropertyGridModel.CreateSeriesLabelModel(SidePoint.Label, propertyPath);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				seriesLabel = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setSeriesPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

	public class CreateWorkdaysOptionsCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public CreateWorkdaysOptionsCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(base.PreviewChart, historyItem);
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis = AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axis);
			dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis.WorkdaysOptions = new WorkdaysOptions();
			return axis;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(base.PreviewChart, historyItem);
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis = AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axis);
			dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis.WorkdaysOptions = null;
			return axis;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(chartControl, historyItem);
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis = AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axis);
			dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis.WorkdaysOptions = new WorkdaysOptions();
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			AxisBase axis = base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis = AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axis);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(newValue: dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis.WorkdaysOptions = new WorkdaysOptions(), executeCommandInfo: new ExecuteCommandInfo(null, new ElementIndexItem("Axis", base.SelectedAxisModel.GetSelfIndex())), command: this, targetObject: axis, oldValue: null), axis);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["DateTimeScaleOptions"].Value.Properties["WorkdaysOptions"].SetValue((object)new WorkdaysOptions());
		}
	}
	public abstract class DateTimeCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		protected const string oldValueIndexKey = "OldItem";

		protected const string newValueIndexKey = "NewItem";

		private WpfChartAxisModel axisModel;

		protected WpfChartAxisModel AxisModel => axisModel;

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		protected abstract string CollectionName { get; }

		public DateTimeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.axisModel = axisModel;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				return axisModel != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerable<DateTime> GetCollection(AxisBase axis);

		protected abstract void SetCollection(AxisBase axis, IEnumerable<DateTime> collection);

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(base.PreviewChart, historyItem);
			SetCollection(axis, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)historyItem.OldValue);
			return axis;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(base.PreviewChart, historyItem);
			SetCollection(axis, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)historyItem.NewValue);
			return axis;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(chartControl, historyItem);
			SetCollection(axis, (IEnumerable<DateTime>)historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["DateTimeScaleOptions"].Value.Properties["WorkdaysOptions"].Value.Properties[CollectionName].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AddDateTimeCommand : DateTimeCommand
	{
		public AddDateTimeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(chartModel, axisModel)
		{
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel selectedAxisModel = base.SelectedAxisModel;
			AxisBase axis = selectedAxisModel.Axis;
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection = new DateTimeCollection();
			if (GetCollection(axis) != null)
			{
				foreach (DateTime item in GetCollection(axis))
				{
					dateTimeCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection2 = new DateTimeCollection(dateTimeCollection);
			dateTimeCollection2.Add((DateTime)parameter);
			SetCollection(axis, dateTimeCollection2);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(null, new ElementIndexItem("Axis", base.AxisModel.GetSelfIndex())), this, axis, dateTimeCollection, dateTimeCollection2));
		}
	}
	public abstract class RemoveDateTimeCommand : DateTimeCommand
	{
		public RemoveDateTimeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(chartModel, axisModel)
		{
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			AxisBase axis = base.AxisModel.Axis;
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection = new DateTimeCollection();
			if (GetCollection(axis) != null)
			{
				foreach (DateTime item in GetCollection(axis))
				{
					dateTimeCollection.Add(item);
				}
			}
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection2 = new DateTimeCollection(dateTimeCollection);
			dateTimeCollection2.Remove((DateTime)parameter);
			SetCollection(axis, dateTimeCollection2);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(null, new ElementIndexItem("Axis", base.AxisModel.GetSelfIndex())), this, axis, dateTimeCollection, dateTimeCollection2), axis);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ReplaceDateTimeCommand : DateTimeCommand
	{
		public ReplaceDateTimeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(chartModel, axisModel)
		{
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			List<DateTime> list = parameter as List<DateTime>;
			DateTime item = list[0];
			DateTime value = list[1];
			AxisBase axis = base.AxisModel.Axis;
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection = new DateTimeCollection();
			if (GetCollection(axis) != null)
			{
				foreach (DateTime item2 in GetCollection(axis))
				{
					dateTimeCollection.Add(item2);
				}
			}
			DateTimeCollection dateTimeCollection2 = new DateTimeCollection(dateTimeCollection);
			dateTimeCollection2[dateTimeCollection2.IndexOf(item)] = value;
			SetCollection(axis, dateTimeCollection2);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(null, new ElementIndexItem("Axis", base.AxisModel.GetSelfIndex())), this, axis, dateTimeCollection, dateTimeCollection2), axis);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisKindCommandBase : AxisConditionalCommandBase
	{
		protected abstract Type AxisType { get; }

		protected virtual AxisAlignment AxisAlignment => base.SelectedAxisModel.Alignment;

		protected virtual bool AxisVisibility => true;

		public AxisKindCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool AxisTypeMatchCommandType(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (!(axisModel.Axis.GetType() == AxisType))
			{
				return axisModel.Axis.GetType().IsSubclassOf(AxisType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsAxisAtCommandState(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (AxisTypeMatchCommandType(axisModel) && axisModel.IsVisible == AxisVisibility)
			{
				return axisModel.Alignment == AxisAlignment;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter is bool && (bool)parameter)
			{
				CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible != AxisVisibility)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult = new ToggleAxisVisibilityCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(AxisVisibility);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				}
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Alignment != AxisAlignment)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult2 = new ChangeAxisAlignmentCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(AxisAlignment);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
				}
				AxisBase axis = base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, axis);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisLabelOrientationCommandBase : AxisConditionalCommandBase
	{
		protected virtual int LabelAngle => base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Angle;

		protected virtual bool LabelStaggered => base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Staggered;

		protected virtual bool LabelVisibility => true;

		public AxisLabelOrientationCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter) && base.SelectedAxisModel != null)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsAxisAtCommandState(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (AxisTypeMatchCommandType(axisModel) && axisModel.Label.Visible == LabelVisibility && axisModel.Label.Staggered == LabelStaggered)
			{
				return axisModel.Label.Angle == LabelAngle;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter is bool && (bool)parameter)
			{
				CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Visible != LabelVisibility)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult = new ToggleAxisLabelsVisibilityCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(LabelVisibility);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				}
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Staggered != LabelStaggered)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult2 = new ToggleAxisLabelsStaggeredCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(LabelStaggered);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
				}
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Angle != LabelAngle)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult3 = new SetAxisLabelAngleCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(LabelAngle);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult3.HistoryItem);
				}
				AxisBase axis = base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, axis);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class AddAxisLabelCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddAxisLabelCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private void SetAxisLabelValue(HistoryItem historyItem, ChartControl chart, AxisLabel value)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Label = value;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Label = value;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisX2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(AxisLabel));
			axisModelItem.Properties["Label"].SetValue((object)value);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelValue(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (AxisLabel)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelValue(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, null);
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelValue(historyItem, chartControl, new AxisLabel());
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			int num = CreateAxisIfNeeded(compositeHistoryItem);
			AxisBase axis = base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
			axis.Label = new AxisLabel();
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, axis, null, axis.Label));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, axis);
		}
	}
	public class ToggleAxisLabelsVisibilityCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ToggleAxisLabelsVisibilityCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private void SetAxisLabelVisibility(HistoryItem historyItem, ChartControl chart, bool value)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Label.Visible = value;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Label.Visible = value;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisX2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Visible = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Visible = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null && base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.Label != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Label"].Value.Properties["Visible"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelVisibility(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (bool)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelVisibility(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (bool)historyItem.OldValue);
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelVisibility(historyItem, chartControl, (bool)historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis.Label == null)
			{
				AddAxisLabelCommand addAxisLabelCommand = new AddAxisLabelCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = addAxisLabelCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			else if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Visible = (bool)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, !(bool)parameter, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}
	public class ToggleAxisLabelsStaggeredCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ToggleAxisLabelsStaggeredCommand(WpfChartModel model)

			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null && base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible && base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is Axis && base.SelectedAxisModel.Label != null)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Visible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelStaggered(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (bool)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelStaggered(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (bool)historyItem.OldValue);
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Label"].Value.Properties["Staggered"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelStaggered(historyItem, chartControl, (bool)historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis.Label == null)
			{
				AddAxisLabelCommand addAxisLabelCommand = new AddAxisLabelCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(addAxisLabelCommand.RuntimeExecute(null).HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			else if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Staggered = (bool)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, !(bool)parameter, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}
	public class SetAxisLabelAngleCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public SetAxisLabelAngleCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private void SetAxisLabelAngle(HistoryItem historyItem, ChartControl chart, int value)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Label.Angle = value;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Label.Angle = value;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisX2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX.Label.Angle = value;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY.Label.Angle = value;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null && base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible && base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is Axis && base.SelectedAxisModel.Label != null)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Visible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelAngle(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (int)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelAngle(historyItem, base.PreviewChart, (int)historyItem.OldValue);
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Label"].Value.Properties["Angle"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisLabelAngle(historyItem, chartControl, (int)historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis.Label == null)
			{
				AddAxisLabelCommand addAxisLabelCommand = new AddAxisLabelCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(addAxisLabelCommand.RuntimeExecute(null).HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			else if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			int angle = base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Angle;
			base.SelectedAxisModel.Label.Angle = (int)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, angle, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisRangeCommandBase : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public AxisRangeCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected CommandResult CreateWholeRangeIfNecessary(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			AxisBase axis = axisModel.Axis;
			CommandResult result = null;
			if ((axis is Axis && ((Axis)axis).WholeRange == null) || (axis is PolarAxisY2D && ((PolarAxisY2D)axis).WholeRange == null) || (axis is RadarAxisX2D && ((RadarAxisX2D)axis).WholeRange == null) || (axis is RadarAxisY2D && ((RadarAxisY2D)axis).WholeRange == null))
			{
				result = new CreateAxisWholeRangeCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(null);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected CommandResult CreateVisualRangeIfNecessary(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			AxisBase axis = axisModel.Axis;
			CommandResult result = null;
			if (axis is Axis2D && ((Axis2D)axis).VisualRange == null)
			{
				result = new CreateAxisVisualRangeCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(null);
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class CreateAxisWholeRangeCommand : AxisRangeCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public CreateAxisWholeRangeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private void SetRange(AxisBase axis, Range range)
		{
			if (axis is Axis)
			{
				((Axis)axis).WholeRange = range;
				return;
			}
			if (axis is PolarAxisY2D)
			{
				((PolarAxisY2D)axis).WholeRange = range;
				return;
			}
			if (axis is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				((RadarAxisX2D)axis).WholeRange = range;
				return;
			}
			if (axis is RadarAxisY2D)
			{
				((RadarAxisY2D)axis).WholeRange = range;
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException(axis.GetType().Name + " is unknown axis type, which contains Range.");
		}

		private Range GetVisibleRange(AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (axis is Axis)
			{
				return ((Axis)axis).WholeRange;
			}
			if (axis is PolarAxisY2D)
			{
				return ((PolarAxisY2D)axis).WholeRange;
			}
			if (axis is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				return ((RadarAxisX2D)axis).WholeRange;
			}
			if (axis is RadarAxisY2D)
			{
				return ((RadarAxisY2D)axis).WholeRange;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException(axis.GetType().Name + " is unknown axis type, which contains Range.");
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartAxisModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			AxisBase axis = wpfChartAxisModel.Axis;
			if (axis is Axis || axis is CircularAxisY2D || axis is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			object targetObject = historyItem.TargetObject;
			if (targetObject is Axis)
			{
				((Axis)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			else if (targetObject is PolarAxisY2D)
			{
				((PolarAxisY2D)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			else if (targetObject is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				((RadarAxisX2D)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			else if (targetObject is RadarAxisY2D)
			{
				((RadarAxisY2D)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			object targetObject = historyItem.TargetObject;
			if (targetObject is Axis)
			{
				((Axis)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.OldValue;
			}
			else if (targetObject is PolarAxisY2D)
			{
				((PolarAxisY2D)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.OldValue;
			}
			else if (targetObject is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				((RadarAxisX2D)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.OldValue;
			}
			else if (targetObject is RadarAxisY2D)
			{
				((RadarAxisY2D)targetObject).WholeRange = (Range)historyItem.OldValue;
			}
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(Range));
			axisModelItem.Properties["WholeRange"].SetValue((object)value);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			AxisBase axisBase = (AxisBase)historyItem.TargetObject;
			if (axisBase is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[index].WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[index].WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is AxisX2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is AxisY2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is AxisX3D)
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is AxisY3D)
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is PolarAxisY2D)
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase is RadarAxisY2D)
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException(historyItem.TargetObject.GetType().Name + " is unknown axis type with Range.");
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			CommandResult commandResult = CreateAxisIfNecessary();
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			AxisBase axis = wpfChartAxisModel.Axis;
			Range visibleRange = GetVisibleRange(axis);
			Range range = new Range();
			SetRange(axis, range);
			ElementIndexItem axisIndexItem = GetAxisIndexItem();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, axisIndexItem);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, axis, visibleRange, range);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}
	public class CreateAxisVisualRangeCommand : AxisRangeCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public CreateAxisVisualRangeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartAxisModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			AxisBase axis = wpfChartAxisModel.Axis;
			if (axis is Axis2D)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject).VisualRange = (Range)historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject).VisualRange = (Range)historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(Range));
			axisModelItem.Properties["VisualRange"].SetValue((object)value);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			AxisBase axisBase = (AxisBase)historyItem.TargetObject;
			if (axisBase.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.VisualRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.VisualRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[index].VisualRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			if (axisBase.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[index].VisualRange = new Range();
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException(historyItem.TargetObject.GetType().Name + " is unknown type with ScrollingRange.");
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			CommandResult commandResult = CreateAxisIfNecessary();
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)wpfChartAxisModel.Axis;
			Range visualRange = axis2D.VisualRange;
			Range newValue = (axis2D.VisualRange = new Range());
			ElementIndexItem axisIndexItem = GetAxisIndexItem();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, axisIndexItem);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, axis2D, visualRange, newValue);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}
	public class SetAxisVisualRangeMaxValueCommand : AxisRangeCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AxisOptions_VisibleRangeMaxValue);

		private readonly ScaleType scaleType;

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ScaleType ScaleType => scaleType;

		public SetAxisVisualRangeMaxValueCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, ScaleType scaleType)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.scaleType = scaleType;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartAxisModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			AxisBase axis = wpfChartAxisModel.Axis;
			if (!(axis is Axis2D))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (scaleType == wpfChartAxisModel.ScaleType)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			wpfChartAxisModel.VisualRangeMaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			wpfChartAxisModel.VisualRangeMaxValue = historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["VisualRange"].Value.Properties["MaxValue"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			AxisBase axis = ((WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject).Axis;
			if (axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[index].VisualRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[index].VisualRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis is AxisX2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.VisualRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis is AxisY2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.VisualRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException(historyItem.TargetObject.GetType().Name + " is unknown type with range.");
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			CommandResult commandResult = CreateVisualRangeIfNecessary((WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			object visualRangeMaxValue = wpfChartAxisModel.VisualRangeMaxValue;
			object newValue = (wpfChartAxisModel.VisualRangeMaxValue = parameter);
			ElementIndexItem axisIndexItem = GetAxisIndexItem();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, axisIndexItem);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, wpfChartAxisModel, visualRangeMaxValue, newValue);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}

	public class SetAxisWholeRangeMaxValueCommand : AxisRangeCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AxisOptions_WholeRangeMaxValue);

		private readonly ScaleType scaleType;

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ScaleType ScaleType => scaleType;

		public SetAxisWholeRangeMaxValueCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, ScaleType scaleType)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.scaleType = scaleType;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartAxisModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			AxisBase axis = wpfChartAxisModel.Axis;
			if (!(axis is Axis) && !(axis is CircularAxisY2D) && !(axis is RadarAxisX2D))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return scaleType == wpfChartAxisModel.ScaleType;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			wpfChartAxisModel.WholeRangeMaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			wpfChartAxisModel.WholeRangeMaxValue = historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["WholeRange"].Value.Properties["MaxValue"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			AxisBase axis = ((WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject).Axis;
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[index].WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[index].WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.WholeRange.MaxValue = historyItem.NewValue;
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException(historyItem.TargetObject.GetType().Name + " is unknown axis type with ScrollingRange.");
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			CommandResult commandResult = CreateWholeRangeIfNecessary((WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			object wholeRangeMaxValue = wpfChartAxisModel.WholeRangeMaxValue;
			object newValue = (wpfChartAxisModel.WholeRangeMaxValue = parameter);
			ElementIndexItem axisIndexItem = GetAxisIndexItem();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, axisIndexItem);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, wpfChartAxisModel, wholeRangeMaxValue, newValue);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisTitlePositionCommandBase : AxisConditionalCommandBase
	{
		protected virtual TitleAlignment TitleAlignment => base.SelectedAxisModel.Title.Alignment;

		protected virtual bool TitleVisibility => true;

		public AxisTitlePositionCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter) && base.SelectedAxisModel != null)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override bool IsAxisAtCommandState(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (AxisTypeMatchCommandType(axisModel) && axisModel.Title.Visible == TitleVisibility)
			{
				return axisModel.Title.Alignment == TitleAlignment;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter is bool && (bool)parameter)
			{
				CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Title.Visible != TitleVisibility)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult = new ToggleAxisTitleVisibilityCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(TitleVisibility);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				}
				if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Title.Alignment != TitleAlignment)
				{
					CommandResult commandResult2 = new ChangeAxisTitleAlignmentCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(TitleAlignment);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
				}
				AxisBase axis = base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, axis);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisXTitlePositionCommandBase : AxisTitlePositionCommandBase
	{
		public AxisXTitlePositionCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool AxisTypeMatchCommandType(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (!(base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is AxisX2D))
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is AxisX3D;
			}
			return true;
		}
	}
