	public class AddAxisTitleCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string defaultAxisTitleText = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DefaultAxisTitleText);

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddAxisTitleCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title = (AxisTitle)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title = (AxisTitle)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title = (AxisTitle)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title = (AxisTitle)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title = (AxisTitle)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title = (AxisTitle)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title = null;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title = null;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title = null;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title = null;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title = null;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title = null;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Title"].SetValue((object)new AxisTitle());
			axisModelItem.Properties["Title"].Value.Properties["Content"].SetValue((object)defaultAxisTitleText);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title = new AxisTitle
					{
						Content = defaultAxisTitleText
					};
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title = new AxisTitle
					{
						Content = defaultAxisTitleText
					};
				}
				return;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.Title = new AxisTitle
				{
					Content = defaultAxisTitleText
				};
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Title = new AxisTitle
				{
					Content = defaultAxisTitleText
				};
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.Title = new AxisTitle
				{
					Content = defaultAxisTitleText
				};
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Title = new AxisTitle
				{
					Content = defaultAxisTitleText
				};
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			int num = CreateAxisIfNeeded(compositeHistoryItem);
			Axis axis = (Axis)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
			axis.Title = new AxisTitle();
			axis.Title.Content = defaultAxisTitleText;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, axis, null, axis.Title));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}
	public class ToggleAxisTitleVisibilityCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AxisOptions_TitleVisibility);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ToggleAxisTitleVisibilityCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null && base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is Axis)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}

				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)

				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))

					((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title.Visible = !(bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;

					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX.Title.Visible = !(bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
				{
					((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY.Title.Visible = !(bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
			}
			return null;

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Title"].Value.Properties["Visible"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Title.Visible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (((Axis)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis).Title == null)
			{
				AddAxisTitleCommand addAxisTitleCommand = new AddAxisTitleCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = addAxisTitleCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			}
			int num = -1;
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			else if (base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				num = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
			}
			base.SelectedAxisModel.Title.Visible = (bool)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, null, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}

	public class AddCalculatedFieldCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public class ParameterInfo
		{
			public object DataSource { get; set; }

			public string DataMember { get; set; }
		}

		private const string calculatedFieldIndexKey = "CalculatedField";

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddCalculatedFieldCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.CalculatedFields.Remove((ChartCalculatedField)historyItem.NewValue);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			base.PreviewChart.CalculatedFields.Insert(index, (ChartCalculatedField)historyItem.NewValue);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			ChartCalculatedField chartCalculatedField = new ChartCalculatedField();
			if (parameter is ParameterInfo)
			{
				chartCalculatedField.DataSource = ((ParameterInfo)parameter).DataSource;
				chartCalculatedField.DataMember = ((ParameterInfo)parameter).DataMember;
			}
			ChartCalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields = base.ChartModel.Chart.CalculatedFields;
			calculatedFields.Add(chartCalculatedField);
			int index = calculatedFields.Count - 1;
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("CalculatedField", index));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, null, null, chartCalculatedField);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.ChartModel.SelectedObject);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ChartCalculatedField chartCalculatedField = new ChartCalculatedField();
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter is ParameterInfo)
			{
				chartCalculatedField.DataSource = ((ParameterInfo)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter).DataSource;
				chartCalculatedField.DataMember = ((ParameterInfo)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter).DataMember;
			}
			chartControl.CalculatedFields.Add(chartCalculatedField);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(ChartCalculatedField));
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter is ParameterInfo)
			{
				val.Properties["DataSource"].SetValue(((ParameterInfo)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter).DataSource);
				val.Properties["DataMember"].SetValue((object)((ParameterInfo)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter).DataMember);
			}
			chartModelItem.Properties["CalculatedFields"].Collection.Add(val);
		}
	}
	public class RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string calculatedFieldIndexKey = "CalculatedField";

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter is ChartCalculatedField;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			base.PreviewChart.CalculatedFields.Insert(index, (ChartCalculatedField)historyItem.OldValue);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			base.PreviewChart.CalculatedFields.RemoveAt(index);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			ChartCalculatedField chartCalculatedField = (ChartCalculatedField)parameter;
			ChartCalculatedFieldCollection calculatedFields = base.ChartModel.Chart.CalculatedFields;
			int index = calculatedFields.IndexOf(chartCalculatedField);
			calculatedFields.RemoveAt(index);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("CalculatedField", index)), this, null, chartCalculatedField, null);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.ChartModel.SelectedObject);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			chartControl.CalculatedFields.RemoveAt(index);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			chartModelItem.Properties["CalculatedFields"].Collection.RemoveAt(num);
		}
	}
	public class SetCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand : PropertyGridCommandBase
	{
		protected const string calculatedFieldIndexKey = "CalculatedField";

		private readonly ChartCalculatedField field;

		public SetCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model, ChartCalculatedField field)
			: base(model)
		{
			this.field = field;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(field, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.OldValue);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(field, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))
			{
				int index = base.ChartModel.Chart.CalculatedFields.IndexOf(field);
				object objectProperty = CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(field, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName);
				CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(field, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("CalculatedField", index)), this, null, objectProperty, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.ChartModel.SelectedObject);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(chartControl.CalculatedFields[index], propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["CalculatedField"];
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["CalculatedFields"].Collection[num];
			val.Properties[propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName].SetValue(propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
		}
	}
	public class RunExpressionEditorCommand : ChartObjectCommandBase
	{
		private readonly ChartCalculatedField field;

		private readonly ICommand setCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand;

		public RunExpressionEditorCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, ChartCalculatedField field)
			: base(null)
		{
			this.field = field;
			setCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand = new SetCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand(chartModel, field);
		}

		public override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return setCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand.CanExecute(parameter);
		}

		public override void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			//IL_0007: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_000d: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_0019: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			ExpressionEditorDialogClosedDelegate val = (ExpressionEditorDialogClosedDelegate)delegate(string expression)
			{
				setCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand.Execute(new PropertyGridCommandParameter("Expression", expression, null));
			};
			ExpressionEditorHelper.ShowExpressionEditor(new ExpressionEditorParams((IDataColumnInfo)(object)new CalculatedFieldData(field), val));
		}
	}
	public abstract class ColorizerCollectionCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected const string SeriesIndexKey = "Series";

		public const string ColorizerIndexKey = "Colorizer";

		public const string SegmentColorizerIndexKey = "SegmentColorizer";

		private readonly ColorizerCommandBehavior commandBehavior;

		protected string ColorizerPropertyName => commandBehavior.ColorizerPropertyName;

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		protected abstract string CommandPropertyName { get; }

		protected ColorizerCollectionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, bool isSegmentColorizer = false)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			commandBehavior = CreateCommandBehavior(isSegmentColorizer);
		}

		private ColorizerCommandBehavior CreateCommandBehavior(bool isSegmentColorizer)
		{
			if (isSegmentColorizer)
			{
				return new SegmentColorizerCommandBehavior();
			}
			return new PointColorizerCommandBehavior();
		}

		protected DoubleCollection GetColorizerRangeStops(Series series)
		{
			return commandBehavior.GetColorizerRangeStops(series);
		}

		protected ColorCollection GetCustomPaletteColors(Series series)
		{
			return commandBehavior.GetCustomPaletteColors(series);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter != null;
		}

		protected CommandResult CreateCommandResult(Series series, object odValue, object parameter, int keyIndex)
		{
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Series", base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(series)), new ElementIndexItem(ColorizerPropertyName, keyIndex));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, series, odValue, parameter);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, series);
		}

		protected abstract void ProcessRedo(HistoryItem historyItem, Series series);

		protected abstract void ProcessUndo(HistoryItem historyItem, Series series);

		protected abstract void ProcessRuntimeApply(HistoryItem historyItem, Series series);

		protected abstract ColorizerCommandResultInfo ProcessRuntimeExecute(object parameter, Series series);

		protected int GetItemIndex(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary[ColorizerPropertyName];
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = (Series)historyItem.TargetObject;
			ProcessRedo(historyItem, series);
			return series;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = (Series)historyItem.TargetObject;
			ProcessUndo(historyItem, series);
			return series;
		}

		protected virtual void ProcessDesignTimeApply(ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo, IModelItem colorizerModelItem)
		{
			colorizerModelItem.Properties[CommandPropertyName].Collection.Add(executeCommandInfo.Parameter);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo;
			int num = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			IModelItem value = val.Properties[ColorizerPropertyName].Value;
			ProcessDesignTimeApply(executeCommandInfo, value);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			ProcessRuntimeApply(historyItem, series);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				Series series = ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).Series;
				ColorizerCommandResultInfo colorizerCommandResultInfo = ProcessRuntimeExecute(parameter, series);
				return CreateCommandResult(series, colorizerCommandResultInfo.OldValue, parameter, colorizerCommandResultInfo.Index);
			}
			ChartDebug.WriteWarning("The '" + GetType().Name + "' command can be executed because of parameter must be Series");
			return null;
		}
	}
	public struct ColorizerCommandResultInfo
	{
		public object OldValue { get; }

		public int Index { get; }

		public ColorizerCommandResultInfo(object oldValue, int index)
		{
			OldValue = oldValue;
			Index = index;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AnnotationOptionsCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected const string AnnotationIndexKey = "Annotation";

		protected const string PaneIndexKey = "Pane";

		protected const string AxisIndexKey = "Axis";

		protected const string SeriesIndexKey = "Series";

		protected const string SeriesDesignTimeIndexKey = "SeriesDesignTime";

		protected const string SeriesPointIndexKey = "Point";

		protected WpfChartAnnotationModel AnnotationModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartAnnotationModel;

		protected WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel PaneAnchorPoint
		{
			get
			{
				if (AnnotationModel == null || AnnotationModel.PropertyGridModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ((WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel)AnnotationModel.PropertyGridModel).AnchorPoint as WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel;
			}
		}

		public override string Caption => string.Empty;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AnnotationOptionsCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected abstract void UndoInternal(WpfChartAnnotationModel model, object oldValue);

			return FontCommandUtils.GetScaleBreakPathIndices(axis2D, SelectedScaleBreak, PreviewXYDiagram2D);
		}

		protected WpfChartScaleBreakModel GetScaleBreakModel(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel;
			switch (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"])
			{
			case -1:
				wpfChartAxisModel = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
				break;
			case -2:
				wpfChartAxisModel = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY;
				break;
			case -3:
			{
				int index2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[index2];
				break;

			case -4:

				int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[index];
				break;
			}
			default:
				throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown pseudo index.");
			}
			int index3 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["ScaleBreak"];
			return (WpfChartScaleBreakModel)wpfChartAxisModel.ScaleBreakCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index3];
		}

		public override string ImageName => null;

			: base(model)

		}

		private void ShowErrorMessage(string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption, string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage, incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
			if (EditorModel != null)
			{
				EditorModel.EditValue = EditorModel.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning("ChangeScaleBreakEdge1Command.EditorModel property was not set. That's why EditValue in an editor was not reset.");
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.SelectedScaleBreakModel != null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			AxisBase scaleBreakOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetScaleBreakOwner(base.SelectedScaleBreak);
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetAxisScaleTypeMap(scaleBreakOwner);
			object obj;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
			{
				obj = parameter.ToString();
			}
			else if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisNumericalMap)
			{
				if (!double.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result))
				{
					string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithNumericalScaleBreakEdge1Caption);
					string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithNumericalScaleBreakEdge1Message);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption, incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result;
			}
			else if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisDateTimeMap)
			{
				if (!DateTime.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result2))
				{
					string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithDateTimeScaleBreakEdge1Caption);
					string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithDateTimeScaleBreakEdge1Message);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption2, incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage2);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(axisScaleTypeMap is AxisTimeSpanMap))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown ScaleTypeMap.");
				}
				if (!TimeSpan.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result3))
				{
					string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithTimeSpanScaleBreakEdge1Caption);
					string incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithTimeSpanScaleBreakEdge1Message);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxCaption3, incompatibleScaleBreakValueMsgBoxMessage3);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result3;
			}
			object edge = base.SelectedScaleBreakModel.Edge1;
			base.SelectedScaleBreakModel.Edge1 = obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexItemList);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedScaleBreak, edge, obj);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ScaleBreak scaleBreak = (ScaleBreak)historyItem.TargetObject;
			scaleBreak.Edge1 = historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ScaleBreak scaleBreak = (ScaleBreak)historyItem.TargetObject;
			scaleBreak.Edge1 = historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ScaleBreak targetScaleBreakForRuntimeApply = GetTargetScaleBreakForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			targetScaleBreakForRuntimeApply.Edge1 = historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetScaleBreakForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetScaleBreakForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			targetScaleBreakForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Edge1"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

	public class AddStackedBarTotalLabelCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string PaneIndexKey = "Pane";

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddStackedBarTotalLabelCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private WpfChartPaneModel FindPaneModel()
		{
			ChartModelElement selectedModel = base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			if (selectedModel is WpfChartPaneModel)
			{
				return (WpfChartPaneModel)selectedModel;
			}
			if (selectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				return ((WpfChartSeriesModel)selectedModel).Pane;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private bool IsPaneContainsStackerBarSeries(Pane pane)
		{
			if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel != null)
			{
				foreach (WpfChartSeriesModel item in base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
				{
					if (item.Series is BarStackedSeries2D && ((BarStackedSeries2D)item.Series).Pane == pane)
					{
						return true;
					}
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			ChartModelElement selectedModel = base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			if (selectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				return ((WpfChartSeriesModel)selectedModel).Series is BarStackedSeries2D;
			}
			if (selectedModel is WpfChartPaneModel)
			{
				return IsPaneContainsStackerBarSeries(((WpfChartPaneModel)selectedModel).Pane);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel = new StackedBarTotalLabel();
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram;
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = FindPaneModel();
			Pane pane = wpfChartPaneModel.Pane;
			if (pane == xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.DefaultPane = pane;
			}
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, stackedBarTotalLabel);
			int index = xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes.IndexOf(pane);
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("Pane", index);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexItem);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, null, stackedBarTotalLabel);
			CommandResult result = new CommandResult(historyItem, stackedBarTotalLabel);
			wpfChartPaneModel.InvalidatePropertyGridModel();
			return result;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			Pane pane = ((XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram).ActualPanes[index];
			StackedBarTotalLabel label = (StackedBarTotalLabel)historyItem.NewValue;
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, label);
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			return pane;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			Pane pane = ((XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram).ActualPanes[index];
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, null);
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			return pane;
		}

			//IL_0162: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value);
			if (val == null)

				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].SetValue((object)new Pane());

			val.Properties[val2].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);

		private const string PaneIndexKey = "Pane";

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemoveStackedBarTotalLabelCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter is StackedBarTotalLabel;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel = (StackedBarTotalLabel)parameter;
			Pane pane = (Pane)stackedBarTotalLabel.Parent;
			StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(pane);
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, null);
			int index = ((XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram).ActualPanes.IndexOf(pane);
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("Pane", index);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexItem);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, totalLabel, null);
			CommandResult result = new CommandResult(historyItem, stackedBarTotalLabel);
			if (base.ChartModel.SelectedModel.Parent is WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel)
			{
				wpfChartPaneModel.InvalidatePropertyGridModel();
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			Pane pane = ((XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram).ActualPanes[index];
			StackedBarTotalLabel stackedBarTotalLabel = (StackedBarTotalLabel)historyItem.NewValue;
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, stackedBarTotalLabel);
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			if (stackedBarTotalLabel == null)
			{
				return base.ChartModel.ChartElement;
			}
			return stackedBarTotalLabel;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			Pane pane = ((XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram).ActualPanes[index];
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, (StackedBarTotalLabel)historyItem.OldValue);
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			return pane;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			//IL_0162: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value);
			if (val == null)
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].SetValue((object)new Pane());
				val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value;
				string text = (string)val.Properties["Name"].Value.GetCurrentValue();
				if (text == "")
				{
					text = ((num == -1) ? "pane" : ("pane" + num));
					val.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
				}
			}
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached propertyGridCommandParameterAttached = (PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			DXPropertyIdentifier val2 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val2))..ctor(propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.PropertyOwnerType, propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.PropertyName);
			val.Properties[val2].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram;
			Pane pane = ((num == -1) ? xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane : xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes[num]);
			BarStackedSeries2D.SetTotalLabel(pane, (StackedBarTotalLabel)historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}
	public class SelectColorDataMemberCommand : SelectDataMemberCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_ColorDataMember);

		public SelectColorDataMemberCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.Behavior == DesignerBehavior.Ribbon)
			{
				if (base.CanExecute(parameter))
				{
					if (SeriesModel.DataSource == null)
					{
						return SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return base.CanExecute(parameter);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
			seriesAccess.Properties["ColorDataMember"].SetValue((object)((DataMemberInfo)value).DataMember);
		}

		protected override void DataMemberUndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			model.ColorDataMember = oldValue as DataMemberInfo;
		}

		protected override void DataMemberRedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			model.ColorDataMember = newValue as DataMemberInfo;
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			series.ColorDataMember = ((DataMemberInfo)value).DataMember;
		}

		public override string GetCommandDataMember()
		{
			return SeriesModel.ColorDataMember.DisplayName;
		}

		public override ScaleType GetCommandScaleType()
		{
			return SeriesModel.ArgumentScaleType;
		}

		public override CommandResult DataMemberRuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = parameter as DataMemberInfo;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember) || dataMemberInfo.DataMember == "None")
			{
				dataMemberInfo = new DataMemberInfo();
			}
			DataMemberInfo colorDataMember = SeriesModel.ColorDataMember;
			if (dataMemberInfo.DataMember != colorDataMember.DataMember)
			{
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				SeriesModel.ColorDataMember = dataMemberInfo;
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, null, colorDataMember, dataMemberInfo));
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, SeriesModel.Series, "SeriesOptions_DataPage");
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class DragDropDataMemberCommandBase : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly List<ScaleType> numericType = new List<ScaleType> { ScaleType.Numerical };

		internal abstract DataMemberInfo DataMember { get; set; }

		protected abstract string DataMemberName { get; }

		public override string Caption
		{
			get
			{
				string text = DataMemberName + " (";
				return text + ((SeriesModel != null && DataMember != null && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(DataMember.DisplayName)) ? (DataMember.DisplayName + ")") : "None)");
			}
		}

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public virtual List<ScaleType> AllowedDataTypes => numericType;

		protected override WpfChartSeriesModel SeriesModel
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesModel != null)
				{
					return base.SeriesModel;
				}
				if (base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartModel && base.ChartModel.DiagramModel != null)
				{
					return base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public DragDropDataMemberCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}
	}
	public abstract class DragDropSimpleDataMemberCommandBase : DragDropDataMemberCommandBase
	{
		public DragDropSimpleDataMemberCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = parameter as DataMemberInfo;
			if (dataMemberInfo == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember) || dataMemberInfo.DataMember == "None")
			{
				dataMemberInfo = new DataMemberInfo();
			}
			DataMemberInfo dataMember = DataMember;
			if (dataMemberInfo.DataMember != dataMember.DataMember)
			{
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
				DataMember = dataMemberInfo;
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, null, dataMember, dataMemberInfo));
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class DragDropSeriesDataMemberCommand : DragDropDataMemberCommandBase
	{
		private readonly List<ScaleType> allowedTypes = new List<ScaleType>
		{
			ScaleType.Numerical,
			ScaleType.Qualitative,
			ScaleType.DateTime,
			ScaleType.TimeSpan
		};

		internal override DataMemberInfo DataMember
		{
			get
			{
				if (SeriesModel == null || SeriesModel.Diagram == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = value;
			}
		}

		protected override string DataMemberName => DragDropCommandCaptions.Series;

		public override List<ScaleType> AllowedDataTypes => allowedTypes;

		public DragDropSeriesDataMemberCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private CommandResult CreateSeriesTemplate()
		{
			CreateSeriesTemplateCommand createSeriesTemplateCommand = new CreateSeriesTemplateCommand(base.ChartModel);
			return createSeriesTemplateCommand.RuntimeExecuteAndUpdateChartModel(null);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SeriesModel == null)
			{
				return base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartModel;
			}
			return SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate;
		}

		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesModelItem, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			model.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = (DataMemberInfo)newValue;
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			Diagram diagram = GetDiagram(series);
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.SeriesDataMember = ((DataMemberInfo)value).DataMember;
			}
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			model.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = (DataMemberInfo)oldValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = parameter as DataMemberInfo;
			if (dataMemberInfo == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember) || dataMemberInfo.DataMember == "None")
			{
				dataMemberInfo = new DataMemberInfo();
			}
			if (SeriesModel == null)
			{
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(CreateSeriesTemplate().HistoryItem);
			}
			DataMemberInfo seriesDataMember = SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember;
			if (dataMemberInfo.DataMember != seriesDataMember.DataMember)
			{
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
				SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = dataMemberInfo;
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, null, seriesDataMember, dataMemberInfo));
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series);
			}
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesDataMember"].SetValue((object)((DataMemberInfo)historyItem.NewValue).DataMember);
		}
	}

			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, pieTotalLabel, null);
			CommandResult result = new CommandResult(historyItem);
			if (base.ChartModel.SelectedModel.Parent is WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				wpfChartSeriesModel.InvalidatePropertyGridModel();
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class AddSeriesTitleCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string defaultSeriesTitleText = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_SeriesTitle);

		protected virtual PieSeries PieSeries => SeriesModel.Series as PieSeries;

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddSeriesTitleCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			PieSeries pieSeries = model.Series as PieSeries;
			pieSeries.Titles.Add((Title)newValue);
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			PieSeries pieSeries = model.Series as PieSeries;
			pieSeries.Titles.RemoveAt(pieSeries.Titles.Count - 1);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesModelItem, object value)
		{
			IModelItem val = seriesModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(Title));
			val.Properties["Content"].SetValue((object)defaultSeriesTitleText);
			seriesModelItem.Properties["Titles"].Collection.Add(val);
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			((PieSeries)series).Titles.Add((Title)value);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SeriesModel != null)
			{
				return PieSeries != null;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Title title = new Title();
			title.Content = defaultSeriesTitleText;
			PieSeries pieSeries = PieSeries;
			pieSeries.Titles.Add(title);
			int index = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(pieSeries);
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("Series", index);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexItem);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, null, title);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, title);
		}
	}

	public class ChangeSeriesAxisXCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private const string AxisXName = "axisx";

		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_ArgumentAxis);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeSeriesAxisXCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter) && SeriesModel != null)
			{
				return SeriesModel.Series is XYSeries2D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			int num = (int)newValue;
			if (num == -1)
			{
				model.AxisX = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
			}
			else
			{
				model.AxisX = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[num];
			}
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			int num = (int)oldValue;
			if (num == -1)
			{
				model.AxisX = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
			}
			else
			{
				model.AxisX = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[num];
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			IModelItem value = null;
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary.TryGetValue("Axis", out var value2))
			{
				IModelItem val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SecondaryAxesX"].Collection[value2];
				string text = "axisx" + value2;
				val2.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
				value = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(val, text);
			}
			val.Properties["AxisX"].SetValue((object)value);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			SecondaryAxisX2D axisX = null;
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary.TryGetValue("Axis", out var value))
			{
				axisX = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[value];
			}
			((XYSeries2D)series).AxisX = axisX;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)parameter;
			int selfIndex = SeriesModel.AxisX.GetSelfIndex();
			SeriesModel.AxisX = wpfChartAxisModel;
			int selfIndex2 = wpfChartAxisModel.GetSelfIndex();
			ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[2];
			if (selfIndex2 >= 0)
			{
				array = new ElementIndexItem[3]
				{
					null,
					null,
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", selfIndex2)
				};
			}
			array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex());
			array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex());
			WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel = SeriesModel;
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, null, selfIndex, selfIndex2), seriesModel.Series);
		}
	}

	public class CommandResult
	{
		public IHistoryItem HistoryItem { get; private set; }

		public object SelectedChartObject { get; private set; }

		public string SelectedPageName { get; private set; }

		public CommandResult(IHistoryItem historyItem)
			: this(historyItem, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public CommandResult(IHistoryItem historyItem, object objectToSelect)
			: this(historyItem, objectToSelect, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public CommandResult(IHistoryItem historyItem, object chartElementToSelect, string selectedPageName)
		{
			HistoryItem = historyItem;
			SelectedChartObject = chartElementToSelect;
			SelectedPageName = selectedPageName;
		}
	}

	public abstract class IndicatorCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string SeriesIndexName = "SeriesIndex";

		private const string IndicatorIndexName = "IndicatorIndex";

		protected Indicator SelectedIndicator => base.ChartModel.SelectedObject as Indicator;

		protected WpfChartIndicatorModel SelectedIndicatorModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartIndicatorModel;

		public IndicatorCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private Indicator GetIndicatorByElementIndexes(ChartControl chartControl, ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo)
		{
			int index = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SeriesIndex"];
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)chartControl.Diagram.Series[index];
			int index2 = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["IndicatorIndex"];
			return xYSeries2D.Indicators[index2];
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartIndicatorModel;
		}

		protected ElementIndexItem[] GetElementIndexes()
		{
			XYSeries2D indicatorOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIndicatorOwner(SelectedIndicator);
			int index = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(indicatorOwner);
			int index2 = indicatorOwner.Indicators.IndexOf(SelectedIndicator);
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("SeriesIndex", index);
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem2 = new ElementIndexItem("IndicatorIndex", index2);
			return new ElementIndexItem[2] { elementIndexItem, elementIndexItem2 };
		}

		protected Indicator GetIndicatorForRuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo)
		{
			return GetIndicatorByElementIndexes(chartControl, executeCommandInfo);
		}

		protected WpfChartIndicatorModel GetIndicatorModelForUndoRedo(ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo)
		{
			int index = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SeriesIndex"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index];
			int index2 = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["IndicatorIndex"];
			return (WpfChartIndicatorModel)wpfChartSeriesModel.IndicatorCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index2];
		}

		protected Indicator GetIndicatorForUndoRedo(ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo)
		{
			return GetIndicatorByElementIndexes(base.PreviewChart, executeCommandInfo);
		}

		protected IModelItem GetIndicatorModelItemForDesignTimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo)
		{
			int num = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SeriesIndex"];
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num];
			int num2 = executeCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["IndicatorIndex"];
			return val.Properties["Indicators"].Collection[num2];
		}
	}

	public class ChangeIndicatorThicknessCommand : IndicatorCommandBase
	{
		private string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Indicator_Thickness);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeIndicatorThicknessCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Indicator indicatorForUndoRedo = GetIndicatorForUndoRedo(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo);
			indicatorForUndoRedo.LineStyle.Thickness = (int)historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Indicator indicatorForUndoRedo = GetIndicatorForUndoRedo(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo);
			indicatorForUndoRedo.LineStyle.Thickness = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem indicatorModelItemForDesignTimeApply = GetIndicatorModelItemForDesignTimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo);
			indicatorModelItemForDesignTimeApply.Properties["LineStyle"].Value.Properties["Thickness"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Indicator indicatorForRuntimeApply = GetIndicatorForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo);
			indicatorForRuntimeApply.LineStyle.Thickness = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (base.SelectedIndicator.LineStyle == null)
			{
				AddIndicatorLineStyleCommand addIndicatorLineStyleCommand = new AddIndicatorLineStyleCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = addIndicatorLineStyleCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			int num = (int)parameter;
			int thickness = base.SelectedIndicatorModel.Thickness;
			ElementIndexItem[] elementIndexes = GetElementIndexes();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexes);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, thickness, num);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			base.SelectedIndicatorModel.Thickness = num;
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}

			base.SelectedIndicatorModel.LegendText = stringAndBoolContainer.String;

			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexes);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, oldValue, stringAndBoolContainer);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

	public class ChangeSeriesPaneCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_SeriesPane);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeSeriesPaneCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter) && SeriesModel != null)
			{
				return SeriesModel.Series is XYSeries2D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			int num = (int)newValue;
			if (num == -1)
			{
				model.Pane = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.DefaultPaneModel;
			}
			else
			{
				model.Pane = (WpfChartPaneModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num];
			}
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			int num = (int)oldValue;
			if (num == -1)
			{
				model.Pane = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.DefaultPaneModel;
			}
			else
			{
				model.Pane = (WpfChartPaneModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num];
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			IModelItem val2;
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary.TryGetValue("Pane", out var value))
			{
				val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[value];
			}
			else
			{
				value = -1;
				val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value;
				if (val2 == null)
				{
					chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].SetValue((object)new Pane());
					val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value;
				}
			}
			string text = (string)val2.Properties["Name"].Value.GetCurrentValue();
			if (text == "")
			{
				text = ((value == -1) ? "pane" : ("pane" + value));
				val2.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
			}
			IModelItem value2 = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(val, text);
			val.Properties["Pane"].SetValue((object)value2);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			int value;
			Pane pane = ((!historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary.TryGetValue("Pane", out value)) ? ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).ActualDefaultPane : ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).Panes[value]);
			((XYSeries2D)series).Pane = pane;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = (WpfChartPaneModel)parameter;
			int selfIndex = SeriesModel.Pane.GetSelfIndex();
			SeriesModel.Pane = wpfChartPaneModel;
			int selfIndex2 = wpfChartPaneModel.GetSelfIndex();
			ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[2];
			if (selfIndex2 >= 0)
			{
				array = new ElementIndexItem[3]
				{
					null,
					null,
					new ElementIndexItem("Pane", selfIndex2)
				};
			}
			array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex());
			array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex());
			WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel = SeriesModel;
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, null, selfIndex, selfIndex2), seriesModel.Series);
		}
	}
