		private SeriesPoint CopySeriesPoint(SeriesPoint sourcePoint)
		{
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint(sourcePoint.Argument, sourcePoint.Value);
			if (seriesType == typeof(BubbleSeries2D))
			{
				double num = BubbleSeries2D.GetWeight(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					num = 1.0;
				}
				BubbleSeries2D.SetWeight(seriesPoint, num);
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(BubbleSeries3D))
			{
				double num2 = BubbleSeries3D.GetWeight(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num2))
				{
					num2 = 1.0;
				}
				BubbleSeries3D.SetWeight(seriesPoint, num2);
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(RadarRangeAreaSeries2D))
			{
				double num3 = RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num3))
				{
					num3 = sourcePoint.Value + 1.0;
				}
				RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num3);
				DateTime dateTime = RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetDateTimeValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (dateTime == DateTime.MaxValue && sourcePoint.DateTimeValue < DateTime.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					dateTime = sourcePoint.DateTimeValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetDateTimeValue2(seriesPoint, dateTime);
				TimeSpan timeSpan = RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetTimeSpanValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (timeSpan == TimeSpan.MaxValue && sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue < TimeSpan.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					timeSpan = sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetTimeSpanValue2(seriesPoint, timeSpan);
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(PolarRangeAreaSeries2D))
			{
				double num4 = PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num4))
				{
					num4 = sourcePoint.Value + 1.0;
				}
				PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num4);
				DateTime dateTime2 = PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetDateTimeValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (dateTime2 == DateTime.MaxValue && sourcePoint.DateTimeValue < DateTime.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					dateTime2 = sourcePoint.DateTimeValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetDateTimeValue2(seriesPoint, dateTime2);
				TimeSpan timeSpan2 = PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetTimeSpanValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (timeSpan2 == TimeSpan.MaxValue && sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue < TimeSpan.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					timeSpan2 = sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetTimeSpanValue2(seriesPoint, timeSpan2);
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D))
			{
				double num5 = RangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num5))
				{
					num5 = sourcePoint.Value + 1.0;
				}
				RangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num5);
				DateTime dateTime3 = RangeAreaSeries2D.GetDateTimeValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (dateTime3 == DateTime.MaxValue && sourcePoint.DateTimeValue < DateTime.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					dateTime3 = sourcePoint.DateTimeValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				RangeAreaSeries2D.SetDateTimeValue2(seriesPoint, dateTime3);
				TimeSpan timeSpan3 = RangeAreaSeries2D.GetTimeSpanValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (timeSpan3 == TimeSpan.MaxValue && sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue < TimeSpan.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					timeSpan3 = sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				RangeAreaSeries2D.SetTimeSpanValue2(seriesPoint, timeSpan3);
			}
			if (seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(RangeBarSeries2D)))
			{
				double num6 = RangeBarSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num6))
				{
					num6 = sourcePoint.Value + 1.0;
				}
				RangeBarSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num6);
				DateTime dateTime4 = RangeBarSeries2D.GetDateTimeValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (dateTime4 == DateTime.MaxValue && sourcePoint.DateTimeValue < DateTime.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					dateTime4 = sourcePoint.DateTimeValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				RangeBarSeries2D.SetDateTimeValue2(seriesPoint, dateTime4);
				TimeSpan timeSpan4 = RangeBarSeries2D.GetTimeSpanValue2(sourcePoint);
				if (timeSpan4 == TimeSpan.MaxValue && sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue < TimeSpan.MaxValue - defaultDateTimeValue2Offset)
				{
					timeSpan4 = sourcePoint.TimeSpanValue + defaultDateTimeValue2Offset;
				}
				RangeBarSeries2D.SetTimeSpanValue2(seriesPoint, timeSpan4);
			}
			if (seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(FinancialSeries2D)))
			{
				double num7 = FinancialSeries2D.GetOpenValue(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num7))
				{
					num7 = sourcePoint.Value + 0.0;
				}
				FinancialSeries2D.SetOpenValue(seriesPoint, num7);
				double num8 = FinancialSeries2D.GetCloseValue(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num8))
				{
					num8 = sourcePoint.Value + 1.0;
				}
				FinancialSeries2D.SetCloseValue(seriesPoint, num8);
				double num9 = FinancialSeries2D.GetLowValue(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num9))
				{
					num9 = sourcePoint.Value + -1.0;
				}
				FinancialSeries2D.SetLowValue(seriesPoint, num9);
				double num10 = FinancialSeries2D.GetHighValue(sourcePoint);
				if (double.IsNaN(num10))
				{
					num10 = sourcePoint.Value + 2.0;
				}
				FinancialSeries2D.SetHighValue(seriesPoint, num10);
			}
			return seriesPoint;
		}

		private void CopySeriesPoints(Series source, Series target)
		{
			if (ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIsAutoPointsAdded(source))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in source.Points)
			{
				target.Points.Add(CopySeriesPoint(point));
			}
		}

		private void CopySeriesPoints(Series source, IModelItem newSeriesModelItem, IEditingContext context)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in source.Points)
			{
				IModelItem val = context.CreateItem(typeof(SeriesPoint));
				val.Properties["Argument"].SetValue((object)point.Argument);
				val.Properties["Value"].SetValue((object)point.Value);
				CopyAdditionalValuesForPoint(source, point, val);
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["Points"].Collection.Add(val);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesType);
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter) && SeriesModel != null && supportedDiagramType == base.PreviewChart.Diagram.GetType())
			{
				return SeriesModel.Series.GetType() != seriesType;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.RemoveAt(num);
				Series series = (Series)historyItem.NewValue;
				if (series is XYSeries2D)
				{
					int num2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						Pane pane = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).Panes[num2];
						((XYSeries2D)series).Pane = pane;
					}
				}
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Insert(num, series);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = (Series)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			return historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.RemoveAt(num);
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Insert(num, (Series)historyItem.OldValue);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = (Series)historyItem.OldValue;
			}
			return historyItem.OldValue;
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			Series series = historyItem.OldValue as Series;
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(seriesType);
			SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(series, val, seriesType);
			if (!ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIsAutoPointsAdded(series))
			{
				CopySeriesPoints(series, val, chartModelItem.Context);
			}
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (historyItem.NewValue is XYSeries2D)
				{
					int num2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						string elementName = (string)chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[num2].Properties["Name"].Value.GetCurrentValue();
						IModelItem value = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(val, elementName);
						val.Properties["Pane"].SetValue((object)value);
					}
				}
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection.RemoveAt(num);
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection.Insert(num, val);
			}
			else
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].SetValue((object)val);
			}
		}

		public bool IsSeriesAtCommandState(WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			return seriesModel.Series.GetType() == seriesType;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			Series source = (Series)historyItem.OldValue;
			Series series = (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType);
			SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(source, series);
			if (!ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIsAutoPointsAdded(series))
			{
				CopySeriesPoints(source, series);
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				chartControl.Diagram.Series.RemoveAt(num);
				if (series is XYSeries2D)
				{
					int num2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
					if (num2 >= 0)
					{
						Pane pane = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).Panes[num2];
						((XYSeries2D)series).Pane = pane;
					}
				}
				chartControl.Diagram.Series.Insert(num, series);
			}
			else
			{
				chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = series;
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || (parameter is bool && (bool)parameter))
			{
				Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
				Series series2 = (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType);
				SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(series, series2);
				if (!ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIsAutoPointsAdded(series2))
				{
					CopySeriesPoints(series, series2);
				}
				int selfIndex = SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex();
				ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[2];
				int num = 0;
				if (series is XYSeries2D && series2 is XYSeries2D)
				{
					XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)series;
					XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
					Pane pane = xYSeries2D.Pane as Pane;
					num = xYDiagram2D.Panes.IndexOf(pane);
					XYSeries2D xYSeries2D2 = (XYSeries2D)series2;
					xYSeries2D2.Pane = pane;
					array = new ElementIndexItem[3]
					{
						null,
						null,
						new ElementIndexItem("Pane", num)
					};
				}
				array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", selfIndex);
				array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex());
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Remove(series);
				if (selfIndex >= 0)
				{
					base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Insert(selfIndex, series2);
				}
				else
				{
					base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = series2;
				}
				return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, null, series, series2), series2);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesCopyHelper
	{
		public static void CopySeriesProperties(Series source, Series target)
		{
			target.DisplayName = source.DisplayName;
			target.DataSource = source.DataSource;
			target.ArgumentDataMember = source.ArgumentDataMember;
			target.ValueDataMember = source.ValueDataMember;
			if (source is FinancialSeries2D && target is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				((FinancialSeries2D)target).LowValueDataMember = ((FinancialSeries2D)source).LowValueDataMember;
				((FinancialSeries2D)target).HighValueDataMember = ((FinancialSeries2D)source).HighValueDataMember;
				((FinancialSeries2D)target).OpenValueDataMember = ((FinancialSeries2D)source).OpenValueDataMember;
				((FinancialSeries2D)target).CloseValueDataMember = ((FinancialSeries2D)source).CloseValueDataMember;
			}
			string weightDataMember = string.Empty;
			if (source is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				weightDataMember = ((BubbleSeries2D)source).WeightDataMember;
			}
			if (target is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				((BubbleSeries2D)target).WeightDataMember = weightDataMember;
			}
			if (source is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				weightDataMember = ((BubbleSeries3D)source).WeightDataMember;
			}
			if (target is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				((BubbleSeries3D)target).WeightDataMember = weightDataMember;
			}
			string value2DataMember = string.Empty;
			if (source is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				value2DataMember = ((RangeBarSeries2D)source).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (target is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				((RangeBarSeries2D)target).Value2DataMember = value2DataMember;
			}
			if (source is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				value2DataMember = ((RangeAreaSeries2D)source).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (target is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				((RangeAreaSeries2D)target).Value2DataMember = value2DataMember;
			}
			if (source is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				value2DataMember = ((CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)source).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (target is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				((CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)target).Value2DataMember = value2DataMember;
			}
		}

		public static void CopySeriesProperties(Series source, IModelItem newSeriesModelItem, Type seriesType)
		{
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.DisplayName))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["DisplayName"].SetValue((object)source.DisplayName);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.ArgumentDataMember))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["ArgumentDataMember"].SetValue((object)source.ArgumentDataMember);
			}
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(source.ValueDataMember))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["ValueDataMember"].SetValue((object)source.ValueDataMember);
			}
			if (source is FinancialSeries2D && seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(FinancialSeries2D)))
			{
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((FinancialSeries2D)source).LowValueDataMember))
				{
					newSeriesModelItem.Properties["LowValueDataMember"].SetValue((object)((FinancialSeries2D)source).LowValueDataMember);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((FinancialSeries2D)source).HighValueDataMember))
				{
					newSeriesModelItem.Properties["HighValueDataMember"].SetValue((object)((FinancialSeries2D)source).HighValueDataMember);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((FinancialSeries2D)source).OpenValueDataMember))
				{
					newSeriesModelItem.Properties["OpenValueDataMember"].SetValue((object)((FinancialSeries2D)source).OpenValueDataMember);
				}
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(((FinancialSeries2D)source).CloseValueDataMember))
				{
					newSeriesModelItem.Properties["CloseValueDataMember"].SetValue((object)((FinancialSeries2D)source).CloseValueDataMember);
				}
			}
			string value = string.Empty;
			if (source is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				value = ((BubbleSeries2D)source).WeightDataMember;
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(BubbleSeries2D) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["WeightDataMember"].SetValue((object)value);
			}
			if (source is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				value = ((BubbleSeries3D)source).WeightDataMember;
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(BubbleSeries3D) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["WeightDataMember"].SetValue((object)value);
			}
			string value2 = string.Empty;
			if (source is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				value2 = ((RangeBarSeries2D)source).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(RangeBarSeries2D)) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["Value2DataMember"].SetValue((object)value2);
			}
			if (source is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				value2 = ((RangeAreaSeries2D)source).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["Value2DataMember"].SetValue((object)value2);
			}
			if (source is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				value2 = ((CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)source).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (seriesType == typeof(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(value2))
			{
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["Value2DataMember"].SetValue((object)value2);
			}
		}
	}

	public class CreateSeriesTemplateCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly Type seriesTemplateType;

		private readonly string caption;

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public CreateSeriesTemplateCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		public CreateSeriesTemplateCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType)
			: this(chartModel)
		{
			seriesTemplateType = seriesType;
			ChartDesignerStringIDs id = (ChartDesignerStringIDs)Enum.Parse(typeof(ChartDesignerStringIDs), seriesType.Name);
			caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (seriesTemplateType != null)
			{
				if (base.PreviewChart.Diagram == null)
				{
					return true;
				}
				Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesTemplateType);
				if (supportedDiagramType == base.PreviewChart.Diagram.GetType())
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			Series seriesTemplate = (Series)newValue;
			base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = seriesTemplate;
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(historyItem.NewValue.GetType());
			chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].SetValue((object)value);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = (Series)historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[2];
			Type type = null;
			array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", -1);
			array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", -1);
			if (seriesTemplateType != null)
			{
				type = seriesTemplateType;
			}
			else if (SeriesModel != null)
			{
				array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex());
				array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex());
				type = SeriesModel.Series.GetType();
			}
			else if (base.ChartModel.IsDiagramExists)
			{
				if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0)
				{
					WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[0];
					type = wpfChartSeriesModel.Series.GetType();
				}
				else
				{
					if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
					{
						type = typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D);
					}
					if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram3D)
					{
						type = typeof(BarSideBySideSeries3D);
					}
					if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is SimpleDiagram2D)
					{
						type = typeof(PieSeries2D);
					}
					if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is SimpleDiagram3D)
					{
						type = typeof(PieSeries3D);
					}
					if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
					{
						type = typeof(RadarPointSeries2D);
					}
					if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
					{
						type = typeof(PolarPointSeries2D);
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				type = typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D);
			}
			Series series = (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(type);
			if (!base.ChartModel.IsDiagramExists)
			{
				Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(type);
				CreateDiagramCommand createDiagramCommand = new CreateDiagramCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(createDiagramCommand.RuntimeExecute(supportedDiagramType).HistoryItem);
			}
			base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = series;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, null, null, series));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series);
		}
	}

			SeriesModel.Diagram.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = null;
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Series", -1), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", -1)), this, null, seriesTemplate, null));
		}
	}

	public abstract class SelectDataMemberCommandBase : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string ImageName => null;

		public SelectDataMemberCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private ScaleType ScaleTypeCoreToScaleType(Scale scaleTypeCore)
		{
			return scaleTypeCore switch
			{
				Scale.Auto => ScaleType.Auto, 
				Scale.DateTime => ScaleType.DateTime, 
				Scale.TimeSpan => ScaleType.TimeSpan, 
				Scale.Numerical => ScaleType.Numerical, 
				Scale.Qualitative => ScaleType.Qualitative, 
				_ => ScaleType.Auto, 
			};
		}

		protected bool AllDataMembersEmpty()
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.ArgumentDataMember.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.ValueDataMember.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.Value2DataMember.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.WeightDataMember.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.LowValueDataMember.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.HighValueDataMember.DataMember) && string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.OpenValueDataMember.DataMember))
			{
				return string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.CloseValueDataMember.DataMember);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected bool AllDataMembersSet()
		{
			Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
			bool flag;
			if (series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				FinancialSeries2D financialSeries2D = series as FinancialSeries2D;
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(financialSeries2D.LowValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(financialSeries2D.HighValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(financialSeries2D.OpenValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(financialSeries2D.CloseValueDataMember);
			}
			else if (series is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				BubbleSeries2D bubbleSeries2D = series as BubbleSeries2D;
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bubbleSeries2D.ValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bubbleSeries2D.WeightDataMember);
			}
			else if (series is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				BubbleSeries3D bubbleSeries3D = series as BubbleSeries3D;
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bubbleSeries3D.ValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(bubbleSeries3D.WeightDataMember);
			}
			else if (series is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				RangeBarSeries2D rangeBarSeries2D = series as RangeBarSeries2D;
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(rangeBarSeries2D.ValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(rangeBarSeries2D.Value2DataMember);
			}
			else if (series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				RangeAreaSeries2D rangeAreaSeries2D = series as RangeAreaSeries2D;
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(rangeAreaSeries2D.ValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(rangeAreaSeries2D.Value2DataMember);
			}
			else if (series is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				CircularRangeAreaSeries2D circularRangeAreaSeries2D = series as CircularRangeAreaSeries2D;
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(circularRangeAreaSeries2D.ValueDataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(circularRangeAreaSeries2D.Value2DataMember);
			}
			else
			{
				flag = !string.IsNullOrEmpty(series.ValueDataMember);
			}
			return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.ArgumentDataMember.DataMember) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember.DataMember) && flag;
		}

		protected void ChangeValueScaleType(string dataMember)
		{
			ScaleType scaleType = ScaleTypeCoreToScaleType(BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, SeriesModel.DataSource, dataMember, ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetCalculatedFields(SeriesModel.Series)));
			if (scaleType != SeriesModel.ValueScaleType)
			{
				SeriesModel.ValueScaleType = scaleType;
			}
		}

		protected void ChangeValueScaleType(string dataMember, CompositeHistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ScaleType scaleType = ScaleTypeCoreToScaleType(BindingHelperCore.GetScaleType(null, SeriesModel.DataSource, dataMember, ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetCalculatedFields(SeriesModel.Series)));
			if (scaleType != SeriesModel.ValueScaleType)
			{
				ChangeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand changeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand = new ChangeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand(base.ChartModel);
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand.RuntimeExecute(scaleType).HistoryItem);
			}
		}

		protected void CopyDataMembers(WpfChartSeriesModel sourceSeries, CompositeHistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SelectArgumentDataMemberCommand selectArgumentDataMemberCommand = new SelectArgumentDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			CommandResult commandResult = selectArgumentDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.ArgumentDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectValueDataMemberCommand selectValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectValueDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.ValueDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectWeightDataMemberCommand selectWeightDataMemberCommand = new SelectWeightDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectWeightDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.WeightDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectValue2DataMemberCommand selectValue2DataMemberCommand = new SelectValue2DataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectValue2DataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.Value2DataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectLowValueDataMemberCommand selectLowValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectLowValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectLowValueDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.LowValueDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectHighValueDataMemberCommand selectHighValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectHighValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectHighValueDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.HighValueDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectOpenValueDataMemberCommand selectOpenValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectOpenValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectOpenValueDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.OpenValueDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
			SelectCloseValueDataMemberCommand selectCloseValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectCloseValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
			commandResult = selectCloseValueDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(sourceSeries.CloseValueDataMember);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			}
		}

		protected void ReplaceSeriesBySeriesTemplate(CompositeHistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel = SeriesModel;
			RemoveSeriesCommand removeSeriesCommand = new RemoveSeriesCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(removeSeriesCommand.RuntimeExecute(seriesModel.Series).HistoryItem);
			CreateSeriesTemplateCommand createSeriesTemplateCommand = new CreateSeriesTemplateCommand(base.ChartModel);
			CommandResult commandResult = createSeriesTemplateCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			ChangeSeriesNameCommand changeSeriesNameCommand = new ChangeSeriesNameCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeSeriesNameCommand.RuntimeExecute(seriesModel.Name).HistoryItem);
			ChangeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand changeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand = new ChangeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand.RuntimeExecute(seriesModel.ValueScaleType).HistoryItem);
			CopyDataMembers(seriesModel, historyItem);
		}

		protected void ReplaceSeriesTemplateBySeries(CompositeHistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AddSeriesCommand addSeriesCommand = new AddSeriesCommand(base.ChartModel, SeriesModel.Series.GetType());
			CommandResult commandResult = addSeriesCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel = SeriesModel;
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			ChangeSeriesNameCommand changeSeriesNameCommand = new ChangeSeriesNameCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeSeriesNameCommand.RuntimeExecute(seriesModel.Name).HistoryItem);
			ChangeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand changeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand = new ChangeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeSeriesValueScaleTypeCommand.RuntimeExecute(seriesModel.ValueScaleType).HistoryItem);
			CopyDataMembers(seriesModel, historyItem);
			SelectChartDataSourceCommand selectChartDataSourceCommand = new SelectChartDataSourceCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(selectChartDataSourceCommand.RuntimeExecute(true).HistoryItem);
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesDataMember.DataMember))
			{
				ChangeIsSeriesTemplatePreviewCommand changeIsSeriesTemplatePreviewCommand = new ChangeIsSeriesTemplatePreviewCommand(base.ChartModel);
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeIsSeriesTemplatePreviewCommand.RuntimeExecute(true).HistoryItem);
			}
			RemoveSeriesTemplateCommand removeSeriesTemplateCommand = new RemoveSeriesTemplateCommand(base.ChartModel);
			historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(removeSeriesTemplateCommand.RuntimeExecute(null).HistoryItem);
		}

		protected bool ShouldReplaceSeriesBySeriesTemplate()
		{
			if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel == null)
			{
				return AllDataMembersSet();
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected abstract void DataMemberUndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue);

		protected abstract void DataMemberRedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue);

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			DataMemberRedoInternal(model, newValue);
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			DataMemberUndoInternal(model, oldValue);
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public abstract string GetCommandDataMember();

		public abstract CommandResult DataMemberRuntimeExecute(object parameter);

		public virtual ScaleType GetCommandScaleType()
		{
			return SeriesModel.ValueScaleType;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CommandResult commandResult = DataMemberRuntimeExecute(parameter);
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
			}
			return commandResult;
		}
	}
	public abstract class SelectSimpleDataMemberCommandBase : SelectDataMemberCommandBase
	{
		public SelectSimpleDataMemberCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.Behavior == DesignerBehavior.Ribbon)
			{
				if (base.CanExecute(parameter))
				{
					if (SeriesModel.DataSource == null)
					{
						return SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return base.CanExecute(parameter);
		}

		protected abstract DataMemberInfo GetOldValue();

		protected abstract void SetNewValue(DataMemberInfo newValue);

		public override CommandResult DataMemberRuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = parameter as DataMemberInfo;
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember) || dataMemberInfo.DataMember == "None")
			{
				dataMemberInfo = new DataMemberInfo();
			}
			DataMemberInfo oldValue = GetOldValue();
			if (dataMemberInfo.DataMember != oldValue.DataMember)
			{
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
				if (base.Behavior == DesignerBehavior.Ribbon && !SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate && SeriesModel.Series.Points.Count > 0 && !SeriesModel.IsAutoPointsAdded)
				{
					RemoveSeriesPointsCommand removeSeriesPointsCommand = new RemoveSeriesPointsCommand(base.ChartModel);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(removeSeriesPointsCommand.RuntimeExecute(null).HistoryItem);
				}
				SetNewValue(dataMemberInfo);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, null, oldValue, dataMemberInfo));
				if (base.Behavior == DesignerBehavior.Ribbon)
				{
					if (SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate)
					{
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember) && !AllDataMembersSet())
						{
							ReplaceSeriesTemplateBySeries(compositeHistoryItem);
							series = SeriesModel.Series;
						}
					}
					else if (ShouldReplaceSeriesBySeriesTemplate())
					{
						ReplaceSeriesBySeriesTemplate(compositeHistoryItem);
						series = SeriesModel.Series;
					}
				}
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series, "SeriesOptions_DataPage");
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		}

		}

	}
	public class SelectDataSourceNoneCommand : SelectDataSourceCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_DataSourceNone);

		public override string ImageName => "GalleryItemImages/DataSource\\DataSourceNone";

		public SelectDataSourceNoneCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SeriesModel != null)
			{
				if (SeriesModel.PredefinedDataSource == null)
				{
					return ((WpfChartModel)SeriesModel.Diagram.Parent).PredefinedDataSource != null;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void DataSourceRedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				wpfChartSeriesModel.DataSource = null;
			}
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
			return wpfChartSeriesModel.Series;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (((Series)historyItem.TargetObject).DataSource == null)
				{
					wpfChartSeriesModel.SetChartDataSource(historyItem.OldValue);
				}
				else
				{
					wpfChartSeriesModel.SetSeriesDataSource();
				}
			}
			base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
			return wpfChartSeriesModel.Series;
		}

		protected override void DataSourceUndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
		}

		protected override CommandResult DataSourceRuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter is bool && (bool)parameter)
			{
				CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
				object dataSource = SeriesModel.DataSource;
				if (SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplatePreview)
				{
					SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand selectSeriesDataMemberCommand = new SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(selectSeriesDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(string.Empty).HistoryItem);
				}
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, series, dataSource, null));
				if (SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate)
				{
					string name = SeriesModel.Name;
					RemoveSeriesTemplateCommand removeSeriesTemplateCommand = new RemoveSeriesTemplateCommand(base.ChartModel);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(removeSeriesTemplateCommand.RuntimeExecute(null).HistoryItem);
					AddSeriesCommand addSeriesCommand = new AddSeriesCommand(base.ChartModel, series.GetType());
					CommandResult commandResult = addSeriesCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
					series = (Series)commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
					base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
					base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = series;
					ChangeSeriesNameCommand changeSeriesNameCommand = new ChangeSeriesNameCommand(base.ChartModel);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(changeSeriesNameCommand.RuntimeExecute(name).HistoryItem);
					SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand selectSeriesDataMemberCommand2 = new SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(selectSeriesDataMemberCommand2.RuntimeExecute(string.Empty).HistoryItem);
				}
				else
				{
					SeriesModel.DataSource = null;
					SelectArgumentDataMemberCommand selectArgumentDataMemberCommand = new SelectArgumentDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					CommandResult commandResult2 = selectArgumentDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectValueDataMemberCommand selectValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectValueDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectWeightDataMemberCommand selectWeightDataMemberCommand = new SelectWeightDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectWeightDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectValue2DataMemberCommand selectValue2DataMemberCommand = new SelectValue2DataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectValue2DataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectLowValueDataMemberCommand selectLowValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectLowValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectLowValueDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectHighValueDataMemberCommand selectHighValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectHighValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectHighValueDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectOpenValueDataMemberCommand selectOpenValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectOpenValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectOpenValueDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					SelectCloseValueDataMemberCommand selectCloseValueDataMemberCommand = new SelectCloseValueDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
					commandResult2 = selectCloseValueDataMemberCommand.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
					if (commandResult2 != null)
					{
						compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
					}
					if (SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplatePreview)
					{
						SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand selectSeriesDataMemberCommand3 = new SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
						commandResult2 = selectSeriesDataMemberCommand3.DataMemberRuntimeExecute(new DataMemberInfo());
						if (commandResult2 != null)
						{
							compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult2.HistoryItem);
						}
					}
				}
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series, "SeriesOptions_DataPage");
			}
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num];
				val.Properties["DataSource"].ClearValue();
			}
		}

		public override bool IsSeriesAtCommandState(WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
		{

			{
				return seriesModel.DataSource == null;

			return false;
		}

			{
				series.DataSource = null;
			}
		}

	public class SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand : SelectDataMemberCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_SeriesDataMember);

		public SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.Behavior == DesignerBehavior.Ribbon)
			{
				if (base.CanExecute(parameter))
				{
					if (!SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate && !SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplatePreview)
					{
						if (SeriesModel.DataSource != null && SeriesModel.Series.DataSource == null)
						{
							return string.IsNullOrEmpty(SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember.DataMember);
						}
						return false;
					}
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
			return base.CanExecute(parameter);
		}

		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override void DataMemberUndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = ((DataMemberInfo)oldValue).DataMember;
		}

		protected override void DataMemberRedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			string dataMember = ((DataMemberInfo)newValue).DataMember;
			base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = dataMember;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMember) && !model.IsSeriesTemplate)
			{
				model.IsSeriesTemplatePreview = true;
			}
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			Diagram diagram = GetDiagram(series);
			if (diagram != null)
			{
				diagram.SeriesDataMember = ((DataMemberInfo)value).DataMember;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesDataMember"].SetValue((object)((DataMemberInfo)historyItem.NewValue).DataMember);
		}

		public override string GetCommandDataMember()
		{
			return SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember.DisplayName;
		}

		public override ScaleType GetCommandScaleType()
		{
			return ScaleType.Auto;
		}

		public override CommandResult DataMemberRuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = parameter as DataMemberInfo;
			if (dataMemberInfo == null || string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember) || dataMemberInfo.DataMember == "None")
			{
				dataMemberInfo = new DataMemberInfo();
			}
			DataMemberInfo seriesDataMember = SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember;
			if (dataMemberInfo.DataMember != seriesDataMember.DataMember)
			{
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				Series series = SeriesModel.Series;
				SeriesModel.Diagram.SeriesDataMember = dataMemberInfo;
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, null, seriesDataMember, dataMemberInfo));
				if (base.Behavior == DesignerBehavior.Ribbon)
				{
					if (SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplate)
					{
						if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember))
						{
							ReplaceSeriesTemplateBySeries(compositeHistoryItem);
							SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplatePreview = false;
							series = SeriesModel.Series;
						}
					}
					else if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(dataMemberInfo.DataMember))
					{
						SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplatePreview = true;
						if (ShouldReplaceSeriesBySeriesTemplate())
						{
							ReplaceSeriesBySeriesTemplate(compositeHistoryItem);
							series = SeriesModel.Series;
						}
					}
					else
					{
						SeriesModel.IsSeriesTemplatePreview = false;
					}
				}
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series, "SeriesOptions_DataPage");
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeriesOptionsCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected const string AxisIndexKey = "Axis";

		protected const string PaneIndexKey = "Pane";

		protected const string SeriesDesigntimeIndexKey = "DesigntimeSeries";

		protected const string SeriesIndexKey = "Series";

		protected const string LegendIndexKey = "Pane";

		protected virtual WpfChartSeriesModel SeriesModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartSeriesModel;

		public SeriesOptionsCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected Diagram GetDiagram(Series series)
		{
			if (series != null)
			{
				return ((IOwnedElement)series).Owner as Diagram;
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SeriesModel != null)
			{
				return !SeriesModel.IsAutoSeries;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected abstract void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesModelItem, object value);

		protected abstract void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue);

		protected abstract void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue);

		protected abstract void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value);

		protected virtual object GetRedoValue(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel model = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			RedoInternal(model, GetRedoValue(historyItem));
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			model = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			if (model == null)
			{
				return base.ChartModel.ChartElement;
			}
			return model.Series;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel model = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			UndoInternal(model, historyItem.OldValue);
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			model = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			if (model == null)
			{
				return base.ChartModel.ChartElement;
			}
			return model.Series;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			IModelItem seriesModelItem = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			DesignTimeApplyInternal(seriesModelItem, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			RuntimeApplyInternal(series, historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}
	public class SetNestedDonutInnerIndentCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private static object DefaultGroup = new object();

		private WpfChartSeriesModel SelectedSeriesModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartSeriesModel;

		private Series SelectedSeries
		{
			get
			{
				if (SelectedSeriesModel != null)
				{
					return SelectedSeriesModel.Series;
				}
				return null;
			}
		}

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public SetNestedDonutInnerIndentCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private bool IsLastInGroup(NestedDonutSeries2D nestedDonutSeries)
		{
			if (base.PreviewChart.Diagram == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			Dictionary<object, List<Series>> dictionary = new Dictionary<object, List<Series>>();
			foreach (Series item in base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series)
			{
				if (item is NestedDonutSeries2D { Group: var obj })
				{
					if (obj == null)
					{
						obj = DefaultGroup;
					}
					object key = obj;
					if (dictionary.TryGetValue(key, out var value))
					{
						value.Add(item);
						continue;
					}
					value = new List<Series> { item };
					dictionary.Add(key, value);
				}
			}
			if (dictionary.TryGetValue(nestedDonutSeries.Group ?? DefaultGroup, out var value2) && value2[value2.Count - 1] == nestedDonutSeries)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (SelectedSeries is NestedDonutSeries2D)
			{
				return !IsLastInGroup((NestedDonutSeries2D)SelectedSeries);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			double num = Convert.ToDouble(parameter);
			double innerIndent = SelectedSeriesModel.InnerIndent;
			SelectedSeriesModel.InnerIndent = num;
			int index = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(SelectedSeries);
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("Series", index);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexItem);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, innerIndent, num);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

	public class SetSeriesLabelConnectorIndentCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly CreateSeriesLabelCommand createSeriesLabelCommand;

		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_Indent);

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public SetSeriesLabelConnectorIndentCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			createSeriesLabelCommand = new CreateSeriesLabelCommand(chartModel);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter))
			{
				if (SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition != ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DCenter && SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition != ComplexLabelPosition.PieInside && SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition != ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelCenter && SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition != ComplexLabelPosition.Marker3DCenter && SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition != ComplexLabelPosition.Bubble2DCenter && SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition != ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled)
				{
					return !(SeriesModel.Series is AreaSeries3D);
				}
				return false;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
			seriesAccess.Properties["Label"].Value.Properties["Indent"].SetValue(value);
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			model.LabelIndent = (int)newValue;
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			series.ActualLabel.Indent = (int)value;
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			model.LabelIndent = (int)oldValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (SeriesModel.Series.Label == null)
			{
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(createSeriesLabelCommand.RuntimeExecute(SeriesModel).HistoryItem);
			}
			int labelIndent = SeriesModel.LabelIndent;
			SeriesModel.LabelIndent = CommandUtils.ExtractInt(parameter);
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
			{
				new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
				new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
			};
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, SeriesModel, labelIndent, CommandUtils.ExtractInt(parameter)));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, SeriesModel.Series);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SetSeriesLabelPositionCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase, IValueConverter
	{
		private readonly string caption;

		private readonly CreateSeriesLabelCommand createSeriesLabelCommand;

		private readonly string description;

		private readonly string glyph;

		private readonly Type[] seriesTypes;

		protected abstract ComplexLabelPosition LabelPosition { get; }

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string Description => description;

		public override string ImageName => glyph;

		public SetSeriesLabelPositionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type[] seriesTypes, string caption, string description, string glyph)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.caption = caption;
			this.glyph = glyph;
			this.seriesTypes = seriesTypes;
			this.description = description;
			createSeriesLabelCommand = new CreateSeriesLabelCommand(chartModel);
		}

		public SetSeriesLabelPositionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType, string caption, string description, string glyph)
			: this(chartModel, new Type[1] { seriesType }, caption, description, glyph)
		{
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value is WpfChartSeriesModel)
				{
					return ((WpfChartSeriesModel)value).ComplexLabelPosition == LabelPosition;
				}
				if (value is ComplexLabelPosition)
				{
					return (ComplexLabelPosition)value == LabelPosition;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.CanExecute(parameter))
			{
				bool flag = false;
				Type[] array = seriesTypes;
				foreach (Type type in array)
				{
					flag |= type.IsAssignableFrom(SeriesModel.Series.GetType());
				}
				return flag;
			}
			return false;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
			//IL_0092: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00d5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0118: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_015b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0264: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ab: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_02ac: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01f0: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0220: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (value == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			IModelItem value2 = seriesAccess.Properties["Label"].Value;
			ComplexLabelPosition complexLabelPosition = (ComplexLabelPosition)value;
			Type itemType = seriesAccess.ItemType;
			if (complexLabelPosition == ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled)
			{
				seriesAccess.Properties["LabelsVisibility"].SetValue((object)false);
				return;
			}
			seriesAccess.Properties["LabelsVisibility"].SetValue((object)true);
			if (typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D), BarSideBySideSeries2D.LabelPositionProperty.Name)].SetValue(WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (typeof(PieSeries2D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(PieSeries2D), PieSeries.LabelPositionProperty.Name)].SetValue(WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (typeof(FunnelSeries2D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(FunnelSeries2D), FunnelSeries2D.LabelPositionProperty.Name)].SetValue(WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (typeof(MarkerSeries3D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(MarkerSeries3D), MarkerSeries3D.LabelPositionProperty.Name)].SetValue(WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (typeof(BubbleSeries2D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				object obj = WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(BubbleSeries2D), BubbleSeries2D.LabelPositionProperty.Name)].SetValue(WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
					return;
				}
				double num = WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToAngle(complexLabelPosition);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(BubbleSeries2D), BubbleSeries2D.LabelPositionProperty.Name)].SetValue((object)Bubble2DLabelPosition.Outside);
					value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(MarkerSeries2D), MarkerSeries2D.AngleProperty.Name)].SetValue((object)num);
				}
			}
			else if (typeof(MarkerSeries2D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(MarkerSeries2D), MarkerSeries2D.AngleProperty.Name)].SetValue((object)WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToAngle(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (typeof(CircularSeries2D).IsAssignableFrom(itemType))
			{
				value2.Properties[new DXPropertyIdentifier(typeof(CircularSeries2D), CircularSeries2D.AngleProperty.Name)].SetValue((object)WpfChartSeriesModel.ComplexToAngle(complexLabelPosition));
			}
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			model.ComplexLabelPosition = (ComplexLabelPosition)newValue;
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			WpfChartSeriesModel.SetComplexLabelPosition(series, (ComplexLabelPosition)value);
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			model.ComplexLabelPosition = (ComplexLabelPosition)oldValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null && (bool)parameter)
			{
				CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
				if (SeriesModel.Series.Label == null)
				{
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(createSeriesLabelCommand.RuntimeExecute(SeriesModel).HistoryItem);
				}
				ComplexLabelPosition complexLabelPosition = SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition;
				SeriesModel.ComplexLabelPosition = LabelPosition;
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
					new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
				};
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, SeriesModel, complexLabelPosition, LabelPosition));
				return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, SeriesModel.Series);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

	public abstract class SeriesOptionsBarCommand : SeriesOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public SeriesOptionsBarCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)

		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;

	public class ToggleSeriesVisibilityCommand : SeriesOptionsBarCommand
	{
		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_SeriesVisibility);

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ToggleSeriesVisibilityCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		protected override void DesignTimeApplyInternal(IModelItem seriesAccess, object value)
		{
			seriesAccess.Properties["Visible"].SetValue(value);
		}

		protected override void RedoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object newValue)
		{
			model.IsVisible = (bool)newValue;
		}

		protected override void RuntimeApplyInternal(Series series, object value)
		{
			series.Visible = (bool)value;
		}

		protected override void UndoInternal(WpfChartSeriesModel model, object oldValue)
		{
			model.IsVisible = (bool)oldValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			bool isVisible = SeriesModel.IsVisible;
			SeriesModel.IsVisible = (bool)parameter;
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Series", SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())), this, SeriesModel, isVisible, parameter));
		}
	}
	public class SetPieTotalLabelPropertyCommand : PropertyGridCommandBase
	{
		private const string seriesIndexKey = "Series";

		protected const string seriesDesigntimeIndexKey = "DesigntimeSeries";

		public SetPieTotalLabelPropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (propertyGridCommandParameter != null)
			{
				return propertyGridCommandParameter.Model is WpfChartSeriesModel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			PieTotalLabelModel pieTotalLabelModel = wpfChartSeriesModel.PieTotalLabelModel;
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			pieTotalLabelModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.OldValue);
			return pieTotalLabelModel?.TotalLabel;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
			PieTotalLabelModel pieTotalLabelModel = wpfChartSeriesModel.PieTotalLabelModel;
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			pieTotalLabelModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.NewValue);
			return pieTotalLabelModel?.TotalLabel;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))
			{
				WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)propertyGridCommandParameter.Model;
				PieTotalLabelModel pieTotalLabelModel = wpfChartSeriesModel.PieTotalLabelModel;
				object oldValue = pieTotalLabelModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Series", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())), this, null, oldValue, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value), pieTotalLabelModel.TotalLabel);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			PieSeries2D pieSeries2D = (PieSeries2D)((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(pieSeries2D.TotalLabel, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			IModelItem value = ModelExtensions.GetProperty(val, "TotalLabel", true).Value;
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetModelItemProperty(value, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
		}
	}
	public class SetSeriesTitleAttachedPropertyCommand : PropertyGridCommandBase
	{
		private const string seriesIndexKey = "Series";

		private const string titleIndexKey = "Title";

		private const string seriesDesigntimeIndexKey = "DesigntimeSeries";

		private WpfChartTitleModel TitleModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartTitleModel;

		public SetSeriesTitleAttachedPropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached propertyGridCommandParameterAttached = (PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.SetAttachedProperty(TitleModel.Title, historyItem.NewValue);
			return TitleModel.Title;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached propertyGridCommandParameterAttached = (PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.SetAttachedProperty(TitleModel.Title, historyItem.OldValue);
			return TitleModel.Title;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached propertyGridCommandParameterAttached = (PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached)parameter;
			object oldValue = propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.GetAttachedProperty(TitleModel.Title);
			propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.SetAttachedProperty(TitleModel.Title, propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.Value);
			ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[3];
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)TitleModel.Parent.Parent;
			array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfIndex());
			array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex());
			array[2] = new ElementIndexItem("Title", TitleModel.GetSelfIndex());
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, null, oldValue, propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.Value);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, TitleModel.Title);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Title"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached propertyGridCommandParameterAttached = (PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			if (series is PieSeries)
			{
				propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.SetAttachedProperty(((PieSeries)series).Titles[index], historyItem.NewValue);
				return;
			}
			if (series is FunnelSeries2D)
			{
				propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.SetAttachedProperty(((FunnelSeries2D)series).Titles[index], historyItem.NewValue);
				return;
			}
			throw new NotSupportedException($"The SetSeriesTitleAttachedPropertyCommand can't set attached property {propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.PropertyName}, because the series type {series.GetType().Name} is not supported");
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			//IL_00d4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			int num2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Title"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			IModelItem val2 = val.Properties["Titles"].Collection[num2];
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached propertyGridCommandParameterAttached = (PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			DXPropertyIdentifier val3 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val3))..ctor(propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.PropertyOwnerType, propertyGridCommandParameterAttached.PropertyName);
			val2.Properties[val3].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SetWaterfallSeriesPropertyCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public static IModelProperty GetWaterfallModelProperty(IModelItem chartModelItem, string propertyName)
		{
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			DXPropertyIdentifier val = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val))..ctor(typeof(WaterfallSeries2D), propertyName);
			return value.Properties[val];
		}

		protected SetWaterfallSeriesPropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private Series SetAttachedProperty(PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter, object value)
		{
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)commandParameter.Model;
			SetObjectProperty(value, commandParameter, (XYDiagram2D)wpfChartSeriesModel.Diagram.Diagram);
			return wpfChartSeriesModel.Series;
		}

		protected abstract object GetTarget(XYDiagram2D diagram);

		protected abstract void SetObjectProperty(object value, PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter, XYDiagram2D diagram);

		protected virtual ExecuteCommandInfo CreateExecuteCommandInfo(object parameter)
		{
			return new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter);
		}

		protected virtual object GetObjectProperty(PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter, object target)
		{
			return CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(target, commandParameter.PropertyName);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (propertyGridCommandParameter != null)
			{
				return propertyGridCommandParameter.Model is WpfChartSeriesModel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return SetAttachedProperty((PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter, historyItem.OldValue);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return SetAttachedProperty((PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))
			{
				WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)propertyGridCommandParameter.Model;
				XYDiagram2D diagram = (XYDiagram2D)wpfChartSeriesModel.Diagram.Diagram;
				object target = GetTarget(diagram);
				object objectProperty = GetObjectProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter, target);
				SetObjectProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.Value, propertyGridCommandParameter, diagram);
				return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(CreateExecuteCommandInfo(parameter), this, target, objectProperty, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value), wpfChartSeriesModel.Series);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetObjectProperty(historyItem.NewValue, (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter, (XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram);
		}
	}
