	public abstract class SubtotalCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected enum CommandAction
		{
			Add,
			Remove
		}

		private Action<SubtotalCollection, Subtotal> AddSubtotalAction => delegate(SubtotalCollection coll, Subtotal item)
		{
			coll.Add(item);
		};

		private Action<SubtotalCollection, Subtotal> RemoveSubtotalAction => delegate(SubtotalCollection coll, Subtotal item)
		{
			coll.Remove(item);
		};

		protected abstract CommandAction ActualAction { get; }

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public SubtotalCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private object DoSubtotalCollectionAction(XYDiagram2D diagram, HistoryItem historyItem, bool isUndo)
		{
			WaterfallValueOptionsBase valueOptions = WaterfallSeries2D.GetValueOptions(diagram);
			SubtotalCollection subtotals = valueOptions.Subtotals;
			switch (ActualAction)
			{
			case CommandAction.Add:
				if (isUndo)
				{
					RemoveSubtotalAction(subtotals, (Subtotal)historyItem.NewValue);
				}
				else
				{
					AddSubtotalAction(subtotals, (Subtotal)historyItem.NewValue);
				}
				break;
			case CommandAction.Remove:
				if (isUndo)
				{
					AddSubtotalAction(subtotals, (Subtotal)historyItem.OldValue);
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveSubtotalAction(subtotals, (Subtotal)historyItem.OldValue);
				}
				break;
			}
			return base.ChartModel.SelectedModel.ChartElement;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return DoSubtotalCollectionAction((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram, historyItem, isUndo: true);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return DoSubtotalCollectionAction((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram, historyItem, isUndo: false);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			DoSubtotalCollectionAction((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram, historyItem, isUndo: false);
		}
	}
	public class AddSubtotalCommand : SubtotalCommand
	{
		protected override CommandAction ActualAction => CommandAction.Add;

		public AddSubtotalCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)

		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)

			valueOptions.Subtotals.Add(subtotal);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, (ElementIndexItem[])null), this, null, null, subtotal), base.ChartModel.SelectedModel.ChartElement);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem value = SetWaterfallSeriesPropertyCommand.GetWaterfallModelProperty(chartModelItem, WaterfallSeries2D.ValueOptionsProperty.Name).Value;
			value.Properties["Subtotals"].Collection.Add(value.Context.CreateItem(typeof(Subtotal)));
		}
	}
	public class RemoveSubtotalCommand : SubtotalCommand
	{
		protected override CommandAction ActualAction => CommandAction.Remove;

		public RemoveSubtotalCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter is Subtotal;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WaterfallValueOptionsBase valueOptions = WaterfallSeries2D.GetValueOptions((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram);
			Subtotal subtotal = (Subtotal)parameter;
			int index = valueOptions.Subtotals.IndexOf(subtotal);
			valueOptions.Subtotals.Remove(subtotal);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Subtotal", index)), this, null, subtotal, null), base.ChartModel.SelectedModel.ChartElement);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem value = SetWaterfallSeriesPropertyCommand.GetWaterfallModelProperty(chartModelItem, WaterfallSeries2D.ValueOptionsProperty.Name).Value;
			value.Properties["Subtotals"].Collection.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Subtotal"]);
		}
	}

		private readonly string imageName = "BarItemImages/XYDiagram2DRotated";

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => imageName;

		public ToggleXYDiagram2DRotatedCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel == null)
			{
				return false;

			if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)

		private List<string> GetVisibleProperties(object element, string path = "")
		{
			PropertyDescriptorCollection properties = TypeDescriptor.GetProperties(element, new Attribute[1]
			{
				new PropertyFilterAttribute(PropertyFilterOptions.All)
			});
			List<string> list = new List<string>();
			foreach (PropertyDescriptor item in properties)
			{
				DependencyPropertyDescriptor dependencyPropertyDescriptor = DependencyPropertyDescriptor.FromProperty(item);
				if (dependencyPropertyDescriptor == null || dependencyPropertyDescriptor.IsReadOnly || dependencyPropertyDescriptor.IsAttached)
				{
					continue;
				}
				Type ownerType = dependencyPropertyDescriptor.DependencyProperty.OwnerType;
				if (!typeof(ChartElement).IsAssignableFrom(ownerType) && !excludedTypes.Contains(ownerType))
				{
					continue;
				}
				Type propertyType = dependencyPropertyDescriptor.DependencyProperty.PropertyType;
				bool flag = propertyType.IsClass || propertyType.IsInterface;
				if (!flag || excludedTypes.Contains(propertyType))
				{
					list.Add(path + item.Name);
					if (flag)
					{
						object value = dependencyPropertyDescriptor.GetValue(element);
						list.AddRange(GetVisibleProperties(value, path + item.Name + "."));
					}
				}
			}
			return list;
		}

		private void propertyGrid_Sort(object sender, PropertyGridSortingEventArgs args)
		{
			List<RowInfo> list = new List<RowInfo>();
			List<string> visibleProperties = GetVisibleProperties(SelectedObject);
			foreach (RowInfo item in args.SourceCollection)
			{
				if (item.IsCategory || visibleProperties.Contains(item.FullPath))
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
			}
			args.ResultCollection = list;
			args.Handled = true;
		}

	internal struct PlaceholderInfo
	{
		private int placeholderStart;

		private int placeholderLength;

		private int placeholderEnd;

		private string placeholder;

		private string placeholderWithFormat;

		private string format;

		public int PlaceholderStart => placeholderStart;

		public int PlaceholderLength => placeholderLength;

		public int PlaceholderEnd => placeholderEnd;

		public string Placeholder => placeholder;

		public string PlaceholderWithFormat => placeholderWithFormat;

		public string Format => format;

		public string WindowTitle => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_WindowTitle);

		public string PlaceholdersLabelText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_PlaceholdersLabelText);

		public string FormatLabelText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_FormatLabelText);

		public string OkButtonText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_OkButtonText);

		public string CancelButtonText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_CancelButtonText);

		public PlaceholderInfo(int placeholderStart, int placeholderLength, string placeholder, string placeholderWithFormat)
		{
			this.placeholderStart = placeholderStart;
			this.placeholderLength = placeholderLength;
			this.placeholder = placeholder;
			this.placeholderWithFormat = placeholderWithFormat;
			placeholderEnd = placeholderStart + placeholderLength;
			format = string.Empty;
			int num = placeholderWithFormat.IndexOf(':');
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				format = placeholderWithFormat.Substring(num + 1);
			}
		}
	}
	internal struct DisplayFormatGroup
	{

		public DisplayFormatGroup(DisplayFormatGroupType type, IEnumerable<DisplayFormatItem> formatGroupSource)

	public class PatternEditor : ThemedWindow, IComponentConnector
	{
		private IPatternValuesSource patternSource;

		private string[] availablePlaceholders;

		private bool placeholderSelected;

		private bool placeholderSelectionChanged;

		private List<PlaceholderInfo> placeholdersInfo = new List<PlaceholderInfo>();

		private PlaceholderInfo selectedPlaceholder;

		private bool suppressCarterValidation;

		private DisplayFormatGroup[] formatGroups;

		private Brush initialSelectionBrush;

		internal PatternEditor PatternEditorWindow;

		internal ListBoxEdit lbPlaceholders;

		internal SimpleButton btnAdd;

		internal SimpleButton btnAddAll;

		internal TextBox tePattern;

		internal TextBox tbSample;

		internal ComboBox cbFormat;

		internal ListBoxEdit lbStandardTypes;

		internal SimpleButton btnOk;

		private bool _contentLoaded;

		private string CurrentPlaceholderDescription => (string)lbPlaceholders.SelectedItem;

		public string WindowTitle => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_WindowTitle);

		public string PlaceholdersLabelText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_PlaceholdersLabelText);

		public string PatternLabelText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_PatternLabelText);

		public string FormatLabelText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_FormatLabelText);

		public string OkButtonText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_OkButtonText);

		public string CancelButtonText => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.PatternEditor_CancelButtonText);

		public string Pattern => tePattern.Text;

		public PatternEditor(Theme currentTheme, string pattern, string[] placeholders, IPatternValuesSource patternSource)
		{
			InitializeComponent();
			try
			{
				ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, currentTheme);
			}
			catch (Exception ex)
			{
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning("Unable to set theme. Exception occurred: " + ex.Message);
			}
			tePattern.Text = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(pattern) ? null : pattern);
			availablePlaceholders = placeholders;
			this.patternSource = patternSource;
			initialSelectionBrush = tePattern.SelectionBrush;
			FillStandardItemsListBox();
			InitializeFormatItems();
			UpdatePlaceholdersInfo();
			UpdateSample();
		}

		private void FillStandardItemsListBox()
		{
			string[] array = availablePlaceholders;
			foreach (string pattern in array)
			{
				lbPlaceholders.Items.Add((object)PatternEditorUtils.GetDescriptionForPatternPlaceholder(pattern));
			}
		}

		private void InitializeFormatItems()
		{
			formatGroups = new DisplayFormatGroup[5];
			formatGroups[0] = new DisplayFormatGroup((DisplayFormatGroupType)5, DisplayFormatTextControl.DisplayFormatDateTime);
			formatGroups[1] = new DisplayFormatGroup((DisplayFormatGroupType)1, DisplayFormatTextControl.DisplayFormatNumber);
			formatGroups[2] = new DisplayFormatGroup((DisplayFormatGroupType)2, DisplayFormatTextControl.DisplayFormatPercent);
			formatGroups[3] = new DisplayFormatGroup((DisplayFormatGroupType)3, DisplayFormatTextControl.DisplayFormatCurrency);
			formatGroups[4] = new DisplayFormatGroup((DisplayFormatGroupType)4, DisplayFormatTextControl.DisplayFormatSpecial);
			cbFormat.Items.Clear();
			DisplayFormatGroup[] array = formatGroups;
			foreach (DisplayFormatGroup displayFormatGroup in array)
			{
				cbFormat.Items.Add(displayFormatGroup);
			}
			cbFormat.SelectedIndex = 0;
		}

		private void UpdatePlaceholdersInfo()
		{
			placeholdersInfo.Clear();
			string text = tePattern.Text;
			string[] array = text.Split('{');
			if (array.Length <= 1)
			{
				return;
			}
			int[] array2 = new int[array.Length - 1];
			int num = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
			{
				if (text[i] == '{')
				{
					array2[num++] = i + 1;
				}
			}
			num = ((array2[0] != 0) ? (-1) : 0);
			string[] array3 = array;
			foreach (string text2 in array3)
			{
				if (text2.Contains("}") && num >= 0)
				{
					int placeholderStart = array2[num];
					string text3 = text2.Substring(0, text2.IndexOf('}'));
					string placeholder = text3;
					if (text3.Contains(":"))
					{
						placeholder = text2.Substring(0, text2.IndexOf(':'));
					}
					int length = text3.Length;
					PlaceholderInfo item = new PlaceholderInfo(placeholderStart, length, placeholder, text3);
					placeholdersInfo.Add(item);
				}
				num++;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSample()
		{
			string text = ChartLocalizer.GetString(ChartStringId.PatternEditorPreviewCaption);
			if (placeholderSelected)
			{
				text = PatternEditorUtils.GetPatternText("{" + selectedPlaceholder.PlaceholderWithFormat + "}", patternSource);
			}
			tbSample.Text = text;
			tbSample.IsEnabled = placeholderSelected;
		}

		private void ValidateCaretPosition()
		{
			placeholderSelectionChanged = false;
			bool flag = placeholderSelected;
			placeholderSelected = false;
			int selectionStart = tePattern.SelectionStart;
			foreach (PlaceholderInfo item in placeholdersInfo)
			{
				if (selectionStart >= item.PlaceholderStart && selectionStart <= item.PlaceholderEnd)
				{
					placeholderSelected = true;
					if (!selectedPlaceholder.Equals(item))
					{
						placeholderSelectionChanged = true;
					}
					selectedPlaceholder = item;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (placeholderSelected != flag)
			{
				placeholderSelectionChanged = true;
			}
			UpdateSample();
		}

		private void DeselectAll()
		{
			suppressCarterValidation = true;
			int selectionStart = tePattern.SelectionStart;
			tePattern.SelectionStart = 0;
			tePattern.SelectionLength = tePattern.Text.Length;
			tePattern.SelectionBrush = initialSelectionBrush;
			tePattern.SelectionLength = 0;
			tePattern.SelectionStart = selectionStart;
			suppressCarterValidation = false;
		}

		private void SelectPlaceholderDescription()
		{
			string descriptionForPatternPlaceholder = PatternEditorUtils.GetDescriptionForPatternPlaceholder(selectedPlaceholder.Placeholder);
			lbPlaceholders.SelectedItem = descriptionForPatternPlaceholder;
		}

		private void AddFormat()
		{
			suppressCarterValidation = true;
			if (lbStandardTypes.SelectedIndex >= 0 && selectedPlaceholder.Format != lbStandardTypes.SelectedItem.ToString())
			{
				tePattern.SelectionStart = selectedPlaceholder.PlaceholderStart;
				tePattern.SelectionLength = selectedPlaceholder.PlaceholderLength;
				tePattern.SelectedText = selectedPlaceholder.Placeholder + ":" + lbStandardTypes.SelectedItem;
			}
			suppressCarterValidation = false;
		}

		private void AddPlaceholder()
		{
			if (placeholderSelected)
			{
				MoveCaretOutOfPlaceholder();
			}
			tePattern.SelectedText = "{" + PatternEditorUtils.GetPatternPlaceholderForDescription(CurrentPlaceholderDescription) + "}";
			tePattern.CaretIndex = tePattern.SelectionStart;
			tePattern.Focus();
		}

		private void MoveCaretOutOfPlaceholder()
		{
			tePattern.SelectionStart = selectedPlaceholder.PlaceholderEnd + 1;
		}

		private void SelectPatternFormat()
		{
			//IL_0078: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_007f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			suppressCarterValidation = true;
			bool flag = false;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedPlaceholder.Format))
			{
				DisplayFormatGroup[] array = formatGroups;
				for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
				{
					DisplayFormatGroup displayFormatGroup = array[i];
					foreach (string formatString in displayFormatGroup.FormatStrings)
					{
						if (formatString == selectedPlaceholder.Format)
						{
							if (((DisplayFormatGroup)cbFormat.SelectedItem).Type != displayFormatGroup.Type)
							{
								cbFormat.SelectedItem = displayFormatGroup;
							}
							if ((string)lbStandardTypes.SelectedItem != formatString)
							{
								lbStandardTypes.SelectedItem = formatString;
							}
							lbStandardTypes.ScrollIntoView((object)formatString);
							flag = true;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if (selectedPlaceholder.PlaceholderWithFormat.Contains(":") && !flag)
			{
				lbStandardTypes.SelectedIndex = -1;
			}
			suppressCarterValidation = false;
		}

		private void SelectNearestPlaceholder()
		{
			int selectionStart = tePattern.SelectionStart;
			int num = tePattern.Text.Length + 1;
			int selectionStart2 = selectionStart;
			foreach (PlaceholderInfo item in placeholdersInfo)
			{
				int num2 = Math.Abs(item.PlaceholderStart - selectionStart);
				int num3 = Math.Abs(selectionStart - item.PlaceholderEnd);
				if (num2 < num || num3 <= num)
				{
					num = Math.Min(num2, num3);
					selectionStart2 = item.PlaceholderStart;
				}
			}
			tePattern.SelectionStart = selectionStart2;
		}

		private void lbPlaceholders_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			tePattern.Focus();
		}

		private void lbPlaceholders_MouseDoubleClick(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			AddPlaceholder();
		}

		private void btnAdd_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			AddPlaceholder();
		}

		private void btnAddAll_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (placeholderSelected)
			{
				MoveCaretOutOfPlaceholder();
			}
			foreach (string item in (CollectionBase)(object)lbPlaceholders.Items)
			{
				tePattern.SelectedText = "{" + PatternEditorUtils.GetPatternPlaceholderForDescription(item) + "}";
				tePattern.CaretIndex = tePattern.SelectionStart;
			}
			tePattern.Focus();
		}

		private void tePattern_TextChanged(object sender, TextChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePlaceholdersInfo();
			if (!suppressCarterValidation && tePattern.SelectionLength == 0)
			{
				ValidateCaretPosition();
				if (!placeholderSelected && placeholderSelectionChanged)
				{
					DeselectAll();
				}
			}
		}

		private void tePattern_SelectionChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdatePlaceholdersInfo();
			if (suppressCarterValidation || tePattern.SelectionLength != 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			ValidateCaretPosition();
			if (placeholderSelectionChanged)
			{
				if (placeholderSelected)
				{
					SelectPlaceholderDescription();
					SelectPatternFormat();
				}
				else
				{
					DeselectAll();
				}
			}
		}

		private void cbFormat_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			((CollectionBase)(object)lbStandardTypes.Items).Clear();
			lbStandardTypes.Items.AddRange((object[])((DisplayFormatGroup)cbFormat.SelectedItem).FormatStrings.ToArray());
		}

		private void lbStandardTypes_SelectedIndexChanged(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (placeholderSelected)
			{
				AddFormat();
				ValidateCaretPosition();
			}
			tePattern.Focus();
		}

		private void lbStandardTypes_MouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!placeholderSelected)
			{
				SelectNearestPlaceholder();
			}
			if (placeholderSelected && string.IsNullOrEmpty(selectedPlaceholder.Format))
			{
				AddFormat();
				ValidateCaretPosition();
			}
			tePattern.Focus();
		}

		private void btnOk_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			((Window)this).DialogResult = true;
			((Window)this).Close();
		}

	public class OptionsPropertyGridUC : PropertyGridUC
	{
		private void SetPropertyDefinitions()
		{
			propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition());
			List<string> list = new List<string> { "OptionsWholeRange.MinValue", "OptionsWholeRange.MaxValue", "OptionsVisualRange.MinValue", "OptionsVisualRange.MaxValue", "OptionsTitle.Content", "OptionsTitle.HorizontalAlignment", "OptionsTitle.Alignment" };
			foreach (string item in list)
			{
				propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition
				{
					Path = item
				});
			}
			ControlTemplate rowTemplate = (ControlTemplate)base.Resources["generalRowTemplate"];
			foreach (DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition in propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions)
			{
				propertyDefinition.RowTemplate = rowTemplate;
			}
			propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions.Add((PropertyDefinitionBase)base.Resources["categoryTemplate"]);
			propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions.Add((PropertyDefinitionBase)base.Resources["booleanPropertyTemplate"]);
			List<string> list2 = new List<string> { "OptionsWholeRange", "OptionsVisualRange", "OptionsTitle" };
			ControlTemplate rowTemplate2 = (ControlTemplate)base.Resources["expandableRowTemplate"];
			foreach (string item2 in list2)
			{
				propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition
				{
					Path = item2,
					RowTemplate = rowTemplate2
				});
			}
			List<string> list3 = new List<string> { "Title", "Title.Content", "Title.Visible" };
			foreach (string item3 in list3)
			{
				propertyGrid.PropertyDefinitions.Add(new DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition
				{
					Path = item3,
					RowTemplate = new ControlTemplate()
				});
			}
		}

		private void PropertyGridSort(object sender, PropertyGridSortingEventArgs args)
		{
			List<RowInfo> list = new List<RowInfo>();
			foreach (RowInfo item in args.SourceCollection)
			{
				string text = (string)item.Description;
				if (text == "PropertyForOptions")
				{
					list.Add(item);
				}
				foreach (RowInfo child in item.Children)
				{
					text = (string)child.Description;
					if (text == "PropertyForOptions")
					{
						list.Add(item);
						break;
					}
					foreach (RowInfo child2 in child.Children)
					{
						text = (string)child2.Description;
						if (text == "PropertyForOptions")
						{
							list.Add(child);
							break;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			args.ResultCollection = list;
			args.Handled = true;
		}

		private void PropertyGridCustomExpand(object sender, CustomExpandEventArgs args)
		{
			args.IsExpanded = true;
			args.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void SetPropertiesFilters()
		{
			propertyGrid.ShowGridLines = false;
			propertyGrid.ShowSearchBox = false;
			propertyGrid.ShowToolPanel = false;
			propertyGrid.ShowMenuButtonInRows = false;
			propertyGrid.HighlightingMode = HeaderHighlightingMode.None;
			SetPropertyDefinitions();
			propertyGrid.SortMode = PropertyGridSortMode.Custom;
			propertyGrid.Sort += PropertyGridSort;
			propertyGrid.CustomExpand += PropertyGridCustomExpand;
			ScrollViewer.SetVerticalScrollBarVisibility(propertyGrid, ScrollBarVisibility.Auto);
			propertyGrid.BorderThickness = new Thickness(0.0);
			propertyGrid.Background = Brushes.Transparent;
		}
	}
	public class ToolBarItemTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate ButtonItemTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate SplitButtonItemTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			if (item != null && item is BarItemViewModelBase)
			{
				if (item is BarButtonItemViewModel)
				{
					return ButtonItemTemplate;
				}
				return SplitButtonItemTemplate;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public struct PaletteImage
	{
		private readonly Palette palette;

		private readonly DrawingImage image;

		public Palette Palette => palette;

		public DrawingImage Image => image;

		public PaletteImage(Palette palette, DrawingImage image)
		{
			this.palette = palette;
			this.image = image;
		}
	}
	public static class PaletteUtils
	{
		public static IEnumerable<PaletteImage> GeneratePaletteImages(double indent, Size colorElementSize)
		{
			List<PaletteImage> list = new List<PaletteImage>();
			IEnumerable<Type> enumerable = from type in Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)).GetTypes()
				where (type.IsSubclassOf(typeof(PredefinedPalette)) && !type.IsAbstract) || type == typeof(CustomPalette)
				select type;
			foreach (Type item in enumerable)
			{
				Palette palette = (Palette)Activator.CreateInstance(item);
				DrawingGroup drawingGroup = new DrawingGroup();
				for (int num = 0; num < palette.Count; num++)
				{
					Color color = palette[num];
					double x = (double)(num + 1) * indent + (double)(num + 1) * colorElementSize.Width;
					Rect rect = new Rect(new Point(x, indent), colorElementSize);
					RectangleGeometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
					GeometryDrawing value = new GeometryDrawing(new SolidColorBrush(color), new Pen(), geometry);
					drawingGroup.Children.Add(value);
				}
				DrawingImage drawingImage = new DrawingImage(drawingGroup);
				drawingImage.Freeze();
				list.Add(new PaletteImage(palette, drawingImage));
			}
			return list;
		}
	}
	public sealed class NonVisualSeriesPresentation
	{
		public Series Series { get; private set; }

		public string TextPresentation
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetLocalizedSeriesTypeName(Series.GetType()) + " [" + Series.DisplayName + "]";
			}
		}

		public NonVisualSeriesPresentation(Series s)
		{
			Series = s;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return TextPresentation;
		}
	}

	public sealed class AxisModelToVisibleRangeMinValueConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is WpfChartAxisModel))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)value;
			SetAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand setAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand = (SetAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand)parameter;
			object visualRangeMinValue = wpfChartAxisModel.VisualRangeMinValue;
			if (visualRangeMinValue == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (setAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand.ScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical && !(visualRangeMinValue is string) && !(visualRangeMinValue is DateTime) && !(visualRangeMinValue is TimeSpan))
			{
				return System.Convert.ToDouble(visualRangeMinValue);
			}
			if (setAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand.ScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime && visualRangeMinValue is DateTime)
			{
				return System.Convert.ToDateTime(visualRangeMinValue);
			}
			if (setAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand.ScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan && visualRangeMinValue is TimeSpan)
			{
				return (TimeSpan)visualRangeMinValue;
			}
			if (setAxisVisualRangeMinValueCommand.ScaleType == ScaleType.Qualitative)
			{
				return System.Convert.ToString(visualRangeMinValue);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}

	public sealed class SelectedModelToFinIndicatorNumericalArgument1Converter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is WpfChartIndicatorModel))
			{
				return null;
			}
			WpfChartIndicatorModel wpfChartIndicatorModel = (WpfChartIndicatorModel)value;
			ChangeFinancialIndicatorArgument1Command changeFinancialIndicatorArgument1Command = (ChangeFinancialIndicatorArgument1Command)parameter;
			object argument = wpfChartIndicatorModel.Argument1;
			if (argument == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (changeFinancialIndicatorArgument1Command.ScaleType == ScaleType.Numerical)
			{
				double num;
				try
				{
					num = System.Convert.ToDouble(argument);
				}
				catch
				{
					num = 0.0;
				}
				return num;
			}
			if (changeFinancialIndicatorArgument1Command.ScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
			{
				DateTime dateTime;
				try
				{
					dateTime = System.Convert.ToDateTime(argument);
				}
				catch
				{
					dateTime = DateTime.Now;
				}
				return dateTime;
			}
			if (changeFinancialIndicatorArgument1Command.ScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
			{
				TimeSpan timeSpan;
				try
				{
					timeSpan = ((!(argument is TimeSpan)) ? TimeSpan.Parse(argument.ToString()) : ((TimeSpan)argument));
				}
				catch
				{
					timeSpan = TimeSpan.Zero;
				}
				return timeSpan;
			}
			return System.Convert.ToString(argument);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel : PropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly SetCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		protected override string Name => "Calculated Field";

		internal ChartCalculatedField CalculatedField { get; private set; }

		[Category("Common")]
		public string FieldName
		{
			get
			{
				return CalculatedField.FieldName;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("FieldName", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Common")]
		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				return CalculatedField.DisplayName;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("DisplayName", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public ChartCalculatedFieldType FieldType
		{
			get
			{
				return CalculatedField.FieldType;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("FieldType", value);
			}
		}

		[Browsable(false)]
		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return CalculatedField.DataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("DataSource", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public string DataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return CalculatedField.DataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("DataMember", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Data")]
		public string Expression
		{
			get
			{
				return CalculatedField.Expression;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Expression", value);
			}
		}

		public WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, ChartCalculatedField field)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			CalculatedField = field;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetCalculatedFieldPropertyCommand(chartModel, field);
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly AddCalculatedFieldCommand addCommand;

		private readonly RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand removeCommand;

		public AddCalculatedFieldCommand AddCommand => addCommand;

		public RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand RemoveCommand => removeCommand;

		private WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		public WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			addCommand = new AddCalculatedFieldCommand(ChartModel);
			removeCommand = new RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand(ChartModel);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.ModelElement == null)
					{
						AddCalculatedFieldCommand addCalculatedFieldCommand = AddCommand;
						((ICommand)addCalculatedFieldCommand).Execute((object)null);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand removeCalculatedFieldCommand = RemoveCommand;
					((ICommand)removeCalculatedFieldCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.CalculatedField);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class BarItemViewModel : BarItemViewModelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty commandParameterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("CommandParameter", typeof(object), typeof(BarItemViewModel));

		private ICommand command;

		private bool isEnabled;

		private ChartCommandBase ChartCommand => command as ChartCommandBase;

		private ToolBarCommandBase ToolBarCommand => command as ToolBarCommandBase;

		public ICommand Command => command;

		public object CommandParameter
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(commandParameterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(commandParameterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public KeyGesture KeyGesture { get; set; }

		public BarItemAlignment Alignment { get; set; }

		public bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return isEnabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isEnabled != value)
				{
					isEnabled = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("IsEnabled");
				}
			}
		}

		public void RaisePropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			OnPropertyChanged(propertyName);
		}

		public BarItemViewModel(ICommand command)
		{
			this.command = command;
			if (ChartCommand != null)
			{
				ChartCommand.RegisterForUpdate();
				base.Caption = ChartCommand.Caption;
				this.command.CanExecuteChanged += CommandCanExecuteChanged;
			}
			if (ToolBarCommand != null)
			{
				ToolBarCommand.RegisterForUpdate();
				this.command.CanExecuteChanged += CommandCanExecuteChanged;
			}
			UpdateIsEnabled();
		}

		private void CommandCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateIsEnabled();
		}

		private void UpdateIsEnabled()
		{
			IsEnabled = command != null && command.CanExecute(CommandParameter);
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			if (command != null)
			{
				command.CanExecuteChanged -= CommandCanExecuteChanged;
				command = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class BarButtonItemViewModel : BarItemViewModel
	{
		public BarButtonItemViewModel(ICommand command)
			: base(command)
		{
		}
	}
	public class DataBrowserViewModel : ViewModelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataSource", typeof(DataSourceItemViewModel), typeof(DataBrowserViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(ValuePropertyChanged));

		private readonly ObservableCollection<DataSourceItemViewModel> dataSources = new ObservableCollection<DataSourceItemViewModel>();

		private readonly ObservableCollection<DataMemberViewModel> dataMembers = new ObservableCollection<DataMemberViewModel>();

		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly ImageSource arrowImage;

		private List<DataBrowserTreeNode> itemsSource;

		private bool canSelectDataSource;

		private ChartModelElement selectedModel;

		private readonly ChartCommandBase addCalculatedFieldCommand;

		private readonly ChartCommandBase removeCalculatedFieldCommand;

		public DataSourceItemViewModel DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return (DataSourceItemViewModel)GetValue(DataSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DataSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<DataSourceItemViewModel> DataSources => dataSources;

		public ObservableCollection<DataMemberViewModel> DataMembers => dataMembers;

		public List<DataBrowserTreeNode> ItemsSource
		{
			get
			{
				return itemsSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (itemsSource != value)
				{
					itemsSource = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ItemsSource");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool CanSelectDataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return canSelectDataSource;
			}
			set
			{
				if (canSelectDataSource != value)
				{
					canSelectDataSource = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("CanSelectDataSource");
				}
			}
		}

		public string ChooseDataSourceCaption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChooseDataSource);

		public string DragDataMembersCaption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DragDataMembers);

		public ICommand AddCalculatedFieldCommand => addCalculatedFieldCommand;

		public ICommand RemoveCalculatedFieldCommand => removeCalculatedFieldCommand;

		public ImageSource ArrowImage => arrowImage;

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DataBrowserViewModel dataBrowserViewModel)
			{
				dataBrowserViewModel.UpdateItemsSource();
			}
		}

		public DataBrowserViewModel(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			chartModel.PropertyChanged += OnChartModelPropertyChanged;
			arrowImage = GlyphUtils.GetBarImageByPath("DataTabImages/Arrow");
			selectedModel = chartModel.SelectedModel;
			UpdateDataSourceList();
			CreateDataMembers();
			UpdateDataMembers();
			addCalculatedFieldCommand = ((WpfChartPropertyGridModel)chartModel.PropertyGridModel).CalculatedFields.AddCommand;
			addCalculatedFieldCommand.CommandExecuted += CalculatedFieldCommandExecuted;
			removeCalculatedFieldCommand = ((WpfChartPropertyGridModel)chartModel.PropertyGridModel).CalculatedFields.RemoveCommand;
			removeCalculatedFieldCommand.CommandExecuted += CalculatedFieldCommandExecuted;
		}

		private void CalculatedFieldCommandExecuted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateItemsSource();
		}

		private void OnChartModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "SelectedModel" && selectedModel != chartModel.SelectedModel)
			{
				selectedModel = chartModel.SelectedModel;
				UpdateDataSourceList();
			}
			UpdateDataMembers();
		}

		private void UpdateDataSourceList()
		{
			dataSources.Clear();
			CanSelectDataSource = false;
			if (selectedModel is WpfChartModel wpfChartModel)
			{
				dataSources.Add(new DataSourceItemViewModel(DataBrowserCaptions.ChartDataSource, wpfChartModel.DataSource));
				DataSource = dataSources[0];
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(selectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel))
				{
					return;
				}
				if (wpfChartSeriesModel.PredefinedDataSource == null)
				{
					dataSources.Add(new DataSourceItemViewModel(DataBrowserCaptions.NoneDataSource, null));
					if (chartModel.DataSource != null)
					{
						dataSources.Add(new DataSourceItemViewModel(DataBrowserCaptions.ChartDataSource, chartModel.DataSource));
						CanSelectDataSource = true;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					dataSources.Add(new DataSourceItemViewModel(DataBrowserCaptions.SeriesDataSource, wpfChartSeriesModel.PredefinedDataSource));
				}
				DataSource = ((wpfChartSeriesModel.DataSource != null && wpfChartSeriesModel.DataSource == chartModel.DataSource) ? dataSources[1] : dataSources[0]);
			}
		}

		private void CreateDataMembers()
		{
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropSeriesDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropArgumentDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropValueDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropValue2DataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropWeightDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropLowDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropHighDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropOpenDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropCloseDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropColorDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
			dataMembers.Add(new DataMemberViewModel(new DragDropToolTipHintDataMemberCommand(chartModel)));
		}

		private void UpdateDataMembers()
		{
			foreach (DataMemberViewModel dataMember in dataMembers)
			{
				dataMember.Update();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateItemsSource()
		{
			DataBrowserPickManager dataBrowserPickManager = new DataBrowserPickManager(new ScaleType[4]
			{
				ScaleType.Qualitative,
				ScaleType.Numerical,
				ScaleType.DateTime,
				ScaleType.TimeSpan
			}, chartModel.Chart.CalculatedFields);
			List<DataBrowserTreeNode> list = new List<DataBrowserTreeNode>();
			Collection<Pair<object, string>> collection = new Collection<Pair<object, string>>();
			collection.Add(new Pair<object, string>((DataSource != null) ? DataSource.DataSourceObject : null, ""));
			((PickManagerBase)dataBrowserPickManager).FillContent((IList)list, collection, true);
			ItemsSource = list;
		}

		private ScaleType GetNodeType(DataBrowserTreeNode node, DataMemberInfo dataMember)
		{
			if (((INode)node).DataMember == dataMember.DataMember)
			{
				return node.Type;
			}
			foreach (DataBrowserTreeNode childNode in node.ChildNodes)
			{
				ScaleType nodeType = GetNodeType(childNode, dataMember);
				if (nodeType != ScaleType.Auto)
				{
					return nodeType;
				}
			}
			return ScaleType.Auto;
		}

		public ScaleType GetDataMemberType(DataMemberInfo dataMember)
		{
			foreach (DataBrowserTreeNode item in itemsSource)
			{
				ScaleType nodeType = GetNodeType(item, dataMember);
				if (nodeType != ScaleType.Auto)
				{
					return nodeType;
				}
			}
			return ScaleType.Auto;
		}
	}

			}

		{

		public DataMemberViewModel(DragDropDataMemberCommandBase command)

				command.CommandExecuted += OnCommandExecuted;
				Caption = command.Caption;

		}

	public class ChartDesignerDropControl : DropTargetControl
	{
		private readonly Cursor applyCursor;

		private readonly Cursor noCursor;

		private DataBrowserViewModel dataBrowserModel;

		private DataBrowserViewModel DataBrowserModel
		{
			get
			{
				if (dataBrowserModel == null)
				{
					dataBrowserModel = (DataBrowserViewModel)LayoutHelper.FindElementByName(LayoutHelper.GetRoot((FrameworkElement)this), "dataMembersPanel").DataContext;
				}
				return dataBrowserModel;
			}
		}

		private bool HasDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Command is DragDropDataMemberCommandBase && ((DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)base.Command).DataMember != null)
				{
					return !string.IsNullOrEmpty(((DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)base.Command).DataMember.DataMember);
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		private static void ContentPropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartDesignerDropControl chartDesignerDropControl = d as ChartDesignerDropControl;
			DragDropDataMemberCommandBase dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = e.NewValue as DragDropDataMemberCommandBase;
			chartDesignerDropControl?.UpdateState();
		}

		static ChartDesignerDropControl()
		{
			Type typeFromHandle = typeof(ChartDesignerDropControl);
			ContentControl.ContentProperty.OverrideMetadata(typeFromHandle, new FrameworkPropertyMetadata(ContentPropertyChanged));
		}

		public ChartDesignerDropControl()
		{
			applyCursor = new Cursor(AssemblyHelper.GetResourceStream(Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartDesignerDropControl)), "ImagesBarDesigner/Apply.cur", true));
			noCursor = new Cursor(AssemblyHelper.GetResourceStream(Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartDesignerDropControl)), "ImagesBarDesigner/No.cur", true));
		}

		private DataMemberInfo ExtractDataMemberInfo(DragEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_002f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0036: Expected O, but got Unknown
			DataMemberInfo result = null;
			string[] formats = e.Data.GetFormats();
			if (formats.Length != 0)
			{
				DragDropDataMemberCommandBase dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = null;
				object data = e.Data.GetData(formats[0]);
				if (data is RecordDragDropData)
				{
					RecordDragDropData val = (RecordDragDropData)data;
					if (val != null && val.Records.Length != 0 && val.Records[0] is DataBrowserTreeNode { IsEmpty: false } dataBrowserTreeNode)
					{
						result = new DataMemberInfo(dataBrowserTreeNode.GetFullDisplayName(), ((INode)dataBrowserTreeNode).DataMember);
					}
				}
				else if (data is DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)
				{
					dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = (DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)data;
					if (dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember != null)
					{
						result = dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember;
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private ScaleType ExtractScaleType(DragEventArgs e)
		{
			//IL_002c: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0033: Expected O, but got Unknown
			ScaleType result = ScaleType.Auto;
			string[] formats = e.Data.GetFormats();
			if (formats.Length != 0)
			{
				DragDropDataMemberCommandBase dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = null;
				object data = e.Data.GetData(formats[0]);
				if (data is RecordDragDropData)
				{
					RecordDragDropData val = (RecordDragDropData)data;
					if (val != null && val.Records.Length != 0 && val.Records[0] is DataBrowserTreeNode { IsEmpty: false } dataBrowserTreeNode)
					{
						result = dataBrowserTreeNode.Type;
					}
				}
				else if (data is DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)
				{
					dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = (DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)data;
					if (dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember != null)
					{
						result = DataBrowserModel.GetDataMemberType(dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember);
					}
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private void UpdateState()
		{
			if (HasDataMember)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "HasData", useTransitions: true);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: true);
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			base.OnApplyTemplate();
			UpdateState();
		}

		protected override void OnMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseDown(e);
			if (base.Command is DragDropDataMemberCommandBase data && HasDataMember)
			{
				DragDropEffects dragDropEffects = DragDrop.DoDragDrop(this, data, DragDropEffects.All);
				if (dragDropEffects == DragDropEffects.None || dragDropEffects == DragDropEffects.Copy)
				{
					base.Command.Execute(null);
					VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: true);
				}
			}
		}

		protected override void OnGiveFeedback(GiveFeedbackEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnGiveFeedback(e);
			e.UseDefaultCursors = false;
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnDragEnter(DragEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnDragEnter(e);
			VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "DataOver", useTransitions: true);
			DataMemberInfo dataMemberInfo = ExtractDataMemberInfo(e);
			string text = ((dataMemberInfo != null) ? dataMemberInfo.DataMember : "");
			DragDropDataMemberCommandBase dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = (DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)base.Command;
			string text2 = ((dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember != null) ? dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember.DataMember : "");
			ScaleType item = ExtractScaleType(e);
			if (dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.AllowedDataTypes.Contains(item))
			{
				if (text == text2)
				{
					Mouse.SetCursor(noCursor);
				}
				else
				{
					Mouse.SetCursor(applyCursor);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				Mouse.SetCursor(noCursor);
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnMouseEnter(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseEnter(e);
			if (HasDataMember)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "DataOver", useTransitions: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnMouseLeave(MouseEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnMouseLeave(e);
			if (HasDataMember)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "HasData", useTransitions: true);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnDragLeave(DragEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnDragLeave(e);
			if (HasDataMember)
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "HasData", useTransitions: true);
			}
			else
			{
				VisualStateManager.GoToState(this, "Normal", useTransitions: true);
			}
			Mouse.SetCursor(Cursors.No);
			e.Handled = true;
		}

		protected override void OnDrop(DragEventArgs e)
		{
			if (base.Command == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			string[] formats = e.Data.GetFormats();
			if (formats.Length != 0)
			{
				DragDropDataMemberCommandBase dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = null;
				DataMemberInfo parameter = ExtractDataMemberInfo(e);
				object data = e.Data.GetData(formats[0]);
				if (data is DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)
				{
					dragDropDataMemberCommandBase = (DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)data;
					parameter = dragDropDataMemberCommandBase.DataMember;
				}
				if (((DragDropDataMemberCommandBase)base.Command).AllowedDataTypes.Contains(ExtractScaleType(e)))
				{
					e.Effects = ((dragDropDataMemberCommandBase != base.Command) ? DragDropEffects.Copy : DragDropEffects.Move);
					base.Command.Execute(parameter);
				}
				UpdateState();
			}
			e.Handled = true;
		}
	}

	public class GalleryViewModel : DependencyObject
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty filterProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Filter", typeof(string), typeof(GalleryViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(OnFilterChanged));

		private readonly ListCollectionView groups;

		public string Filter
		{
			get
			{
				return (string)GetValue(filterProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(filterProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ListCollectionView Groups => groups;

		private static void OnFilterChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(d is GalleryViewModel galleryViewModel))
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GalleryItemGroupViewModel item in galleryViewModel.Groups.SourceCollection)
			{
				item.Items.Refresh();
			}
			galleryViewModel.Groups.Refresh();
		}

		public GalleryViewModel(IList<GalleryItemGroupViewModel> groupSource)
		{
			groups = new ListCollectionView((IList)groupSource);
			groups.Filter = delegate(object group)
			{
				GalleryItemGroupViewModel galleryItemGroupViewModel = group as GalleryItemGroupViewModel;
				bool flag = true;
				if (galleryItemGroupViewModel != null)
				{
					{
						IEnumerator enumerator2 = ((IEnumerable)galleryItemGroupViewModel.Items).GetEnumerator();
						try
						{
							if (enumerator2.MoveNext())
							{
								object current2 = enumerator2.Current;
								flag = false;
							}
						}
						finally
						{
							IDisposable disposable = enumerator2 as IDisposable;
							if (disposable != null)
							{
								disposable.Dispose();
							}
						}
					}
				}
				return !flag;
			};
			foreach (GalleryItemGroupViewModel item in groupSource)
			{
				item.Items.Filter = delegate(object item)
				{
					GalleryItemViewModel galleryItemViewModel = item as GalleryItemViewModel;
					return string.IsNullOrEmpty(Filter) || galleryItemViewModel == null || galleryItemViewModel.Caption.IndexOf(Filter, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0;
				};
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class ToolBarCommandBase : ICommand
	{
		private readonly WeakReference chartModel;

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => (WpfChartModel)chartModel.Target;

		private event EventHandler canExecuteChanged;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canExecuteChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				canExecuteChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public ToolBarCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
		{
			chartModel = new WeakReference(model);
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return CanExecute();
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			OnExecute(parameter);
		}

		protected abstract void OnExecute(object parameter);

		protected virtual bool CanExecute()
		{
			return chartModel != null;
		}

		public virtual void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.canExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				this.canExecuteChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		public void RegisterForUpdate()
		{
			ChartModel.RegisterToolBarCommand(this);
		}
	}
	public abstract class HistoryCommandBase : ToolBarCommandBase
	{
		private readonly CommandManager commandManager;

		private bool canExecute;

		protected CommandManager CommandManager => commandManager;

		public HistoryCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
			commandManager = model.CommandManager;
			commandManager.HistoryItemAdded += OnHistoryItemAdded;
		}

		private void OnHistoryItemAdded(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			canExecute = true;
		}

		protected abstract bool GetCanExecute();

		protected override bool CanExecute()
		{
			if (base.CanExecute())
			{
				return canExecute;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (commandManager != null)
			{
				canExecute = GetCanExecute();
			}
			base.RaiseCanExecuteChanged();
		}
	}
	public class UndoCommand : HistoryCommandBase
	{
		public UndoCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool GetCanExecute()
		{
			return base.CommandManager.QueuePosition > -1;
		}

		protected override void OnExecute(object parameter)
		{
			base.CommandManager.Undo();
		}
	}
	public class RedoCommand : HistoryCommandBase
	{
		public RedoCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool GetCanExecute()
		{
			return base.CommandManager.QueuePosition < base.CommandManager.Commands.Count - 1;
		}

		protected override void OnExecute(object parameter)
		{
			base.CommandManager.Redo();
		}
	}

	{

		private readonly AddPaneVerticalCommand verticalCommand;

		public AddPaneToolBarCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			horizontalCommand = new AddPaneHorizontalCommand(chartModel);
			verticalCommand = new AddPaneVerticalCommand(chartModel);
		}

		protected override void OnExecute(object parameter)
		{
			switch (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PaneOrientation)
			{
			case Orientation.Horizontal:
				((ICommand)horizontalCommand).Execute((object)null);
				break;
			case Orientation.Vertical:
				((ICommand)verticalCommand).Execute((object)null);
				break;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute()
		{
			if (base.CanExecute() && base.ChartModel.DiagramModel != null)
			{
				return base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

	public abstract class AddAxisElementToolBarCommand : ToolBarCommandBase
	{
		protected abstract ICommand AddElementToAxisX { get; }

		protected abstract ICommand AddElementToAxisY { get; }

		public AddAxisElementToolBarCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual bool IsAxisXCommand(object parameter)
		{
			return base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartAxisModelX;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute()
		{
			if (base.CanExecute())
			{
				return base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartAxisModel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override void OnExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (IsAxisXCommand(parameter))
			{
				AddElementToAxisX.Execute(parameter);
			}
			else
			{
				AddElementToAxisY.Execute(parameter);
			}
		}
	}
	public class AddConstantLineToolBarCommand : AddAxisElementToolBarCommand
	{
		private readonly AddConstantLineToAxisXCommand addToXCommand;

		private readonly AddConstantLineToAxisYCommand addToYCommand;

		protected override ICommand AddElementToAxisX => addToXCommand;

		protected override ICommand AddElementToAxisY => addToYCommand;

		public AddConstantLineToolBarCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			addToXCommand = new AddConstantLineToAxisXCommand(chartModel);
			addToYCommand = new AddConstantLineToAxisYCommand(chartModel);
		}
	}

	public static class AxisHelper
	{
		public static AxisBase GetAxis(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(parameter is ChartTreeModel chartTreeModel))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return chartTreeModel.DataModel.Parent.ChartElement as AxisBase;
		}
	}
	public sealed class DesignerViewModelBar : ViewModelBase
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollection<BarItemViewModelBase> bars = new ObservableCollection<BarItemViewModelBase>();

		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly Captions captions = new Captions();

		private ChartTreeModel treeModelRoot;

		private IEnumerable<BarItemViewModelBase> barViewModels;

		private DataBrowserViewModel dataBrowserViewModel;

		private string title = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartDesignerWindowTitle);

		public string Title => title;

		public ObservableCollection<BarItemViewModelBase> ToolBarControlBars => bars;

		public ChartTreeModel TreeModelRoot
		{
			get
			{
				return treeModelRoot;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (treeModelRoot != value)
				{
					treeModelRoot = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("TreeModelRoot");
				}
			}
		}

		public DataBrowserViewModel DataBrowserModel
		{
			get
			{
				return dataBrowserViewModel;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (dataBrowserViewModel != value)
				{
					dataBrowserViewModel = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DataBrowserModel");
				}
			}
		}

		public Captions Captions => captions;

		public WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		public DesignerViewModelBar(WpfChartModel chartModel, ChartDesignerWindow window)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			if (chartModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			barViewModels = chartModel.CreateToolBarModels(window);
			foreach (BarItemViewModelBase barViewModel in barViewModels)
			{
				ToolBarControlBars.Add(barViewModel);
			}
			TreeModelRoot = new ChartTreeRootModelBar(chartModel);
			DataBrowserModel = new DataBrowserViewModel(chartModel);
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (BarItemViewModelBase barViewModel in barViewModels)
			{
				barViewModel.CleanUp();
			}
		}
	}

	public class AnnotationShapePositionItemInitializer : IInstanceInitializer
	{
		IEnumerable<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> IInstanceInitializer.Types
		{
			get
			{
				List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> list = new List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo>();
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfAnnotationFreePositionPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AnnotationFreePosition)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfAnnotationRelativePositionPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AnnotationRelativePosition)));
				return list;
			}
		}

		object IInstanceInitializer.CreateInstance(DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo type)
		{
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type.Type);
		}
	}

		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetAnnotationPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public abstract AnnotationShapePosition CreateShapePosition();
	}

	public class AnnotationAnchorPointItemInitializer : IInstanceInitializer
	{
		private ChartControl chart;

		private bool IsPaneAnchorPointSupported
		{
			get
			{
				if (chart != null)
				{
					return chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		IEnumerable<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> IInstanceInitializer.Types
		{
			get
			{
				yield return new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfAnnotationChartAnchorPointPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AnnotationChartAnchorPoint));
				if (IsPaneAnchorPointSupported)
				{
					yield return new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AnnotationPaneAnchorPoint));
				}
				yield return new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfAnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPointPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPoint));
			}
		}

		public AnnotationAnchorPointItemInitializer(ChartControl chart)
		{
			this.chart = chart;
		}

		object IInstanceInitializer.CreateInstance(DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo type)
		{
			return Activator.CreateInstance(type.Type);
		}
	}
	public abstract class WpfAnnotationAnchorPointPropertyGridModel : NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private AnnotationAnchorPoint anchorPoint;

		private SetAnnotationPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		internal AnnotationAnchorPoint AnchorPoint => anchorPoint;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		public static WpfAnnotationAnchorPointPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForAnchorPoint(WpfChartAnnotationModel annotationModel)
		{
			if (annotationModel.Annotation.AnchorPoint is ChartAnchorPoint)
			{
				return new WpfAnnotationChartAnchorPointPropertyGridModel(annotationModel);
			}
			if (annotationModel.Annotation.AnchorPoint is PaneAnchorPoint)
			{
				return new WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel(annotationModel);
			}
			if (annotationModel.Annotation.AnchorPoint is SeriesPointAnchorPoint)
			{
				return new WpfAnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPointPropertyGridModel(annotationModel);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WpfAnnotationAnchorPointPropertyGridModel(WpfChartAnnotationModel annotationModel)
			: base(annotationModel, "AnchorPoint.")
		{
			if (annotationModel != null)
			{
				anchorPoint = annotationModel.Annotation.AnchorPoint;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetAnnotationPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public abstract AnnotationAnchorPoint CreateAnchorPoint();
	}

	public class WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel : WpfAnnotationAnchorPointPropertyGridModel
	{
		private ChangeAnnotationPaneCommand changePaneCommand;

		private WpfAxisXCoordinatePropertyGridModel axisXCoordinate;

		private WpfAxisYCoordinatePropertyGridModel axisYCoordinate;

		private WpfChartPaneModel pane;

		protected override string Name => "Pane Anchor Point";

		internal new PaneAnchorPoint AnchorPoint => base.AnchorPoint as PaneAnchorPoint;

		[Category("Layout")]
		public WpfChartPaneModel Pane
		{
			get
			{
				return pane;
			}
			set
			{
				((ICommand)changePaneCommand).Execute((object)value);
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Layout")]
		public WpfAxisXCoordinatePropertyGridModel AxisXCoordinate
		{
			get
			{
				return axisXCoordinate;
			}
			set
			{
				AxisXCoordinate value2 = ((value != null) ? new AxisXCoordinate() : null);
				SetProperty("AxisXCoordinate", value2);
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Layout")]
		public WpfAxisYCoordinatePropertyGridModel AxisYCoordinate
		{
			get
			{
				return axisYCoordinate;
			}
			set
			{
				AxisYCoordinate value2 = ((value != null) ? new AxisYCoordinate() : null);
				SetProperty("AxisYCoordinate", value2);
			}
		}

		public WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfAnnotationPaneAnchorPointPropertyGridModel(WpfChartAnnotationModel annotationModel)
			: base(annotationModel)
		{
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private WpfChartPaneModel GetPaneModel()
		{
			if (base.ChartModel != null && base.ChartModel.DiagramModel != null && base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.AllPanes != null)
			{
				foreach (WpfChartPaneModel allPane in base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.AllPanes)
				{
					if (allPane.Pane == AnchorPoint.Pane)
					{
						return allPane;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			changePaneCommand = new ChangeAnnotationPaneCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			pane = GetPaneModel();
			if (AnchorPoint == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (AnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate != null)
			{
				if (axisXCoordinate == null || AnchorPoint.AxisXCoordinate != axisXCoordinate.AxisCoordinate)
				{
					axisXCoordinate = new WpfAxisXCoordinatePropertyGridModel(base.ModelElement as WpfChartAnnotationModel);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				axisXCoordinate = null;
			}
			if (AnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate != null)
			{
				if (axisYCoordinate == null || AnchorPoint.AxisYCoordinate != axisYCoordinate.AxisCoordinate)
				{
					axisYCoordinate = new WpfAxisYCoordinatePropertyGridModel(base.ModelElement as WpfChartAnnotationModel);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				axisYCoordinate = null;
			}
		}

		public override AnnotationAnchorPoint CreateAnchorPoint()
		{
			return new PaneAnchorPoint();
		}
	}

	public class WpfAnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPointPropertyGridModel : WpfAnnotationAnchorPointPropertyGridModel
	{
		private ChangeAnnotationSeriesPointCommand changePointCommand;

		private WpfChartSeriesPointModel pointModel;

		private SeriesPointAnchorPoint Point => base.AnchorPoint as SeriesPointAnchorPoint;

		protected override string Name => "Series Point Anchor Point";

		[Category("Layout")]
		public WpfChartSeriesPointModel SeriesPoint
		{
			get
			{
				return pointModel;
			}
			set
			{
				((ICommand)changePointCommand).Execute((object)value);
			}
		}

		public WpfAnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPointPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfAnnotationSeriesPointAnchorPointPropertyGridModel(WpfChartAnnotationModel annotationModel)
			: base(annotationModel)
		{
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private WpfChartSeriesPointModel GetPointModel()
		{
			if (base.ChartModel != null && base.ChartModel.DiagramModel != null)
			{
				foreach (WpfChartSeriesModel item in base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
				{
					foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointModel item2 in item.SeriesPointCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item2.SeriesPoint == Point.SeriesPoint)
						{
							return item2;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override AnnotationAnchorPoint CreateAnchorPoint()
		{
			return new SeriesPointAnchorPoint();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			pointModel = GetPointModel();
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			changePointCommand = new ChangeAnnotationSeriesPointCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}
	}

	public abstract class WpfChartDateTimeScaleOptionsBasePropertyGridModel : NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private const string propertyPath = "DateTimeScaleOptions.";

		private readonly DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeOptions;

		private readonly SetAxisPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		private readonly CreateWorkdaysOptionsCommand createWorkdaysOptionsCommand;

		private readonly WorkTimeRulesPropertyGridModelCollection workTimeRules;

		private WorkdaysOptionsPropertyGridModel workdaysOptions;

		protected internal DateTimeScaleOptionsBase DateTimeScaleOptions => dateTimeOptions;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool WorkdaysOnly
		{
			get
			{
				return dateTimeOptions.WorkdaysOnly;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("WorkdaysOnly", value);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public WorkdaysOptionsPropertyGridModel WorkdaysOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return workdaysOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				PropertyGridCommandParameter parameter = ((value == null || value.WorkdaysOptions == null) ? new PropertyGridCommandParameter("DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions", new WorkdaysOptions(), base.ModelElement) : new PropertyGridCommandParameter("DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions", value.WorkdaysOptions, base.ModelElement));
				((ICommand)createWorkdaysOptionsCommand).Execute((object)parameter);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool WorkTimeOnly
		{
			get
			{
				return dateTimeOptions.WorkTimeOnly;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("WorkTimeOnly", value);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public WorkTimeRulesPropertyGridModelCollection WorkTimeRules => workTimeRules;

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public GridLayoutMode GridLayoutMode
		{
			get
			{
				return dateTimeOptions.GridLayoutMode;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("GridLayoutMode", value);
			}
		}

		public static WpfChartDateTimeScaleOptionsBasePropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeOptions, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (dateTimeOptions is AutomaticDateTimeScaleOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartAutomaticDateTimeScaleOptionsPropertyGridModel(modelElement, (AutomaticDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeOptions, propertyPath);
			}
			if (dateTimeOptions is IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartIntervalDateTimeScaleOptionsPropertyGridModel(modelElement, (IntervalDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeOptions, propertyPath);
			}
			if (dateTimeOptions is ManualDateTimeScaleOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartManualDateTimeScaleOptionsPropertyGridModel(modelElement, (ManualDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeOptions, propertyPath);
			}
			if (dateTimeOptions is ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartContinuousDateTimeScaleOptionsPropertyGridModel(modelElement, (ContinuousDateTimeScaleOptions)dateTimeOptions, propertyPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WpfChartDateTimeScaleOptionsBasePropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeOptions, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			this.dateTimeOptions = dateTimeOptions;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetAxisPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			createWorkdaysOptionsCommand = new CreateWorkdaysOptionsCommand(base.ChartModel);
			CreateWorkdaysOptions();
			workTimeRules = new WorkTimeRulesPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel, (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ModelElement);
			UpdateWorkTimeRules();
		}

		private void CreateWorkdaysOptions()
		{
			if (dateTimeOptions != null && dateTimeOptions.WorkdaysOptions != null)
			{
				workdaysOptions = new WorkdaysOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ModelElement, dateTimeOptions.WorkdaysOptions, "DateTimeScaleOptions.WorkdaysOptions.");
			}
			else
			{
				workdaysOptions = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateWorkTimeRules()
		{
			if (dateTimeOptions != null)
			{
				workTimeRules.UpdateCollection(dateTimeOptions.WorkTimeRules);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			CreateWorkdaysOptions();
			UpdateWorkTimeRules();
		}

		public abstract DateTimeScaleOptionsBase CreateScaleOptions();
	}

	public abstract class DateTimePropertyGridModelCollection : ObservableCollection<DateTime>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private WpfChartAxisModel axisModel;

		private bool allowExecuteCommand = true;

		protected bool AllowExecuteCommand => allowExecuteCommand;

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		protected WpfChartAxisModel AxisModel => axisModel;

		public DateTimePropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.axisModel = axisModel;
			if (axisModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			allowExecuteCommand = false;
			IEnumerable<DateTime> collection = GetCollection(AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axisModel.Axis).WorkdaysOptions);
			if (collection != null)
			{
				foreach (DateTime item in collection)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			allowExecuteCommand = true;
		}

		protected abstract IEnumerable<DateTime> GetCollection(WorkdaysOptions options);

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Collection)";
		}
	}
	public class HolidaysPropertyGridModelCollection : DateTimePropertyGridModelCollection
	{
		public HolidaysPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(chartModel, axisModel)
		{
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!base.AllowExecuteCommand)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (DateTime newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					HolidaysAddDateTimeCommand holidaysAddDateTimeCommand = new HolidaysAddDateTimeCommand(base.ChartModel, base.AxisModel);
					((ICommand)holidaysAddDateTimeCommand).Execute((object)newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (DateTime oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					HolidaysRemoveDateTimeCommand holidaysRemoveDateTimeCommand = new HolidaysRemoveDateTimeCommand(base.ChartModel, base.AxisModel);
					((ICommand)holidaysRemoveDateTimeCommand).Execute((object)oldItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < e.NewItems.Count; i++)
				{
					HolidaysReplaceDateTimeCommand holidaysReplaceDateTimeCommand = new HolidaysReplaceDateTimeCommand(base.ChartModel, base.AxisModel);
					((ICommand)holidaysReplaceDateTimeCommand).Execute((object)new List<DateTime>
					{
						(DateTime)e.OldItems[i],
						(DateTime)e.NewItems[i]
					});
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override IEnumerable<DateTime> GetCollection(WorkdaysOptions options)
		{
			return options.Holidays;
		}
	}

	public class WeekdaysWrapper : List<Weekday>
	{
	}
	public class WeekdayEnumTypeConverter : EnumConverter
	{
		public static Weekday ConvertFromList(WeekdaysWrapper values)
		{
			Weekday weekday = Weekday.None;
			if (values != null)
			{
				foreach (Weekday value in values)
				{
					weekday |= value;
				}
			}
			return weekday;
		}

		public static WeekdaysWrapper ConvertToList(Weekday weekday)
		{
			WeekdaysWrapper weekdaysWrapper = new WeekdaysWrapper();
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Monday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Monday);
			}
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Tuesday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Tuesday);
			}
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Wednesday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Wednesday);
			}
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Thursday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Thursday);
			}
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Friday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Friday);
			}
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Saturday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Saturday);
			}
			if ((weekday & Weekday.Sunday) > Weekday.None)
			{
				weekdaysWrapper.Add(Weekday.Sunday);
			}
			return weekdaysWrapper;
		}

		public WeekdayEnumTypeConverter()
			: this(typeof(Weekday))
		{
		}

		public WeekdayEnumTypeConverter(Type type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		public override bool CanConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, Type sourceType)
		{
			if (!sourceType.IsGenericType)
			{
				return base.CanConvertFrom(context, sourceType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override object ConvertFrom(ITypeDescriptorContext context, CultureInfo culture, object value)
		{
			if (value != null && value is IEnumerable<object>)
			{
				WeekdaysWrapper weekdaysWrapper = new WeekdaysWrapper();
				IEnumerable<object> enumerable = (IEnumerable<object>)value;
				{
					foreach (object item in enumerable)
					{
						weekdaysWrapper.Add((Weekday)item);
					}
					return weekdaysWrapper;
				}
			}
			return base.ConvertFrom(context, culture, value);
		}

		public static Array GetNonEmptyValues()
		{
			return new Weekday[7]
			{
				Weekday.Sunday,
				Weekday.Monday,
				Weekday.Tuesday,
				Weekday.Wednesday,
				Weekday.Thursday,
				Weekday.Friday,
				Weekday.Saturday
			};
		}
	}
	public class WorkTimeRulesPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WorkTimeRulePropertyGridModel>
	{
		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly WpfChartAxisModel axisModel;

		public WorkTimeRulesPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.axisModel = axisModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WorkTimeRulePropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.ModelElement == null)
					{
						ICommand command2 = new AddWorkTimeRuleCommand(chartModel, axisModel);
						command2.Execute(null);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WorkTimeRulePropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					ICommand command = new RemoveWorkTimeRuleCommand(chartModel, axisModel);
					command.Execute(oldItem.WorkTimeRule);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCollection(WorkTimeRuleCollection workTimeRules)
		{
			Clear();
			foreach (WorkTimeRule workTimeRule in workTimeRules)
			{
				Add(new WorkTimeRulePropertyGridModel(axisModel, workTimeRule));
			}
		}
	}

	public class AnnotationPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		public AnnotationPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.AnnotationModel == null)
					{
						AddAnnotationCommand addAnnotationCommand = new AddAnnotationCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)addAnnotationCommand).Execute((object)null);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (chartModel.AnnotationCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Contains(oldItem.AnnotationModel))
					{
						RemoveAnnotationCommand removeAnnotationCommand = new RemoveAnnotationCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)removeAnnotationCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.Annotation);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
