		public WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel(WpfChartAnnotationModel annotationModel)
			: base(annotationModel)
		{
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetAnnotationPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Annotation == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Annotation.ShapePosition != null)
			{
				if (shapePosition == null || Annotation.ShapePosition != shapePosition.ShapePosition)
				{
					shapePosition = WpfAnnotationShapePositionPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForShapePosition(AnnotationModel);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				shapePosition = null;
			}
			if (Annotation.AnchorPoint != null)
			{
				if (anchorPoint == null || Annotation.AnchorPoint != anchorPoint.AnchorPoint)
				{
					anchorPoint = WpfAnnotationAnchorPointPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForAnchorPoint(AnnotationModel);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				anchorPoint = null;
			}
			if (Annotation.BorderStyle != null)
			{
				if (borderStyle == null || Annotation.BorderStyle != borderStyle.LineStyle)
				{
					borderStyle = new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(AnnotationModel, Annotation.BorderStyle, setPropertyCommand, "BorderStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				borderStyle = null;
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return AnnotationModel.DisplayName;
		}
	}

	public class SubtotalPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel;

		public SubtotalPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.seriesModel = seriesModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.Subtotal == null)
					{
						ICommand command2 = new AddSubtotalCommand(chartModel);
						command2.Execute(seriesModel);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				IEnumerator enumerator = e.OldItems.GetEnumerator();
				try
				{
					if (enumerator.MoveNext())
					{
						WpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel wpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel = (WpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel)enumerator.Current;
						ICommand command = new RemoveSubtotalCommand(chartModel);
						command.Execute(wpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel.Subtotal);
					}
					break;
				}
				finally
				{
					IDisposable disposable = enumerator as IDisposable;
					if (disposable != null)
					{
						disposable.Dispose();
					}
				}
			}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCollection(SubtotalCollection subtotals)
		{
			Clear();
			foreach (Subtotal subtotal in subtotals)
			{
				Add(new WpfChartSubtotalPropertyGridModel(seriesModel, subtotal));
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class TitlePropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfChartTitlePropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		protected abstract ICommand CreateAddCommand(WpfChartTitlePropertyGridModel title);

		protected abstract ICommand CreateRemoveCommand();

		protected abstract bool IsTitleInCollection(WpfChartTitleModel titleModel);

		public TitlePropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartTitlePropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.TitleModel == null)
					{
						ICommand command2 = CreateAddCommand(newItem);
						command2.Execute(null);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartTitlePropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (IsTitleInCollection(oldItem.TitleModel))
					{
						ICommand command = CreateRemoveCommand();
						command.Execute(oldItem.Title);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartAxis2DLabelPropertyGridModel : WpfChartAxisLabelPropertyGridModel
	{
		private WpfChartResolveOverlappingOptionsPropertyGridModel resolveOverlappingOptions;

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public WpfChartResolveOverlappingOptionsPropertyGridModel ResolveOverlappingOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return resolveOverlappingOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				SetAttachedProperty("ResolveOverlappingOptions", new AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions(), base.ModelElement, typeof(Axis2D), delegate(object targetObject, object newValue)
				{
					Axis2D.SetResolveOverlappingOptions((AxisLabel)targetObject, (AxisLabelResolveOverlappingOptions)newValue);
				}, (object targetObject) => Axis2D.GetResolveOverlappingOptions((AxisLabel)targetObject));
			}
		}

		public WpfChartAxis2DLabelPropertyGridModel()
		{
		}

		public WpfChartAxis2DLabelPropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, AxisLabel label)
			: base(modelElement, label)
		{
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Axis2D.GetResolveOverlappingOptions(base.Label) != null)
			{
				if (resolveOverlappingOptions == null || Axis2D.GetResolveOverlappingOptions(base.Label) != resolveOverlappingOptions.ResolveOverlappingOptions)
				{
					resolveOverlappingOptions = new WpfChartResolveOverlappingOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ModelElement, Axis2D.GetResolveOverlappingOptions(base.Label));
				}
			}
			else
			{
				resolveOverlappingOptions = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class WpfChartAxisRangeOptionsPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		protected WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel AxisBaseModel => chartModel.SelectedModel.PropertyGridModel as WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel;

		protected abstract WpfChartAxisRangePropertyGridModel RangeModel { get; }

		protected abstract Range ActualRange { get; }

		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsAxisRange_Auto)]
		public bool Auto
		{
			get
			{
				return RangeModel == null;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!value)
				{
					CreateRange();
				}
				else
				{
					RemoveRange();
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsAxisRange_MaxValue)]
		public object MaxValue
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualRange.ActualMaxValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (RangeModel != null)
				{
					RangeModel.MaxValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsAxisRange_MinValue)]
		public object MinValue
		{
			get
			{
				return ActualRange.ActualMinValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (RangeModel != null)
				{
					RangeModel.MinValue = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartAxisRangeOptionsPropertyGridModelBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected abstract void CreateRange();

		protected abstract void RemoveRange();

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Range Options)";
		}
	}

	public abstract class LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollectionBase : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		protected abstract AddLayoutDefinitionCommand AddCommand { get; }

		protected abstract RemoveLayoutDefinitionCommandBase RemoveCommand { get; }

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		public LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollectionBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.ModelElement == null)
					{
						AddLayoutDefinitionCommand addCommand = AddCommand;
						((ICommand)addCommand).Execute((object)null);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					RemoveLayoutDefinitionCommandBase removeCommand = RemoveCommand;
					((ICommand)removeCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.Definition);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public class RowLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection : LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollectionBase

	}
	public class CustomLegendItemPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionBase
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		public CustomLegendItemPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartCustomLegendItemPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.ModelElement == null)
					{
						AddCustomLegendItemCommand addCustomLegendItemCommand = new AddCustomLegendItemCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)addCustomLegendItemCommand).Execute((object)null);
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartCustomLegendItemPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					RemoveCustomLegendItemCommand removeCustomLegendItemCommand = new RemoveCustomLegendItemCommand(chartModel);
					((ICommand)removeCustomLegendItemCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.CustomLegendItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public class IndicatorItemInitializer : IInstanceInitializer
	{
		IEnumerable<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> IInstanceInitializer.Types

				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartWeightedMovingAveragePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewWeightedMovingAverage)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartExponentialMovingAveragePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewExponentialMovingAverage)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartTriangularMovingAveragePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewTriangularMovingAverage)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartRegressionLinePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewRegressionLine)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartTrendLinePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewTrendLine)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartFibonacciRetracementPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewFibonacciRetracement)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartFibonacciFansPropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.NewFibonacciFans)));

	public class IndicatorPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel;

		public IndicatorPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.seriesModel = seriesModel;
		}

		private void ExecuteCommand(ICommand command, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			command.Execute(seriesModel);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.IndicatorModel == null)
					{
						if (newItem is WpfChartSimpleMovingAveragePropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<SimpleMovingAverage>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartWeightedMovingAveragePropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<WeightedMovingAverage>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartExponentialMovingAveragePropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<ExponentialMovingAverage>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartTriangularMovingAveragePropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<TriangularMovingAverage>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartRegressionLinePropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<RegressionLine>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartTrendLinePropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<TrendLine>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartFibonacciRetracementPropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<FibonacciRetracement>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartFibonacciFansPropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<FibonacciFans>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						else if (newItem is WpfChartFibonacciArcsPropertyGridModel)
						{
							ExecuteCommand(new AddIndicatorCommand<FibonacciArcs>(chartModel), seriesModel);
						}
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (seriesModel.IndicatorCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Contains(oldItem.IndicatorModel))
					{
						RemoveIndicatorCommand removeIndicatorCommand = new RemoveIndicatorCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)removeIndicatorCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.Indicator);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel : PropertyGridModelBase, ISupportVisibleModel

		public static WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForIndicator(WpfChartIndicatorModel indicatorModel)
		{
			Indicator indicator = indicatorModel.Indicator;
			if (indicator is SimpleMovingAverage)
			{
				return new WpfChartSimpleMovingAveragePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is WeightedMovingAverage)
			{
				return new WpfChartWeightedMovingAveragePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is ExponentialMovingAverage)
			{
				return new WpfChartExponentialMovingAveragePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is TriangularMovingAverage)
			{
				return new WpfChartTriangularMovingAveragePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is TripleExponentialMovingAverageTema)
			{
				return new WpfChartTripleExponentialMovingAverageTemaPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is RegressionLine)
			{
				return new WpfChartRegressionLinePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is TrendLine)
			{
				return new WpfChartTrendLinePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is FibonacciRetracement)
			{
				return new WpfChartFibonacciRetracementPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is FibonacciFans)
			{
				return new WpfChartFibonacciFansPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is FibonacciArcs)
			{
				return new WpfChartFibonacciArcsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is AverageTrueRange)
			{
				return new WpfChartAverageTrueRangePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is ChaikinsVolatility)
			{
				return new WpfChartChaikinsVolatilityPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is CommodityChannelIndex)
			{
				return new WpfChartCommodityChannelIndexPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is DetrendedPriceOscillator)
			{
				return new WpfChartDetrendedPriceOscillatorPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is MassIndex)
			{
				return new WpfChartMassIndexPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)
			{
				return new WpfChartMovingAverageConvergenceDivergencePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is RateOfChange)
			{
				return new WpfChartRateOfChangePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is RelativeStrengthIndex)
			{
				return new WpfChartRelativeStrengthIndexPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is StandardDeviation)
			{
				return new WpfChartStandardDeviationPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is TripleExponentialMovingAverageTrix)
			{
				return new WpfChartTripleExponentialMovingAverageTrixPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is WilliamsR)
			{
				return new WpfChartWilliamsRPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is BollingerBands)
			{
				return new WpfChartBollingerBandsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is MedianPrice)
			{
				return new WpfChartMedianPricePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is TypicalPrice)
			{
				return new WpfChartTypicalPricePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is WeightedClose)
			{
				return new WpfChartWeightedClosePropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is DataSourceBasedErrorBars)
			{
				return new WpfChartDataSourceBasedErrorBarsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is FixedValueErrorBars)
			{
				return new WpfChartFixedValueErrorBarsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is PercentageErrorBars)
			{
				return new WpfChartPercentageErrorBarsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is StandardDeviationErrorBars)
			{
				return new WpfChartStandardDeviationErrorBarsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			if (indicator is StandardErrorBars)
			{
				return new WpfChartStandardErrorBarsPropertyGridModel(indicatorModel);
			}
			throw new ArgumentException("The WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForIndicator can't give a PropertyGridModel for the indicator of " + indicatorModel.Indicator.GetType().Name + "type.");
		}

		public WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel(WpfChartIndicatorModel indicatorModel)
			: base(indicatorModel)
		{
			changeLegendCommand = new ChangeIndicatorLegendCommand(base.ChartModel);
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private void UpdateLegendModel()
		{
			if (Indicator.Legend != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && Indicator.Legend == legend.Legend)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WpfChartLegendModel item in base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Legend == Indicator.Legend)
						{
							legend = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			legend = null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (IndicatorModel == null || Indicator == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Indicator.LineStyle != null)
			{
				if (lineStyle == null || Indicator.LineStyle != lineStyle.LineStyle)
				{
					lineStyle = new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(IndicatorModel, Indicator.LineStyle, SetObjectPropertyCommand, "LineStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				lineStyle = null;
			}
			UpdateLegendModel();
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetIndicatorPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return IndicatorModel.Name;
		}
	}

	public abstract class WpfChartSeparatePaneIndicatorPropertyGridModel : WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel
	{
		private readonly ChangeIndicatorPaneCommand changePaneCommand;

		private readonly ChangeIndicatorAxisYCommand changeAxisYCommand;

		private WpfChartPaneModel pane;

		private WpfChartAxisModel axisY;

		[Category("Layout")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		public WpfChartPaneModel Pane
		{
			get
			{
				return pane;
			}
			set
			{
				if (pane != value)
				{
					((ICommand)changePaneCommand).Execute((object)value);
				}
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		public WpfChartAxisModel AxisY
		{
			get
			{
				return axisY;
			}
			set
			{
				if (axisY != value)
				{
					((ICommand)changeAxisYCommand).Execute((object)value);
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartSeparatePaneIndicatorPropertyGridModel(WpfChartIndicatorModel indicatorModel)
			: base(indicatorModel)
		{
			changePaneCommand = new ChangeIndicatorPaneCommand(base.ChartModel);
			changeAxisYCommand = new ChangeIndicatorAxisYCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public WpfChartSeparatePaneIndicatorPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		private void UpdateModels()
		{
			pane = base.IndicatorModel.Pane;
			axisY = base.IndicatorModel.AxisY;
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			UpdateModels();
		}
	}

		public WpfChartCrosshairOptionsPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartCrosshairOptionsPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, CrosshairOptions crosshairOptions, string propertyPath)
			: base(chartModel, propertyPath)
		{
			this.crosshairOptions = crosshairOptions;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (CrosshairOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition != null)
			{
				if (crosshairLabelPosition == null || CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition != crosshairLabelPosition.CrosshairLabelPosition)
				{
					if (CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition is CrosshairFreePosition)
					{
						crosshairLabelPosition = new WpfChartCrosshairFreePositionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition, "CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition.");
					}
					else if (CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition is CrosshairMousePosition)
					{
						crosshairLabelPosition = new WpfChartCrosshairMousePositionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition, "CrosshairOptions.CommonLabelPosition.");
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				crosshairLabelPosition = null;
			}
			if (CrosshairOptions.ArgumentLineStyle != null)
			{
				if (argumentLineStyle == null || CrosshairOptions.ArgumentLineStyle != argumentLineStyle.LineStyle)
				{
					argumentLineStyle = new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, CrosshairOptions.ArgumentLineStyle, SetObjectPropertyCommand, "CrosshairOptions.ArgumentLineStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				argumentLineStyle = null;
			}
			if (CrosshairOptions.ValueLineStyle != null)
			{
				if (valueLineStyle == null || CrosshairOptions.ValueLineStyle != valueLineStyle.LineStyle)
				{
					valueLineStyle = new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, CrosshairOptions.ValueLineStyle, SetObjectPropertyCommand, "CrosshairOptions.ValueLineStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				valueLineStyle = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class ColorizerKeysPropertyGridModelCollection : ObservableCollection<object>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private bool allowExecuteCommand = true;

		public ColorizerKeysPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!allowExecuteCommand)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand addKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand = new AddKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand(chartModel);
					((ICommand)addKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand).Execute(newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				int num2 = e.OldStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						RemoveKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand removeKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand = new RemoveKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand(chartModel, num2);
						((ICommand)removeKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand).Execute(oldItem);
						num2++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object newItem2 in e.NewItems)
					{
						ReplaceKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand replaceKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand = new ReplaceKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand(chartModel, num);
						((ICommand)replaceKeyColorColorizerKeyCommand).Execute(newItem2);
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCollection(IList<object> items)
		{
			allowExecuteCommand = false;
			ClearItems();
			if (items != null)
			{
				foreach (object item in items)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			allowExecuteCommand = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Collection)";
		}
	}

	public class CustomPalettePropertyGridModelCollection : ObservableCollection<Color>
	{
		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly bool isSegmentColorizer;

		private readonly bool allowExecute;

		public CustomPalettePropertyGridModelCollection()
		{
		}

		public CustomPalettePropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, Palette palette, bool isSegmentColorizer)
		{
			this.isSegmentColorizer = isSegmentColorizer;
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			if (palette != null)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < palette.Count; i++)
				{
					Add(palette[i]);
				}
			}
			allowExecute = true;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!allowExecute)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					ICommand command3 = new AddPaletteColorsColorizerCommand(chartModel, isSegmentColorizer);
					command3.Execute(newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				int num2 = e.OldStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						ICommand command2 = new RemovePaletteColorsColorizerCommand(chartModel, num2, isSegmentColorizer);
						command2.Execute(oldItem);
						num2++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object newItem2 in e.NewItems)
					{
						ICommand command = new ReplacePaletteColorsColorizerCommand(chartModel, num, isSegmentColorizer);
						command.Execute(newItem2);
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Collection)";
		}
	}

	public class ColorizerDoublePropertyGridModelCollection : ObservableCollection<double>
	{
		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly bool isSegmentColorizer;

		private bool allowExecuteCommand = true;

		public ColorizerDoublePropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, bool isSegmentColorizer)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.isSegmentColorizer = isSegmentColorizer;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (!allowExecuteCommand)
			{
				return;
			}
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (object newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					AddRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand addRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand = new AddRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand(chartModel, isSegmentColorizer);
					((ICommand)addRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand).Execute(newItem);
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				int num2 = e.OldStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object oldItem in e.OldItems)
					{
						RemoveRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand removeRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand = new RemoveRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand(chartModel, isSegmentColorizer, num2);
						((ICommand)removeRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand).Execute(oldItem);
						num2++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Replace:
			{
				int num = e.NewStartingIndex;
				{
					foreach (object newItem2 in e.NewItems)
					{
						ReplaceRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand replaceRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand = new ReplaceRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand(chartModel, isSegmentColorizer, num);
						((ICommand)replaceRangeColorizerRangeStopCommand).Execute(newItem2);
						num++;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			}
		}

		public void UpdateCollection(DoubleCollection items)
		{
			allowExecuteCommand = false;
			ClearItems();
			if (items != null)
			{
				foreach (double item in items)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			allowExecuteCommand = true;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Collection)";
		}
	}
	public abstract class WpfChartSegmentColorizerBasePropertyGridModel : NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private SegmentColorizerBase segmentColorizer;

		private SetSeriesPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		protected internal SegmentColorizerBase SegmentColorizer => segmentColorizer;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		public static WpfChartSegmentColorizerBasePropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, SegmentColorizerBase colorizer, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (colorizer is RangeSegmentColorizer)
			{
				return new WpfChartRangeSegmentColorizerPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (RangeSegmentColorizer)colorizer, propertyPath);
			}
			if (colorizer is TrendSegmentColorizer)
			{
				return new WpfChartTrendSegmentColorizerPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (TrendSegmentColorizer)colorizer, propertyPath);
			}
			if (colorizer is PointBasedSegmentColorizer)
			{
				return new WpfChartPointBasedSegmentColorizerPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (PointBasedSegmentColorizer)colorizer, propertyPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WpfChartSegmentColorizerBasePropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, SegmentColorizerBase colorizer, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			segmentColorizer = colorizer;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public abstract SegmentColorizerBase CreateColorizer();
	}
	public class WpfChartRangeSegmentColorizerPropertyGridModel : WpfChartSegmentColorizerBasePropertyGridModel
	{
		private readonly ColorizerDoublePropertyGridModelCollection rangeStops;

		private PalettePropertyGridModel paletteModel;

		private new RangeSegmentColorizer SegmentColorizer => (RangeSegmentColorizer)base.SegmentColorizer;

		protected override string Name => "Range Segment Colorizer";

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Common")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public PalettePropertyGridModel Palette
		{
			get
			{
				return paletteModel;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Palette", value.Palette);
			}
		}

		[Category("Common")]
		public ColorizerDoublePropertyGridModelCollection RangeStops => rangeStops;

		[Category("Common")]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public bool ShowInLegend
		{
			get
			{
				return SegmentColorizer.ShowInLegend;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ShowInLegend", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Common")]
		[DefaultValue(true)]
		public string LegendTextPattern
		{
			get
			{
				return SegmentColorizer.LegendTextPattern;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("LegendTextPattern", value);
			}
		}

		public WpfChartRangeSegmentColorizerPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartRangeSegmentColorizerPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, SegmentColorizerBase colorizer, string propertyPath)
			: base(chartModel, colorizer, propertyPath)
		{
			rangeStops = new ColorizerDoublePropertyGridModelCollection(chartModel, isSegmentColorizer: true);
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (SegmentColorizer != null)
			{
				RangeStops.UpdateCollection(SegmentColorizer.RangeStops);
				if (SegmentColorizer.Palette != null)
				{
					paletteModel = PalettePropertyGridModel.Create(base.ChartModel, SegmentColorizer.Palette, isSegmentColorizer: true);
				}
			}
		}

		public override SegmentColorizerBase CreateColorizer()
		{
			return new RangeSegmentColorizer();
		}
	}

	public class GridLayoutPropertyGridModel : WpfChartElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly GridLayout layout;

		private readonly RowLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection rowDefinitions;

		private readonly ColumnLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection columnDefinitions;

		protected override string Name => "Pane Layout";

		internal GridLayout Layout => layout;

		[Category("Elements")]
		public RowLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection RowDefinitions => rowDefinitions;

		[Category("Elements")]
		public ColumnLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection ColumnDefinitions => columnDefinitions;

		public GridLayoutPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public GridLayoutPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, GridLayout layout)
			: base(chartModel, "Diagram.PaneLayout.")
		{
			this.layout = layout;
			rowDefinitions = new RowLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel);
			columnDefinitions = new ColumnLayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel);
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Layout == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			rowDefinitions.Clear();
			foreach (LayoutDefinition rowDefinition in Layout.RowDefinitions)
			{
				rowDefinitions.Add(new LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, rowDefinition, new SetRowLayoutDefinitionPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel, rowDefinition)));
			}
			columnDefinitions.Clear();
			foreach (LayoutDefinition columnDefinition in Layout.ColumnDefinitions)
			{
				columnDefinitions.Add(new LayoutDefinitionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, columnDefinition, new SetColumnLayoutDefinitionPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel, columnDefinition)));
			}
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartRangeControlOptionsPropertyGridModel : NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly RangeControlOptions rangeControlOptions;

		private readonly SetSeriesPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		private WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel view;

		protected internal RangeControlOptions RangeControlOptions => rangeControlOptions;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		protected override string Name => "Range Control Options";

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{
			get
			{
				return RangeControlOptions.ValueLevel;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ValueLevel", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return RangeControlOptions.Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Visible", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool UseSeriesBrush
		{
			get
			{
				return RangeControlOptions.UseSeriesBrush;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("UseSeriesBrush", value);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Presentation")]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		public WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel View
		{
			get
			{
				return view;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					SetProperty("View", value.CreateView());
				}
				else
				{
					SetProperty("View", null);
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartRangeControlOptionsPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartRangeControlOptionsPropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, RangeControlOptions rangeControlOptions, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			setPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			this.rangeControlOptions = rangeControlOptions;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (RangeControlOptions != null && RangeControlOptions.View != null)
			{
				if (view == null || RangeControlOptions.View != view.View)
				{
					view = WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel.CreateModel(RangeControlOptions.View, base.ChartModel, "RangeControlOptions.View.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				view = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel : NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly RangeControlClientView view;

		private readonly SetSeriesPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		protected internal RangeControlClientView View => view;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		[Category("Appearance")]
		public SolidColorBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return View.Brush;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Brush", value);
			}
		}

		public static WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel CreateModel(RangeControlClientView view, WpfChartModel chartModel, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (view is RangeControlClientBarView)
			{
				return new WpfChartRangeControlClientBarViewPropertyGridModel(chartModel, view, propertyPath);
			}
			if (view is RangeControlClientAreaView)
			{
				return new WpfChartRangeControlClientAreaViewPropertyGridModel(chartModel, view, propertyPath);
			}
			if (view is RangeControlClientLineView)
			{
				return new WpfChartRangeControlClientLineViewPropertyGridModel(chartModel, view, propertyPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartRangeControlClientViewPropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, RangeControlClientView view, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			setPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			this.view = view;
		}

		public abstract RangeControlClientView CreateView();
	}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]

				return timeSpanModel;
			}
			set

				SetProperty("TimeSpanSummaryOptions", value?.CreateOptions());
			}
		}

		[Category("Common")]
		public SummaryFunctionBase Function
		{
			get
			{
				return Summary.Function;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Function", value);
			}
		}

		public static SummaryPropertyGridModel Create(WpfChartModel chartModel, Summary summary)
		{
			return new SummaryPropertyGridModel(chartModel, summary, "Summary.");
		}

		private void ResetFunction()
		{
			SummaryFunctionBase summaryFunctionBase = Summary.FunctionProperty.DefaultMetadata?.DefaultValue as SummaryFunctionBase;
			Summary.Function = ((summaryFunctionBase != null) ? ((SummaryFunctionBase)Activator.CreateInstance(summaryFunctionBase.GetType())) : null);
		}

		public SummaryPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public SummaryPropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, Summary summary, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			Summary = summary;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Summary != null)
			{
				numericModel = ((Summary.NumericSummaryOptions != null) ? NumericSummaryOptionsPropertyGridModel.Create(base.ChartModel, Summary.NumericSummaryOptions) : null);
				dateTimeModel = ((Summary.DateTimeSummaryOptions != null) ? DateTimeSummaryOptionsPropertyGridModel.Create(base.ChartModel, Summary.DateTimeSummaryOptions) : null);
				timeSpanModel = ((Summary.TimeSpanSummaryOptions != null) ? TimeSpanSummaryOptionsPropertyGridModel.Create(base.ChartModel, Summary.TimeSpanSummaryOptions) : null);
			}
		}

		public Summary CreateSummary()
		{
			return new Summary();
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartToolTipOptionsPropertyGridModel : WpfChartElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly ToolTipOptions toolTipOptions;

		private WpfChartToolTipPositionPropertyGridModel toolTipPosition;

		protected override string Name => "Tool Tip Options";

		protected internal ToolTipOptions ToolTipOptions => toolTipOptions;

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool ShowForSeries
		{
			get
			{
				return ToolTipOptions.ShowForSeries;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ShowForSeries", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public bool ShowForPoints
		{
			get
			{
				return ToolTipOptions.ShowForPoints;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ShowForPoints", value);
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public WpfChartToolTipPositionPropertyGridModel ToolTipPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return toolTipPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ToolTipPosition", value.NewToolTipPosition);
			}
		}

		public WpfChartToolTipOptionsPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartToolTipOptionsPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, ToolTipOptions toolTipOptions, string propertyPath)
			: base(chartModel, propertyPath)
		{
			this.toolTipOptions = toolTipOptions;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (ToolTipOptions == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition != null)
			{
				if (toolTipPosition == null || ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition != toolTipPosition.ToolTipPosition)
				{
					if (ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipFreePosition)
					{
						toolTipPosition = new WpfChartToolTipFreePositionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition, "ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition.");
					}
					else if (ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipMousePosition)
					{
						toolTipPosition = new WpfChartToolTipMousePositionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition, "ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition.");
					}
					else if (ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition is ToolTipRelativePosition)
					{
						toolTipPosition = new WpfChartToolTipRelativePositionPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition, "ToolTipOptions.ToolTipPosition.");
					}
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipPosition = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public class PanePropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionBase
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		public PanePropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartPanePropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.PaneModel == null)
					{
						AddPaneCommandBase addPaneCommandBase = ((chartModel.DiagramModel.PaneOrientation != Orientation.Horizontal) ? ((AddPaneCommandBase)new AddPaneVerticalCommand(chartModel)) : ((AddPaneCommandBase)new AddPaneHorizontalCommand(chartModel)));
						((ICommand)addPaneCommandBase).Execute((object)null);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartPanePropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (chartModel.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Contains(oldItem.PaneModel))
					{
						RemovePaneCommand removePaneCommand = new RemovePaneCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)removePaneCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.Pane);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartPanePropertyGridModel : PropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private SetPanePropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		private WpfChartScrollBarOptionsPropertyGridModel axisXScrollBarOptions;

		private WpfChartScrollBarOptionsPropertyGridModel axisYScrollBarOptions;

		private WpfPaneTitlePropertyGridModel titleModel;

		private WpfChartStackedBarTotalLabelPropertyGridModel totalLabelModel;

		private SetTotalLabelAttachedPropertyCommand setTotalLabelAttachedPropertyCommand;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectAttachedPropertyCommand => setTotalLabelAttachedPropertyCommand;

		protected internal WpfChartPaneModel PaneModel => base.ModelElement as WpfChartPaneModel;

		protected internal Pane Pane => PaneModel.Pane;

		[Category("Navigation")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsPane_EnableAxisXNavigation)]

		public WpfChartPanePropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartPanePropertyGridModel(WpfChartPaneModel paneModel)
			: base(paneModel)
		{
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (PaneModel == null || PaneModel.Pane == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions != null)
			{
				if (axisXScrollBarOptions == null || Pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions != axisXScrollBarOptions.ScrollBarOptions)
				{
					axisXScrollBarOptions = new WpfChartScrollBarOptionsPropertyGridModel(PaneModel, Pane.AxisXScrollBarOptions, setPropertyCommand, "AxisXScrollBarOptions.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				axisXScrollBarOptions = null;
			}
			if (Pane.AxisYScrollBarOptions != null)
			{
				if (axisYScrollBarOptions == null || Pane.AxisYScrollBarOptions != axisYScrollBarOptions.ScrollBarOptions)
				{
					axisYScrollBarOptions = new WpfChartScrollBarOptionsPropertyGridModel(PaneModel, Pane.AxisYScrollBarOptions, setPropertyCommand, "AxisYScrollBarOptions.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				axisYScrollBarOptions = null;
			}
			PaneTitle title = Pane.Title;
			if (title != null)
			{
				if (titleModel == null || title != titleModel.Title)
				{
					titleModel = new WpfPaneTitlePropertyGridModel(PaneModel, title);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				titleModel = null;
			}
			StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(Pane);
			if (totalLabel != null)
			{
				if (totalLabelModel == null || totalLabel != totalLabelModel.StackedBarTotalLabel)
				{
					totalLabelModel = new WpfChartStackedBarTotalLabelPropertyGridModel(PaneModel, totalLabel);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				totalLabelModel = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetPanePropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			setTotalLabelAttachedPropertyCommand = new SetTotalLabelAttachedPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return PaneModel.Name;
		}
	}

				return strip.BorderColor;
			}

			}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsStrip_Legend)]
		public WpfChartLegendModel Legend
		{
			get
			{
				return legend;
			}
			set
			{
				if (legend != value)
				{
					((ICommand)changeLegendCommand).Execute((object)value);
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartStripPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartStripModel stripModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			strip = stripModel.Strip;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetStripPropertyCommand(chartModel);
			changeLegendCommand = new ChangeStripLegendCommand(chartModel);
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private void UpdateLegendModel()
		{
			if (strip.Legend != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && strip.Legend == legend.Legend)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WpfChartLegendModel item in base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Legend == strip.Legend)
						{
							legend = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			legend = null;
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			UpdateLegendModel();
		}
	}

				}
			}
			else
			{
				title = null;
			}
			UpdateLegendModel();
		}

				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				CreateTitleIfNecessary();
				((WpfChartConstantLineTitlePropertyGridModel)TitleModel).ShowBelowLine = value;
			}
		}

			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(LineStyle lineStyle)
			: this(null, lineStyle, null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, LineStyle lineStyle, ICommand setPropertyCommand, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			this.lineStyle = lineStyle;
			this.propertyPath = propertyPath;
			this.setPropertyCommand = setPropertyCommand;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (lineStyle != null && lineStyle.DashStyle != null)
			{
				if (dashStyle == null || lineStyle.DashStyle != dashStyle.DashStyle)
				{
					dashStyle = new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(base.ModelElement, this, setPropertyCommand, propertyPath + "DashStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				dashStyle = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel : NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly ICommand setPropertyCommand;

		private readonly LineStyle lineStyle;

		private readonly WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel lineStyleModel;

		private DashesPropertyGridModelCollection dashes;

		private double offset;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		internal DashStyle DashStyle => lineStyle.DashStyle;

		internal DashStyle ActualDashStyle => new DashStyle(Dashes, Offset);

		[Category("Elements")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public DashesPropertyGridModelCollection Dashes => dashes;

		[Category("Common")]
		public double Offset
		{
			get
			{
				return offset;
			}
			set
			{
				offset = value;
				lineStyleModel.DashStyle = new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(ActualDashStyle);
			}
		}

		public WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(DashStyle dashStyle)
			: this(null, new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(new LineStyle
			{
				DashStyle = dashStyle
			}), null, string.Empty)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel lineStyleModel, ICommand setPropertyCommand, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement, propertyPath)
		{
			this.lineStyleModel = lineStyleModel;
			lineStyle = lineStyleModel.LineStyle;
			this.setPropertyCommand = setPropertyCommand;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (DashStyle != null)
			{
				dashes = new DashesPropertyGridModelCollection(DashStyle.Dashes, lineStyleModel, this);
				offset = DashStyle.Offset;
			}
			else
			{
				dashes = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class DashesPropertyGridModelCollection : ObservableCollection<double>
	{
		private readonly WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel lineStyleModel;

		private readonly WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel dashStyleModel;

		private bool allowExecuteCommand = true;

		public DashesPropertyGridModelCollection(DoubleCollection collection, WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel lineStyleModel, WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel dashStyleModel)
		{
			this.lineStyleModel = lineStyleModel;
			this.dashStyleModel = dashStyleModel;
			UpdateCollection(collection);
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			if (allowExecuteCommand)
			{
				lineStyleModel.DashStyle = new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(dashStyleModel.ActualDashStyle);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return "(Collection)";
		}

		public void UpdateCollection(DoubleCollection items)
		{
			allowExecuteCommand = false;
			ClearItems();
			if (items != null)
			{
				foreach (double item in items)
				{
					Add(item);
				}
			}
			allowExecuteCommand = true;
		}
	}

		public static WpfChartTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, TopNOptionsBase options, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (options is CountTopNOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartCountTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (CountTopNOptions)options, propertyPath);
			}
			if (options is ValueTopNOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartValueTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (ValueTopNOptions)options, propertyPath);
			}
			if (options is PercentageTopNOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartPercentageTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (PercentageTopNOptions)options, propertyPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static WpfChartTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel CreatePiePropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, TopNOptionsBase options, string propertyPath)
		{
			if (options is CountTopNOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartPieCountTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (CountTopNOptions)options, propertyPath);
			}
			if (options is ValueTopNOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartPieValueTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (ValueTopNOptions)options, propertyPath);
			}
			if (options is PercentageTopNOptions)
			{
				return new WpfChartPiePercentageTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel(chartModel, (PercentageTopNOptions)options, propertyPath);
			}
			return null;
		}

		}

			this.topNOptions = topNOptions;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		protected void SetOthersPointExplodedDistance(double value)
		{
			SetAttachedProperty("OthersPointExplodedDistance", value, typeof(PieSeries), delegate(object targetObject, object newValue)
			{
				PieSeries.SetOthersPointExplodedDistance((TopNOptionsBase)targetObject, (double)newValue);
			}, (object targetObject) => PieSeries.GetOthersPointExplodedDistance((TopNOptionsBase)targetObject));
		}

		public abstract TopNOptionsBase CreateOptions();
	}

	public class WpfChartPropertyGridModel : WpfChartElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly ChangeChartPaletteCommand changePaletteCommand;

		private WpfChartToolTipOptionsPropertyGridModel toolTipOptions;

		private WpfChartToolTipControllerPropertyGridModel toolTipController;

		[Category("Behavior")]

		[Category("Elements")]
		public ChartTitlePropertyGridModelCollection Titles => titles;

		[Category("Elements")]
		public AnnotationPropertyGridModelCollection Annotations => annotations;

		[Category("Data")]
		public WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModelCollection CalculatedFields => calculatedFields;

		[Category("Elements")]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		public WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModelCollection Legends => legends;

		[Browsable(false)]
		public IEnumerable<PaletteViewModel> Palettes
		{
			get
			{
				if (palettes == null)
				{
					InitPalettes();
				}
				return palettes;
			}
		}

		public WpfChartPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel, string.Empty)
		{
			changePaletteCommand = new ChangeChartPaletteCommand(base.ChartModel);
			titles = new ChartTitlePropertyGridModelCollection(chartModel);
			if (chartModel != null && chartModel.TitleCollectionModel != null)
			{
				chartModel.TitleCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += TitlesCollectionUpdated;
			}
			annotations = new AnnotationPropertyGridModelCollection(chartModel);
			if (chartModel != null && chartModel.AnnotationCollectionModel != null)
			{
				chartModel.AnnotationCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += AnnotationsCollectionUpdated;
			}
			legends = new WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModelCollection(chartModel);
			if (chartModel != null && chartModel.LegendCollectionModel != null)
			{
				chartModel.LegendCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += LegendsCollectionUpdated;
			}
			calculatedFields = new WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModelCollection(chartModel);
			if (chartModel != null)
			{
				chartModel.Chart.CalculatedFields.CollectionChanged += CalculatedFieldsCollectionChanged;
			}
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private void InitPalettes()
		{
			Size colorElementSize = new Size(10.0, 10.0);
			palettes = new List<PaletteViewModel>();
			IEnumerable<PaletteImage> enumerable = PaletteUtils.GeneratePaletteImages(1.0, colorElementSize);
			foreach (PaletteImage item in enumerable)
			{
				PaletteViewModel paletteViewModel = new PaletteViewModel(item.Palette, item.Image);
				palettes.Add(paletteViewModel);
				if (Chart.Palette.PaletteName == paletteViewModel.Name)
				{
					actualPalette = paletteViewModel;
				}
			}
		}

		private void TitlesCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateCollectionHelper.UpdateCollection<WpfChartTitlePropertyGridModel, WpfChartTitleModel>(args, titles);
		}

		private void AnnotationsCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateCollectionHelper.UpdateCollection<WpfAnnotationPropertyGridModel, WpfChartAnnotationModel>(args, annotations);
		}

		private void LegendsCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateCollectionHelper.UpdateCollection<WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel, WpfChartLegendModel>(args, legends);
		}

		private void CalculatedFieldsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateCalculatedFields();
		}

		private void UpdateCalculatedFields()
		{
			calculatedFields.Clear();
			foreach (ChartCalculatedField calculatedField in Chart.CalculatedFields)
			{
				calculatedFields.Add(new WpfChartCalculatedFieldPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, calculatedField));
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Chart.ToolTipOptions != null)
			{
				if (toolTipOptions == null || Chart.ToolTipOptions != toolTipOptions.ToolTipOptions)
				{
					toolTipOptions = new WpfChartToolTipOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Chart.ToolTipOptions, "ToolTipOptions.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipOptions = null;
			}
			if (Chart.ToolTipController != null)
			{
				if (toolTipController == null || Chart.ToolTipController != toolTipController.ToolTipController)
				{
					toolTipController = new WpfChartToolTipControllerPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Chart.ToolTipController, "ToolTipController.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				toolTipController = null;
			}
			if (Chart.CrosshairOptions != null)
			{
				if (crosshairOptions == null || Chart.CrosshairOptions != crosshairOptions.CrosshairOptions)
				{
					crosshairOptions = new WpfChartCrosshairOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Chart.CrosshairOptions, "CrosshairOptions.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				crosshairOptions = null;
			}
			UpdateCalculatedFields();
		}
	}
	public static class UpdateCollectionHelper
	{
		public static void UpdateCollection<P, M>(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args, Collection<P> propertyGridCollection) where P : PropertyGridModelBase where M : ChartModelElement
		{
			foreach (InsertedItem addedItem in args.AddedItems)
			{
				if (addedItem.Index < propertyGridCollection.Count && propertyGridCollection[addedItem.Index].ModelElement == null)
				{
					propertyGridCollection[addedItem.Index].UpdateModelElement(addedItem.Item);
				}
				else
				{
					propertyGridCollection.Insert(addedItem.Index, (P)addedItem.Item.PropertyGridModel);
				}
			}
			List<P> list = new List<P>();
			foreach (M removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
			{
				foreach (P item in propertyGridCollection)
				{
					if (item.ModelElement == removedItem)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (P item2 in list)
			{
				propertyGridCollection.Remove(item2);
			}
		}
	}
	public class PaletteViewModel
	{
		private readonly ImageSource image;

		private readonly Palette palette;

		internal Palette Palette => palette;

		public ImageSource Image => image;

		public string Name => palette.PaletteName;

		public PaletteViewModel(Palette palette, ImageSource image)
		{
			this.image = image;
			this.palette = palette;
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{

	public abstract class SecondaryAxisPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionBase
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		protected abstract bool IsAxisX { get; }

		public SecondaryAxisPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected abstract void ExecuteCommand();

		protected abstract bool CanRemoveAxis(WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel axis);

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, PropertyGridModelBase item)
		{
			if (((WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel)item).IsFake)
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, (PropertyGridModelBase)WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForAxis(ChartModel.DiagramModel, IsAxisX));
			}
			else
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
			}
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.AxisModel == null)
					{
						ExecuteCommand();
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (CanRemoveAxis(oldItem))
					{
						RemoveSecondaryAxisCommand removeSecondaryAxisCommand = new RemoveSecondaryAxisCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)removeSecondaryAxisCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.AxisModel.Axis);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}

	}

		public static WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForAxis(WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel, bool isAxisX)
		{
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				if (isAxisX)
				{
					return new WpfChartAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(null);
				}
				return new WpfChartAxisY2DPropertyGridModel(null);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				if (isAxisX)
				{
					return new WpfChartAxisX3DPropertyGridModel(null);
				}
				return new WpfChartAxisY3DPropertyGridModel(null);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (isAxisX)
				{
					return new WpfChartRadarAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(null);
				}
				return new WpfChartCircularAxisY2DPropertyGridModel(null);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (isAxisX)
				{
					return new WpfChartCircularAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(null);
				}
				return new WpfChartCircularAxisY2DPropertyGridModel(null);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public static WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForAxis(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (axisModel.Axis is AxisX3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartAxisX3DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			if (axisModel.Axis is AxisY3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartAxisY3DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			if (axisModel.Axis is AxisX2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			if (axisModel.Axis is AxisY2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartAxisY2DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			if (axisModel.Axis is RadarAxisX2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartRadarAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			if (axisModel.Axis is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartCircularAxisY2DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			if (axisModel.Axis is PolarAxisX2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartCircularAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(axisModel);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(axisModel)
		{
			if (axisModel != null)
			{
				UpdateInternal();
			}
		}

		protected virtual WpfChartAxisLabelPropertyGridModel CreateLabelModel(AxisLabel label)
		{
			return new WpfChartAxisLabelPropertyGridModel(AxisModel, label);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (AxisModel == null || AxisModel.Axis == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Axis.GridLinesLineStyle != null)
			{
				if (gridLinesLineStyle == null || Axis.GridLinesLineStyle != gridLinesLineStyle.LineStyle)
				{
					gridLinesLineStyle = new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(AxisModel, Axis.GridLinesLineStyle, setPropertyCommand, "GridLinesLineStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				gridLinesLineStyle = null;
			}
			if (Axis.GridLinesMinorLineStyle != null)
			{
				if (gridLinesMinorLineStyle == null || Axis.GridLinesMinorLineStyle != gridLinesMinorLineStyle.LineStyle)
				{
					gridLinesMinorLineStyle = new WpfChartLineStylePropertyGridModel(AxisModel, Axis.GridLinesMinorLineStyle, setPropertyCommand, "GridLinesMinorLineStyle.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				gridLinesMinorLineStyle = null;
			}
			if (Axis.Label != null)
			{
				if (label == null || Axis.Label != label.Label)
				{
					label = CreateLabelModel(Axis.Label);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				label = (Axis.ActualLabel.Visible ? CreateLabelModel(Axis.ActualLabel) : null);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetAxisPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return AxisModel.Name;
		}
	}

			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					SetProperty("DateTimeScaleOptions", value.CreateScaleOptions());
				}
				else
				{
					SetProperty("DateTimeScaleOptions", null);
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public WpfChartTimeSpanScaleOptionsBasePropertyGridModel TimeSpanScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return timeSpanScaleOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					SetProperty("TimeSpanScaleOptions", value.CreateScaleOptions());
				}
				else
				{
					SetProperty("TimeSpanScaleOptions", null);
				}
			}
		}

		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Behavior")]
		public WpfChartQualitativeScaleOptionsPropertyGridModel QualitativeScaleOptions
		{
			get
			{
				return qualitativeScaleOptions;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					SetProperty("QualitativeScaleOptions", value.CreateScaleOptions());
				}
				else

					SetProperty("QualitativeScaleOptions", null);
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartRadarAxisX2DPropertyGridModel(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
			: base(axisModel)
		{
			optionsWholeRange = new WpfChartRadarAxisX2DWholeRangeOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel);
		}

		private WpfChartAxisRangePropertyGridModel CreateRangeModel(Range range, string propertyPath)
		{
			return new WpfChartAxisRangePropertyGridModel(base.AxisModel, range, propertyPath);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Axis.WholeRange != null)
			{
				if (wholeRange == null || Axis.WholeRange != wholeRange.Range)
				{
					wholeRange = CreateRangeModel(Axis.WholeRange, "WholeRange.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				wholeRange = null;
			}
			if (Axis.DateTimeScaleOptions != null)
			{
				dateTimeScaleOptions = WpfChartDateTimeScaleOptionsBasePropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModel(base.AxisModel, Axis.DateTimeScaleOptions, "DateTimeScaleOptions.");
			}
			else
			{
				dateTimeScaleOptions = null;
			}
			if (Axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions != null)
			{
				timeSpanScaleOptions = WpfChartTimeSpanScaleOptionsBasePropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModel(base.AxisModel, Axis.TimeSpanScaleOptions, "TimeSpanScaleOptions.");
			}
			else
			{
				timeSpanScaleOptions = null;
			}
			if (Axis.QualitativeScaleOptions != null)
			{
				qualitativeScaleOptions = WpfChartQualitativeScaleOptionsPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModel(base.AxisModel, Axis.QualitativeScaleOptions, "QualitativeScaleOptions.");
			}
			else
			{
				qualitativeScaleOptions = null;
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartAxisTitlePropertyGridModel : WpfChartTitleBasePropertyGridModel
	{

		internal new AxisTitle Title => base.Title as AxisTitle;

		[Category("Layout")]

		{
			get
			{
				return Title.Alignment;
			}
			set

				SetProperty("Alignment", value);
			}
		}

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		public WpfChartAxisTitlePropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartAxisTitlePropertyGridModel(ChartModelElement modelElement, AxisTitle title)
			: base(modelElement, title, "Title.")
		{
			setPropertyCommand = new SetAxisPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		protected override void ResetForegroundImpl()
		{
			base.Foreground = (Brush)Control.ForegroundProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected override void ResetFontSizeImpl()
		{
			base.FontSize = (double)Control.FontSizeProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected override void ResetFontStretchImpl()
		{
			base.FontStretch = (FontStretch)Control.FontStretchProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected override void ResetFontWeightImpl()
		{
			base.FontWeight = (FontWeight)Control.FontWeightProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected override void ResetFontStyleImpl()
		{
			base.FontStyle = (FontStyle)Control.FontStyleProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}

		protected override void ResetFontFamilyImpl()
		{
			base.FontFamily = (FontFamily)Control.FontFamilyProperty.DefaultMetadata.DefaultValue;
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartAxisTitleOptionsPropertyGridModel : WpfChartTitleOptionsPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private WpfChartAxisPropertyGridModel AxisModel => chartModel.SelectedModel.PropertyGridModel as WpfChartAxisPropertyGridModel;

		protected override WpfChartTitleBasePropertyGridModel TitleModel => AxisModel.Title;

		public WpfChartAxisTitleOptionsPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void CreateTitleIfNecessary()
		{
			if (TitleModel == null)
			{
				AxisModel.Title = new WpfChartAxisTitlePropertyGridModel();
				TitleModel.Visible = false;
			}
		}
	}

	public class DashStyleItemInitializer : IInstanceInitializer
	{
		IEnumerable<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> IInstanceInitializer.Types
		{
			get
			{
				List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> list = new List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo>();
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_Dash)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_DashDot)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_DashDotDot)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_Dot)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_Solid)));
				return list;
			}
		}

		object IInstanceInitializer.CreateInstance(DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo type)
		{
			if (type.Name == ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_Dash))
			{
				return new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(DashStyles.Dash);
			}
			if (type.Name == ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_DashDot))
			{
				return new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(DashStyles.DashDot);
			}
			if (type.Name == ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_DashDotDot))
			{
				return new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(DashStyles.DashDotDot);
			}
			if (type.Name == ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DashStyle_Dot))
			{
				return new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(DashStyles.Dot);
			}
			return new WpfChartDashStylePropertyGridModel(DashStyles.Solid);
		}
	}

	public class ColorizerKeyItemInitializer : IInstanceInitializer
	{
		IEnumerable<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> IInstanceInitializer.Types
		{
			get
			{
				List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> list = new List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo>();
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(string), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ColorizerKeyString)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(int), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ColorizerKeyInt)));
				list.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(typeof(double), ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ColorizerKeyDouble)));
				return list;
			}
		}

		object IInstanceInitializer.CreateInstance(DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo type)
		{
			if (type.Type == typeof(string))
			{
				return "New String";
			}
			if (type.Type == typeof(int))
			{
				return 0;
			}
			if (type.Type == typeof(double))
			{
				return 0.0;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ColorizerPaletteItemInitializer : IInstanceInitializer
	{
		private List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> types;

		IEnumerable<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo> IInstanceInitializer.Types => types;

		public ColorizerPaletteItemInitializer()
		{
			types = new List<DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo>();
			IEnumerable<Type> enumerable = from x in Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)).GetTypes()
				where (x.IsSubclassOf(typeof(PredefinedPalette)) && !x.IsAbstract) || x == typeof(CustomPalette)
				select x;
			foreach (Type item in enumerable)
			{
				Palette palette = (Palette)Activator.CreateInstance(item);
				types.Add(new DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo(item, palette.PaletteName));
			}
		}

		object IInstanceInitializer.CreateInstance(DevExpress.Mvvm.Native.TypeInfo type)
		{
			return PalettePropertyGridModel.Create(null, (Palette)Activator.CreateInstance(type.Type), isSegmentColorizer: false);
		}
	}
