	public class WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		public WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.LegendModel == null)
					{
						AddLegendCommand addLegendCommand = new AddLegendCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)addLegendCommand).Execute((object)null);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (chartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Contains(oldItem.LegendModel))
					{
						RemoveLegendCommand removeLegendCommand = new RemoveLegendCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)removeLegendCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.Legend);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel : TextElementPropertyGridModelBase<Legend>, ISupportVisibleModel
	{
		private readonly CustomLegendItemPropertyGridModelCollection customItems;

		private readonly WpfChartLegendTitleOptionsPropertyGridModel optionsTitle;

		private readonly ChangeLegendDockTargetCommand changeDockTargetCommand;

		private SetLegendPropertyCommand setPropertyCommand;

		private WpfChartLegendTitlePropertyGridModel title;

		internal WpfChartLegendModel LegendModel => base.ModelElement as WpfChartLegendModel;

		internal Legend Legend => TextElement;

		protected override Legend TextElement
		{
			get
			{
				if (LegendModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return LegendModel.Legend;
			}
		}

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setPropertyCommand;

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_ReverseItems)]
		public bool ReverseItems
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.ReverseItems;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ReverseItems", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_HorizontalPosition)]
		public HorizontalPosition HorizontalPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.HorizontalPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("HorizontalPosition", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_VerticalPosition)]
		public VerticalPosition VerticalPosition
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.VerticalPosition;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("VerticalPosition", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_DockTarget)]
		public ChartModelElement DockTarget
		{
			get
			{
				ChartModelElement chartModelElement = null;
				if (Legend.DockTarget != null)
				{
					chartModelElement = base.ChartModel.PerformFullSearch(Legend.DockTarget);
				}
				if (chartModelElement == null)
				{
					return base.ChartModel;
				}
				return chartModelElement;
			}
			set
			{
				((ICommand)changeDockTargetCommand).Execute((object)value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_MarkerMode)]
		public LegendMarkerMode MarkerMode
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.MarkerMode;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("MarkerMode", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_Visible)]
		public bool? Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.Visible;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Visible", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Layout")]
		public Thickness IndentFromDiagram
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.IndentFromDiagram;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("IndentFromDiagram", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_Orientation)]
		public Orientation Orientation
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.Orientation;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("Orientation", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Elements")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsLegend_ItemVisibilityMode)]
		public LegendItemVisibilityMode ItemVisibilityMode
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.ItemVisibilityMode;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("ItemVisibilityMode", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Elements")]
		public CustomLegendItemPropertyGridModelCollection CustomItems => customItems;

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double MaxCrosshairContentWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.MaxCrosshairContentWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("MaxCrosshairContentWidth", value);
			}
		}

		[Category("Behavior")]
		public double MaxCrosshairContentHeight
		{
			get
			{
				return Legend.MaxCrosshairContentHeight;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("MaxCrosshairContentHeight", value);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[DefaultValue(null)]
		[Category("Elements")]
		public WpfChartLegendTitlePropertyGridModel Title
		{
			get
			{
				return title;
			}
			set
			{
				LegendTitle value2 = ((value != null) ? new LegendTitle() : null);
				SetProperty("Title", value2);
			}
		}

		[TypeConverter(typeof(ExpandableObjectConverter))]
		[Category("Elements")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Options_Title)]
		public WpfChartLegendTitleOptionsPropertyGridModel OptionsTitle => optionsTitle;

		bool ISupportVisibleModel.Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (!Visible.HasValue)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return Visible.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				Visible = value;
			}
		}

		public WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel(WpfChartLegendModel legendModel)
			: base((Legend)null, (ChartModelElement)legendModel)
		{
			customItems = new CustomLegendItemPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel);
			optionsTitle = new WpfChartLegendTitleOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel);
			UpdateInternal();
			changeDockTargetCommand = new ChangeLegendDockTargetCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		private void UpdateTitle()
		{
			if (Legend.Title != null)
			{
				if (title == null || Legend.Title != title.Title)
				{
					title = new WpfChartLegendTitlePropertyGridModel(LegendModel, Legend.Title);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				title = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Legend == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			customItems.Clear();
			foreach (CustomLegendItem customItem in Legend.CustomItems)
			{
				customItems.Add(new WpfChartCustomLegendItemPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, customItem));
			}
			UpdateTitle();
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommands()
		{
			base.UpdateCommands();
			setPropertyCommand = new SetLegendPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return LegendModel.Name;
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartLegendTitleOptionsPropertyGridModel : WpfChartTitleOptionsPropertyGridModelBase

			}

	public class SeriesPointPropertyGridModelCollection : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel>
	{
		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel;

		public SeriesPointPropertyGridModelCollection(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.seriesModel = seriesModel;
		}

		protected override void OnCollectionChanged(NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnCollectionChanged(e);
			switch (e.Action)
			{
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Add:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					if (newItem.IsFake)
					{
						AddSeriesPointCommand addSeriesPointCommand = new AddSeriesPointCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)addSeriesPointCommand).Execute((object)seriesModel);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			case NotifyCollectionChangedAction.Remove:
			{
				foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					if (seriesModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Contains(oldItem.PointModel))
					{
						RemoveSeriesPointCommand removeSeriesPointCommand = new RemoveSeriesPointCommand(chartModel);
						((ICommand)removeSeriesPointCommand).Execute((object)oldItem.PointModel);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			}
			}
		}

		protected override void InsertItem(int index, WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel item)
		{
			if (item.IsFake)
			{
				WpfChartModel parent = seriesModel.GetParent<WpfChartModel>();
				WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel item2 = WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForSeriesPoint(parent, seriesModel.Series);
				if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(seriesModel.Series.ArgumentDataMember))
				{
					base.InsertItem(index, item2);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				base.InsertItem(index, item);
			}
		}
	}

		private static WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForSeriesPoint(WpfChartModel chartModel, Series series, WpfChartSeriesPointModel pointModel)
		{
			if (series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartRangeAreaSeries2DPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			if (series is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartRangeBarSeries2DPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			if (series is PieSeries)
			{
				return new WpfChartPieSeriesPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			if (series is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartBubbleSeries3DPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			if (series is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartBubbleSeries2DPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			if (series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartFinancialSeries2DPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			if (series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartBoxPlotSeries2DPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
			}
			return new WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel(chartModel, pointModel);
		}

		public static WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForSeriesPoint(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesPointModel pointModel)
		{
			return CreatePropertyGridModelForSeriesPoint(chartModel, pointModel.Series, pointModel);
		}

		public static WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForSeriesPoint(WpfChartModel chartModel, Series series)
		{
			return CreatePropertyGridModelForSeriesPoint(chartModel, series, null);
		}

		public WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel()
			: this(null, null)
		{
		}

		public WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesPointModel pointModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.pointModel = pointModel;
			setPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPointPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			setAttachedPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPointAttachedPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}
	}

		private SetSeriesLabelAttachedPropertyCommand CreateSetPropertyCommand(string propertyPath)
		{
			if (propertyPath == "FirstPoint.")

				return new SetSidePointLabelAttachedPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel, (Series s) => ((XYSeries2D)s).FirstPoint.Label);
			}
			if (propertyPath == "LastPoint.")
			{
				return new SetSidePointLabelAttachedPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel, (Series s) => ((XYSeries2D)s).LastPoint.Label);
			}
			return new SetSeriesLabelAttachedPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

	public static class PropertyDescriptions
	{
		public const string PropertyForOptions = "PropertyForOptions";
	}
	public class OptionsHeaderAttribute : Attribute
	{
		private readonly ChartDesignerStringIDs headerID;

		public string Header => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(headerID);

		public OptionsHeaderAttribute()
		{
		}

		public OptionsHeaderAttribute(ChartDesignerStringIDs headerID)
		{
			this.headerID = headerID;
		}
	}
	public abstract class PropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private ChartModelElement modelElement;

		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		protected internal ChartModelElement ModelElement => modelElement;

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		protected abstract ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand { get; }

		protected virtual ICommand SetObjectAttachedPropertyCommand => null;

		protected virtual string Name => base.ToString();

		public PropertyGridModelBase(ChartModelElement modelElement)
		{
			UpdateModelElementCore(modelElement, updatePropertyGridModel: false);
		}

		private void UpdateModelElementCore(ChartModelElement modelElement, bool updatePropertyGridModel)
		{
			if (modelElement != null)
			{
				this.modelElement = modelElement;
				chartModel = (WpfChartModel)((modelElement is WpfChartModel) ? modelElement : modelElement.GetParent<WpfChartModel>());
				UpdateCommands();
				if (updatePropertyGridModel)
				{
					modelElement.UpdatePropertyGridModel(this);
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateComplexProperties()
		{
			Type type = GetType();
			PropertyInfo[] properties = type.GetProperties();
			PropertyInfo[] array = properties;
			foreach (PropertyInfo propertyInfo in array)
			{
				object value = propertyInfo.GetValue(this, new object[0]);
				if (value is PropertyGridModelBase && value != null)
				{
					((PropertyGridModelBase)value).Update();
				}
			}
		}

		protected virtual void SetProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter parameter = new PropertyGridCommandParameter(propertyName, value, ModelElement);
			SetObjectPropertyCommand.Execute(parameter);
		}

		protected void SetProperty(string propertyName, object value, ChartModelElement model)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter parameter = new PropertyGridCommandParameter(propertyName, value, model);
			SetObjectPropertyCommand.Execute(parameter);
		}

		protected virtual void SetAttachedProperty(string propertyName, object value, Type propertyOwnerType, SetAttached setAttachedProperty, GetAttached getAttachedProperty)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached parameter = new PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached(propertyName, value, propertyOwnerType, setAttachedProperty, getAttachedProperty);
			SetObjectAttachedPropertyCommand.Execute(parameter);
		}

		protected void SetAttachedProperty(string propertyName, object value, ChartModelElement model, Type propertyOwnerType, SetAttached setAttachedProperty, GetAttached getAttachedProperty)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached parameter = new PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached(propertyName, value, model, propertyOwnerType, setAttachedProperty, getAttachedProperty);
			SetObjectAttachedPropertyCommand.Execute(parameter);
		}

		protected void SetProperty(ChartCommandBase command, object value)
		{
			((ICommand)command).Execute(value);
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateInternal()
		{
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCommands()
		{
		}

		public void Update()
		{
			UpdateInternal();
			UpdateComplexProperties();
		}

		public void UpdateModelElement(ChartModelElement modelElement)
		{
			UpdateModelElementCore(modelElement, updatePropertyGridModel: true);
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return $"({Name})";
		}
	}
	public abstract class NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase : PropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly string propertyPath;

		public NestedElementPropertyGridModelBase(ChartModelElement modelElement, string propertyPath)
			: base(modelElement)
		{
			this.propertyPath = propertyPath;
		}

		protected override void SetProperty(string propertyName, object value)
		{
			base.SetProperty(propertyPath + propertyName, value);
		}

		protected override void SetAttachedProperty(string propertyName, object value, Type propertyOwnerType, SetAttached setAttachedProperty, GetAttached getAttachedProperty)
		{
			string targetObjectPath = (string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyPath) ? null : propertyPath.Substring(0, propertyPath.Length - 1));
			PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached parameter = new PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached(targetObjectPath, propertyName, value, base.ModelElement, propertyOwnerType, setAttachedProperty, getAttachedProperty);
			SetObjectAttachedPropertyCommand.Execute(parameter);
		}
	}
	public abstract class PropertyGridModelCollectionBase : PropertyGridModelCollectionGeneric<PropertyGridModelBase>
	{
	}
	public class ValueScaleTypeConverter : EnumConverter
	{
		public ValueScaleTypeConverter(Type type)
			: base(type)
		{
		}

		public override StandardValuesCollection GetStandardValues(ITypeDescriptorContext context)
		{
			List<ScaleType> list = new List<ScaleType>();
			list.Add(ScaleType.Auto);
			list.Add(ScaleType.DateTime);
			list.Add(ScaleType.Numerical);
			list.Add(ScaleType.TimeSpan);
			return new StandardValuesCollection(list);
		}
	}
	public abstract class WpfChartSeriesPropertyGridModel : PropertyGridModelBase, ISupportVisibleModel
	{
		private readonly SetSeriesPropertyCommand setSeriesPropertyCommand;

		private readonly ChangeSeriesLegendCommand changeLegendCommand;

		private readonly SeriesPointPropertyGridModelCollection points;

		private WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel;

		private WpfChartSeriesLabelPropertyGridModel seriesLabel;

		private ChartColorizerBasePropertyGridModel colorizer;

		private WpfChartTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel topNOptions;

		private WpfChartLegendModel legend;

		private SummaryPropertyGridModel summaryModel;

		protected WpfChartSeriesModel SeriesModel => seriesModel;

		protected Series Series => seriesModel.Series;

		protected override ICommand SetObjectPropertyCommand => setSeriesPropertyCommand;

		[Category("Presentation")]
		[Description("PropertyForOptions")]
		[OptionsHeader(ChartDesignerStringIDs.OptionsSeries_DisplayName)]
		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{

		public static WpfChartSeriesPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForSeries(WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel, WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			if (seriesModel.Series is AreaSeries3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartAreaSeries3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartBubbleSeries3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is PointSeries3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartPointSeries3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is BarSeries3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartBarSeries3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is PieSeries3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartPieSeries3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is NestedDonutSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartNestedDonutSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is PieSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartPieSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is FunnelSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartFunnelSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is SplineAreaFullStackedSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartSplineAreaFullStackedSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is SplineAreaStackedSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartSplineAreaStackedSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is StockSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartStockSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is CandleStickSeries2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartCandleStickSeries2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, seriesModel);
			}
			if (seriesModel.Series is CircularLineSeries2D)
			{

			if (seriesModel.Series is CircularAreaSeries2D)

			if (seriesModel.Series is LineStepSeries2D)

			if (seriesModel.Series is SplineSeries2D)

		public WpfChartSeriesPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.seriesModel = seriesModel;
			setSeriesPropertyCommand = new SetSeriesPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
			changeLegendCommand = new ChangeSeriesLegendCommand(base.ChartModel);
			points = new SeriesPointPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel, seriesModel);
			seriesModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += SeriesPointCollectionUpdated;
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private void SeriesPointCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			foreach (InsertedItem addedItem in args.AddedItems)
			{
				if (addedItem.Index < points.Count)
				{
					points[addedItem.Index].PointModel = (WpfChartSeriesPointModel)addedItem.Item;
				}
				else
				{
					points.Insert(addedItem.Index, (WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel)addedItem.Item.PropertyGridModel);
				}
			}
			List<WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel> list = new List<WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel>();
			foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointModel removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
			{
				foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel point in points)
				{
					if (point.PointModel == removedItem)
					{
						list.Add(point);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointPropertyGridModel item in list)
			{
				points.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLegendModel()
		{
			if (Series.Legend != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && Series.Legend == legend.Legend)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WpfChartLegendModel item in base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Legend == Series.Legend)
						{
							legend = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			legend = ((base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0) ? ((WpfChartLegendModel)base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[0]) : null);
		}

		protected internal virtual WpfChartSeriesLabelPropertyGridModel CreateSeriesLabelModel(SeriesLabel seriesLabel, string propertyPath = "")
		{
			return new WpfChartSeriesLabelPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, seriesLabel, propertyPath);
		}

		protected virtual WpfChartTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel CreateTopNOptionsModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, TopNOptionsBase topNOptions, string path)
		{
			return WpfChartTopNOptionsPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModel(chartModel, topNOptions, path);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Series.Label != null)
			{
				if (seriesLabel == null || Series.Label != seriesLabel.Label)
				{
					seriesLabel = CreateSeriesLabelModel(Series.Label);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				seriesLabel = null;
			}
			if (Series.Colorizer != null)
			{
				if (colorizer == null || Series.Colorizer != colorizer.Colorizer)
				{
					colorizer = ChartColorizerBasePropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Series.Colorizer, "Colorizer.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				colorizer = null;
			}
			if (Series.TopNOptions != null)
			{
				if (topNOptions == null || Series.TopNOptions != topNOptions.TopNOptions)
				{
					topNOptions = CreateTopNOptionsModel(base.ChartModel, Series.TopNOptions, "TopNOptions.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				topNOptions = null;
			}
			if (Series.Summary != null)
			{
				if (summaryModel == null || Series.Summary != summaryModel.Summary)
				{
					summaryModel = SummaryPropertyGridModel.Create(base.ChartModel, Series.Summary);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				summaryModel = null;
			}
			UpdateLegendModel();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return seriesModel.Name;
		}
	}

		public WpfChartXYSeries2DPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel)
			: base(chartModel, seriesModel)
		{
			indicators = new IndicatorPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel, seriesModel);
			if (seriesModel.IndicatorCollectionModel != null)
			{
				seriesModel.IndicatorCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += IndicatorCollectionUpdated;
			}
			changePaneCommand = new ChangeSeriesPaneCommand(base.ChartModel);
			changeAxisXCommand = new ChangeSeriesAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
			changeAxisYCommand = new ChangeSeriesAxisYCommand(base.ChartModel);
			setEmptyPointOptionsCommand = new SetEmptyPointOptionsPropertyCommand(base.ChartModel);
		}

		private void IndicatorCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			foreach (InsertedItem addedItem in args.AddedItems)
			{
				if (addedItem.Index < indicators.Count)
				{
					indicators[addedItem.Index].UpdateModelElement((WpfChartIndicatorModel)addedItem.Item);
				}
				else
				{
					indicators.Insert(addedItem.Index, (WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel)addedItem.Item.PropertyGridModel);
				}
			}
			List<WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel> list = new List<WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel>();
			foreach (WpfChartIndicatorModel removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
			{
				foreach (WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel indicator in indicators)
				{
					if (indicator.IndicatorModel == removedItem)
					{
						list.Add(indicator);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel item in list)
			{
				indicators.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePaneModel()
		{
			if (Series.Pane != null && base.ChartModel.DiagramModel != null)
			{
				if (pane != null && Series.Pane == pane.Pane)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Series.Pane != base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.DefaultPaneModel.Pane)
				{
					foreach (WpfChartPaneModel item in base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Pane == Series.Pane)
						{
							pane = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				pane = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.DefaultPaneModel;
			}
			else
			{
				pane = null;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisXModel()
		{
			if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Series.AxisX != null)
			{
				if (axisX != null && Series.AxisX == axisX.Axis)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Series.AxisX != base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX.Axis)
				{
					foreach (WpfChartAxisModelX item in base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Axis == Series.AxisX)
						{
							axisX = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				axisX = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
			}
			else
			{
				axisX = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisYModel()
		{
			if (base.ChartModel.DiagramModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Series.AxisY != null)
			{
				if (axisY != null && Series.AxisY == axisY.Axis)
				{
					return;
				}
				if (Series.AxisY != base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY.Axis)
				{
					foreach (WpfChartAxisModelY item in base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Axis == Series.AxisY)
						{
							axisY = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
				axisY = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY;
			}
			else
			{
				axisY = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY;
			}
		}

		protected virtual WpfChartSidePointPropertyGridModel CreateSidePointModel(SidePoint sidePoint, string propertyPath)
		{
			return new WpfChartSidePointPropertyGridModel(base.SeriesModel, this, sidePoint, propertyPath);
		}

		protected virtual EmptyPointOptions CreateEmptyPointOptions()
		{
			return new EmptyPointOptions();
		}

		protected virtual WpfChartEmptyPointOptionsPropertyGridModel CreateEmptyPointOptionsModel(EmptyPointOptions options)
		{
			return new WpfChartEmptyPointOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, options);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (Series.RangeControlOptions != null)
			{
				if (rangeControlOptions == null || Series.RangeControlOptions != rangeControlOptions.RangeControlOptions)
				{
					rangeControlOptions = new WpfChartRangeControlOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Series.RangeControlOptions, "RangeControlOptions.");
				}
			}
			else
			{
				rangeControlOptions = null;
			}
			if (Series.FirstPoint != null && (firstPoint == null || Series.FirstPoint != firstPoint.SidePoint))
			{
				firstPoint = CreateSidePointModel(Series.FirstPoint, string.Format("{0}.", "FirstPoint"));
			}
			if (Series.LastPoint != null && (lastPoint == null || Series.LastPoint != lastPoint.SidePoint))
			{
				lastPoint = CreateSidePointModel(Series.LastPoint, string.Format("{0}.", "LastPoint"));
			}
			if (Series.EmptyPointOptions != null && (emptyPointOptions == null || Series.EmptyPointOptions != emptyPointOptions.Options))
			{
				emptyPointOptions = CreateEmptyPointOptionsModel(Series.EmptyPointOptions);
			}
			UpdatePaneModel();
			UpdateAxisXModel();
			UpdateAxisYModel();
		}
	}

	public abstract class WpfChartDiagramPropertyGridModel : WpfChartElementPropertyGridModelBase
	{
		private readonly WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel;

		protected WpfChartDiagramModel DiagramModel => diagramModel;

		protected Diagram Diagram => diagramModel.Diagram;

		[Category("Data")]
		public string SeriesDataMember
		{
			get
			{
				return Diagram.SeriesDataMember;
			}
			set
			{
				SetProperty("SeriesDataMember", value);
			}
		}

		public static WpfChartDiagramPropertyGridModel CreatePropertyGridModelForDiagram(WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel, WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartXYDiagram2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, diagramModel);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is SimpleDiagram2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartSimpleDiagram2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, diagramModel);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartXYDiagram3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, diagramModel);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is SimpleDiagram3D)
			{
				return new WpfChartSimpleDiagram3DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, diagramModel);
			}
			if (diagramModel.Diagram is CircularDiagram2D)
			{
				return new WpfChartCircularDiagram2DPropertyGridModel(chartModel, diagramModel);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public WpfChartDiagramPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel)
			: base(chartModel, "Diagram.")
		{
			this.diagramModel = diagramModel;
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartXYDiagram2DPropertyGridModel : WpfChartDiagramPropertyGridModel

		public WpfChartXYDiagram2DPropertyGridModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel)
			: base(chartModel, diagramModel)
		{
			panes = new PanePropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel);
			if (diagramModel != null && diagramModel.PanesCollectionModel != null)
			{
				diagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += PanesCollectionUpdated;
			}
			secondaryAxesX = new SecondaryAxisXPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel);
			if (diagramModel != null && diagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX != null)
			{
				diagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.CollectionUpdated += SecondaryAxesXCollectionUpdated;
			}
			secondaryAxesY = new SecondaryAxisYPropertyGridModelCollection(base.ChartModel);
			if (diagramModel != null && diagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY != null)
			{
				diagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.CollectionUpdated += SecondaryAxesYCollectionUpdated;
			}
			createPaneLayoutCommand = new CreatePaneLayoutCommand(chartModel);
			UpdateInternal();
		}

		private void UpdateCollection(PropertyGridModelCollectionBase collection, ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			foreach (InsertedItem addedItem in args.AddedItems)
			{
				if (addedItem.Index < collection.Count)
				{
					collection[addedItem.Index].UpdateModelElement(addedItem.Item);
				}
				else
				{
					collection.Insert(addedItem.Index, addedItem.Item.PropertyGridModel);
				}
			}
			List<PropertyGridModelBase> list = new List<PropertyGridModelBase>();
			foreach (ChartModelElement removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
			{
				foreach (PropertyGridModelBase item in collection)
				{
					if (item.ModelElement == removedItem)
					{
						list.Add(item);
					}
				}
			}
			foreach (PropertyGridModelBase item2 in list)
			{
				collection.Remove(item2);
			}
		}

		private void PanesCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateCollection(panes, args);
		}

		private void SecondaryAxesXCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateCollection(secondaryAxesX, args);
		}

		private void SecondaryAxesYCollectionUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateCollection(secondaryAxesY, args);
		}

		protected override void UpdateInternal()
		{
			base.UpdateInternal();
			if (base.DiagramModel == null || Diagram == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (Diagram.NavigationOptions != null)
			{
				if (navigationOptions == null || Diagram.NavigationOptions != navigationOptions.NavigationOptions)
				{
					navigationOptions = new WpfChartXYNavigationOptionsPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Diagram.NavigationOptions);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				navigationOptions = null;
			}
			if (Diagram.PaneLayout != null)
			{
				if (paneLayout == null || Diagram.PaneLayout != paneLayout.Layout)
				{
					paneLayout = new GridLayoutPropertyGridModel(base.ChartModel, Diagram.PaneLayout as GridLayout);
				}
				paneLayout.Update();
			}
			else
			{
				paneLayout = null;
			}
			if (base.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				panes.Clear();
				foreach (ChartModelElement item in base.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
				{
					panes.Add(item.PropertyGridModel);
				}
			}
			if (base.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				secondaryAxesX.Clear();
				foreach (ChartModelElement item2 in base.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection)
				{
					secondaryAxesX.Add(item2.PropertyGridModel);
				}
			}
			if (base.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			secondaryAxesY.Clear();
			foreach (ChartModelElement item3 in base.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection)
			{
				secondaryAxesY.Add(item3.PropertyGridModel);
			}
		}
	}

	public class PropertyGridCommandParameter
	{
		private readonly string propertyName;

		private readonly object value;

		private readonly ChartModelElement model;

		public string PropertyName => propertyName;

		public object Value => value;

		public ChartModelElement Model => model;

		public PropertyGridCommandParameter(string propertyName, object value, ChartModelElement model)
		{
			this.propertyName = propertyName;
			this.value = value;
			this.model = model;
		}
	}
	public delegate void SetAttached(object targetObject, object value);
	public delegate object GetAttached(object targetObject);
	public class PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached : PropertyGridCommandParameter
	{
		private readonly Type propertyOwnerType;

		private readonly SetAttached setAttachedProperty;

		private readonly GetAttached getAttachedProperty;

		private readonly string targetObjectPath;

		public Type PropertyOwnerType => propertyOwnerType;

		public SetAttached SetAttachedProperty => setAttachedProperty;

		public GetAttached GetAttachedProperty => getAttachedProperty;

		public string TargetObjectPath => targetObjectPath;

		public PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached(string targetObjectPath, string propertyName, object value, ChartModelElement model, Type propertyOwnerType, SetAttached setAttachedProperty, GetAttached getAttachedProperty)
			: this(propertyName, value, model, propertyOwnerType, setAttachedProperty, getAttachedProperty)
		{
			this.targetObjectPath = targetObjectPath;
		}

		public PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached(string propertyName, object value, Type propertyOwnerType, SetAttached setAttachedProperty, GetAttached getAttachedProperty)
			: this(propertyName, value, null, propertyOwnerType, setAttachedProperty, getAttachedProperty)
		{
		}

		public PropertyGridCommandParameterAttached(string propertyName, object value, ChartModelElement model, Type propertyOwnerType, SetAttached setAttachedProperty, GetAttached getAttachedProperty)
			: base(propertyName, value, model)
		{
			this.propertyOwnerType = propertyOwnerType;
			this.setAttachedProperty = setAttachedProperty;
			this.getAttachedProperty = getAttachedProperty;
		}
	}

		}

		{
			return true;
		}

		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			base.ChartModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.OldValue);
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;

			return historyItem.TargetObject;

	public class SetPanePropertyCommand : PropertyGridCommandBase
	{
		private const string paneIndexKey = "Pane";

		public SetPanePropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private void CreatePaneIfNeeded()
		{
			if (((XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram).DefaultPane == null)
			{
				ICommand command = new AddDefaultPaneCommand(base.ChartModel);
				command.Execute(null);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (propertyGridCommandParameter != null)

				return propertyGridCommandParameter.Model is WpfChartPaneModel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartPaneModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.DefaultPaneModel);
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			wpfChartPaneModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.OldValue);
			return wpfChartPaneModel?.Pane;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = ((num >= 0) ? ((WpfChartPaneModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num]) : base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.DefaultPaneModel);

			return wpfChartPaneModel?.Pane;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = (WpfChartPaneModel)propertyGridCommandParameter.Model;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))

				if (wpfChartPaneModel.GetSelfIndex() < 0)

					CreatePaneIfNeeded();
					wpfChartPaneModel = base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartPaneModel;
				}
				object oldValue = wpfChartPaneModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Pane", wpfChartPaneModel.GetSelfIndex())), this, null, oldValue, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value), wpfChartPaneModel.Pane);
			}

			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))
			{
				WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = (WpfChartPaneModel)propertyGridCommandParameter.Model;
				object oldValue = wpfChartPaneModel.StackedBarTotalLabelModel.SetChartElementProperty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("Pane", wpfChartPaneModel.GetSelfIndex());
				return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexItem), this, null, oldValue, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value), wpfChartPaneModel.StackedBarTotalLabelModel.StackedBarTotalLabel);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram;
			Pane pane = ((num == -1) ? xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes[0] : xYDiagram2D.ActualPanes[num]);
			StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(pane);
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(totalLabel, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val2 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val2))..ctor(typeof(BarStackedSeries2D), BarStackedSeries2D.TotalLabelProperty.Name);
			IModelItem value = val.Properties[val2].Value;
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetModelItemProperty(value, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
		}
	}

	public abstract class SetLayoutDefinitionPropertyCommandBase : PropertyGridCommandBase
	{
		protected const string layoutDefinitionIndexKey = "LayoutDefinition";

		private readonly LayoutDefinition definition;

		private XYDiagram2D Diagram => ((WpfChartDiagramModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).Diagram as XYDiagram2D;

		private GridLayout Layout => Diagram.PaneLayout as GridLayout;

		protected abstract string CollectionName { get; }

		public SetLayoutDefinitionPropertyCommandBase(WpfChartModel model, LayoutDefinition definition)
			: base(model)
		{
			this.definition = definition;
		}

		protected abstract LayoutDefinitionCollection GetCollection(GridLayout layout);

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(definition, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.OldValue);
			return base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(definition, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
			return base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))
			{
				GridLayout layout = Layout;
				int index = GetCollection(layout).IndexOf(definition);
				object objectProperty = CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(definition, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName);
				CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(definition, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("LayoutDefinition", index)), this, null, objectProperty, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				return new CommandResult(historyItem, Diagram);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["LayoutDefinition"];
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(GetCollection((GridLayout)((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).PaneLayout)[index], propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["LayoutDefinition"];
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			IModelItem val = value.Properties["PaneLayout"].Value.Properties[CollectionName].Collection[num];
			val.Properties[propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName].SetValue(propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ModelOptionsCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected const string seriesIndexKey = "seriesIndex";

		protected const string seriesDesigntimeIndexKey = "DesigntimeSeries";

		protected WpfChartSeriesModel SeriesModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartSeriesModel;

	public class DisableMarkerCommand : ModelOptionsCommand, IValueConverter
	{
		private Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.SeriesModel.Series;
			}
		}

		private ISupportMarker2D MarkerSeries => Series as ISupportMarker2D;

		private CircularLineSeries2D CircularLineSeries => Series as CircularLineSeries2D;

		private CircularAreaSeries2D CircularAreaSeries => Series as CircularAreaSeries2D;

		private bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (MarkerSeries == null)
				{
					if (CircularLineSeries == null)
					{
						if (CircularAreaSeries == null)
						{
							return false;
						}
						return CircularAreaSeries.MarkerVisible;
					}
					return CircularLineSeries.MarkerVisible;
				}
				return MarkerSeries.MarkerVisible;
			}
			set
			{
				if (MarkerSeries != null)
				{
					MarkerSeries.MarkerVisible = value;
				}
				else if (CircularLineSeries != null)
				{
					CircularLineSeries.MarkerVisible = value;
				}
				else if (CircularAreaSeries != null)
				{
					CircularAreaSeries.MarkerVisible = value;
				}
			}
		}

		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SeriesOptions_NoModelString);

		public DisableMarkerCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				if (wpfChartSeriesModel.Series is ISupportMarker2D supportMarker2D && !(supportMarker2D is PointSeries2D) && !(supportMarker2D is BubbleSeries2D))
				{
					return !supportMarker2D.MarkerVisible;
				}
				if (wpfChartSeriesModel.Series is CircularLineSeries2D circularLineSeries2D)
				{
					return !circularLineSeries2D.MarkerVisible;
				}
				if (wpfChartSeriesModel.Series is CircularAreaSeries2D circularAreaSeries2D)
				{
					return !circularAreaSeries2D.MarkerVisible;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if ((MarkerSeries == null || MarkerSeries is PointSeries2D || MarkerSeries is BubbleSeries2D) && CircularLineSeries == null)
			{
				return CircularAreaSeries != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Visible = (bool)historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["seriesIndex"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			bool markerVisible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			if (series is ISupportMarker2D)
			{
				((ISupportMarker2D)series).MarkerVisible = markerVisible;
			}
			else if (series is CircularLineSeries2D)
			{
				((CircularLineSeries2D)series).MarkerVisible = markerVisible;
			}
			else if (series is CircularAreaSeries2D)
			{
				((CircularAreaSeries2D)series).MarkerVisible = markerVisible;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			val.Properties["MarkerVisible"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || !(bool)parameter)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("seriesIndex", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex()));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, Series, Visible, false);
			Visible = false;
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}
	}

	public class ToggleMarker2DVisibleCommand : ModelOptionsCommand
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		private Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.SeriesModel.Series;
			}
		}

		public ToggleMarker2DVisibleCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private void ApplyValue(Series series, bool value, out bool oldValue)
		{
			ISupportMarker2D supportMarker2D = series as ISupportMarker2D;
			oldValue = false;
			if (supportMarker2D != null)
			{
				if (!(supportMarker2D is PointSeries2D) && !(supportMarker2D is BubbleSeries2D))
				{
					oldValue = supportMarker2D.MarkerVisible;
					supportMarker2D.MarkerVisible = value;
				}
			}
			else if (series is CircularSeries2D circularSeries2D)
			{
				if (circularSeries2D is CircularLineSeries2D)
				{
					oldValue = ((CircularLineSeries2D)circularSeries2D).MarkerVisible;
					((CircularLineSeries2D)circularSeries2D).MarkerVisible = value;
				}
				if (circularSeries2D is CircularAreaSeries2D)
				{
					oldValue = ((CircularAreaSeries2D)circularSeries2D).MarkerVisible;
					((CircularAreaSeries2D)circularSeries2D).MarkerVisible = value;
				}
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter is bool;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			ApplyValue(Series, (bool)parameter, out var oldValue);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("seriesIndex", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())), this, Series, oldValue, (bool)parameter));
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = (Series)historyItem.TargetObject;
			ApplyValue(series, (bool)historyItem.OldValue, out var _);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = (Series)historyItem.TargetObject;
			ApplyValue(series, (bool)historyItem.NewValue, out var _);
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["seriesIndex"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			ApplyValue(series, (bool)historyItem.NewValue, out var _);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			Series series = (Series)val.GetCurrentValue();
			if ((!(series is PointSeries2D) && !(series is BubbleSeries2D)) || series is CircularLineSeries2D || series is CircularAreaSeries2D)
			{
				val.Properties["MarkerVisible"].SetValue((object)(bool)historyItem.NewValue);
			}
		}
	}
	public class Marker2DModelCommand : ModelOptionsCommand, IValueConverter
	{
		private readonly Marker2DKind kind;

		private Series Series
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.SeriesModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return base.SeriesModel.Series;
			}
		}

		private ISupportMarker2D MarkerSeries => Series as ISupportMarker2D;

		private CircularSeries2D CircularSeries => Series as CircularSeries2D;

		private CircularLineSeries2D CircularLineSeries => CircularSeries as CircularLineSeries2D;

		private CircularAreaSeries2D CircularAreaSeries => CircularSeries as CircularAreaSeries2D;

		private bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (MarkerSeries != null)
				{
					if (!(MarkerSeries is PointSeries2D) && !(MarkerSeries is BubbleSeries2D))
					{
						return MarkerSeries.MarkerVisible;
					}
					return true;
				}
				if (CircularSeries != null)
				{
					if (CircularLineSeries == null)
					{
						if (CircularAreaSeries == null)
						{
							return true;
						}
						return CircularAreaSeries.MarkerVisible;
					}
					return CircularLineSeries.MarkerVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public override string Caption => kind.ToString();

		public static Marker2DModel GetModel(object kind)
		{
			return (Marker2DModel)Activator.CreateInstance(((Marker2DKind)kind).Type);
		}

		public static Marker2DKind GetKind(Type modelType)
		{
			IEnumerable<Marker2DKind> predefinedKinds = Marker2DModel.GetPredefinedKinds();
			foreach (Marker2DKind item in predefinedKinds)
			{
				if (object.Equals(item.Type, modelType))
				{
					return item;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public Marker2DModelCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Marker2DKind kind)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.kind = kind;
		}

		object IValueConverter.Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				if (wpfChartSeriesModel.Series is ISupportMarker2D supportMarker2D)
				{
					bool flag = object.Equals(kind.Type, supportMarker2D.MarkerModel.GetType());
					if (supportMarker2D is PointSeries2D || supportMarker2D is BubbleSeries2D)
					{
						return flag;
					}
					return supportMarker2D.MarkerVisible && flag;
				}
				if (wpfChartSeriesModel.Series is CircularSeries2D circularSeries2D)
				{
					bool flag2 = object.Equals(kind.Type, circularSeries2D.MarkerModel.GetType());
					if (circularSeries2D is CircularLineSeries2D)
					{
						return ((CircularLineSeries2D)circularSeries2D).MarkerVisible && flag2;
					}
					if (circularSeries2D is CircularAreaSeries2D)
					{
						return ((CircularAreaSeries2D)circularSeries2D).MarkerVisible && flag2;
					}
					return flag2;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		object IValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (MarkerSeries == null)
			{
				return CircularSeries != null;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ApplyValue(Series, (Marker2DKind)historyItem.OldValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ApplyValue(Series, (Marker2DKind)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["seriesIndex"];
			Series series = ((num >= 0) ? chartControl.Diagram.Series[num] : chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			ApplyValue(series, kind);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			val.Properties["MarkerModel"].SetValue((object)GetModel(kind));
		}

		private void ApplyValue(Series series, Marker2DKind kind)
		{
			ISupportMarker2D supportMarker2D = series as ISupportMarker2D;
			Marker2DModel model = GetModel(kind);
			if (supportMarker2D != null)
			{
				supportMarker2D.MarkerModel = model;
			}
			else if (series is CircularSeries2D circularSeries2D)
			{
				circularSeries2D.MarkerModel = model;
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || !(bool)parameter)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			Marker2DModel marker2DModel = ((MarkerSeries != null) ? MarkerSeries.MarkerModel : CircularSeries.MarkerModel);
			if (!Visible)
			{
				ToggleMarker2DVisibleCommand toggleMarker2DVisibleCommand = new ToggleMarker2DVisibleCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(toggleMarker2DVisibleCommand.RuntimeExecute(true).HistoryItem);
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("seriesIndex", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex()));
			Marker2DKind oldValue = GetKind(marker2DModel.GetType());
			ApplyValue(Series, kind);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, Series, oldValue, kind));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || !(bool)parameter)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("seriesIndex", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", base.SeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex()));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, Series, GetKind(Series.Model.GetType()), kind);
			Series.Model = GetModel(kind);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}
	}
	public class SetEmptyPointOptionsPropertyCommand : SetSeriesPropertyCommand
	{
		public SetEmptyPointOptionsPropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override object SetChartElementProperty(object value, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel, PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter)
		{
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = seriesModel.Series as XYSeries2D;
			EmptyPointOptions result = null;
			if (xYSeries2D != null)
			{
				result = xYSeries2D.EmptyPointOptions;
				xYSeries2D.EmptyPointOptions = (EmptyPointOptions)value;
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void SetObjectProperty(object value, Series series, PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter)
		{
			if (series is XYSeries2D xYSeries2D)
			{
				xYSeries2D.EmptyPointOptions = (EmptyPointOptions)value;
			}
		}
	}
	public class SetEmptyPointOptionsInnerPropertyCommand : SetSeriesPropertyCommand
	{
		private const string prefix = "EmptyPointOptions.";

		public SetEmptyPointOptionsInnerPropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override object SetChartElementProperty(object value, WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel, PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter)
		{
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = seriesModel.Series as XYSeries2D;
			object result = null;
			if (xYSeries2D != null && xYSeries2D.EmptyPointOptions != null)
			{
				string propertyPath = commandParameter.PropertyName.Replace("EmptyPointOptions.", string.Empty);
				EmptyPointOptions emptyPointOptions = xYSeries2D.EmptyPointOptions;
				result = CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(emptyPointOptions, propertyPath);
				CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(emptyPointOptions, propertyPath, value);
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected override void SetObjectProperty(object value, Series series, PropertyGridCommandParameter commandParameter)
		{
			if (series is XYSeries2D { EmptyPointOptions: var emptyPointOptions })
			{
				CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(emptyPointOptions, commandParameter.PropertyName.Replace("EmptyPointOptions.", string.Empty), value);
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class StripCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public const string AxisKey = "Axis";

		public const string SecondaryAxisKey = "SecondaryAxis";

		public const string StripKey = "Strip";

		protected WpfChartStripModel SelectedStripModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartStripModel;

		public Strip SelectedStrip => SelectedStripModel?.Strip;

		protected XYDiagram2D PreviewXYDiagram2D => (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;

		public StripCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected ElementIndexItem[] GetPathIndexItemList(Axis2D axis2D = null)
		{
			return FontCommandUtils.GetStripPathIndices(axis2D, SelectedStrip, PreviewXYDiagram2D);
		}

		protected WpfChartStripModel GetStripModel(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel;
			switch (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"])
			{
			case -1:
				wpfChartAxisModel = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
				break;
			case -2:
				wpfChartAxisModel = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY;
				break;
			case -3:
			{
				int index2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[index2];
				break;
			}
			case -4:
			{
				int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[index];
				break;
			}
			default:
				throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown pseudo index.");
			}
			int index3 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Strip"];
			return (WpfChartStripModel)wpfChartAxisModel.StripCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index3];
		}

		protected Strip GetTargetStripForRuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram;
			Axis2D targetAxisForRuntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Strip"];
			return targetAxisForRuntimeApply.Strips[index];
		}

		protected IModelItem GetTargetStripForDesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			IModelItem targetAxisForDesigntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Strip"];
			return targetAxisForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Strips"].Collection[num];
		}
	}
	public class ChangeStripMinLimitCommand : StripCommandBase
	{
		private string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Strip_MinLimit);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public BarEditValueItemViewModel EditorModel { get; set; }

		public ChangeStripMinLimitCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private void ShowErrorMessage(string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption, string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage, incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
			if (EditorModel != null)
			{
				EditorModel.EditValue = EditorModel.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning("ChangeStripMinLimitCommand.EditorModel property was not set. That's why EditValue in an editor was not reset.");
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.SelectedStripModel != null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			AxisBase stripOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetStripOwner(base.SelectedStrip);
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetAxisScaleTypeMap(stripOwner);
			object obj;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
			{
				obj = parameter.ToString();
			}
			else if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisNumericalMap)
			{
				if (!double.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result))
				{
					string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithNumericalStripMinLimitCaption);
					string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithNumericalStripMinLimitMessage);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption, incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result;
			}
			else if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisDateTimeMap)
			{
				if (!DateTime.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result2))
				{
					string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithDateTimeStripMinLimitCaption);
					string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithDateTimeStripMinLimitMessage);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption2, incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage2);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(axisScaleTypeMap is AxisTimeSpanMap))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown ScaleTypeMap.");
				}
				if (!TimeSpan.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result3))
				{
					string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithTimeSpanStripMinLimitCaption);
					string incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithTimeSpanStripMinLimitMessage);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxCaption3, incompatibleStripValueMsgBoxMessage3);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result3;
			}
			object minLimit = base.SelectedStripModel.MinLimit;
			base.SelectedStripModel.MinLimit = obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexItemList);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedStrip, minLimit, obj);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Strip strip = (Strip)historyItem.TargetObject;
			strip.MinLimit = historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Strip strip = (Strip)historyItem.TargetObject;
			strip.MinLimit = historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Strip targetStripForRuntimeApply = GetTargetStripForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			targetStripForRuntimeApply.MinLimit = historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetStripForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetStripForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			targetStripForDesigntimeApply.Properties["MinLimit"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}
