	public class ChangeStripLegendCommand : StripCommandBase
	{
		private const string LegendIndexKey = "Legend";

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeStripLegendCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedStripModel != null)
			{
				return parameter is WpfChartLegendModel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartLegendModel wpfChartLegendModel = (WpfChartLegendModel)parameter;
			int num = ((base.SelectedStripModel.Legend != null) ? base.SelectedStripModel.Legend.GetSelfIndex() : (-1));
			base.SelectedStripModel.Legend = wpfChartLegendModel;
			int selfIndex = wpfChartLegendModel.GetSelfIndex();
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[3]
			{
				pathIndexItemList[0],
				pathIndexItemList[1],
				new ElementIndexItem("Legend", selfIndex)
			};
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedStripModel, num, selfIndex);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.SelectedStrip);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartStripModel wpfChartStripModel = (WpfChartStripModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			int num = (int)historyItem.OldValue;
			if (num != -1)
			{
				wpfChartStripModel.Legend = (WpfChartLegendModel)base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num];
			}
			else
			{
				wpfChartStripModel.Legend = null;
			}
			return wpfChartStripModel?.Strip;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartStripModel wpfChartStripModel = (WpfChartStripModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			int index = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			wpfChartStripModel.Legend = (WpfChartLegendModel)base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index];
			return wpfChartStripModel?.Strip;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Strip targetStripForRuntimeApply = GetTargetStripForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			int index = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			Legend legend = chartControl.Legends[index];
			targetStripForRuntimeApply.Legend = legend;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetStripForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetStripForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			int num = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			IModelItem val = LegendCommandsHelper.FindLegendModelItem(chartModelItem, num);
			string text = ((num == -1) ? "legend" : ("legend" + num));
			val.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
			IModelItem value = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(targetStripForDesigntimeApply, text);
			targetStripForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Legend"].SetValue((object)value);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartCommandBase : ICommand
	{
		private readonly WeakReference chartModel;

		private readonly DesignerBehavior behavior;

		protected WpfChartModel ChartModel => (WpfChartModel)chartModel.Target;

		protected ChartControl PreviewChart => ChartModel.Chart;

		protected DesignerBehavior Behavior => behavior;

		public abstract string Caption { get; }

		public abstract string ImageName { get; }

		public virtual string Description => null;

		private event EventHandler canExecuteChanged;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canExecuteChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				canExecuteChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler CommandExecuted;

		public ChartCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
		{
			chartModel = new WeakReference(model);
			if (model != null)
			{
				behavior = ((IDesignerBehaviorProvider)model).Behavior;
			}
			else
			{
				behavior = DesignerBehavior.Bar;
			}
		}

		bool ICommand.CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return CanExecute(parameter);
		}

		void ICommand.Execute(object parameter)
		{
			if (CanExecute(parameter))
			{
				CommandResult commandResult = RuntimeExecute(parameter);
				if (commandResult != null)
				{
					ChartModel.CommandManager.AddHistoryItem(commandResult.HistoryItem);
					UpdateChartModelAfterCommandExecution(commandResult);
					RiseCommandExecutedEvent();
					ChartModel.SelectedPageName = commandResult.SelectedPageName;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.Fail("The " + GetType().Name + " can not be executed because the CanExecute method has returned a false value.");
			}
		}

		private void UpdateChartModelAfterCommandExecution(CommandResult result)
		{
			if (result != null)
			{
				ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
				ChartModel.UpdateCommandsCanExecute();
				if (result.SelectedChartObject != null)
				{
					ChartModel.SelectedObject = result.SelectedChartObject;
				}
				ChartModel.UpdateModelProperties();
			}
		}

		private void RiseCommandExecutedEvent()
		{
			if (this.CommandExecuted != null)
			{
				this.CommandExecuted(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		protected abstract bool CanExecute(object parameter);

		protected abstract object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem);

		protected abstract object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem);

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public abstract void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider);

		public void RaiseCanExecuteChanged()
		{
			if (this.canExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				this.canExecuteChanged(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		public void Redo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			object obj = RuntimeRedo(historyItem);
			ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			ChartModel.UpdateCommandsCanExecute();
			if (obj != null)
			{
				ChartModel.SelectedObject = obj;
				ChartModel.UpdateModelProperties();
			}
		}

		public void RegisterForUpdate()
		{
			ChartModel.RegisterCommand(this);
		}

		public abstract void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem);

		public abstract CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter);

		public void Undo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			object obj = RuntimeUndo(historyItem);
			ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			ChartModel.UpdateCommandsCanExecute();
			if (obj != null)
			{
				ChartModel.SelectedObject = obj;
				ChartModel.UpdateModelProperties();
			}
		}

		public CommandResult RuntimeExecuteAndUpdateChartModel(object parameter)
		{
			CommandResult result = RuntimeExecute(parameter);
			UpdateChartModelAfterCommandExecution(result);
			return result;
		}
	}
	public class AddSeriesCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string paneIndexName = "Pane";

		private readonly string seriesNamePrefix = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DefaultSeriesNamePrefix);

		private string caption;

		private string imageName;

		private double valueOffset;

		private double argumentOffset;

		private Type seriesType;

		private Type previousAddedSeriesType;

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => imageName;

		public AddSeriesCommand(WpfChartModel model, Type seriesType)
			: base(model)
		{
			this.seriesType = seriesType;
			imageName = "Series/" + seriesType.Name;
			ChartDesignerStringIDs id = (ChartDesignerStringIDs)Enum.Parse(typeof(ChartDesignerStringIDs), seriesType.Name);
			caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(id);
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> CreatePointsForFunnelSeries(Series series)
		{
			Type type = series.GetType();
			if (previousAddedSeriesType == type)
			{
				argumentOffset += 1.0;
			}
			previousAddedSeriesType = type;
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			NonCryptographicRandom system = NonCryptographicRandom.System;
			for (int num = 5; num > 0; num--)
			{
				double value = 15 * num + system.Next(0, 10);
				SeriesPoint item = new SeriesPoint((double)num + argumentOffset, value);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> CreatePointsForPolarSeries(Series series)
		{
			Type type = series.GetType();
			if (previousAddedSeriesType == type)
			{
				argumentOffset += 1.0;
			}
			previousAddedSeriesType = type;
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			NonCryptographicRandom system = NonCryptographicRandom.System;
			for (int num = 4; num > 0; num--)
			{
				double value = 10 * num + system.Next(0, 10);
				SeriesPoint item = new SeriesPoint(((double)num + argumentOffset - 1.0) * 90.0, value);
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> CreatePoints(Series series, bool shouldGenerateNegativeValues)
		{
			Type type = series.GetType();
			if (previousAddedSeriesType == type && !type.Name.Contains("Stacked") && !type.Name.Contains("SideBySide"))
			{
				argumentOffset += 1.0;
			}
			previousAddedSeriesType = type;
			valueOffset += 1.5;
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			NonCryptographicRandom system = NonCryptographicRandom.System;
			for (int i = 1; i <= 5; i++)
			{
				double num = Math.Pow(-1.0, i);
				double num2 = (double)(3 * i) - num * 2.0 + valueOffset - (double)((shouldGenerateNegativeValues && num > 0.0) ? 15 : 0);
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint((double)i + argumentOffset, num2);
				if (series is RangeBarSeries2D)
				{
					RangeBarSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num2 + (double)system.Next(-5, 5));
				}
				if (series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
				{
					RangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num2 + (double)system.Next(-5, 5));
				}
				if (series is RadarRangeAreaSeries2D)
				{
					RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num2 + (double)system.Next(-5, 5));
				}
				if (series is PolarRangeAreaSeries2D)
				{
					PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.SetValue2(seriesPoint, num2 + (double)system.Next(-5, 5));
				}
				if (series is BubbleSeries2D)
				{
					BubbleSeries2D.SetWeight(seriesPoint, num2 + (double)system.Next(0, 5));
				}
				if (series is BubbleSeries3D)
				{
					BubbleSeries3D.SetWeight(seriesPoint, num2 + (double)system.Next(0, 5));
				}
				if (series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
				{
					BoxPlotNumericValues values = new BoxPlotNumericValues(system.Next(1, 5), system.Next(6, 10), system.Next(11, 15), system.Next(21, 25), system.Next(26, 30), system.Next(16, 20));
					BoxPlotSeries2D.SetValues(seriesPoint, values);
				}
				list.Add(seriesPoint);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> CreatePointsForFinancialSeries(Series series)
		{
			List<SeriesPoint> list = new List<SeriesPoint>();
			Type type = series.GetType();
			if (previousAddedSeriesType == type && !type.Name.Contains("Stacked") && !type.Name.Contains("SideBySide"))
			{
				argumentOffset += 1.0;
			}
			previousAddedSeriesType = type;
			NonCryptographicRandom system = NonCryptographicRandom.System;
			double num = system.Next(50, 150);
			for (int i = 0; i < 30; i++)
			{
				double num2 = num;
				double num3 = num2 + (double)system.Next(-20, 20);
				double value = Math.Min(num2, num3) - (double)system.Next(0, 10);
				double value2 = Math.Max(num2, num3) + (double)system.Next(0, 10);
				num = num3;
				SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint(DateTime.Today.AddDays(i));
				FinancialSeries2D.SetLowValue(seriesPoint, value);
				FinancialSeries2D.SetOpenValue(seriesPoint, num2);
				FinancialSeries2D.SetCloseValue(seriesPoint, num3);
				FinancialSeries2D.SetHighValue(seriesPoint, value2);
				list.Add(seriesPoint);
			}
			return list;
		}

		private IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> CreatePointsForSeries(Series series)
		{
			if (series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				return CreatePointsForFinancialSeries(series);
			}
			if (series is FunnelSeries2D)
			{
				return CreatePointsForFunnelSeries(series);
			}
			if (series is PolarLineSeries2D || series is PolarPointSeries2D || series is PolarAreaSeries2D || series is PolarLineScatterSeries2D)
			{
				return CreatePointsForPolarSeries(series);
			}
			return CreatePoints(series, series is WaterfallSeries2D);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private List<IModelItem> CreatePointsForSeries(IEditingContext context, IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> points)
		{
			//IL_009f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00ef: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_013f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_018f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01df: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_022f: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_027a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0319: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0337: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0355: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0373: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			List<IModelItem> list = new List<IModelItem>();
			DXPropertyIdentifier val2 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val3 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val4 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val5 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val6 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val7 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val8 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val9 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val10 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val11 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			DXPropertyIdentifier val12 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in points)
			{
				IModelItem val = context.CreateItem(typeof(SeriesPoint));
				val.Properties["Argument"].SetValue((object)point.Argument);
				val.Properties["Value"].SetValue((object)point.Value);
				if (seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(RangeBarSeries2D)))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val2))..ctor(typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), RangeBarSeries2D.Value2Property.Name);
					val.Properties[val2].SetValue((object)RangeBarSeries2D.GetValue2(point));
				}
				if (seriesType == typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val3))..ctor(typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), RangeAreaSeries2D.Value2Property.Name);
					val.Properties[val3].SetValue((object)RangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(point));
				}
				if (seriesType == typeof(RadarRangeAreaSeries2D))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val4))..ctor(typeof(RadarRangeAreaSeries2D), RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.Value2Property.Name);
					val.Properties[val4].SetValue((object)RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(point));
				}
				if (seriesType == typeof(PolarRangeAreaSeries2D))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val5))..ctor(typeof(PolarRangeAreaSeries2D), PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.Value2Property.Name);
					val.Properties[val5].SetValue((object)PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(point));
				}
				if (seriesType == typeof(BubbleSeries2D))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val6))..ctor(typeof(BubbleSeries2D), BubbleSeries2D.WeightProperty.Name);
					val.Properties[val6].SetValue((object)BubbleSeries2D.GetWeight(point));
				}
				if (seriesType == typeof(BubbleSeries3D))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val7))..ctor(typeof(BubbleSeries3D), BubbleSeries3D.WeightProperty.Name);
					val.Properties[val7].SetValue((object)BubbleSeries3D.GetWeight(point));
				}
				if (seriesType == typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val8))..ctor(typeof(BoxPlotSeries2D), "Values");
					val.Properties[val8].SetValue((object)BoxPlotSeries2D.GetValues(point));
				}
				if (seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(FinancialSeries2D)))
				{
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val9))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), FinancialSeries2D.LowValueProperty.Name);
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val10))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), FinancialSeries2D.OpenValueProperty.Name);
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val11))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), FinancialSeries2D.CloseValueProperty.Name);
					((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val12))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), FinancialSeries2D.HighValueProperty.Name);
					val.Properties[val9].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetLowValue(point));
					val.Properties[val10].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetOpenValue(point));
					val.Properties[val11].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetCloseValue(point));
					val.Properties[val12].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetHighValue(point));
				}
				list.Add(val);
			}
			return list;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.PreviewChart.Diagram == null)
			{
				return true;
			}
			Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesType);
			if (supportedDiagramType == base.PreviewChart.Diagram.GetType())
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series item = historyItem.NewValue as Series;
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Remove(item);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = historyItem.NewValue as Series;
			if (series != null)
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Add(series);
			}
			return series;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(seriesType);
			if (seriesType.IsSubclassOf(typeof(FinancialSeries2D)))
			{
				val.Properties["ArgumentScaleType"].SetValue((object)ScaleType.DateTime);
			}
			val.Properties["DisplayName"].SetValue((object)((Series)historyItem.NewValue).DisplayName);
			List<IModelItem> list = CreatePointsForSeries(chartModelItem.Context, (IEnumerable<SeriesPoint>)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.AdditionalInfo);
			foreach (IModelItem item in list)
			{
				val.Properties["Points"].Collection.Add(item);
			}
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				IModelItem val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[num];
				string text = "pane" + num;
				val2.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
				IModelItem value = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(val, text);
				val.Properties["Pane"].SetValue((object)value);
			}
			chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection.Add(val);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType);
			if (series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				series.ArgumentScaleType = ScaleType.DateTime;
			}
			series.DisplayName = seriesNamePrefix + " " + chartControl.Diagram.Series.Count;
			series.Points.AddRange(CreatePointsForSeries(series));
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"] >= 0)
			{
				((XYSeries2D)series).Pane = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).Panes[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"]];
			}
			chartControl.Diagram.Series.Add(series);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			Diagram diagram = base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesType);
			if (diagram == null)
			{
				CreateDiagramCommand createDiagramCommand = new CreateDiagramCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(createDiagramCommand.RuntimeExecute(supportedDiagramType).HistoryItem);
			}
			Series series = (Series)Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType);
			IEnumerable<SeriesPoint> enumerable = CreatePointsForSeries(series);
			series.Points.AddRange(enumerable);
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Add(series);
			series.DisplayName = seriesNamePrefix + " " + base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Count;
			int index = -1;
			if (base.ChartModel.SelectedObject is Pane && series is XYSeries2D && base.ChartModel.SelectedObject != ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).ActualDefaultPane)
			{
				((XYSeries2D)series).Pane = (Pane)base.ChartModel.SelectedObject;
				index = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).Panes.IndexOf((Pane)base.ChartModel.SelectedObject);
			}
			ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem = new ElementIndexItem("Pane", index);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, enumerable, elementIndexItem);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.PreviewChart.Diagram, null, series));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, series);
		}
	}
	public class CreateDiagramCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => "Create Diagram";

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public CreateDiagramCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.PreviewChart.Diagram == null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Type type = parameter as Type;
			Diagram diagram = Activator.CreateInstance(type) as Diagram;
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter), this, base.PreviewChart, base.PreviewChart.Diagram, diagram);
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram = diagram;
			base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram = historyItem.OldValue as Diagram;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram = historyItem.NewValue as Diagram;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Type type = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter as Type;
			Diagram diagram = Activator.CreateInstance(type) as Diagram;
			chartControl.Diagram = diagram;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			Type type = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter as Type;
			if (type != null)
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].SetValue((object)chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(type));
			}
		}
	}

	public class ChangeChartTypeCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{

		public ChangeChartTypeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType)

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void CopyAdditionalValuesForPoint(Series source, SeriesPoint sourcePoint, IModelItem pointModelItem)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_009a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)

			//IL_01eb: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0209: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0227: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			if (source is RangeBarSeries2D)

				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val))..ctor(typeof(RangeBarSeries2D), "Value2");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val].SetValue((object)RangeBarSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint));
			}
			if (source is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				DXPropertyIdentifier val2 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val2))..ctor(typeof(RangeAreaSeries2D), "Value2");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val2].SetValue((object)RangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint));
			}
			if (source is RadarRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				DXPropertyIdentifier val3 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val3))..ctor(typeof(RadarRangeAreaSeries2D), "Value2");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val3].SetValue((object)RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint));
			}
			if (source is PolarRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				DXPropertyIdentifier val4 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val4))..ctor(typeof(PolarRangeAreaSeries2D), "Value2");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val4].SetValue((object)PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(sourcePoint));
			}
			if (source is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				DXPropertyIdentifier val5 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val5))..ctor(typeof(BubbleSeries2D), "Weight");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val5].SetValue((object)BubbleSeries2D.GetWeight(sourcePoint));
			}
			if (source is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				DXPropertyIdentifier val6 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val6))..ctor(typeof(BubbleSeries3D), "Weight");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val6].SetValue((object)BubbleSeries3D.GetWeight(sourcePoint));
			}
			if (source is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				DXPropertyIdentifier val7 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val7))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), "LowValue");
				DXPropertyIdentifier val8 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val8))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), "OpenValue");
				DXPropertyIdentifier val9 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val9))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), "CloseValue");
				DXPropertyIdentifier val10 = default(DXPropertyIdentifier);
				((DXPropertyIdentifier)(ref val10))..ctor(typeof(FinancialSeries2D), "HighValue");
				pointModelItem.Properties[val7].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetLowValue(sourcePoint));
				pointModelItem.Properties[val8].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetOpenValue(sourcePoint));
				pointModelItem.Properties[val9].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetCloseValue(sourcePoint));
				pointModelItem.Properties[val10].SetValue((object)FinancialSeries2D.GetHighValue(sourcePoint));
			}
		}

		private void CopySeriesPoints(Series source, Series target)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in source.Points)
			{
				target.Points.Add(point);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		private void CopySeriesPoints(Series source, IEditingContext context, IModelItem newSeriesModelItem)
		{
			foreach (SeriesPoint point in source.Points)
			{
				IModelItem val = context.CreateItem(typeof(SeriesPoint));
				val.Properties["Argument"].SetValue((object)point.Argument);
				val.Properties["Value"].SetValue((object)point.Value);
				CopyAdditionalValuesForPoint(source, point, val);
				newSeriesModelItem.Properties["Points"].Collection.Add(val);
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.PreviewChart.Diagram != null && base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series != null && base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Count > 0)
			{
				return base.PreviewChart.Diagram.GetType() == ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesType);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Clear();
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.AddRange((SeriesCollection)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Clear();
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.AddRange((SeriesCollection)historyItem.OldValue);
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			IModelItem value2 = value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value;
			if (value2 != null)
			{
				IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(seriesType);
				SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties((Series)value2.GetCurrentValue(), val, seriesType);
				value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].SetValue((object)val);
			}
			value.Properties["Series"].Collection.Clear();
			foreach (Series item in (SeriesCollection)historyItem.NewValue)
			{
				IModelItem val2 = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(seriesType);
				SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(item, val2, seriesType);
				CopySeriesPoints(item, chartModelItem.Context, val2);
				value.Properties["Series"].Collection.Add(val2);
			}
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				Series seriesTemplate = chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate;
				Series series = Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType) as Series;
				SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(seriesTemplate, series);
				chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = series;
			}
			Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesType);
			if (chartControl.Diagram.GetType() != supportedDiagramType)
			{
				chartControl.Diagram = (Diagram)Activator.CreateInstance(supportedDiagramType);
			}
			else
			{
				chartControl.Diagram.Series.Clear();
			}
			chartControl.Diagram.Series.AddRange((SeriesCollection)historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection = new SeriesCollection();
			seriesCollection.AddRange(base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series);
			SeriesCollection seriesCollection2 = new SeriesCollection();
			if (base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate != null)
			{
				Series seriesTemplate = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate;
				Series series = Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType) as Series;
				SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(seriesTemplate, series);
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = series;
			}
			foreach (Series item in base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series)
			{
				if (!ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIsAutoSeries(item))
				{
					Series series2 = Activator.CreateInstance(seriesType) as Series;
					SeriesCopyHelper.CopySeriesProperties(item, series2);
					CopySeriesPoints(item, series2);
					seriesCollection2.Add(series2);
				}
			}
			Type supportedDiagramType = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetSupportedDiagramType(seriesType);
			if (base.PreviewChart.Diagram.GetType() != supportedDiagramType)
			{
				RemoveDiagramCommand removeDiagramCommand = new RemoveDiagramCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(removeDiagramCommand.RuntimeExecute(null).HistoryItem);
				CreateDiagramCommand createDiagramCommand = new CreateDiagramCommand(base.ChartModel);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(createDiagramCommand.RuntimeExecute(supportedDiagramType).HistoryItem);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Clear();
			}
			base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.AddRange(seriesCollection2);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter), this, null, seriesCollection, seriesCollection2));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}
	}
	public class AddLegendCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string legendIndexKey = "Legend";

		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Default_Elements_AddLegend);

		private HorizontalPosition horizontalPosition;

		private VerticalPosition verticalPosition;

		private string imageName;

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => imageName;

		public HorizontalPosition HorizontalLegendPosition => horizontalPosition;

		public VerticalPosition VerticalLegendPosition => verticalPosition;

		public AddLegendCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, VerticalPosition verticalPosition = VerticalPosition.Top, HorizontalPosition horizontalPosition = HorizontalPosition.Right)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.horizontalPosition = horizontalPosition;
			this.verticalPosition = verticalPosition;
			imageName = "GalleryItemImages/LegendPositions/" + verticalPosition.ToString() + horizontalPosition;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Legends.Remove((Legend)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Legend legend = (Legend)historyItem.NewValue;
			base.PreviewChart.Legends.Insert(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Legend"], legend);
			return legend;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			chartControl.Legends.Add(new Legend
			{
				HorizontalPosition = horizontalPosition,
				VerticalPosition = verticalPosition
			});
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(Legend));
			val.Properties["HorizontalPosition"].SetValue((object)horizontalPosition);
			val.Properties["VerticalPosition"].SetValue((object)verticalPosition);
			chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection.Add(val);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Legend legend = new Legend
			{
				HorizontalPosition = horizontalPosition,
				VerticalPosition = verticalPosition
			};
			base.PreviewChart.Legends.Add(legend);
			int index = base.PreviewChart.Legends.Count - 1;
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Legend", index));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.PreviewChart, null, legend);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, legend);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AddConstantLineBaseCommand : ConstantLineCommandBase
	{
		protected WpfChartAxisModel SelectedAxisModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartAxisModel;

		public AddConstantLineBaseCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private object GetConstantLineValueInCenterOfAxis(Axis2D axis)
		{
			double actualMinValueInternal = axis.ActualWholeRange.ActualMinValueInternal;
			double actualMaxValueInternal = axis.ActualWholeRange.ActualMaxValueInternal;
			double value = actualMinValueInternal + (actualMaxValueInternal - actualMinValueInternal) / 2.0;
			IScaleMap axisScaleTypeMap = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetAxisScaleTypeMap(axis);
			return axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value);
		}

		protected virtual AxisBase GetAxis(object parameter)
		{
			return SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
		}

		protected ConstantLine CreateConstantLine(Axis2D axis)
		{
			object constantLineValueInCenterOfAxis = GetConstantLineValueInCenterOfAxis(axis);
			ConstantLine constantLine = new ConstantLine();
			constantLine.Value = constantLineValueInCenterOfAxis;
			constantLine.Title = new ConstantLineTitle
			{
				Content = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DefaultConstantLineTitle)
			};
			return constantLine;
		}

		protected IModelItem CreateConstantLineModelItem(IModelItem axis, IModelItem chart, object value)
		{
			IModelItem val = chart.Context.CreateItem(typeof(ConstantLine));
			val.Properties["Value"].SetValue(value);
			string value2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DefaultConstantLineTitle);
			IModelItem val2 = chart.Context.CreateItem(typeof(ConstantLineTitle));
			val2.Properties["Content"].SetValue((object)value2);
			val.Properties["Title"].SetValue((object)val2);
			return val;
		}

		protected int GetAxisIndex(object axis)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				result = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)axis);
			}
			else if (axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				result = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)axis);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D targetAxisForRuntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			ConstantLine item = CreateConstantLine(targetAxisForRuntimeApply);
			targetAxisForRuntimeApply.ConstantLinesInFront.Add(item);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetAxisForDesigntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem val = CreateConstantLineModelItem(targetAxisForDesigntimeApply, chartModelItem, historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.AdditionalInfo);
			targetAxisForDesigntimeApply.Properties["ConstantLinesInFront"].Collection.Add(val);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject;
			axis2D.ConstantLinesInFront.Remove((ConstantLine)historyItem.NewValue);
			return base.ChartModel.Chart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject;
			axis2D.ConstantLinesInFront.Add((ConstantLine)historyItem.NewValue);
			return historyItem.NewValue;
		}
	}
	public class AddConstantLineXCommand : AddConstantLineBaseCommand
	{
		private string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Default_Elements_AddConstantLineX);

		private string description = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Default_Elements_AddConstantLineXDescription);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => "GalleryItemImages/AddConstantLine\\AddConstantLineX";

		public override string Description => description;

		public AddConstantLineXCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram;
			AxisX2D axisX2D;
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				if (xYDiagram2D.AxisX == null)
				{
					AddAxisXCommand addAxisXCommand = new AddAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
					CommandResult commandResult = addAxisXCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				}
				axisX2D = xYDiagram2D.AxisX;
			}
			else
			{
				axisX2D = (AxisX2D)parameter;
			}
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList(axisX2D);
			ConstantLine constantLine = CreateConstantLine(axisX2D);
			axisX2D.ConstantLinesInFront.Add(constantLine);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, constantLine.Value, pathIndexItemList);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, axisX2D, null, constantLine);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, constantLine);
		}
	}

	public class AddAxisXCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddAxisXCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Diagram diagram = base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram;
			if (!(diagram is XYDiagram2D) && !(diagram is XYDiagram3D) && !(diagram is PolarDiagram2D))
			{
				return diagram is RadarDiagram2D;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Diagram diagram = base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			AxisBase axisBase;
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				axisBase = new AxisX2D();
				((XYDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = (AxisX2D)axisBase;
			}
			else if (diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				axisBase = new PolarAxisX2D();
				((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = (PolarAxisX2D)axisBase;
			}
			else if (diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				axisBase = new RadarAxisX2D();
				((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = (RadarAxisX2D)axisBase;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(diagram is XYDiagram3D))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + diagram.GetType().Name + "' has no axes or it is unknown diagram type.");
				}
				axisBase = new AxisX3D();
				((XYDiagram3D)diagram).AxisX = (AxisX3D)axisBase;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, diagram, null, axisBase);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, axisBase);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Diagram diagram = chartControl.Diagram;
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = new AxisX2D();
				return;
			}
			if (diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = new PolarAxisX2D();
				return;
			}
			if (diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = new RadarAxisX2D();
				return;
			}
			if (diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)diagram).AxisX = new AxisX3D();
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + diagram.GetType().Name + "' can not have axes or it is unknown diagram type.");
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			Type itemType = value.ItemType;
			IModelItem value2;
			if (itemType == typeof(XYDiagram2D))
			{
				value2 = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(AxisX2D));
			}
			else if (itemType == typeof(PolarDiagram2D))
			{
				value2 = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(PolarAxisX2D));
			}
			else if (itemType == typeof(RadarDiagram2D))
			{
				value2 = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(RadarAxisX2D));
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(itemType == typeof(XYDiagram3D)))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + ((object)value).GetType().Name + "'  can not have axes or it is unknown diagram type.");
				}
				value2 = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(AxisX3D));
			}
			value.Properties["AxisX"].SetValue((object)value2);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axisBase = null;
			Diagram diagram = base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = null;
				return ((XYDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = null;
				return ((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = null;
				return ((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).ActualAxisX;
			}
			if (diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)diagram).AxisX = null;
				return ((XYDiagram3D)diagram).ActualAxisX;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + diagram.GetType().Name + "' can not have axes or it is unknown diagram type.");
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Diagram diagram = base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = (AxisX2D)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			else if (diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = (PolarAxisX2D)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			else if (diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisX = (RadarAxisX2D)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			else
			{

				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + diagram.GetType().Name + "' can not have axes or it is unknown diagram type.");

	public class AddAxisYCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public AddAxisYCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Diagram diagram = base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram;
			if (!(diagram is XYDiagram2D) && !(diagram is XYDiagram3D) && !(diagram is PolarDiagram2D))
			{
				return diagram is RadarDiagram2D;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Diagram diagram = base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			AxisBase axisBase;
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				axisBase = new AxisY2D();
				((XYDiagram2D)diagram).AxisY = (AxisY2D)axisBase;
			}
			else if (diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				axisBase = new PolarAxisY2D();
				((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisY = (PolarAxisY2D)axisBase;
			}
			else if (diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				axisBase = new RadarAxisY2D();
				((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisY = (RadarAxisY2D)axisBase;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(diagram is XYDiagram3D))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + diagram.GetType().Name + "' has no axes or it is unknown diagram type.");
				}
				axisBase = new AxisY3D();
				((XYDiagram3D)diagram).AxisY = (AxisY3D)axisBase;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, diagram, null, axisBase);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, axisBase);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Diagram diagram = chartControl.Diagram;
			if (diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{

				return;
			}
			if (diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisY = new PolarAxisY2D();
				return;
			}
			if (diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)diagram).AxisY = new RadarAxisY2D();
				return;
			}
			if (diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				((XYDiagram3D)diagram).AxisY = new AxisY3D();
				return;
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException("Diagram type '" + diagram.GetType().Name + "' can not have axes or it is unknown diagram type.");
		}

	public abstract class AddStripCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected WpfChartAxisModel SelectedAxisModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartAxisModel;

		protected XYDiagram2D PreviewXYDiagram2D => (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;

		protected WpfChartStripModel SelectedStripModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartStripModel;

		public Strip SelectedStrip => SelectedStripModel?.Strip;

		public AddStripCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private void CalculateMinMaxStripLimits(Axis2D axis, out object minStripValue, out object maxStripValue)
		{
			double actualMinValueInternal = axis.ActualWholeRange.ActualMinValueInternal;
			double actualMaxValueInternal = axis.ActualWholeRange.ActualMaxValueInternal;
			double num = actualMaxValueInternal - actualMinValueInternal;
			double num2 = actualMinValueInternal + num / 2.0;
			double value = num2 - 0.15 * num;
			double value2 = num2 + 0.15 * num;
			IScaleMap axisScaleTypeMap = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetAxisScaleTypeMap(axis);
			minStripValue = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value);
			maxStripValue = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value2);
		}

		protected ElementIndexItem[] GetPathIndexItemList(Axis2D axis2D = null)
		{
			return FontCommandUtils.GetStripPathIndices(axis2D, SelectedStrip, PreviewXYDiagram2D);
		}

		protected virtual AxisBase GetAxis(object parameter)
		{
			return SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
		}

		protected Strip CreateStrip(Axis2D axis)
		{
			Strip strip = new Strip();
			CalculateMinMaxStripLimits(axis, out var minStripValue, out var maxStripValue);
			strip.MinLimit = minStripValue;
			strip.MaxLimit = maxStripValue;
			strip.LegendText = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DefaultStripLegendText);
			return strip;
		}

		protected IModelItem CreateStripModelItem(IModelItem axis, IModelItem chartModelItem, StripLimits limits)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(Strip));
			val.Properties["MinLimit"].SetValue(limits.MinLimit);
			val.Properties["MaxLimit"].SetValue(limits.MaxLimit);
			return val;
		}

		protected int GetAxisIndex(object axis)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				result = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)axis);
			}
			else if (axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				result = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)axis);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D targetAxisForRuntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			Strip item = CreateStrip(targetAxisForRuntimeApply);
			targetAxisForRuntimeApply.Strips.Add(item);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject;
			axis2D.Strips.Remove((Strip)historyItem.NewValue);
			return base.ChartModel.Chart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject;
			axis2D.Strips.Add((Strip)historyItem.NewValue);
			return historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetAxisForDesigntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem val = CreateStripModelItem(targetAxisForDesigntimeApply, chartModelItem, (StripLimits)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.AdditionalInfo);
			targetAxisForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Strips"].Collection.Add(val);
		}
	}
	public class AddStripXCommand : AddStripCommandBase
	{
		private string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Default_Elements_AddStripX);

		private string description = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Default_Elements_AddStripXDescription);

		private string imageName = "GalleryItemImages/AddStrip\\AddStripX";

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => imageName;

		public override string Description => description;

		public AddStripXCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram;
			AxisX2D axisX2D;
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				if (xYDiagram2D.AxisX == null)
				{
					AddAxisXCommand addAxisXCommand = new AddAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
					CommandResult commandResult = addAxisXCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				}
				axisX2D = xYDiagram2D.AxisX;
			}
			else
			{
				axisX2D = (AxisX2D)parameter;
			}
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList(axisX2D);
			Strip strip = CreateStrip(axisX2D);
			axisX2D.Strips.Add(strip);
			int num = axisX2D.Strips.Count - 1;
			StripLimits additionalInfo = new StripLimits
			{
				MinLimit = strip.MinLimit,
				MaxLimit = strip.MaxLimit
			};
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, additionalInfo, pathIndexItemList);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, axisX2D, null, strip);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, strip);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AddScaleBreakCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected WpfChartAxisModel SelectedAxisModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartAxisModel;

		protected WpfChartScaleBreakModel SelectedScaleBreakModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartScaleBreakModel;

		public ScaleBreak SelectedScaleBreak => SelectedScaleBreakModel?.ScaleBreak;

		protected XYDiagram2D PreviewXYDiagram2D => (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;

		public AddScaleBreakCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private void CalculateScaleBreakEdges(Axis2D axis, out object edge1, out object edge2)
		{
			double actualMinValueInternal = axis.ActualWholeRange.ActualMinValueInternal;
			double actualMaxValueInternal = axis.ActualWholeRange.ActualMaxValueInternal;
			double num = actualMaxValueInternal - actualMinValueInternal;
			double num2 = actualMinValueInternal + num / 2.0;
			double value = num2 - 0.15 * num;
			double value2 = num2 + 0.15 * num;
			IScaleMap axisScaleTypeMap = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetAxisScaleTypeMap(axis);
			edge1 = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value);
			edge2 = axisScaleTypeMap.InternalToNative(value2);
		}

		protected ElementIndexItem[] GetPathIndexItemList(Axis2D axis2D = null)
		{
			return FontCommandUtils.GetScaleBreakPathIndices(axis2D, SelectedScaleBreak, PreviewXYDiagram2D);
		}

		protected virtual AxisBase GetAxis(object parameter)
		{
			return SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
		}

		protected ScaleBreak CreateScaleBreak(Axis2D axis)
		{
			ScaleBreak scaleBreak = new ScaleBreak();
			CalculateScaleBreakEdges(axis, out var edge, out var edge2);
			scaleBreak.Edge1 = edge;
			scaleBreak.Edge2 = edge2;
			return scaleBreak;
		}

		protected IModelItem CreateScaleBreakModelItem(IModelItem axis, IModelItem chartModelItem, ScaleBreakEdges edges)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(ScaleBreak));
			val.Properties["Edge1"].SetValue(edges.Edge1);
			val.Properties["Edge2"].SetValue(edges.Edge2);
			return val;
		}

		protected int GetAxisIndex(object axis)
		{
			int result = -1;
			if (axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				result = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)axis);
			}
			else if (axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				result = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)axis);
			}
			return result;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D targetAxisForRuntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			ScaleBreak item = CreateScaleBreak(targetAxisForRuntimeApply);
			targetAxisForRuntimeApply.ScaleBreaks.Add(item);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject;
			axis2D.ScaleBreaks.Remove((ScaleBreak)historyItem.NewValue);
			return base.ChartModel.Chart;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D axis2D = (Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject;
			axis2D.ScaleBreaks.Add((ScaleBreak)historyItem.NewValue);
			return historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetAxisForDesigntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem val = CreateScaleBreakModelItem(targetAxisForDesigntimeApply, chartModelItem, (ScaleBreakEdges)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.AdditionalInfo);
			targetAxisForDesigntimeApply.Properties["ScaleBreaks"].Collection.Add(val);
		}
	}

			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, additionalInfo, pathIndexItemList);

			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, scaleBreak);
		}
	}
	public abstract class AddPaneCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string paneIndexKey = "Pane";

		private Orientation paneOrientation;

		public AddPaneCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel, Orientation paneOrientation)
			: base(chartModel)

			this.paneOrientation = paneOrientation;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.ChartModel.Chart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;

			return base.ChartModel.Chart;

			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			Pane pane = (Pane)historyItem.NewValue;
			xYDiagram2D.Panes.Insert(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"], pane);
			return pane;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;

			xYDiagram2D.PaneOrientation = paneOrientation;

		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;
			base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PaneOrientation = paneOrientation;

			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Pane", index));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, xYDiagram2D, null, pane);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, pane);
		}
	}

	public class AddIndicatorCommand<indicatorType> : ChartCommandBase where indicatorType : Indicator
	{
		private const string SeriesIndexKey = "Series";

		private const string IndicatorIndexKey = "Indicator";

		private const ValueLevel DefaultValueLevelForFinancialSeries = ValueLevel.High;

		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetLocalizedIndicatorTypeName(typeof(indicatorType));

		public override string ImageName => null;

		private static void SetArgumentsAndValueLevels(XYSeries2D xySeries2D, Indicator indicator)
		{
			if (indicator is FinancialIndicator && xySeries2D.Points.Count > 1)
			{
				((FinancialIndicator)indicator).Argument1 = xySeries2D.Points[0].Argument;
				((FinancialIndicator)indicator).Argument2 = xySeries2D.Points[xySeries2D.Points.Count - 1].Argument;
				if (xySeries2D is FinancialSeries2D)
				{
					((FinancialIndicator)indicator).ValueLevel1 = ValueLevel.High;
					((FinancialIndicator)indicator).ValueLevel2 = ValueLevel.High;
				}
			}
			if (indicator is RegressionLine && xySeries2D is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				((RegressionLine)indicator).ValueLevel = ValueLevel.High;
			}
			if (indicator is MovingAverage && xySeries2D is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				((MovingAverage)indicator).ValueLevel = ValueLevel.High;
			}
		}

		public AddIndicatorCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		private string[] GetIndicatorsNames(IndicatorCollection indicators)
		{
			return CommonUtils.GetIndicatorsNames(indicators);
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(parameter is XYSeries2D) && (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel) || !(((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).Series is XYSeries2D)))
			{
				return base.ChartModel.HighlightModel is WpfChartIndicatorCollectionModel;
			}
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Indicator"];
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = ((num >= 0) ? ((XYSeries2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series[num]) : ((XYSeries2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate));
			xYSeries2D.Indicators.Insert(index, (Indicator)historyItem.NewValue);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Indicator"];
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = ((num >= 0) ? ((XYSeries2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series[num]) : ((XYSeries2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate));
			xYSeries2D.Indicators.RemoveAt(index);
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			IModelItem val = ((num >= 0) ? chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[num] : chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].Value);
			IModelItem val2 = chartModelItem.Context.CreateItem(typeof(indicatorType));
			val2.Properties["ShowInLegend"].SetValue((object)true);
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)val.GetCurrentValue();
			string[] indicatorsNames = GetIndicatorsNames(xYSeries2D.Indicators);
			val2.Properties["DisplayName"].SetValue((object)NameGenerator.UniqueName(ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetLocalizedIndicatorTypeName(typeof(indicatorType)), indicatorsNames, useFirstItemIndex: false));
			if (typeof(indicatorType).IsSubclassOf(typeof(FinancialIndicator)) && xYSeries2D.Points.Count > 1)
			{
				val2.Properties["Argument1"].SetValue((object)xYSeries2D.Points[0].Argument);
				val2.Properties["Argument2"].SetValue((object)xYSeries2D.Points[xYSeries2D.Points.Count - 1].Argument);
				if (xYSeries2D is FinancialSeries2D)
				{
					val2.Properties["ValueLevel1"].SetValue((object)ValueLevel.High);
					val2.Properties["ValueLevel2"].SetValue((object)ValueLevel.High);
				}
			}
			if (typeof(indicatorType).IsSubclassOf(typeof(RegressionLine)) && xYSeries2D is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				val2.Properties["ValueLevel"].SetValue((object)ValueLevel.High);
			}
			if (typeof(indicatorType).IsSubclassOf(typeof(MovingAverage)) && xYSeries2D is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				val2.Properties["ValueLevel"].SetValue((object)ValueLevel.High);
			}
			val.Properties["Indicators"].Collection.Add(val2);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D = ((num >= 0) ? ((XYSeries2D)chartControl.Diagram.Series[num]) : ((XYSeries2D)chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate));
			Indicator indicator = new indicatorType
			{
				ShowInLegend = true
			};
			string[] indicatorsNames = GetIndicatorsNames(xYSeries2D.Indicators);
			indicator.DisplayName = NameGenerator.UniqueName(ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetLocalizedIndicatorTypeName(typeof(indicatorType)), indicatorsNames, useFirstItemIndex: false);
			SetArgumentsAndValueLevels(xYSeries2D, indicator);
			xYSeries2D.Indicators.Add(indicator);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			XYSeries2D xYSeries2D;
			if (parameter is XYSeries2D)
			{
				xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)parameter;
			}
			else if (base.ChartModel.HighlightModel is WpfChartIndicatorCollectionModel)
			{
				xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)((WpfChartIndicatorCollectionModel)base.ChartModel.HighlightModel).Parent.ChartElement;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel) || !(((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).Series is XYSeries2D))
				{
					ChartDebug.WriteWarning("The '" + GetType().Name + "' command can be executed because of parameter must be XYSeries2D");
					return null;
				}
				xYSeries2D = (XYSeries2D)((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).Series;
			}
			Indicator indicator = Activator.CreateInstance<indicatorType>();
			string[] indicatorsNames = GetIndicatorsNames(xYSeries2D.Indicators);
			indicator.DisplayName = NameGenerator.UniqueName(ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetLocalizedIndicatorTypeName(typeof(indicatorType)), indicatorsNames, useFirstItemIndex: false);
			indicator.ShowInLegend = true;
			SetArgumentsAndValueLevels(xYSeries2D, indicator);
			xYSeries2D.Indicators.Add(indicator);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Series", base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(xYSeries2D)), new ElementIndexItem("Indicator", xYSeries2D.Indicators.Count - 1));
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, null, indicator);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, indicator);
		}
	}

		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
