	public interface ISupportVisibleModel
	{
		bool Visible { get; set; }
	}
	public class ToggleVisibilityCommand : ICommand
	{
		private readonly ISupportVisibleModel supportVisibleModel;

		private event EventHandler canExecuteChanged;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canExecuteChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				canExecuteChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public ToggleVisibilityCommand(ISupportVisibleModel supportVisibleModel)
		{
			this.supportVisibleModel = supportVisibleModel;
			if (this.canExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				this.canExecuteChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return supportVisibleModel != null;
		}

		public void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			supportVisibleModel.Visible = !supportVisibleModel.Visible;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisOptionsCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		protected const string axisIndexKey = "Axis";

		protected WpfChartAxisModel SelectedAxisModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartAxisModel;

		public AxisOptionsCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected ElementIndexItem GetAxisIndexItem()
		{
			int selfIndex = SelectedAxisModel.GetSelfIndex();
			return new ElementIndexItem("Axis", selfIndex);
		}

		protected CommandResult CreateAxisIfNecessary()
		{
			CommandResult result = null;
			if (SelectedAxisModel != null && SelectedAxisModel.IsPrimaryAxis)
			{
				ChartCommandBase chartCommandBase = null;
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is AxisX2D && ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is AxisY2D && ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisYCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is AxisX3D && ((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is AxisY3D && ((XYDiagram3D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisYCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is RadarAxisX2D && ((RadarDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is RadarAxisY2D && ((RadarDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisYCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is PolarAxisX2D && ((PolarDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisX == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisXCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis is PolarAxisY2D && ((PolarDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).AxisY == null)
				{
					chartCommandBase = new AddAxisYCommand(base.ChartModel);
				}
				if (chartCommandBase != null)
				{
					result = chartCommandBase.RuntimeExecuteAndUpdateChartModel(null);
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected int CreateAxisIfNeeded(CompositeHistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			CommandResult commandResult = CreateAxisIfNecessary();
			if (commandResult != null)
			{
				historyItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			if (SelectedAxisModel == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return SelectedAxisModel.GetSelfIndex();
		}

		protected void CreateLabelIfNeeded()
		{
			if (SelectedAxisModel.Axis.Label == null)
			{
				ICommand command = new AddAxisLabelCommand(base.ChartModel);
				command.Execute(null);
			}
		}

		protected AxisBase GetAxis(ChartControl chart, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase result = null;
			int num = -1;
			object obj = ((historyItem.TargetObject is AxisBase) ? historyItem.TargetObject : ((WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject).Axis);
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			}
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					result = ((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]];
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					result = ((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
				{
					result = ((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
				{
					result = ((XYDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
				{
					result = ((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisX;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
				{
					result = ((XYDiagram3D)chart.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisX2D))
				{
					result = ((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
				{
					result = ((PolarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
				{
					result = ((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisX;
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
				{
					result = ((RadarDiagram2D)chart.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected IModelItem GetAxisModelItem(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			IModelItem result = null;
			int num = -1;
			object obj = ((historyItem.TargetObject is AxisBase) ? historyItem.TargetObject : ((WpfChartAxisModel)historyItem.TargetObject).Axis);
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			}
			string text = "Diagram";
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					result = chartModelItem.Properties[text].Value.Properties["SecondaryAxesX"].Collection[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]];
				}
				if (obj.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					result = chartModelItem.Properties[text].Value.Properties["SecondaryAxesY"].Collection[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (obj is AxisX2D || historyItem.TargetObject is AxisX3D || historyItem.TargetObject is CircularAxisX2D)
				{
					result = chartModelItem.Properties[text].Value.Properties["AxisX"].Value;
				}
				if (obj is AxisY2D || historyItem.TargetObject is AxisY3D || historyItem.TargetObject is CircularAxisY2D)
				{
					result = chartModelItem.Properties[text].Value.Properties["AxisY"].Value;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		protected WpfChartAxisModel GetAxisModel(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			Type type = historyItem.TargetObject.GetType();
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				if (type == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					return (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[num];
				}
				if (type == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					return (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection[num];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (type == typeof(AxisX2D) || type == typeof(AxisX3D) || type == typeof(PolarAxisX2D) || type == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
				{
					return base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
				}
				if (type == typeof(AxisY2D) || type == typeof(AxisY3D) || type == typeof(PolarAxisY2D) || type == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
				{
					return base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public static class AxisOptionsHelper
	{
		public static DateTimeScaleOptionsBase GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(AxisBase axis)
		{
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				return ((AxisX2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				return ((AxisY2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
			{
				return ((SecondaryAxisX2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
			{
				return ((SecondaryAxisY2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisX3D))
			{
				return ((AxisX3D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(AxisY3D))
			{
				return ((AxisY3D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
			{
				return ((PolarAxisY2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisX2D))
			{
				return ((RadarAxisX2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			if (axis.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
			{
				return ((RadarAxisY2D)axis).DateTimeScaleOptions;
			}
			return null;
		}
	}
	public abstract class AxisConditionalCommandBase : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public AxisConditionalCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected abstract bool AxisTypeMatchCommandType(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel);

		protected virtual void DesigntimeApplyInternal(IModelItem axisModelItem, object value)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null)
			{
				return AxisTypeMatchCommandType(base.SelectedAxisModel);
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return null;
		}

		public abstract bool IsAxisAtCommandState(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel);

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			DesigntimeApplyInternal(axisModelItem, historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}
	public class ToggleAxisVisibilityCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ToggleAxisVisibilityCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		private void SetAxisVisible(AxisBase axis, bool visible)
		{
			if (axis is Axis2D)
			{
				((Axis2D)axis).Visible = visible;
			}
			if (axis is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				((CircularAxisY2D)axis).Visible = visible;
			}
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null)
			{
				if (!(base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is Axis2D))
				{
					return base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is CircularAxisY2D;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisVisible((AxisBase)historyItem.TargetObject, (bool)historyItem.NewValue);
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			SetAxisVisible((AxisBase)historyItem.TargetObject, (bool)historyItem.OldValue);
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Visible"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
				}
				return;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
			{
				((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
			{
				((RadarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
			{
				((PolarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Visible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			int num = CreateAxisIfNeeded(compositeHistoryItem);
			base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible = (bool)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, !(bool)parameter, (bool)parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		public ToggleAxisVisibilityBarCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)

		}

	public class ChangeAxisAlignmentCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeAxisAlignmentCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null && base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is Axis2D)
			{
				return base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject).Alignment = (AxisAlignment)historyItem.NewValue;
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject).Alignment = (AxisAlignment)historyItem.OldValue;
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Alignment"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IsValidPath)
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Alignment = (AxisAlignment)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]].Alignment = (AxisAlignment)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX.Alignment = (AxisAlignment)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
				{
					((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY.Alignment = (AxisAlignment)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
				}
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			int num = CreateAxisIfNeeded(compositeHistoryItem);
			AxisAlignment alignment = base.SelectedAxisModel.Alignment;
			base.SelectedAxisModel.Alignment = (AxisAlignment)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, alignment, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}

	public abstract class AxisInterlacedCommandBase : AxisConditionalCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AxisOptions_Interlaced);

		protected abstract Type AxisType { get; }

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public AxisInterlacedCommandBase(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool AxisTypeMatchCommandType(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (!(axisModel.Axis.GetType() == AxisType))
			{
				return axisModel.Axis.GetType().IsSubclassOf(AxisType);
			}
			return true;
		}

		public override bool IsAxisAtCommandState(WpfChartAxisModel axisModel)
		{
			if (AxisTypeMatchCommandType(axisModel))
			{
				return axisModel.Interlaced;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				CommandResult commandResult = new ToggleAxisInterlacedCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute((bool)parameter);
				AxisBase axis = base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis;
				base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = base.PreviewChart;
				return new CommandResult(commandResult.HistoryItem, axis);
			}
			return null;
		}
	}

		public AxisY3DInterlacedCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)

	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AxisOptions_Interlaced);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => "BarItemImages/AxisInterlaced";

		public ToggleAxisInterlacedCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.SelectedAxisModel != null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((AxisBase)historyItem.TargetObject).Interlaced = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((AxisBase)historyItem.TargetObject).Interlaced = !(bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			axisModelItem.Properties["Interlaced"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(chartControl, historyItem);
			axis.Interlaced = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || !(parameter is bool))
			{
				return null;
			}
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			int num = CreateAxisIfNeeded(compositeHistoryItem);
			base.SelectedAxisModel.Interlaced = (bool)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, null, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}
	}
	public class ToggleAxisGridLinesVisibleCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase

				{
					axisBase = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesX[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]];
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(SecondaryAxisY2D))
				{
					axisBase = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).SecondaryAxesY[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]];
				}
			}
			else
			{
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisX2D))
				{
					axisBase = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisX;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(AxisY2D))
				{
					axisBase = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(RadarAxisY2D))
				{
					axisBase = ((RadarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
				if (historyItem.TargetObject.GetType() == typeof(PolarAxisY2D))
				{
					axisBase = ((PolarDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).AxisY;
				}
			}
			axisBase.GridLinesVisible = (bool)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			int num = CreateAxisIfNeeded(compositeHistoryItem);
			base.SelectedAxisModel.GridLinesVisible = (bool)parameter;
			object obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] array;
			if (num < 0)
			{
				obj = null;
			}
			else
			{
				obj = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem("Axis", num)
				};
				array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			}
			array = (ElementIndexItem[])obj;
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis, null, parameter));
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis);
		}

	public class ToggleAxisTickmarksVisibleCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private readonly string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.AxisOptions_MajorVisible);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ToggleAxisTickmarksVisibleCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedAxisModel != null && base.SelectedAxisModel.IsVisible)
			{
				if (!(base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is Axis2D))
				{
					return base.SelectedAxisModel.Axis is CircularAxisY2D;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.TargetObject is Axis2D)
			{
				((Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject).TickmarksVisible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				((CircularAxisY2D)historyItem.TargetObject).TickmarksVisible = (bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			return historyItem.TargetObject;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			if (historyItem.TargetObject is Axis2D)
			{
				((Axis2D)historyItem.TargetObject).TickmarksVisible = !(bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			if (historyItem.TargetObject is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				((CircularAxisY2D)historyItem.TargetObject).TickmarksVisible = !(bool)historyItem.NewValue;
			}
			return historyItem.TargetObject;

	public class SetWorkTimeRulePropertyCommand : AxisOptionsCommandBase
	{
		private const string workTimeRuleIndexKey = "WorkTimeRule";

		private readonly WorkTimeRule workTimeRule;

		protected WpfChartAxisModel AxisModel => (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public SetWorkTimeRulePropertyCommand(WpfChartModel model, WorkTimeRule workTimeRule)
			: base(model)
		{
			this.workTimeRule = workTimeRule;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(workTimeRule, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.OldValue);
			return GetAxis(base.PreviewChart, historyItem);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(workTimeRule, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
			return GetAxis(base.PreviewChart, historyItem);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)parameter;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName))
			{
				WpfChartAxisModel axisModel = AxisModel;
				AxisBase axis = axisModel.Axis;
				DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis = AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axis);
				int index = dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis.WorkTimeRules.IndexOf(workTimeRule);
				int selfIndex = axisModel.GetSelfIndex();
				object objectProperty = CommandUtils.GetObjectProperty(workTimeRule, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName);
				CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(workTimeRule, propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("WorkTimeRule", index), new ElementIndexItem("Axis", selfIndex)), this, axisModel, objectProperty, propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
				return new CommandResult(historyItem, axis);
			}
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["WorkTimeRule"];
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			AxisBase axis = GetAxis(chartControl, historyItem);
			DateTimeScaleOptionsBase dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis = AxisOptionsHelper.GetDateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis(axis);
			CommandUtils.SetObjectProperty(dateTimeScaleOptionsByAxis.WorkTimeRules[index], propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["WorkTimeRule"];
			IModelItem axisModelItem = GetAxisModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			PropertyGridCommandParameter propertyGridCommandParameter = (PropertyGridCommandParameter)historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.Parameter;
			IModelItem val = axisModelItem.Properties["DateTimeScaleOptions"].Value.Properties["WorkTimeRules"].Collection[num];
			val.Properties[propertyGridCommandParameter.PropertyName].SetValue(propertyGridCommandParameter.Value);
		}
	}

	public abstract class ConstantLineCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public const string AxisKey = "Axis";

		public const string SecondaryAxisKey = "SecondaryAxis";

		public const string ConstantLineKey = "ConstantLine";

		protected WpfChartConstantLineModel SelectedConstantLineModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartConstantLineModel;

		public ConstantLine SelectedConstantLine => SelectedConstantLineModel?.ConstantLine;

		protected XYDiagram2D PreviewXYDiagram2D => (XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram;

		public ConstantLineCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected ElementIndexItem[] GetPathIndexItemList(Axis2D axis2D = null)
		{
			return FontCommandUtils.GetConstantLineTitlePathIndexes(axis2D, SelectedConstantLine, PreviewXYDiagram2D);
		}

		protected WpfChartConstantLineModel GetConstantLineModel(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel wpfChartAxisModel;
			switch (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"])
			{
			case -1:
				wpfChartAxisModel = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelX;
				break;
			case -2:
				wpfChartAxisModel = base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.PrimaryAxisModelY;
				break;
			case -3:
			{
				int index2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[index2];
				break;
			}
			case -4:
			{
				int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				wpfChartAxisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection[index];
				break;
			}
			default:
				throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown pseudo index.");
			}
			int index3 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["ConstantLine"];
			return (WpfChartConstantLineModel)wpfChartAxisModel.ConstantLinesCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index3];
		}

		protected ConstantLine GetTargetConstantLineForRuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram;
			Axis2D targetAxisForRuntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["ConstantLine"];
			return targetAxisForRuntimeApply.ConstantLinesInFront[index];
		}

		protected IModelItem GetTargetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			IModelItem targetAxisForDesigntimeApply = FontCommandUtils.GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["ConstantLine"];
			return targetAxisForDesigntimeApply.Properties["ConstantLinesInFront"].Collection[num];
		}

		protected int GetConstantLineIndex(ExecuteCommandInfo info)
		{
			return info.IndexByNameDictionary["ConstantLine"];
		}
	}
	public class ChangeConstantLineValueCommand : ConstantLineCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ConstantLine_Value);

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public BarEditValueItemViewModel EditorModel { get; set; }

		public ChangeConstantLineValueCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.SelectedConstantLineModel != null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			AxisBase constantLineOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetConstantLineOwner(base.SelectedConstantLine);
			AxisScaleTypeMap axisScaleTypeMap = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetAxisScaleTypeMap(constantLineOwner);
			object obj;
			if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisQualitativeMap)
			{
				obj = parameter.ToString();
			}
			else if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisNumericalMap)
			{
				if (!double.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result))
				{
					string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithNumericConstantLineValueCaption);
					string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithNumericConstantLineValueMessage);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption, incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result;
			}
			else if (axisScaleTypeMap is AxisDateTimeMap)
			{
				if (!DateTime.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result2))
				{
					string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithDateTimeConstantLineValueCaption);
					string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithDateTimeConstantLineValueMessage);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption2, incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage2);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result2;
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(axisScaleTypeMap is AxisTimeSpanMap))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown ScaleTypeMap.");
				}
				if (!TimeSpan.TryParse(parameter.ToString(), out var result3))
				{
					string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithTimeSpanConstantLineValueCaption);
					string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.CommandMessages_IncompatibleWithTimeSpanConstantLineValueMessage);
					ShowErrorMessage(incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption3, incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage3);
					return null;
				}
				obj = result3;
			}
			object value = base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Value;
			base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Value = obj;
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexItemList);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedConstantLine, value, obj);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

		private void ShowErrorMessage(string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption, string incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage)
		{
			MessageBox.Show(incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxMessage, incompatibleConstantLineValueMsgBoxCaption, MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Exclamation);
			if (EditorModel != null)
			{
				EditorModel.EditValue = EditorModel.Value;
			}
			else
			{
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning("ChangeConstantLineValueCommand.EditorModel property was not set. That's why EditValue in an editor was not reset.");
			}
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)historyItem.TargetObject;
			constantLine.Value = historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)historyItem.TargetObject;
			constantLine.Value = historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply.Value = historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Value"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}

			return null;

			ConstantLine targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			if (historyItem.NewValue == null)
			{

		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)

			IModelItem targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply.Properties["LegendText"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}

	public class ChangeConstantLineThicknessCommand : ConstantLineCommandBase
	{
		private string caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ConstantLine_Thickness);

		public override string Caption => caption;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeConstantLineThicknessCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return base.SelectedConstantLine != null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			int num = (int)parameter;
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (base.SelectedConstantLine.LineStyle == null)
			{
				AddConstantLineStyleCommand addConstantLineStyleCommand = new AddConstantLineStyleCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = addConstantLineStyleCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexItemList);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedConstantLine, base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Thickness, num);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Thickness = num;
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)historyItem.TargetObject;
			constantLine.LineStyle.Thickness = (int)historyItem.OldValue;

	public abstract class ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionBase : ConstantLineCommandBase
	{
		protected virtual ConstantLineTitleAlignment Alignment => ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near;

		protected virtual bool ShowBelowLine => false;

		public ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected bool IsConstantLineVertical()
		{
			AxisBase constantLineOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetConstantLineOwner(base.SelectedConstantLine);
			if (constantLineOwner == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			return !ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.IsAxisVertical(constantLineOwner);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null && !(bool)parameter)
			{
				return null;
			}
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (base.SelectedConstantLine.Title == null)
			{
				CreateConstantLineTitleCommand createConstantLineTitleCommand = new CreateConstantLineTitleCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = createConstantLineTitleCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
				compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
			}
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexItemList);
			Axis2D constantLineOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetConstantLineOwner(base.SelectedConstantLine);
			bool isConstantLineVertical = !ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.IsAxisVertical(constantLineOwner);
			ConstantLineTitlePosition oldValue = new ConstantLineTitlePosition(base.SelectedConstantLine.Title.Alignment, base.SelectedConstantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine, isConstantLineVertical);
			ConstantLineTitlePosition newValue = new ConstantLineTitlePosition(Alignment, ShowBelowLine, isConstantLineVertical);
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedConstantLine, oldValue, newValue);
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			base.SelectedConstantLineModel.ShowTitleBelowLine = ShowBelowLine;
			base.SelectedConstantLineModel.TitleAlignment = Alignment;
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)historyItem.TargetObject;
			constantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine = ((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.OldValue).ShowBelowLine;
			constantLine.Title.Alignment = ((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.OldValue).Alignment;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine constantLine = (ConstantLine)historyItem.TargetObject;
			constantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine = ((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).ShowBelowLine;
			constantLine.Title.Alignment = ((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).Alignment;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply.Title.ShowBelowLine = ((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).ShowBelowLine;
			targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply.Title.Alignment = ((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).Alignment;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			IModelItem value = targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Title"].Value;
			value.Properties["ShowBelowLine"].SetValue((object)((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).ShowBelowLine);
			value.Properties["Alignment"].SetValue((object)((ConstantLineTitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).Alignment);
		}
	}

		public new WpfChartConstantLineModel FontModel => (WpfChartConstantLineModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;

		public ConstantLineTitleFontItalicCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedObject is ConstantLine constantLine))
			{
				return false;
			}
			return constantLine.Title != null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			FontStyle fontStyle = (((bool)parameter) ? FontStyles.Italic : FontStyles.Normal);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, GetPathIndexes());
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, FontModel.ConstantLine.Title, FontModel.ConstantLine.Title.FontStyle, fontStyle);
			FontModel.ConstantLine.Title.FontStyle = fontStyle;
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

		protected override ElementIndexItem[] GetPathIndexes()
		{
			XYDiagram2D diagram = (XYDiagram2D)base.ChartModel.DiagramModel.Diagram;
			return FontCommandUtils.GetConstantLineTitlePathIndexes(null, (ConstantLine)base.ChartModel.SelectedObject, diagram);
		}

		protected override Control GetFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine constantLineFontHolder = FontCommandUtils.GetConstantLineFontHolder(chartControl, historyItem);
			return constantLineFontHolder.Title;
		}

		protected override IModelItem GetFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			IModelItem constantLineFontHolder = FontCommandUtils.GetConstantLineFontHolder(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			return constantLineFontHolder.Properties["Title"].Value;
		}
	}
	public class ChangeConstantLineLegendCommand : ConstantLineCommandBase
	{
		private const string LegendIndexKey = "Legend";

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public ChangeConstantLineLegendCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (base.SelectedConstantLineModel != null)
			{
				return parameter is WpfChartLegendModel;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartLegendModel wpfChartLegendModel = (WpfChartLegendModel)parameter;
			int num = ((base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Legend != null) ? base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Legend.GetSelfIndex() : (-1));
			base.SelectedConstantLineModel.Legend = wpfChartLegendModel;
			int selfIndex = wpfChartLegendModel.GetSelfIndex();
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexItemList = GetPathIndexItemList();
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[3]
			{
				pathIndexItemList[0],
				pathIndexItemList[1],
				new ElementIndexItem("Legend", selfIndex)
			};
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.SelectedConstantLineModel, num, selfIndex);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.SelectedConstantLine);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartConstantLineModel wpfChartConstantLineModel = (WpfChartConstantLineModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			int num = (int)historyItem.OldValue;
			if (num != -1)
			{
				wpfChartConstantLineModel.Legend = (WpfChartLegendModel)base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[num];
			}
			else
			{
				wpfChartConstantLineModel.Legend = null;
			}
			return wpfChartConstantLineModel?.ConstantLine;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			WpfChartConstantLineModel wpfChartConstantLineModel = (WpfChartConstantLineModel)historyItem.TargetObject;
			int index = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			wpfChartConstantLineModel.Legend = (WpfChartLegendModel)base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[index];
			return wpfChartConstantLineModel?.ConstantLine;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			ConstantLine targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			int index = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			Legend legend = chartControl.Legends[index];
			targetConstantLineForRuntimeApply.Legend = legend;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			int num = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			IModelItem val = LegendCommandsHelper.FindLegendModelItem(chartModelItem, num);
			string text = ((num == -1) ? "legend" : ("legend" + num));
			val.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
			IModelItem value = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply, text);
			targetConstantLineForDesigntimeApply.Properties["Legend"].SetValue((object)value);
		}
	}

	public class TitlePosition
	{
		public int TitleIndex { get; private set; }

		public Dock Dock { get; private set; }

		public HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment { get; private set; }

		public VerticalAlignment VerticalAlignment { get; private set; }

		public TitlePosition(int titleIndex, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
			: this(titleIndex, dock, horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment.Center)
		{
		}

		public TitlePosition(int titleIndex, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment)
		{
			TitleIndex = titleIndex;
			Dock = dock;
			HorizontalAlignment = horizontalAlignment;
			VerticalAlignment = verticalAlignment;
		}

		protected virtual Title GetTitle(ChartControl chart)
		{
			return chart.Titles[TitleIndex];
		}

		public void Apply(ChartControl chart)
		{
			Title title = GetTitle(chart);
			title.Dock = Dock;
			title.HorizontalAlignment = HorizontalAlignment;
			title.VerticalAlignment = VerticalAlignment;
		}
	}
	public class SeriesTitlePosition : TitlePosition
	{
		public int SeriesIndex { get; private set; }

		public SeriesTitlePosition(int seriesIndex, int titleIndex, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
			: this(seriesIndex, titleIndex, dock, horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment.Center)
		{
		}

		public SeriesTitlePosition(int seriesIndex, int titleIndex, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment, VerticalAlignment verticalAlignment)
			: base(titleIndex, dock, horizontalAlignment, verticalAlignment)
		{
			SeriesIndex = seriesIndex;
		}

		protected override Title GetTitle(ChartControl chart)
		{
			PieSeries pieSeries = (PieSeries)chart.Diagram.Series[SeriesIndex];
			return pieSeries.Titles[base.TitleIndex];
		}
	}
	public abstract class TitlePositionCommand : ChangeChartTitleCommandBase
	{
		private readonly Dock dock;

		private readonly HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment;

		public Dock Dock => dock;

		public HorizontalAlignment HorizontalAlignment => horizontalAlignment;

		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartTitleOptions_Position);

		public override string ImageName => "BarItemImages/Elements\\AddTitle";

		public TitlePositionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			this.dock = dock;
			this.horizontalAlignment = horizontalAlignment;
		}

		protected abstract TitlePosition[] CreateTitlePositions(WpfChartTitleModel titleModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment);

		protected abstract IModelItem FindTitleModel(IModelItem chartModelItem, TitlePosition position);

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartTitleModel wpfChartTitleModel) || !(parameter is bool) || !(bool)parameter)
			{
				return null;
			}
			TitlePosition[] array = CreateTitlePositions(wpfChartTitleModel, dock, horizontalAlignment);
			array[1].Apply(base.PreviewChart);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter), this, base.PreviewChart, array[0], array[1]);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, wpfChartTitleModel.Title);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((TitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).Apply(chartControl);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			TitlePosition titlePosition = (TitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue;
			IModelItem val = FindTitleModel(chartModelItem, titlePosition);
			val.Properties["Dock"].SetValue((object)titlePosition.Dock);
			val.Properties["HorizontalAlignment"].SetValue((object)titlePosition.HorizontalAlignment);
			val.Properties["VerticalAlignment"].SetValue((object)titlePosition.VerticalAlignment);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((TitlePosition)historyItem.OldValue).Apply(base.PreviewChart);
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			((TitlePosition)historyItem.NewValue).Apply(base.PreviewChart);
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ChartTitlePositionCommand : TitlePositionCommand
	{
		public ChartTitlePositionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
			: base(chartModel, dock, horizontalAlignment)
		{
		}

		protected override TitlePosition[] CreateTitlePositions(WpfChartTitleModel titleModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
		{
			int titleIndex = base.PreviewChart.Titles.IndexOf(titleModel.Title);
			return new TitlePosition[2]
			{
				new TitlePosition(titleIndex, titleModel.Title.Dock, titleModel.Title.HorizontalAlignment, titleModel.Title.VerticalAlignment),
				new TitlePosition(titleIndex, dock, horizontalAlignment)
			};
		}

		protected override IModelItem FindTitleModel(IModelItem chartModelItem, TitlePosition position)
		{
			return chartModelItem.Properties["Titles"].Collection[position.TitleIndex];
		}
	}
	public class SeriesTitlePositionCommand : TitlePositionCommand
	{
		public SeriesTitlePositionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
			: base(chartModel, dock, horizontalAlignment)
		{
		}

		protected override TitlePosition[] CreateTitlePositions(WpfChartTitleModel titleModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment)
		{
			PieSeries pieSeries = (PieSeries)titleModel.GetParent<WpfChartSeriesModel>().Series;
			int seriesIndex = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(pieSeries);
			int titleIndex = pieSeries.Titles.IndexOf(titleModel.Title);
			return new TitlePosition[2]
			{
				new SeriesTitlePosition(seriesIndex, titleIndex, titleModel.Title.Dock, titleModel.Title.HorizontalAlignment, titleModel.Title.VerticalAlignment),
				new SeriesTitlePosition(seriesIndex, titleIndex, dock, horizontalAlignment)
			};
		}

		protected override IModelItem FindTitleModel(IModelItem chartModelItem, TitlePosition position)
		{
			return SeriesTitleHelper.FindTitleModel(chartModelItem, ((SeriesTitlePosition)position).SeriesIndex, position.TitleIndex);
		}
	}
	public abstract class TitleTextCommand : ChangeChartTitleCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public TitleTextCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected abstract ElementIndexItem[] GetElementIndexItems(WpfChartTitleModel titleModel);

		protected abstract Title FindTitle(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem);

		protected abstract IModelItem FindTitleModelItem(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem);

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null)
			{
				return null;
			}
			string text = parameter.ToString();
			ElementIndexItem[] elementIndexItems = GetElementIndexItems(base.TitleModel);
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, elementIndexItems);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.TitleModel.Title, base.TitleModel.Title.Content, text);
			CommandResult result = new CommandResult(historyItem);
			base.TitleModel.DisplayName = text;
			return result;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Title title = (Title)historyItem.TargetObject;
			title.Content = historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Title title = (Title)historyItem.TargetObject;
			title.Content = historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			FindTitle(chartControl, historyItem).Content = historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			FindTitleModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem).Properties["Content"].SetValue(historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}

	public static class SeriesTitleHelper
	{
		private const string SeriesIndexKey = "Series";

		public static Title FindTitle(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			PieSeries pieSeries = (PieSeries)chartControl.Diagram.Series[index];
			int index2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Title"];
			return pieSeries.Titles[index2];
		}

		public static IModelItem FindTitleModel(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int seriesIndex = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			int titleIndex = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Title"];
			return FindTitleModel(chartModelItem, seriesIndex, titleIndex);
		}

		public static IModelItem FindTitleModel(IModelItem chartModelItem, int seriesIndex, int titleIndex)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[seriesIndex];
			return val.Properties["Titles"].Collection[titleIndex];
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetElementIndexItems(WpfChartTitleModel titleModel)
		{
			ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[2];
			WpfChartSeriesModel parent = titleModel.GetParent<WpfChartSeriesModel>();
			array[0] = new ElementIndexItem("Series", parent.GetSelfIndex());
			Title title = titleModel.Title;
			array[1] = new ElementIndexItem("Title", ((PieSeries)parent.Series).Titles.IndexOf(title));
			return array;
		}
	}
	public static class FontCommandUtils
	{
		private const string titleIndexKey = "TitleIndex";

		private const string annotationIndexKey = "AnnotationIndex";

		private const string legendIndexKey = "LegendIndex";

		public static Control GetLegendFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl)
		{
			return chartControl.Legend;
		}

		public static IModelItem GetLegendFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, int index)
		{
			return chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection[index];
		}

		private static int GetTitleIndex(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["TitleIndex"];
		}

		private static int GetAnnotationIndex(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["AnnotationIndex"];
		}

		private static int GetLegendIndex(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["LegendIndex"];
		}

		public static Control GetTitleFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return chartControl.Titles[GetTitleIndex(historyItem)];
		}

		public static IModelItem GetTitleFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return chartModelItem.Properties["Titles"].Collection[GetTitleIndex(historyItem)];
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetTitlePathIndexes(WpfChartModel model)
		{
			WpfChartTitleModel wpfChartTitleModel = (WpfChartTitleModel)model.SelectedModel;
			int index = model.Chart.Titles.IndexOf(wpfChartTitleModel.Title);
			return new ElementIndexItem[1]
			{
				new ElementIndexItem("TitleIndex", index)
			};
		}

		public static Control GetAnnotationFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return chartControl.Annotations[GetAnnotationIndex(historyItem)];
		}

		public static IModelItem GetAnnotationFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return chartModelItem.Properties["Annotations"].Collection[GetAnnotationIndex(historyItem)];
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetAnnotationPathIndexes(WpfChartModel model)
		{
			WpfChartAnnotationModel wpfChartAnnotationModel = (WpfChartAnnotationModel)model.SelectedModel;
			int index = model.Chart.Annotations.IndexOf(wpfChartAnnotationModel.Annotation);
			return new ElementIndexItem[1]
			{
				new ElementIndexItem("AnnotationIndex", index)
			};
		}

		public static Control GetLegendFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return chartControl.Legends[GetLegendIndex(historyItem)];
		}

		public static IModelItem GetLegendFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection[GetLegendIndex(historyItem)];
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetLegendPathIndexes(WpfChartModel ChartModel)
		{
			WpfChartLegendModel wpfChartLegendModel = (WpfChartLegendModel)ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			int index = ChartModel.Chart.Legends.IndexOf(wpfChartLegendModel.Legend);
			return new ElementIndexItem[1]
			{
				new ElementIndexItem("LegendIndex", index)
			};
		}

		private static Axis2D GetAxis(Axis2D axis2D, ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			return axis2D ?? ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetConstantLineOwner(constantLine);
		}

		private static Axis2D GetAxis(Axis2D axis2D, Strip strip)
		{
			return axis2D ?? ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetStripOwner(strip);
		}

		private static Axis2D GetAxis(Axis2D axis2D, ScaleBreak scaleBreak)
		{
			return axis2D ?? ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetScaleBreakOwner(scaleBreak);
		}

		private static List<ElementIndexItem> PopulateIndicesPath(XYDiagram2D diagram, Axis2D axis)
		{
			List<ElementIndexItem> list = new List<ElementIndexItem>();
			if (axis is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("Axis", -3));
				int index = diagram.SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)axis);
				list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("SecondaryAxis", index));
			}
			else if (axis is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("Axis", -4));
				int index2 = diagram.SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)axis);
				list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("SecondaryAxis", index2));
			}
			else if (axis is AxisX2D)
			{
				list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("Axis", -1));
			}
			else
			{
				if (!(axis is AxisY2D))
				{
					throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown axis type.");
				}
				list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("Axis", -2));
			}
			return list;
		}

		private static int GetIndex(ConstantLine constantLine, Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (constantLine == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return axis.ConstantLinesInFront.IndexOf(constantLine);
		}

		private static int GetIndex(Strip strip, Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (strip == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return axis.Strips.IndexOf(strip);
		}

		private static int GetIndex(ScaleBreak scaleBreak, Axis2D axis)
		{
			if (scaleBreak == null)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return axis.ScaleBreaks.IndexOf(scaleBreak);
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetConstantLineTitlePathIndexes(Axis2D axis2D, ConstantLine constantLine, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			Axis2D axis = GetAxis(axis2D, constantLine);
			List<ElementIndexItem> list = PopulateIndicesPath(diagram, axis);
			int index = GetIndex(constantLine, axis);
			list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("ConstantLine", index));
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetStripPathIndices(Axis2D axis2D, Strip strip, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			Axis2D axis = GetAxis(axis2D, strip);
			List<ElementIndexItem> list = PopulateIndicesPath(diagram, axis);
			int index = GetIndex(strip, axis);
			list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("Strip", index));
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static ElementIndexItem[] GetScaleBreakPathIndices(Axis2D axis2D, ScaleBreak scaleBreak, XYDiagram2D diagram)
		{
			Axis2D axis = GetAxis(axis2D, scaleBreak);
			List<ElementIndexItem> list = PopulateIndicesPath(diagram, axis);
			int index = GetIndex(scaleBreak, axis);
			list.Add(new ElementIndexItem("ScaleBreak", index));
			return list.ToArray();
		}

		public static ConstantLine GetConstantLineFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Axis2D targetAxisForRuntimeApply = GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(chartControl, historyItem);
			int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["ConstantLine"];
			return targetAxisForRuntimeApply.ConstantLinesInFront[index];
		}

		public static Axis2D GetTargetAxisForRuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"];
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram;
			switch (num)
			{
			case -1:
				return xYDiagram2D.AxisX;
			case -2:
				return xYDiagram2D.AxisY;
			case -3:
			{
				int index2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				return xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX[index2];
			}
			case -4:
			{
				int index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				return xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY[index];
			}
			default:
				throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown pseudo index.");
			}
		}

		internal static IModelItem GetConstantLineFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			IModelItem targetAxisForDesigntimeApply = GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, historyItem);
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["ConstantLine"];
			return targetAxisForDesigntimeApply.Properties["ConstantLinesInFront"].Collection[num];
		}

		public static IModelItem GetTargetAxisForDesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			IModelItem value = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value;
			switch (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"])
			{
			case -1:
				return value.Properties["AxisX"].Value;
			case -2:
				return value.Properties["AxisY"].Value;
			case -3:
			{
				int num2 = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				return value.Properties["SecondaryAxesX"].Collection[num2];
			}
			case -4:
			{
				int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["SecondaryAxis"];
				return value.Properties["SecondaryAxesY"].Collection[num];
			}
			default:
				throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown pseudo index.");
			}
		}
	}
	public abstract class FontCommandBase : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public WpfChartFontModel FontModel => (WpfChartFontModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;

		public ChartControl ChartControl => base.PreviewChart;

		public FontCommandBase(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual ElementIndexItem[] GetPathIndexes()
		{
			return new ElementIndexItem[0];
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected abstract Control GetFontHolder(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem);

		protected abstract IModelItem GetFontHolder(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem);
	}
	public abstract class FontFamilyCommand : FontCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Font_Family);

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public FontFamilyCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Control control = (Control)historyItem.TargetObject;
			control.FontFamily = (FontFamily)historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Control control = (Control)historyItem.TargetObject;
			control.FontFamily = (FontFamily)historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(parameter is FontFamily fontFamily))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, GetPathIndexes());
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.FontModel.FontHolder, base.FontModel.FontHolder.FontFamily, fontFamily);
			base.FontModel.FontHolder.FontFamily = fontFamily;
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			GetFontHolder(chartControl, historyItem).FontFamily = (FontFamily)historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			GetFontHolder(chartModelItem, historyItem).Properties["FontFamily"].SetValue((object)(FontFamily)historyItem.NewValue);
		}
	}
	public abstract class FontSizeCommand : FontCommandBase, IComboBoxItemsFiller
	{
		private const int FontSizesCount = 40;

		public override string Caption => ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.Font_Size);

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public FontSizeCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		public object[] GetItems()
		{
			object[] array = new object[40];
			int num = 3;
			for (int i = 0; i < array.Length; i++)
			{
				array[i] = num;
				num = ((num < 80) ? ((num < 40) ? ((num < 24) ? (num + 1) : (num + 2)) : (num + 4)) : (num + 8));
			}
			return array;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Control control = (Control)historyItem.TargetObject;
			control.FontSize = (double)historyItem.OldValue;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Control control = (Control)historyItem.TargetObject;
			control.FontSize = (double)historyItem.NewValue;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			GetFontHolder(chartControl, historyItem).FontSize = (double)historyItem.NewValue;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			GetFontHolder(chartModelItem, historyItem).Properties["FontSize"].SetValue((object)(double)historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter == null || !(parameter is int))
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, GetPathIndexes());
			double num = (int)parameter;
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, base.FontModel.FontHolder, base.FontModel.FontHolder.FontSize, num);
			base.FontModel.FontHolder.FontSize = num;
			return new CommandResult(historyItem);
		}
	}
	public interface IComboBoxItemsFiller
	{
		object[] GetItems();
	}
