	public class RemoveElementCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		public override string Caption => "Remove Element";

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemoveElementCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter != null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			return null;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			ChartCommandBase chartCommandBase = null;
			if (parameter is Diagram)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveDiagramCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Legend)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveLegendCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Series)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveSeriesCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Pane)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemovePaneCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is SecondaryAxisX2D || parameter is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveSecondaryAxisCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is ConstantLine)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveConstantLineCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Strip)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveStripCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is ScaleBreak)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveScaleBreakCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Title)
			{
				chartCommandBase = ((!(((Title)parameter).Parent is PieSeries)) ? ((ChartCommandBase)new RemoveChartTitleCommand(base.ChartModel)) : ((ChartCommandBase)new RemoveSeriesTitleCommand(base.ChartModel)));
			}
			else if (parameter is PieTotalLabel)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemovePieTotalLabelCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Indicator)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveIndicatorCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is Annotation)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveAnnotationCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			else if (parameter is StackedBarTotalLabel)
			{
				chartCommandBase = new RemoveStackedBarTotalLabelCommand(base.ChartModel);
			}
			return chartCommandBase?.RuntimeExecute(parameter);
		}
	}
	public class RemoveElementBarCommand : RemoveElementCommand
	{
		public RemoveElementBarCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}
	}
	public class RemoveLegendCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string legendIndexKey = "Legend";

		public override string Caption => "Remove Legend";

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemoveLegendCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter is Legend;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Legend legend = parameter as Legend;
			int index = base.PreviewChart.Legends.IndexOf(legend);
			HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Legend", index)), this, base.PreviewChart, legend, null);
			base.PreviewChart.Legends.RemoveAt(index);
			return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.PreviewChart);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Legends.Insert(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Legend"], historyItem.OldValue as Legend);
			return historyItem.OldValue as Legend;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			base.PreviewChart.Legends.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Legend"]);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			chartControl.Legends.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Legend"]);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Legend"];
			if (chartModelItem.Properties["Legend"].Value != null && chartModelItem.Properties["Legend"].Value.GetCurrentValue() != null)
			{
				if (num != 0)
				{
					num--;
					chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection.RemoveAt(num);
				}
				else
				{
					chartModelItem.Properties["Legend"].SetValue((object)null);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}
	}
	public class RemoveSeriesCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string seriesIndexKey = "Series";

		protected const string seriesDesigntimeIndexKey = "DesigntimeSeries";

		public override string Caption => "Remove Series";

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemoveSeriesCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				return parameter is Series;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			Series oldValue = parameter as Series;
			int selfIndex = ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).GetSelfIndex();
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
			{
				new ElementIndexItem("Series", selfIndex),
				new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", ((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
			};
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes), this, base.PreviewChart, oldValue, null));
			if (selfIndex >= 0)
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.RemoveAt(selfIndex);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = null;
				SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand selectSeriesDataMemberCommand = new SelectSeriesDataMemberCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = selectSeriesDataMemberCommand.RuntimeExecute(string.Empty);
				if (commandResult != null)
				{
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
				}
			}
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, base.PreviewChart);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.Insert(num, historyItem.OldValue as Series);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = historyItem.OldValue as Series;
			}
			return historyItem.OldValue as Series;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]);
			}
			else
			{
				base.PreviewChart.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = null;
			}
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				chartControl.Diagram.Series.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			else
			{
				chartControl.Diagram.SeriesTemplate = null;
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			int num = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"];
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection.RemoveAt(num);
			}
			else
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SeriesTemplate"].ClearValue();
			}
		}
	}
	public class RemovePaneCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string paneIndexKey = "Pane";

		public override string Caption => "Remove Pane";

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemovePaneCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null && parameter is Pane)
			{
				return base.PreviewChart.Diagram is XYDiagram2D;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			Pane pane = parameter as Pane;
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.PreviewChart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane != pane)
			{
				int index = xYDiagram2D.Panes.IndexOf(pane);
				HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Pane", index)), this, base.PreviewChart, pane, null);
				xYDiagram2D.Panes.RemoveAt(index);
				return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.PreviewChart);
			}
			return new RemoveDiagramCommand(base.ChartModel).RuntimeExecute(parameter);
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.PreviewChart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			xYDiagram2D.Panes.Insert(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"], historyItem.OldValue as Pane);
			return historyItem.OldValue as Pane;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.PreviewChart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			xYDiagram2D.Panes.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"]);
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chartControl.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			xYDiagram2D.Panes.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"]);
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Pane"]);
		}
	}
	public class RemoveSecondaryAxisCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string axisIndexKey = "Axis";

		public override string Caption => "Remove Axis";

		public override string ImageName => null;

		public RemoveSecondaryAxisCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (parameter != null)
			{
				if (!(parameter is SecondaryAxisX2D))
				{
					return parameter is SecondaryAxisY2D;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.PreviewChart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (parameter is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				int index = xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisY2D)parameter);
				HistoryItem historyItem = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Axis", index)), this, base.PreviewChart, parameter, null);
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY.RemoveAt(index);
				return new CommandResult(historyItem, base.PreviewChart);
			}
			if (parameter is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				int index2 = xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX.IndexOf((SecondaryAxisX2D)parameter);
				HistoryItem historyItem2 = new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, new ElementIndexItem("Axis", index2)), this, base.PreviewChart, parameter, null);
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX.RemoveAt(index2);
				return new CommandResult(historyItem2, base.PreviewChart);
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.PreviewChart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY.Insert(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"], historyItem.OldValue as SecondaryAxisY2D);
			}
			else if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX.Insert(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"], historyItem.OldValue as SecondaryAxisX2D);
			}
			return historyItem.OldValue as Axis2D;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = base.PreviewChart.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]);
			}
			else if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]);
			}
			return base.PreviewChart;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = chartControl.Diagram as XYDiagram2D;
			if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]);
			}
			else if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisY2D)
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SecondaryAxesY"].Collection.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]);
			}
			else if (historyItem.OldValue is SecondaryAxisX2D)
			{
				chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["SecondaryAxesX"].Collection.RemoveAt(historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Axis"]);
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class LegendOptionsCommand : ChartCommandBase
	{
		private const string legendIndexKey = "Legend";

		protected string LegendIndexKey => "Legend";

		protected WpfChartLegendCollectionModel LegendCollectionModel => base.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel;

		public LegendOptionsCommand(WpfChartModel model)
			: base(model)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (LegendCollectionModel != null)
			{
				return LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0;
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected int GetLegendIndex(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int result = 0;
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				result = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Legend"];
			}
			return result;
		}
	}
	internal static class LegendCommandsHelper
	{
		public static IModelItem FindLegendModelItem(IModelItem chartModelItem, int legendIndex)
		{
			if (chartModelItem.Properties["Legend"].Value != null && chartModelItem.Properties["Legend"].Value.GetCurrentValue() != null)
			{
				if (legendIndex != 0)
				{
					legendIndex--;
					return chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection[legendIndex];
				}
				return chartModelItem.Properties["Legend"].Value;
			}
			return chartModelItem.Properties["Legends"].Collection[legendIndex];
		}

		public static IModelItem FindLegendModelItem(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, string legendIndexKey)
		{
			int legendIndex = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary[legendIndexKey];
			return FindLegendModelItem(chartModelItem, legendIndex);
		}
	}

	{
		private readonly string imageName;

		private readonly HorizontalPosition horizontalPosition;

		private readonly VerticalPosition verticalPosition;

		public override string Caption => null;

		public override string ImageName => imageName;

		public HorizontalPosition HorizontalPosition => horizontalPosition;

		public VerticalPosition VerticalPosition => verticalPosition;

		public ChartControl ChartControl => base.PreviewChart;

		public WpfChartLegendModel LegendModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartLegendModel;

		public ChangeLegendPositionCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel, HorizontalPosition horizPos, VerticalPosition vertPos)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
			horizontalPosition = horizPos;
			verticalPosition = vertPos;
			imageName = "GalleryItemImages/LegendPositions/" + verticalPosition.ToString() + horizontalPosition;
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return ChartControl.Diagram != null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			LegendModel.VerticalPosition = ((LegendPosition)historyItem.OldValue).VerticalPosition;
			LegendModel.HorizontalPosition = ((LegendPosition)historyItem.OldValue).HorizontalPosition;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			LegendModel.VerticalPosition = ((LegendPosition)historyItem.NewValue).VerticalPosition;
			LegendModel.HorizontalPosition = ((LegendPosition)historyItem.NewValue).HorizontalPosition;
			return null;
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			if (!(parameter is bool) || !(bool)parameter)
			{
				return null;
			}
			ExecuteCommandInfo executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter);
			CompositeHistoryItem compositeHistoryItem = new CompositeHistoryItem();
			if (LegendModel == null)
			{
				AddLegendCommand addLegendCommand = new AddLegendCommand(base.ChartModel);
				CommandResult commandResult = addLegendCommand.RuntimeExecute(null);
				if (commandResult != null)
				{
					base.ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
					base.ChartModel.UpdateCommandsCanExecute();
					if (commandResult.SelectedChartObject != null)
					{
						base.ChartModel.SelectedObject = commandResult.SelectedChartObject;
					}
					compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(commandResult.HistoryItem);
					executeCommandInfo = ((HistoryItem)commandResult.HistoryItem).ExecuteCommandInfo;
				}
			}
			else
			{
				ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[1]
				{
					new ElementIndexItem(base.LegendIndexKey, LegendModel.GetSelfIndex())
				};
				executeCommandInfo = new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, pathIndexes);
			}
			HistoryItem item = new HistoryItem(executeCommandInfo, this, LegendModel.Legend, new LegendPosition(LegendModel.HorizontalPosition, LegendModel.VerticalPosition), new LegendPosition(horizontalPosition, verticalPosition));
			compositeHistoryItem.HistoryItems.Add(item);
			LegendModel.HorizontalPosition = horizontalPosition;
			LegendModel.VerticalPosition = verticalPosition;
			return new CommandResult(compositeHistoryItem, LegendModel.Legend);
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int index = 0;
			if (historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary.Count > 0)
			{
				index = historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary[base.LegendIndexKey];
			}
			Legend legend = chartControl.Legends[index];
			legend.HorizontalPosition = horizontalPosition;
			legend.VerticalPosition = verticalPosition;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = LegendCommandsHelper.FindLegendModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem, base.LegendIndexKey);
			val.Properties["HorizontalPosition"].SetValue((object)horizontalPosition);
			val.Properties["VerticalPosition"].SetValue((object)verticalPosition);
		}
	}

	public class ChangeLegendDockTargetCommand : LegendOptionsCommand
	{
		protected const string PaneIndexKey = "Pane";

		public override string Caption => string.Empty;

		public override string ImageName => string.Empty;

		public WpfChartLegendModel LegendModel => base.ChartModel.SelectedModel as WpfChartLegendModel;

		public ChangeLegendDockTargetCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int legendIndex = GetLegendIndex(historyItem);
			object dockTarget = null;
			int num = (int)historyItem.OldValue;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				dockTarget = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).Panes[num - 1];
			}
			else if (num == 0)
			{
				dockTarget = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).ActualDefaultPane;
			}
			base.PreviewChart.Legends[legendIndex].DockTarget = dockTarget;
			return null;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int legendIndex = GetLegendIndex(historyItem);
			object dockTarget = null;
			int num = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				dockTarget = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).Panes[num - 1];
			}
			else if (num == 0)
			{
				dockTarget = ((XYDiagram2D)base.PreviewChart.Diagram).ActualDefaultPane;
			}
			base.PreviewChart.Legends[legendIndex].DockTarget = dockTarget;
			return null;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			int legendIndex = GetLegendIndex(historyItem);
			object dockTarget = null;
			int num = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			if (num > 0)
			{
				dockTarget = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).Panes[num - 1];
			}
			else if (num == 0)
			{
				dockTarget = ((XYDiagram2D)chartControl.Diagram).ActualDefaultPane;
			}
			chartControl.Legends[legendIndex].DockTarget = dockTarget;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = LegendCommandsHelper.FindLegendModelItem(chartModelItem, historyItem, base.LegendIndexKey);
			int num = (int)historyItem.NewValue;
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				IModelItem val2 = null;
				if (num > 0)
				{
					val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Panes"].Collection[num - 1];
				}
				else
				{
					val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value;
					if (val2 == null)
					{
						chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].SetValue((object)new Pane());
						val2 = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["DefaultPane"].Value;
					}
				}
				string text = (string)val2.Properties["Name"].Value.GetCurrentValue();
				if (text == "")
				{
					text = ((num == 0) ? "pane" : ("pane" + num));
					val2.Properties["Name"].SetValue((object)text);
				}
				IModelItem value = designTimeProvider.CreateBindingItem(val, text);
				val.Properties["DockTarget"].SetValue((object)value);
			}
			else
			{
				val.Properties["DockTarget"].SetValue((object)null);
			}
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel = ((WpfChartLegendPropertyGridModel)LegendModel.PropertyGridModel).DockTarget as WpfChartPaneModel;
			int num = -1;
			if (wpfChartPaneModel != null)
			{
				num = wpfChartPaneModel.GetSelfIndex() + 1;
			}
			WpfChartPaneModel wpfChartPaneModel2 = parameter as WpfChartPaneModel;
			int num2 = -1;
			if (wpfChartPaneModel2 != null)
			{
				num2 = wpfChartPaneModel2.GetSelfIndex() + 1;
			}
			ElementIndexItem[] array = new ElementIndexItem[1];
			int num3 = 0;
			if (LegendModel != null)
			{
				num3 = LegendModel.GetSelfIndex();
				array[0] = new ElementIndexItem(base.LegendIndexKey, num3);
			}
			if (wpfChartPaneModel2 != null)
			{
				LegendModel.Legend.DockTarget = wpfChartPaneModel2.Pane;
			}
			else
			{
				LegendModel.Legend.DockTarget = null;
			}
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(parameter, array), this, null, num, num2));
		}
	}

	public class AddSeriesPointCommand : SeriesPointCommand
	{
		public AddSeriesPointCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)parameter;
			Series series = wpfChartSeriesModel.Series;
			SeriesPoint seriesPoint = new SeriesPoint();
			series.Points.Add(seriesPoint);
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(null, new ElementIndexItem("Series", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()), new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())), this, null, null, seriesPoint));
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]];
			series.Points.Remove((SeriesPoint)historyItem.NewValue);
			return series;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]];
			series.Points.Add((SeriesPoint)historyItem.NewValue);
			return series;
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = chartControl.Diagram.Series[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]];
			series.Points.Add(new SeriesPoint());
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"]];
			val.Properties["Points"].Collection.Add(val.Context.CreateItem(typeof(SeriesPoint)));
		}
	}

	public class ClearSeriesDataCommand : SeriesPointCommand
	{
		public ClearSeriesDataCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return true;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeUndo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]];
			series.Points.AddRange((SeriesPoint[])historyItem.OldValue);
			return series;
		}

		protected override object RuntimeRedo(HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = base.PreviewChart.Diagram.Series[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]];
			series.Points.Clear();
			return series;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"]];
			val.Properties["Points"].Collection.Clear();
		}

		public override void RuntimeApply(ChartControl chartControl, HistoryItem historyItem)
		{
			Series series = chartControl.Diagram.Series[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Series"]];
			series.Points.Clear();
		}

		public override CommandResult RuntimeExecute(object parameter)
		{
			WpfChartSeriesModel wpfChartSeriesModel = null;
			if (base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel)
			{
				wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel;
			}
			else if (base.ChartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel)
			{
				wpfChartSeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)((WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel)base.ChartModel.SelectedModel).Parent;
			}
			Series series = wpfChartSeriesModel.Series;
			ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes = new ElementIndexItem[2]
			{
				new ElementIndexItem("Series", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfIndex()),
				new ElementIndexItem("DesigntimeSeries", wpfChartSeriesModel.GetSelfDesigntimeIndex())
			};
			SeriesPoint[] array = new SeriesPoint[series.Points.Count];
			series.Points.CopyTo(array, 0);
			series.Points.Clear();
			return new CommandResult(new HistoryItem(new ExecuteCommandInfo(null, pathIndexes), this, null, array, null), null);
		}
	}

		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public override void DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, HistoryItem historyItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			IModelItem val = chartModelItem.Properties["Diagram"].Value.Properties["Series"].Collection[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["DesigntimeSeries"]];
			IModelItem seriesPointItem = val.Properties["Points"].Collection[historyItem.ExecuteCommandInfo.IndexByNameDictionary["Point"]];
			SetProperty(val, seriesPointItem, historyItem.NewValue);
		}

		protected abstract object GetProperty(WpfChartSeriesPointModel seriesPointModel);

		protected abstract void SetProperty(WpfChartSeriesPointModel seriesPointModel, object value);

		protected abstract void SetProperty(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, object value);

		protected abstract void SetProperty(IModelItem seriesItem, IModelItem seriesPointItem, object value);
	}

	public class SetSeriesPointValueCommand : SeriesPointPropertyCommand
	{
		public SetSeriesPointValueCommand(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: base(chartModel)
		{
		}

		protected override object GetProperty(WpfChartSeriesPointModel seriesPointModel)
		{
			return seriesPointModel.Value;
		}

		protected override void SetProperty(WpfChartSeriesPointModel seriesPointModel, object value)
		{
			seriesPointModel.Value = value;
		}

		protected override void SetProperty(SeriesPoint seriesPoint, object value)
		{
			if (value is DateTime)
			{
				seriesPoint.DateTimeValue = (DateTime)value;
				return;
			}
			if (value is TimeSpan)
			{
				seriesPoint.TimeSpanValue = (TimeSpan)value;
				return;
			}
			double value2 = double.NaN;
			if (value is string)
			{
				value2 = double.Parse((string)value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			if (value is double)
			{
				value2 = (double)value;
			}
			seriesPoint.Value = value2;
		}

		protected override void SetProperty(IModelItem seriesItem, IModelItem seriesPointItem, object value)
		{
			seriesPointItem.Properties["Value"].SetValue(value);
		}
	}

	public abstract class TitleCategoryModelCreator
	{
		private string bindingPathToSelectedModel;

		private WpfChartModel chartModel;

		protected virtual bool NeedAddEmptyChartItem => true;

		public TitleCategoryModelCreator(WpfChartModel chartModel, string bindingPathToSelectedModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			this.bindingPathToSelectedModel = bindingPathToSelectedModel;
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryViewModel CreateTitleCategoryModel()
		{
			RibbonPageCategoryViewModel ribbonPageCategoryViewModel = CreateTitleOptionsCategory(chartModel, typeof(WpfChartTitleModel));
			ribbonPageCategoryViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartTitleOptionsRibbonCategoryTitle);
			RibbonPageViewModel ribbonPageViewModel = new RibbonPageViewModel(chartModel, "ChartTitleOptionsPage");
			ribbonPageViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartTitleOptions_SelectedTitle);
			ribbonPageCategoryViewModel.Pages.Add(ribbonPageViewModel);
			ribbonPageViewModel.Groups.Add(CreateTitleGeneralGroup());
			ChartCommandBase familyCommand = CreateFontFamilyCommand(chartModel);
			ChartCommandBase sizeCommand = CreateFontSizeCommand(chartModel);
			ChartCommandBase boldCommand = CreateFontBoldCommand(chartModel);
			ChartCommandBase italicCommand = CreateFontItalicCommand(chartModel);
			RibbonPageGroupViewModel item = chartModel.CreateFontGroup(bindingPathToSelectedModel, familyCommand, sizeCommand, boldCommand, italicCommand);
			ribbonPageViewModel.Groups.Add(item);
			return ribbonPageCategoryViewModel;
		}

		private BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel CreateGalleryDropDownButton_ChartTitlePosition()
		{
			BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel = new BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel();
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.InitialVisibleColCount = 3;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.InitialVisibleRowCount = 3;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.ItemCheckMode = (GalleryItemCheckMode)1;
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartTitleOptions_Position);
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.ImageName = "BarItemImages/Elements/AddTitle";
			GalleryGroupViewModel galleryGroupViewModel = new GalleryGroupViewModel();
			IValueConverter converter = CreateTitlePositionConverter();
			string text = "GalleryItemImages/AddChartTitle\\";
			BarButtonViewModel barButtonViewModel = new BarButtonViewModel(CreateAddTitleCommand(chartModel, Dock.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Left));
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Left), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "TopNear"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "TopNear")
			});
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Center), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "TopCenter"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "TopCenter")
			});
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Top, HorizontalAlignment.Right), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "TopRight"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "TopRight")
			});
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Left, HorizontalAlignment.Center), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "LeftCenter"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "LeftCenter")
			});
			if (NeedAddEmptyChartItem)
			{
				galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(new EmptyChartCommand(chartModel), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter));
			}
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Right, HorizontalAlignment.Center), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "RightCenter"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "RightCenter")
			});
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Left), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "BottomLeft"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "BottomLeft")
			});
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Center), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "BottomCenter"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "BottomCenter")
			});
			galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitlePositionCommand(chartModel, Dock.Bottom, HorizontalAlignment.Right), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, converter)
			{
				Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(text + "BottomRight"),
				LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(text + "BottomRight")
			});
			barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel.Groups.Add(galleryGroupViewModel);
			return barDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel;
		}

		private RibbonPageGroupViewModel CreateTitleGeneralGroup()
		{
			RibbonPageGroupViewModel ribbonPageGroupViewModel = new RibbonPageGroupViewModel();
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(CreateGalleryDropDownButton_ChartTitlePosition());
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.Caption = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartTitleOptions_General);
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(new BarStaticTextViewModel(ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartTitleOptions_Text)));
			ribbonPageGroupViewModel.BarItems.Add(new BarEditValueItemViewModel(CreateTitleTextCommand(chartModel), chartModel, bindingPathToSelectedModel, new ChartTitleContentConverter()));
			return ribbonPageGroupViewModel;
		}

		protected abstract ChartCommandBase CreateFontBoldCommand(WpfChartModel wpfChartModel);

		protected abstract ChartCommandBase CreateFontItalicCommand(WpfChartModel wpfChartModel);

		protected abstract ChartCommandBase CreateAddTitleCommand(WpfChartModel wpfChartModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment);

		protected abstract ChartCommandBase CreateTitlePositionCommand(WpfChartModel wpfChartModel, Dock dock, HorizontalAlignment horizontalAlignment);

		protected abstract ChartCommandBase CreateTitleTextCommand(WpfChartModel wpfChartModel);

		protected abstract IValueConverter CreateTitlePositionConverter();
	}

	public abstract class WpfChartFontModel : ChartModelElement
	{
		public Control FontHolder => (Control)base.ChartElement;

		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => null;

		public FontFamily FontFamily
		{
			get
			{
				return FontHolder.FontFamily;
			}
			set
			{
				if (FontHolder.FontFamily != value)
				{
					FontHolder.FontFamily = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("FontFamily");
				}
			}
		}

		public FontStyle FontStyle
		{
			get
			{
				return FontHolder.FontStyle;
			}
			set
			{
				if (FontHolder.FontStyle != value)
				{
					FontHolder.FontStyle = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("FontStyle");
				}
			}
		}

		public FontWeight FontWeight
		{
			get
			{
				return FontHolder.FontWeight;
			}
			set
			{
				if (FontHolder.FontWeight != value)
				{
					FontHolder.FontWeight = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("FontWeight");
				}
			}
		}

		public double FontSize
		{
			get
			{
				return FontHolder.FontSize;
			}
			set
			{
				if (FontHolder.FontSize != value)
				{
					FontHolder.FontSize = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("FontSize");
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartFontModel(ChartModelElement parent, Control fontHolder)
			: base(parent, fontHolder)
		{
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartAxisLabelModel : ChartModelElement
	{
		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => null;

		public AxisLabel Label => (AxisLabel)base.ChartElement;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Label != null)
				{
					return Label.Visible;
				}
				return true;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Label != null && Label.Visible != value)
				{
					Label.Visible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Visible");
				}
			}
		}

	public class WpfChartAxisCustomLabelModel : ChartModelElement
	{
		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => null;

		public CustomAxisLabel CustomAxisLabel => (CustomAxisLabel)base.ChartElement;

		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (CustomAxisLabel.Content is string)
				{
					return (string)CustomAxisLabel.Content;
				}
				return ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ComplexTitleContent);
			}
		}

		public WpfChartAxisCustomLabelModel(ChartModelElement parent, CustomAxisLabel axisLabel)
			: base(parent, axisLabel)
		{
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartAxisCustomLabelCollectionModel : ChartElementCollectionModelBase
	{
		public WpfChartAxisCustomLabelCollectionModel(ChartModelElement parent, CustomAxisLabelCollection customAxisLabelCollection)
			: base(parent, customAxisLabelCollection)
		{
		}

		protected override ChartModelElement CreateModel(object chartElement, int index)
		{
			return new WpfChartAxisCustomLabelModel(this, (CustomAxisLabel)chartElement);
		}

		public ValueLevel ValueLevel
		{

				{
					return ((MovingAverage)Indicator).ValueLevel;
				}
				if (Indicator is DetrendedPriceOscillator)
				{
					return ((DetrendedPriceOscillator)Indicator).ValueLevel;
				}
				if (Indicator is BollingerBands)
				{
					return ((BollingerBands)Indicator).ValueLevel;
				}
				if (Indicator is MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)
				{
					return ((MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)Indicator).ValueLevel;
				}
				if (Indicator is RateOfChange)
				{
					return ((RateOfChange)Indicator).ValueLevel;
				}
				if (Indicator is RelativeStrengthIndex)

					return ((RelativeStrengthIndex)Indicator).ValueLevel;

				if (Indicator is StandardDeviation)
				{
					return ((StandardDeviation)Indicator).ValueLevel;

					return ((TripleExponentialMovingAverageTrix)Indicator).ValueLevel;

				return ValueLevel.Value;

			set

					if (((RegressionLine)Indicator).ValueLevel != value)

						OnPropertyChanged("ValueLevel");
					}
				}
				else if (Indicator is MovingAverage)
				{
					if (((MovingAverage)Indicator).ValueLevel != value)
					{
						((MovingAverage)Indicator).ValueLevel = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("ValueLevel");
					}
				}
				else if (Indicator is DetrendedPriceOscillator)
				{
					if (((DetrendedPriceOscillator)Indicator).ValueLevel != value)
					{
						((DetrendedPriceOscillator)Indicator).ValueLevel = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("ValueLevel");
					}
				}
				else if (Indicator is BollingerBands)
				{
					if (((BollingerBands)Indicator).ValueLevel != value)
					{
						((BollingerBands)Indicator).ValueLevel = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("ValueLevel");
					}
				}
				else if (Indicator is MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)
				{
					if (((MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)Indicator).ValueLevel != value)
					{
						((MovingAverageConvergenceDivergence)Indicator).ValueLevel = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("ValueLevel");
					}
				}
				else if (Indicator is RateOfChange)
				{
					if (((RateOfChange)Indicator).ValueLevel != value)
					{
						((RateOfChange)Indicator).ValueLevel = value;
						OnPropertyChanged("ValueLevel");
					}

				return 0;

			set

					OnPropertyChanged("ShortPeriod");
				}
				else
				{
					WriteUnsupportedPropertySetWarning("ShortPeriod", IndicatorTypeName);
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartIndicatorModel(ChartModelElement parent, Indicator indicator)
			: base(parent, indicator)
		{
			Series indicatorOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIndicatorOwner(indicator);
			if (indicatorOwner is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.High));
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.Low));
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.Open));
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.Close));
			}
			else if (indicatorOwner is RangeBarSeries2D || indicatorOwner is RangeAreaSeries2D || indicatorOwner is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.Value));
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.Value2));
			}
			else
			{
				valueLevels.Add(new ValueLevelComboBoxPresentation(ValueLevel.Value));
			}
			if (Indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator)
			{
				UpdatePane();
				UpdateAxisY();
			}
			base.PropertyGridModel = WpfChartIndicatorPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForIndicator(this);
		}

		private Brush GetActualIndicatorBrush()
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ChartModelElement child in base.Parent.Children)
			{
				if (child == this)
				{
					WpfChartModel wpfChartModel = GetParent<WpfChartModel>();
					return new SolidColorBrush(wpfChartModel.Chart.IndicatorsPalette[num]);
				}
				num++;
			}
			return null;
		}

		private void UpdatePane()
		{
			Pane pane = ((SeparatePaneIndicator)Indicator).Pane as Pane;
			WpfChartDiagramModel diagram = Diagram;
			if (pane == null || diagram.DefaultPaneModel.Pane == pane)
			{
				Pane = diagram.DefaultPaneModel;
			}
			else
			{
				if (diagram.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ChartModelElement item in diagram.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
				{
					if (((WpfChartPaneModel)item).Pane == pane)
					{
						Pane = (WpfChartPaneModel)item;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxisY()
		{
			WpfChartDiagramModel diagram = Diagram;
			if (!(((SeparatePaneIndicator)Indicator).AxisY is SecondaryAxisY2D secondaryAxisY2D))
			{
				AxisY = diagram.PrimaryAxisModelY;
			}
			else
			{
				if (diagram.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ChartModelElement item in diagram.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection)
				{
					if (((WpfChartAxisModel)item).Axis == secondaryAxisY2D)
					{
						AxisY = (WpfChartAxisModel)item;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLegend()
		{
			WpfChartModel chartModel = Diagram.ChartModel;
			if (Indicator.Legend != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && Indicator.Legend == legend.Legend)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WpfChartLegendModel item in chartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Legend == Indicator.Legend)
						{
							Legend = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			Legend = ((chartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0) ? ((WpfChartLegendModel)chartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[0]) : null);
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			if (Indicator is SeparatePaneIndicator)
			{
				UpdatePane();
				UpdateAxisY();
			}
			UpdateLegend();
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartPaneModel : ChartModelElement
	{
		private string paneName;

		private WpfChartPaneTitleModel titleModel;

		private WpfChartStackedBarTotalLabelModel stackedBarTotalLabelModel;

		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => new ChartModelElement[2] { titleModel, stackedBarTotalLabelModel };

		public Pane Pane => (Pane)base.ChartElement;

		public string Name => paneName;

		public WpfChartPaneTitleModel TitleModel => titleModel;

		public WpfChartStackedBarTotalLabelModel StackedBarTotalLabelModel => stackedBarTotalLabelModel;

		public WpfChartPaneModel()
			: this(null, null, "")
		{
		}

		public WpfChartPaneModel(ChartModelElement parent, Pane pane, string paneName)
			: base(parent, pane)
		{
			this.paneName = paneName;
			base.PropertyGridModel = new WpfChartPanePropertyGridModel(this);
		}

		private void UpdateTitleModel()
		{
			PaneTitle title = Pane.Title;
			if (title != null)
			{
				titleModel = new WpfChartPaneTitleModel(this, title);
			}
			else
			{
				titleModel = null;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("TitleModel");
		}

		private void UpdateStackedBarTotalLabelModel()
		{
			StackedBarTotalLabel totalLabel = BarStackedSeries2D.GetTotalLabel(Pane);
			if (totalLabel != null)
			{
				stackedBarTotalLabelModel = new WpfChartStackedBarTotalLabelModel(this, totalLabel);
			}
			else
			{
				stackedBarTotalLabelModel = null;
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("StackedBarTotalLabelModel");
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			base.UpdateChildren();
			UpdateTitleModel();
			UpdateStackedBarTotalLabelModel();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return Name;
		}

		public int GetSelfIndex()
		{
			if (base.Parent is WpfChartDiagramModel)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (base.Parent is WpfChartPanesCollectionModel)
			{
				return ((WpfChartPanesCollectionModel)base.Parent).IndexOf(this);
			}
			return -2;
		}
	}

				if (Axis is CircularAxisY2D)

					((CircularAxisY2D)Axis).TickmarksVisible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("TickmarksVisible");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool TickmarksMinorVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Axis is Axis2D)
				{
					return ((Axis2D)Axis).TickmarksMinorVisible;
				}
				if (Axis is CircularAxisY2D)
				{
					return ((CircularAxisY2D)Axis).TickmarksMinorVisible;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Axis is Axis2D && ((Axis2D)Axis).TickmarksMinorVisible != value)
				{
					((Axis2D)Axis).TickmarksMinorVisible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("TickmarksMinorVisible");
				}
				if (Axis is CircularAxisY2D)
				{
					((CircularAxisY2D)Axis).TickmarksMinorVisible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("TickmarksMinorVisible");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Interlaced
		{
			get
			{
				return Axis.Interlaced;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Axis.Interlaced != value)
				{
					Axis.Interlaced = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Interlaced");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsArgumentAxis => !IsValuesAxis;

		public bool IsValuesAxis => ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.IsValuesAxis(Axis);

		public bool IsPrimaryAxis
		{
			get
			{
				if (base.Parent is WpfChartDiagramModel)
				{
					return true;
				}
				return false;
			}
		}

		public WpfChartAxisModel(ChartModelElement parent, AxisBase axis, string axisName)
			: base(parent, axis)
		{
			this.axisName = axisName;
			if (Axis is Axis2D)
			{
				constantLinesCollectionModel = new WpfChartConstantLinesCollectionModel(this, ((Axis2D)Axis).ConstantLinesInFront);
				customAxisLabelCollectionModel = new WpfChartAxisCustomLabelCollectionModel(this, ((Axis2D)Axis).CustomLabels);
				stripCollectionModel = new WpfChartStripCollectionModel(this, ((Axis2D)Axis).Strips);
				scaleBreakCollectionModel = new WpfChartScaleBreakCollectionModel(this, ((Axis2D)Axis).ScaleBreaks);
			}
			UpdateTitle();
			UpdateLabel();
			WpfChartDiagramModel wpfChartDiagramModel = GetParent<WpfChartDiagramModel>();
			base.PropertyGridModel = WpfChartAxisBasePropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForAxis(this);
		}

		private void UpdateTitle()
		{
			if (Axis is Axis && (title == null || ((Axis)Axis).Title != title.Title))
			{
				Title = new WpfChartAxisTitleModel(this, ((Axis)Axis).Title);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLabel()
		{
			if (label == null || Axis.Label != label.Label)
			{
				Label = new WpfChartAxisLabelModel(this, Axis.Label);
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			UpdateTitle();
			UpdateLabel();
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			return axisName;
		}

		public int GetSelfIndex()
		{
			if (base.Parent is WpfChartDiagramModel)
			{
				return -1;
			}
			if (base.Parent is WpfChartSecondaryAxesCollectionModel)
			{
				return ((WpfChartSecondaryAxesCollectionModel)base.Parent).IndexOf(this);
			}
			return -2;
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartSeriesPointModel : ChartModelElement
	{
		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => null;

		public Series Series => SeriesPoint.Series;

		public SeriesPoint SeriesPoint => (SeriesPoint)base.ChartElement;

		public WpfChartSeriesModel SeriesModel => (WpfChartSeriesModel)base.Parent.Parent;

		public object Argument
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series != null)
				{
					if (Series.ArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						return SeriesPoint.DateTimeArgument;
					}
					if (Series.ArgumentScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						return SeriesPoint.TimeSpanArgument;
					}
				}
				return SeriesPoint.Argument;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(value, SeriesPoint.Argument))
				{
					DataEditorUtils.SetSeriesPointArgumentSafely(SeriesPoint, value);
					OnPropertyChanged("Argument");
				}
			}
		}

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series != null)
				{
					if (Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
					{
						return SeriesPoint.DateTimeValue;
					}
					if (Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
					{
						return SeriesPoint.TimeSpanValue;
					}
				}
				return SeriesPoint.Value;
			}
			set
			{
				if (value != null)
				{
					if ((Series != null && Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime) || value is DateTime)
					{
						SeriesPoint.DateTimeValue = (DateTime)value;
					}
					else if ((Series != null && Series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan) || value is TimeSpan)
					{
						SeriesPoint.TimeSpanValue = (TimeSpan)value;
					}
					else
					{
						double value2 = double.NaN;
						if (value is string)
						{
							value2 = double.Parse((string)value, CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
						}
						if (value is double)
						{
							value2 = (double)value;
						}
						SeriesPoint.Value = value2;
					}
				}
				else
				{
					SeriesPoint.Value = 0.0;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("Value");
			}
		}

		public double Value2
		{
			get
			{
				return DataEditorUtils.GetAttachedValue2(SeriesPoint);
			}
			set
			{
				DataEditorUtils.SetAttachedValue2(SeriesPoint, value);
				OnPropertyChanged("Value2");
			}
		}

		public double Weight
		{
			get
			{
				return DataEditorUtils.GetAttachedWeight(SeriesPoint);

	public class WpfChartStripModel : WpfChartFontModel
	{
		private WpfChartLegendModel legend;

		private WpfChartModel ChartModel => GetParent<WpfChartModel>();

		public override IEnumerable<ChartModelElement> Children => null;

		public Strip Strip => (Strip)base.ChartElement;

		public object MaxLimit
		{
			get
			{
				return Strip.MaxLimit;
			}
			set

				if (Strip.MaxLimit != value)

					Strip.MaxLimit = value;
				}
				OnPropertyChanged("MaxLimit");
			}
		}

		public object MinLimit
		{
			get
			{
				return Strip.MinLimit;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Strip.MinLimit != value)
				{
					Strip.MinLimit = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("MinLimit");
				}
			}
		}

		public string AxisLabelText
		{
			get
			{
				return Strip.AxisLabelText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Strip.AxisLabelText != value)
				{
					Strip.AxisLabelText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("AxisLabelText");
				}
			}
		}

		public string LegendText
		{
			get
			{
				return Strip.LegendText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Strip.LegendText != value)
				{
					Strip.LegendText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("LegendText");
				}
			}
		}

		public SolidColorBrush Brush
		{
			get
			{
				return Strip.Brush as SolidColorBrush;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Strip.Brush != value)
				{
					Strip.Brush = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Brush");
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartLegendModel Legend
		{
			get
			{
				return legend;
			}
			set
			{
				if (legend != value)
				{
					legend = value;
					if (legend != null)
					{
						Strip.Legend = legend.Legend;
					}
					else
					{
						Strip.Legend = null;
					}
					OnPropertyChanged("Legend");
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartStripModel(ChartModelElement parent, Strip strip)
			: base(parent, strip)
		{
			base.PropertyGridModel = new WpfChartStripPropertyGridModel(GetParent<WpfChartModel>(), this);
		}

		private void UpdateLegend()
		{
			if (Strip.Legend != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && Strip.Legend == legend.Legend)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WpfChartLegendModel item in ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Legend == Strip.Legend)
						{
							Legend = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			Legend = ((ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0) ? ((WpfChartLegendModel)ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[0]) : null);
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			base.UpdateChildren();
			UpdateLegend();
		}

		public int GetSelfIndex()
		{
			if (base.Parent is WpfChartStripCollectionModel)
			{
				return ((WpfChartStripCollectionModel)base.Parent).IndexOf(this);
			}
			return -1;
		}
	}

	public abstract class WpfChartTitleModelBase : WpfChartFontModel
	{
		private TitleBase Title => (TitleBase)base.ChartElement;

		public string DisplayName
		{
			get
			{
				if (Title != null && Title.Content != null)
				{
					if (Title.Content is string)
					{
						return Title.Content as string;
					}
					return ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ComplexTitleContent);
				}
				return string.Empty;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!(Title.Content is string) || (string)Title.Content != value)
				{
					Title.Content = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("DisplayName");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				if (Title != null)
				{
					if (!Title.Visible.HasValue)
					{
						return true;
					}
					return Title.Visible.Value;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{
				if (Title.Visible != value)
				{
					Title.Visible = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Visible");
				}
			}
		}

		public WpfChartTitleModelBase(ChartModelElement parent, TitleBase title)
			: base(parent, title)
		{
		}
	}

	public class WpfChartConstantLineModel : WpfChartFontModel

					{
						return (string)ConstantLine.Title.Content;
					}
					if (ConstantLine.Title.Content is EditableTextContent)
					{

				return string.Empty;

					ConstantLine.Value = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Value");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool ShowTitleBelowLine
		{
			get
			{
				if (ConstantLine.Title != null)
				{
					return ConstantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine;
				}
				return (bool)ConstantLineTitle.ShowBelowLineProperty.GetMetadata(typeof(ConstantLineTitle)).DefaultValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ConstantLine.Title != null && ConstantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine != value)
				{
					ConstantLine.Title.ShowBelowLine = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("ShowTitleBelowLine");
				}
			}

			}

		private void UpdateLegend()
		{
			if (ConstantLine.Legend != null)
			{
				if (legend != null && ConstantLine.Legend == legend.Legend)
				{
					return;
				}
				{
					foreach (WpfChartLegendModel item in ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
					{
						if (item.Legend == ConstantLine.Legend)
						{
							Legend = item;
							break;
						}
					}
					return;
				}
			}
			Legend = ((ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count > 0) ? ((WpfChartLegendModel)ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection[0]) : null);
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			base.UpdateChildren();
			UpdateLegend();
		}

			: this(id, dataSource, dataMember, allowedScaleTypes, parent, ScaleType.Auto)
		{
		}

		public DataBrowserTreeNode(string id, object dataSource, string dataMember, ScaleType[] allowedScaleTypes, DataBrowserTreeNode parent, ScaleType type)
		{
			this.id = id;
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			this.dataMember = dataMember;
			glyphSource = null;
			this.allowedScaleTypes = allowedScaleTypes;
			this.parent = parent;
			this.type = type;
			childNodes = new DataBrowserTreeNodeList(this);
		}

		private void RemoveDummyNodes()
		{
			List<DataBrowserTreeNode> list = new List<DataBrowserTreeNode>();
			foreach (DataBrowserTreeNode childNode in childNodes)
			{
				if (childNode.IsDummyNode || (parent == null && childNode.dataMember.Contains(".")))
				{
					list.Add(childNode);
				}
			}
			foreach (DataBrowserTreeNode item in list)
			{
				childNodes.Remove(item);
			}
		}

		public void SetParent(DataBrowserTreeNode parent)
		{
			if (this.parent != parent)
			{
				this.parent = parent;
			}
		}

		private void FillChildNodes()
		{
			if (childNodes.Count == 1 && childNodes[0].IsDummyNode)
			{
				childNodes.Clear();
				Collection<Pair<object, string>> collection = new Collection<Pair<object, string>>();
				collection.Add(new Pair<object, string>(dataSource, dataMember));
				List<DataBrowserTreeNode> list = new List<DataBrowserTreeNode>();
				((PickManagerBase)new DataBrowserPickManager(allowedScaleTypes)).FillContent((IList)list, collection, false);
				if (list.Count > 0)
				{
					childNodes.AddRange((DataBrowserTreeNodeList)list[0].ChildNodes);
				}
			}
		}

		public void InvalidateNodes()
		{
			RemoveDummyNodes();
			foreach (DataBrowserTreeNode childNode in childNodes)
			{
				childNode.FillChildNodes();
			}
		}

		public string GetFullDisplayName()
		{
			if (parent != null)
			{
				string fullDisplayName = parent.GetFullDisplayName();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(fullDisplayName))
				{
					return fullDisplayName + "." + id;
				}
				return id;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}

		void INode.Expand(EventHandler callback)
		{
		}

		bool INode.HasDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			if (this.dataSource != null)
			{
				return this.dataSource.Equals(dataSource);
			}
			return false;
		}
	}

		private bool IsAllowedDataMember(TypeSpecifics dataMemberType, ScaleType[] allowedScaleTypes)
		{
			//IL_0024: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0027: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0040: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0043: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0029: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_002c: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0045: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0047: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_002e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0030: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0049: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_004b: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0032: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0034: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0038: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = 0; i < allowedScaleTypes.Length; i++)
			{
				switch (allowedScaleTypes[i])
				{
				case ScaleType.Qualitative:
					flag = true;
					break;
				case ScaleType.Numerical:
					flag = (int)dataMemberType == 16 || (int)dataMemberType == 15 || (int)dataMemberType == 7 || (int)dataMemberType == 6 || (int)dataMemberType == 4;
					break;
				case ScaleType.DateTime:
					flag = (int)dataMemberType == 17 || (int)dataMemberType == 8 || (int)dataMemberType == 4;
					break;
				}
				if (flag)
				{
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		protected override INode CreateDataMemberNode(object dataSource, string dataMember, string displayName, bool isList, object owner, IPropertyDescriptor property)
		{
			//IL_001b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0021: Invalid comparison between Unknown and I4
			//IL_0036: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0096: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0053: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			DataBrowserTreeNode parent = ((owner is DataBrowserTreeNodeList) ? ((DataBrowserTreeNodeList)owner).Owner : null);
			if ((int)property.Specifics == 1)

					PropertyDescriptor realProperty = ((FakedPropertyDescriptor)property).RealProperty;

	public static class CommandUtils
	{
		private static PropertyInfo GetPropertyInfo(string propertyPath, ref object targetObject)
		{
			string[] array = propertyPath.Split('.');
			string[] array2 = new string[array.Length - 1];
			Array.Copy(array, 0, array2, 0, array.Length - 1);
			string name = array[array.Length - 1];
			string[] array3 = array2;
			foreach (string text in array3)
			{
				Type type = targetObject.GetType();
				PropertyInfo property = type.GetProperty(text);
				object obj = targetObject;
				targetObject = property.GetValue(targetObject, new object[0]);
				if (targetObject == null)
				{
					property = type.GetProperty("Actual" + text);
					targetObject = property.GetValue(obj, new object[0]);
				}
			}
			Type type2 = targetObject.GetType();
			return type2.GetProperty(name);
		}

		private static IModelItem GetModelItem(IModelItem modelItem, string propertyName)
		{
			string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
			IModelItem val = modelItem;
			string[] array2 = new string[array.Length - 1];
			Array.Copy(array, 0, array2, 0, array.Length - 1);
			string[] array3 = array2;
			foreach (string text in array3)
			{
				val = val.Properties[text].Value;
			}
			return val;
		}

		public static int ExtractInt(object value, int defaultValue = 0)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(string))
				{
					if (int.TryParse((string)value, out var result))
					{
						return result;
					}
					return defaultValue;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					return (int)value;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(decimal))
				{
					return (int)(decimal)value;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(float))
				{
					return (int)(float)value;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(double))
				{
					return (int)(double)value;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(long))
				{
					return (int)(long)value;
				}
			}
			return defaultValue;
		}

		public static object GetObjectProperty(object targetObject, string propertyPath)
		{
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = GetPropertyInfo(propertyPath, ref targetObject);
			return propertyInfo.GetValue(targetObject, new object[0]);
		}

		public static void SetObjectProperty(object targetObject, string propertyPath, object value)
		{
			PropertyInfo propertyInfo = GetPropertyInfo(propertyPath, ref targetObject);
			propertyInfo.SetValue(targetObject, value, new object[0]);
		}

		public static IModelItem GetModelItemProperty(IModelItem modelItem, string propertyName)
		{
			string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
			IModelItem modelItem2 = GetModelItem(modelItem, propertyName);
			string text = array[array.Length - 1];
			return modelItem2.Properties[text].Value;
		}

		public static void SetModelItemProperty(IModelItem modelItem, string propertyName, object value)
		{
			string[] array = propertyName.Split('.');
			IModelItem modelItem2 = GetModelItem(modelItem, propertyName);
			string text = array[array.Length - 1];
			modelItem2.Properties[text].SetValue(value);
		}

		public static List<IndicatorBarItem> GetIndicatorTypes()
		{
			Assembly assembly = Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl));
			List<Type> list = (from t in assembly.GetTypes()
				where t.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Indicator)) && !t.IsAbstract && !t.IsSubclassOf(typeof(ParametricRegression))
				select t).ToList();
			list.Sort(new TypeComparer());
			List<IndicatorBarItem> list2 = new List<IndicatorBarItem>();
			foreach (Type item in list)
			{
				string localizedIndicatorTypeName = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetLocalizedIndicatorTypeName(item);
				list2.Add(new IndicatorBarItem(localizedIndicatorTypeName, item));
			}
			return list2;
		}
	}
	internal class TypeComparer : IComparer<Type>
	{
		public int Compare(Type x, Type y)
		{
			return string.Compare(x.Name, y.Name);
		}
	}

		{
			List<object> list = new List<object>();
			List<object> list2 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list3 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list4 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list5 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list6 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list7 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list8 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list9 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list10 = new List<object>();
			List<object> list11 = new List<object>();
			List<Type> list12 = new List<Type>(from x in Assembly.GetAssembly(typeof(ChartControl)).GetTypes()
				where x.IsSubclassOf(typeof(Series)) && x.IsPublic
				select x);
			list12.Remove(typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D));
			list12.Insert(0, typeof(BarSideBySideSeries2D));
			foreach (Type item13 in list12)
			{
				if (item13.IsAbstract || item13.Name.Contains("Test"))
				{
					continue;
				}
				object item = CreateGalleryItemModel(chartModel, item13, ownerModel);
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Range"))
				{
					list4.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Polar"))
				{
					list9.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Radar"))
				{
					list10.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Bar") || item13.Name.Contains("Waterfall"))
				{
					list.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Area"))
				{
					list2.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Line") || item13.Name.Contains("Spline"))
				{
					list3.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.IsSubclassOf(typeof(FinancialSeries2D)))
				{
					list5.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Point") || item13.Name.Contains("Bubble"))
				{
					list6.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Pie") || item13.Name.Contains("Donut"))
				{
					list7.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("Funnel"))
				{
					list8.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				if (item13.Name.Contains("BoxPlot"))
				{
					list11.Add(item);
					continue;
				}
				throw new ChartDesignerException("XpfChartModel can't put '" + item13.Name + "' in group.");
			}
			List<object> list13 = new List<object>();
			object item2 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_BarSeries), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item2);
			object item3 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list2, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_Area), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item3);
			object item4 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list3, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_LineSeries), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item4);
			object item5 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list4, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_RangeSeries), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item5);
			object item6 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list5, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_Financial), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item6);
			object item7 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list6, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_PointBubble), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item7);
			object item8 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list7, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_Pie), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item8);
			object item9 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list8, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_Funnel), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item9);
			object item10 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list9, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_Polar), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item10);
			object item11 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list10, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_Radar), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item11);
			object item12 = CreateGalleryGroupModel(list11, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartViewGallery_BoxPlot), hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled);
			list13.Add(item12);
			return CreateGallery(list13, ownerModel);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesViewGalleryCreator : SeriesViewGalleryCreatorBase
	{
		public SeriesViewGalleryCreator(bool hideItemsWhenDisabled = false)
			: base(hideItemsWhenDisabled)
		{
		}

		protected abstract BarButtonViewModel CreateGalleryItem(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType, GalleryViewModelBase ownerModel);

		protected override object CreateGalleryItemModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType, object ownerModel)
		{
			return CreateGalleryItem(chartModel, seriesType, (GalleryViewModelBase)ownerModel);
		}

		protected override object CreateGalleryGroupModel(IEnumerable items, string caption, bool hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled)
		{
			GalleryGroupViewModel galleryGroupViewModel = new GalleryGroupViewModel(hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled)
			{
				Caption = caption
			};
			foreach (BarButtonViewModel item in items)
			{
				galleryGroupViewModel.Items.Add(item);
			}
			return galleryGroupViewModel;
		}

		protected override object CreateGallery(IEnumerable groups, object ownerModel)
		{
			GalleryViewModelBase galleryViewModelBase = ownerModel as GalleryViewModelBase;
			if (galleryViewModelBase != null)
			{
				foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel group in groups)
				{
					galleryViewModelBase.Groups.Add(group);
				}
			}
			return galleryViewModelBase;
		}

		public void CreateGallery(WpfChartModel chartModel, GalleryViewModelBase ownerModel)
		{
			CreateSeriesViewGallery(chartModel, ownerModel);
		}
	}
	public abstract class SeriesViewPopupGalleryCreator : SeriesViewGalleryCreatorBase
	{
		protected abstract GalleryItemViewModel CreateGalleryItem(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType);

		protected override object CreateGalleryItemModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type seriesType, object ownerModel)
		{
			return CreateGalleryItem(chartModel, seriesType);
		}

		protected override object CreateGalleryGroupModel(IEnumerable items, string caption, bool hideGroupWhenAllItemsDisabled)
		{
			List<GalleryItemViewModel> list = new List<GalleryItemViewModel>();
			foreach (GalleryItemViewModel item in items)
			{
				list.Add(item);
			}
			return new GalleryItemGroupViewModel(caption, list);
		}

		protected override object CreateGallery(IEnumerable groups, object ownerModel)
		{
			List<GalleryItemGroupViewModel> list = new List<GalleryItemGroupViewModel>();
			foreach (GalleryItemGroupViewModel group in groups)
			{
				list.Add(group);
			}
			return new GalleryViewModel(list);
		}

		public GalleryViewModel CreateGallery(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			return (GalleryViewModel)CreateSeriesViewGallery(chartModel, null);
		}
	}

			return splitButtonGalleryItemViewModel;
		}
	}

	public sealed class ConstantLineTitlePositionToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is WpfChartConstantLineModel wpfChartConstantLineModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (wpfChartConstantLineModel.ConstantLine.Title == null && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionNone)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (wpfChartConstantLineModel.ConstantLine.Title == null && !(parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionNone))
			{
				return false;
			}
			ConstantLineTitleAlignment titleAlignment = wpfChartConstantLineModel.TitleAlignment;
			bool showTitleBelowLine = wpfChartConstantLineModel.ShowTitleBelowLine;
			ConstantLine selectedConstantLine = ((ConstantLineCommandBase)parameter).SelectedConstantLine;
			Axis2D constantLineOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetConstantLineOwner(selectedConstantLine);
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near && !showTitleBelowLine && IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionNearAboveVertical)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near && showTitleBelowLine && IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionNearBelowVertical)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Far && !showTitleBelowLine && IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionFarAboveVertical)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Far && showTitleBelowLine && IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionFarBelowVertical)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near && !showTitleBelowLine && !IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionNearAboveHorizontal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Near && showTitleBelowLine && !IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionNearBelowHorizontal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Far && !showTitleBelowLine && !IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionFarAboveHorizontal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (titleAlignment == ConstantLineTitleAlignment.Far && showTitleBelowLine && !IsVertical(selectedConstantLine) && parameter is ChangeConstantLineTitlePositionFarBelowHorizontal)
			{
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private bool IsVertical(ConstantLine constantLine)
		{
			Axis2D constantLineOwner = ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetConstantLineOwner(constantLine);
			return !ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.IsAxisVertical(constantLineOwner);
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class ScaleTypeConverter : IValueConverter
	{

		}
