		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class TabItemVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is ChartModelElement && parameter != null)
			{
				switch (parameter.ToString())
				{
				case "Options":
				case "Properties":
					return (value is WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
				case "Data":
					if (value is WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel)
					{
						return Visibility.Visible;
					}
					if (value is WpfChartModel)
					{
						return (((WpfChartModel)value).DataSource == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
					}
					if (value is WpfChartSeriesModel)
					{
						WpfChartModel wpfChartModel = ((WpfChartSeriesModel)value).Root as WpfChartModel;
						return (wpfChartModel.DataSource == null && ((WpfChartSeriesModel)value).PredefinedDataSource == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
					}
					break;
				}
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class DataControlsVisibilityConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is ChartModelElement && parameter != null)
			{
				switch (parameter.ToString())
				{
				case "Points":
					return (!(value is WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel)) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
				case "DataBrowser":
					if (value is WpfChartModel wpfChartModel2)
					{
						return (wpfChartModel2.DiagramModel == null || wpfChartModel2.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel == null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
					}
					return (value is WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
				case "Template":
					if (value is WpfChartModel wpfChartModel)
					{
						return (wpfChartModel.DiagramModel != null && wpfChartModel.DiagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel != null) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
					}
					return Visibility.Collapsed;
				}
			}
			return Visibility.Collapsed;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class ChartTreeVisibleToOpacityConverter : IValueConverter

	public sealed class PageCategoryVisibleConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		private bool IsTitleProperlyCategory(IOwnedElement title, string parameter)
		{
			if (!(title.Owner.GetType() == typeof(ChartControl)) || !(parameter == "ChartTitle"))
			{
				if (title.Owner.GetType().IsSubclassOf(typeof(PieSeries)))
				{
					return parameter == "SeriesTitle";
				}
				return false;
			}
			return true;
		}

		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			VisibilityConverterParameter visibilityConverterParameter = parameter as VisibilityConverterParameter;
			if (value != null && parameter != null && visibilityConverterParameter != null)
			{
				if (value is WpfChartTitleModel wpfChartTitleModel)
				{
					return IsTitleProperlyCategory(wpfChartTitleModel.Title, visibilityConverterParameter.StringParameter);
				}
				Type type = value.GetType();
				return type == visibilityConverterParameter.TypeParameter || type.IsSubclassOf(visibilityConverterParameter.TypeParameter);
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class PageSelectedConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is string && parameter is string)
			{
				return value == parameter;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool)
			{
				if (!(bool)value)
				{
					return string.Empty;
				}
				return parameter;
			}
			return string.Empty;
		}
	}
	public sealed class LegendPositionToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ChangeLegendPositionCommand changeLegendPositionCommand = (ChangeLegendPositionCommand)parameter;
			HorizontalPosition horizontalPosition = changeLegendPositionCommand.HorizontalPosition;
			VerticalPosition verticalPosition = changeLegendPositionCommand.VerticalPosition;
			if (changeLegendPositionCommand.LegendModel != null)
			{
				Legend legend = changeLegendPositionCommand.LegendModel.Legend;
				return legend != null && legend.HorizontalPosition == horizontalPosition && legend.VerticalPosition == verticalPosition;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class LegendOrientationToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value == null)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ChangeLegendOrientationCommand changeLegendOrientationCommand = (ChangeLegendOrientationCommand)parameter;
			if (changeLegendOrientationCommand.ChartControl.Legends.Count > 0)
			{
				return changeLegendOrientationCommand.ChartControl.Legends[0].Orientation == changeLegendOrientationCommand.Orientation;
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return false;
		}
	}

	public sealed class ChartTitlePositionToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is WpfChartTitleModel wpfChartTitleModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parameter is EmptyChartCommand)
			{
				return false;
			}
			ChartTitlePositionCommand chartTitlePositionCommand = (ChartTitlePositionCommand)parameter;
			Title title = wpfChartTitleModel.Title;
			if (title != null && title.Dock == chartTitlePositionCommand.Dock)
			{
				switch (chartTitlePositionCommand.Dock)
				{
				case Dock.Top:
				case Dock.Bottom:
					return title.HorizontalAlignment == chartTitlePositionCommand.HorizontalAlignment || (title.HorizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Stretch && chartTitlePositionCommand.HorizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Center);
				case Dock.Left:
				case Dock.Right:
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class SeriesTitlePositionToBoolConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is WpfChartTitleModel wpfChartTitleModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (parameter is EmptyChartCommand)
			{
				return false;
			}
			SeriesTitlePositionCommand seriesTitlePositionCommand = (SeriesTitlePositionCommand)parameter;
			Title title = wpfChartTitleModel.Title;
			if (title != null && title.Dock == seriesTitlePositionCommand.Dock)
			{
				switch (seriesTitlePositionCommand.Dock)
				{
				case Dock.Top:
				case Dock.Bottom:
					return title.HorizontalAlignment == seriesTitlePositionCommand.HorizontalAlignment || (title.HorizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Stretch && seriesTitlePositionCommand.HorizontalAlignment == HorizontalAlignment.Center);
				case Dock.Left:
				case Dock.Right:
					return true;
				}
			}
			return false;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value;
		}
	}
	public sealed class ChartTitleContentConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(value is WpfChartTitleModel wpfChartTitleModel))
			{
				return false;
			}
			if (!(wpfChartTitleModel.Title.Content is string))
			{
				return ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ComplexTitleContent);
			}
			return wpfChartTitleModel.Title.Content.ToString();

	public sealed class SelectedItemGlyphConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		object IMultiValueConverter.Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (values.Length != 0)
			{
				if (values.Length > 1)
				{
					if (values[0] is IList<GalleryItem> { Count: >0 } list && list[0].Glyph != null)
					{
						return list[0].Glyph;
					}
					if (values[1] != null)
					{
						return values[1] as ImageSource;
					}
				}
				else if (values[0] is IList<GalleryItem> { Count: >0 } list2)
				{
					return list2[0].Glyph;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		object[] IMultiValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return new object[1] { value };
		}

	public class MarginMultiConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		private void FindMaxExpandLevel(TreeListNodeCollection nodes, ref int maxLevel)
		{
			foreach (TreeListNode item in (Collection<TreeListNode>)(object)nodes)
			{
				maxLevel = Math.Max(maxLevel, item.Level);
				if (((TreeListNodeBase)item).IsExpanded)
				{
					FindMaxExpandLevel(item.Nodes, ref maxLevel);
				}
			}
		}

		public object Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (!(values[0] is TreeListRowData treeListRowData))
			{
				return null;
			}
			TreeListView treeListView = (TreeListView)treeListRowData.View;
			int maxLevel = 0;
			FindMaxExpandLevel(((TreeListView)treeListRowData.View).Nodes, ref maxLevel);
			double right = treeListView.RowIndent + (double)maxLevel * treeListView.RowIndent;
			return new Thickness(0.0, 0.0, right, 0.0);
		}

		public object[] ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class OptionsHeaderConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		private string GetOptionsHeader(string propertyPath, Type modelType)
		{
			if (propertyPath.Contains("."))
			{
				string name = propertyPath.Split('.')[0];
				string propertyPath2 = propertyPath.Split('.')[1];
				PropertyInfo property = modelType.GetProperty(name);
				return GetOptionsHeader(propertyPath2, modelType.GetProperty(name).PropertyType);
			}
			PropertyInfo property2 = modelType.GetProperty(propertyPath);
			if (property2 == null)
			{
				return string.Empty;
			}
			object[] customAttributes = property2.GetCustomAttributes(inherit: false);
			object[] array = customAttributes;
			foreach (object obj in array)
			{
				if (obj is OptionsHeaderAttribute optionsHeaderAttribute)
				{
					return optionsHeaderAttribute.Header;
				}
			}
			return propertyPath;
		}

		object IMultiValueConverter.Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			string text = values[0] as string;
			DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition propertyDefinition = values[1] as DevExpress.Xpf.PropertyGrid.PropertyDefinition;
			if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(text) && propertyDefinition != null && propertyDefinition.DataContext is DesignerViewModelBar designerViewModelBar)
			{
				PropertyGridModelBase propertyGridModel = designerViewModelBar.ChartModel.SelectedModel.PropertyGridModel;
				return GetOptionsHeader(text, propertyGridModel.GetType());
			}
			return text;
		}

		object[] IMultiValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class ImagesVisibilityToWidthConverter : IMultiValueConverter
	{
		private const double imageWidth = 16.0;

		private const double padding = 3.0;

		object IMultiValueConverter.Convert(object[] values, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			double num = 0.0;
			double num2 = (double)values[0];
			ChartTreeModel chartTreeModel = (ChartTreeModel)((TreeListRowData)values[2]).Row;
			if (chartTreeModel != null)
			{
				if (chartTreeModel.GlyphSource != null)
				{
					num += 16.0;
				}
				if ((bool)values[1])
				{
					if (chartTreeModel.AddCommand != null)
					{
						num += 16.0;
					}
					if (chartTreeModel.DeleteCommand != null)
					{
						num += 16.0;
					}
					if (chartTreeModel.ToggleVisibleCommand != null)
					{
						num += 16.0;
					}
					if (num != 0.0)
					{
						num += 3.0;
					}
				}
			}
			return Math.Max(num2 - num, 0.0);
		}

		object[] IMultiValueConverter.ConvertBack(object value, Type[] targetTypes, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return null;
		}
	}
	public class SelectedIndexToIsSelectedConverter : IMultiValueConverter

		}

	public class PointCollectionEditorEnabledToNewItemRowPositionConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value is bool && (bool)value)
			{
				return NewItemRowPosition.Bottom;
			}
			return NewItemRowPosition.None;
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			return value is NewItemRowPosition && (NewItemRowPosition)value == NewItemRowPosition.Bottom;
		}
	}

		private static void OnComboBoxItemsChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel = (BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel)d;
			if (barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.ComboBoxItems != null && barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.ComboBoxItems.Length != 0)
			{
				barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.SelectedComboBoxItem = barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.ComboBoxItems[0];
			}
		}

		private static void OnSelectedComboBoxItemChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel = (BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel)d;
			if (e.NewValue == null && barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.ComboBoxItems != null && barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.ComboBoxItems.Length != 0)
			{
				barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.SelectedComboBoxItem = barDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel.ComboBoxItems[0];
			}
		}

		public BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel(object comboBoxItemsBindingSource, string comboBoxItemsBindingPath, IValueConverter comboBoxItemsBindingConverter = null)
		{
			//IL_0009: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Binding binding = new Binding(comboBoxItemsBindingPath)
			{
				Source = comboBoxItemsBindingSource,
				Converter = comboBoxItemsBindingConverter
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, comboBoxItemsProperty, binding);
			base.Groups.CollectionChanged += Groups_CollectionChanged;
		}

		private void Groups_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.Items.CollectionChanged += Items_CollectionChanged;
					foreach (BarButtonViewModel item in newItem.Items)
					{
						SetBindingGalleryItemCommandParameterToSelectedComboBoxItem(item);
					}
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
			{
				oldItem.Items.CollectionChanged -= Items_CollectionChanged;
				foreach (BarButtonViewModel item2 in oldItem.Items)
				{
					BindingOperations.ClearBinding(item2, BarButtonViewModel.commandParameterProperty);
				}
			}
		}

		private void Items_CollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (BarButtonViewModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					SetBindingGalleryItemCommandParameterToSelectedComboBoxItem(newItem);
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (BarButtonViewModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
			{
				BindingOperations.ClearBinding(oldItem, BarButtonViewModel.commandParameterProperty);
			}
		}

		private void SetBindingGalleryItemCommandParameterToSelectedComboBoxItem(BarButtonViewModel galleryItem)
		{
			Binding binding = new Binding("SelectedComboBoxItem");
			binding.Source = this;
			binding.Converter = SelectedComboBoxItemToGalleryItemCommandParameterConverter;
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(galleryItem, BarButtonViewModel.commandParameterProperty, binding);
		}
	}
	public class BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel : BarEditValueItemViewModel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty DataSourceProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("DataSource", typeof(object), typeof(BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(ValuePropertyChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ScaleTypeProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("ScaleType", typeof(ScaleType), typeof(BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(ValuePropertyChanged));

		private List<DataBrowserTreeNode> itemsSource;

		private bool isValueDataMember;

		public List<DataBrowserTreeNode> ItemsSource => itemsSource;

		public object DataSource
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(DataSourceProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(DataSourceProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public ScaleType ScaleType
		{
			get
			{
				return (ScaleType)GetValue(ScaleTypeProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ScaleTypeProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel barPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel)
			{
				barPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel.UpdatePopupTree();
			}
		}

		public BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, ChartModelElement source, string editValuePath, IValueConverter converter, bool isValueDataMember)
			: this(command, source, editValuePath, converter, null, isValueDataMember)
		{
		}

		public BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, ChartModelElement source, string editValuePath, IValueConverter converter, IRibbonBehavior behavior, bool isValueDataMember)
			: base(command, source, editValuePath, converter, behavior)
		{
			this.isValueDataMember = isValueDataMember;
			Binding binding = new Binding(editValuePath)
			{
				Source = source,
				Converter = new DataSourceConverter()
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, DataSourceProperty, binding);
			Binding binding2 = new Binding(editValuePath)
			{
				Source = source,
				Converter = new ScaleTypeConverter(),
				ConverterParameter = command
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ScaleTypeProperty, binding2);
		}

		private void UpdatePopupTree()
		{
			ScaleType[] allowedScaleTypes = ((ScaleType != ScaleType.Auto) ? new ScaleType[1] { ScaleType } : ((!isValueDataMember) ? new ScaleType[4]
			{
				ScaleType.Qualitative,
				ScaleType.Numerical,
				ScaleType.DateTime,
				ScaleType.TimeSpan
			} : new ScaleType[3]
			{
				ScaleType.Numerical,
				ScaleType.DateTime,
				ScaleType.TimeSpan
			}));
			DataBrowserPickManager dataBrowserPickManager = new DataBrowserPickManager(allowedScaleTypes);
			List<DataBrowserTreeNode> list = new List<DataBrowserTreeNode>();
			Collection<Pair<object, string>> collection = new Collection<Pair<object, string>>();
			collection.Add(new Pair<object, string>(DataSource, ""));
			((PickManagerBase)dataBrowserPickManager).FillContent((IList)list, collection, true);
			itemsSource = list;
		}
	}
	public class BarEditValueIntegerConverter : IValueConverter
	{
		public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				return value.ToString();
			}
			return "0";
		}

		public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
		{
			if (value != null)
			{
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(int))
				{
					return value;
				}
				if (value.GetType() == typeof(string))
				{
					return int.Parse((string)value);
				}
			}
			return 0;
		}
	}
	public class BarEditValueItemViewModel : BarButtonViewModel
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(BarEditValueItemViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(ValuePropertyChanged));

		private IValueConverter converter;

		private object converterParameter;

		private object editValue;

		private string nullText = string.Empty;

		private int editWidth = 90;

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public object EditValue
		{
			get
			{
				return editValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(editValue, value))
				{
					editValue = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("EditValue");
					object obj = null;
					if (converter != null)
					{
						obj = converter.ConvertBack(editValue, null, converterParameter, null);
					}
					object parameter = ((obj == null) ? editValue : obj);
					if (base.Command != null && base.Command.CanExecute(parameter))
					{
						base.Command.Execute(parameter);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public int EditWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return editWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (editWidth != value)
				{
					editWidth = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("EditWidth");
				}
			}
		}

		public string NullText
		{
			get
			{
				return nullText;
			}
			set
			{
				if (nullText != value)
				{
					nullText = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("NullText");
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is BarEditValueItemViewModel barEditValueItemViewModel)
			{
				barEditValueItemViewModel.editValue = e.NewValue;
				barEditValueItemViewModel.OnPropertyChanged("Value");
				barEditValueItemViewModel.OnPropertyChanged("EditValue");
			}
		}

			: base(command, behavior)
		{
			this.converter = converter ?? (command as IValueConverter);
			converterParameter = command;
			Binding binding = new Binding(editValuePath)

				ConverterParameter = converterParameter,
				TargetNullValue = bindingFailureValue,
				FallbackValue = bindingFailureValue
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ValueProperty, binding);
		}

	{
		public BarColorEditViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, ChartModelElement source, string editValuePath)
			: base(command, source, editValuePath)

			base.PropertyChanged += ColorEditItemViewModel_PropertyChanged;
		}

		public BarColorEditViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, ChartModelElement source, string editValuePath, IValueConverter converter)
			: base(command, source, editValuePath, converter)
		{
			base.PropertyChanged += ColorEditItemViewModel_PropertyChanged;
		}

		private void ColorEditItemViewModel_PropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!(e.PropertyName != "EditValue") && base.EditValue != null)
			{
				SolidColorBrush brush = ((!(base.EditValue is SolidColorBrush)) ? new SolidColorBrush((Color)base.EditValue) : ((SolidColorBrush)base.EditValue));
				Rect rect = new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), new Size(16.0, 16.0));
				RectangleGeometry geometry = new RectangleGeometry(rect);
				GeometryDrawing drawing = new GeometryDrawing(brush, new Pen(), geometry);
				DrawingImage drawingImage = new DrawingImage(drawing);
				drawingImage.Freeze();
				base.Glyph = drawingImage;
				Rect rect2 = new Rect(new Point(0.0, 0.0), new Size(16.0, 16.0));
				RectangleGeometry geometry2 = new RectangleGeometry(rect2);
				GeometryDrawing drawing2 = new GeometryDrawing(brush, new Pen(), geometry2);
				DrawingImage drawingImage2 = new DrawingImage(drawing2);
				drawingImage2.Freeze();
				base.LargeGlyph = drawingImage2;
			}
		}
	}

				return largeGlyph;
			}
			set
			{
				if (largeGlyph != value)
				{
					largeGlyph = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("LargeGlyph");
				}
			}
		}

		public ICommand Command
		{
			get
			{
				return command;
			}
			set
			{
				if (command != value)
				{
					command = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Command");
				}
			}
		}

		public BarButtonViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, IRibbonBehavior behavior)
		{
			//IL_0002: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			Command = command;
			if (Command != null)
			{
				command.RegisterForUpdate();
				if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(command.ImageName))
				{
					Glyph = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(command.ImageName);
					LargeGlyph = GlyphUtils.GetLargeGlyphByPath(command.ImageName);
				}
				base.Caption = command.Caption;
				Command.CanExecuteChanged += CommandCanExecuteChanged;
				UpdateIsEnabled();
			}
			behavior?.Initialize(this);
		}

		public BarButtonViewModel(ChartCommandBase command)
			: this(command, null)
		{
		}

		private void CommandCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateIsEnabled();
		}

		private void UpdateIsEnabled()
		{
			base.IsEnabled = Command != null && Command.CanExecute(CommandParameter);
		}

		public void UpdateVisibility(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			base.IsVisible = Command != null && Command.CanExecute(CommandParameter);
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			if (Command != null)
			{
				Command.CanExecuteChanged -= CommandCanExecuteChanged;
				Command = null;
			}
		}
	}

	public abstract class GalleryViewModelBase : RibbonItemViewModelBase
	{
		private ObservableCollection<GalleryGroupViewModel> galleryGroupModels = new ObservableCollection<GalleryGroupViewModel>();

		public ObservableCollection<GalleryGroupViewModel> Groups => galleryGroupModels;

		public GalleryViewModelBase()
		{
			galleryGroupModels.CollectionChanged += OnGalleryGroupModelsCollectionChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateIsEnabled()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel galleryGroupModel in galleryGroupModels)
			{
				if (!galleryGroupModel.AreAllCommandsDisabled)
				{
					flag = true;
					break;
				}
			}
			base.IsEnabled = flag;
		}

		private void OnGalleryGroupModelsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.PropertyChanged -= OnItemPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			UpdateIsEnabled();
		}

		private void OnItemPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "AreAllCommandsDisabled")
			{
				UpdateIsEnabled();
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (GalleryGroupViewModel group in Groups)
			{
				group.CleanUp();
			}
		}
	}

	public class GalleryGroupViewModel : RibbonItemViewModelBase
	{
		private ObservableCollection<BarButtonViewModel> items = new ObservableCollection<BarButtonViewModel>();

		private bool hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled;

		private bool areAllCommandsDisabled;

		public ObservableCollection<BarButtonViewModel> Items => items;

		public bool AreAllCommandsDisabled
		{
			get
			{
				return areAllCommandsDisabled;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (areAllCommandsDisabled != value)
				{
					areAllCommandsDisabled = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("AreAllCommandsDisabled");
				}
			}
		}

		public GalleryGroupViewModel(bool hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled = false)
		{
			this.hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled = hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled;
			Items.CollectionChanged += ItemsCollectionChanged;
			if (hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled)
			{
				UpdateVisibilityAndCheckEnabledOfCommands();
			}
			else
			{
				CheckEnabledOfCommandsOnly();
			}
		}

		private void ItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (BarButtonViewModel oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.Command.CanExecuteChanged -= OnCanExecuteChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (BarButtonViewModel newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.Command.CanExecuteChanged += OnCanExecuteChanged;
				}
			}
			if (hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled)
			{
				UpdateVisibilityAndCheckEnabledOfCommands();
			}
			else
			{
				CheckEnabledOfCommandsOnly();
			}
		}

		private void OnCanExecuteChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			if (hideGroupIfAllItemsAreDisabled)
			{
				UpdateVisibilityAndCheckEnabledOfCommands();
			}
			else
			{
				CheckEnabledOfCommandsOnly();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateVisibilityAndCheckEnabledOfCommands()
		{
			base.IsVisible = false;
			foreach (BarButtonViewModel item in Items)
			{
				base.IsVisible |= item.Command.CanExecute(item.CommandParameter);
			}
			bool flag = areAllCommandsDisabled;
			AreAllCommandsDisabled = !base.IsVisible;
		}

		private void CheckEnabledOfCommandsOnly()
		{
			foreach (BarButtonViewModel item in Items)
			{
				if (item.Command.CanExecute(item.CommandParameter))
				{
					AreAllCommandsDisabled = false;
					break;
				}
				AreAllCommandsDisabled = true;
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (BarButtonViewModel item in Items)
			{
				item.CleanUp();
			}
		}
	}

	public class BarThicknessEditViewModel : BarButtonViewModel
	{
		public class Item
		{
			private readonly string representation;

			private readonly int thickness;

			private readonly Visibility lineVisibility;

			public string Representation => representation;

			public int Thickness => thickness;

			public Visibility LineVisibility => lineVisibility;

			public Item(string representation, int thickness)
			{
				this.representation = representation;
				this.thickness = thickness;
				lineVisibility = ((thickness == 0) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible);
			}
		}

		public static readonly DependencyProperty ValueProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Value", typeof(object), typeof(BarThicknessEditViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(ValuePropertyChanged));

		private static readonly DependencyPropertyKey ItemsPropertyKey = DependencyProperty.RegisterReadOnly("Items", typeof(ObservableCollection<Item>), typeof(BarThicknessEditViewModel), new PropertyMetadata());

		private IValueConverter converter;

		private object converterParameter;

		private object editValue;

		private int editWidth = 90;

		public ObservableCollection<Item> Items
		{
			get
			{
				return (ObservableCollection<Item>)GetValue(ItemsPropertyKey.DependencyProperty);
			}
			private set
			{
				SetValue(ItemsPropertyKey, value);
			}
		}

		public object Value
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(ValueProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ValueProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public object EditValue
		{
			get
			{
				return editValue;
			}
			set
			{
				if (!object.Equals(editValue, value))
				{
					editValue = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("EditValue");
					object obj = null;
					if (converter != null)
					{
						obj = converter.ConvertBack(editValue, null, converterParameter, null);
					}
					if (base.Command != null)
					{
						base.Command.Execute((obj == null) ? editValue : obj);
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public int EditWidth
		{
			get
			{
				return editWidth;
			}
			set
			{
				if (editWidth != value)
				{
					editWidth = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("EditWidth");
				}
			}
		}

		private static void ValuePropertyChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			BarThicknessEditViewModel barThicknessEditViewModel = d as BarThicknessEditViewModel;
			Item item = null;
			if (e.NewValue == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)e.NewValue;
			foreach (Item item2 in barThicknessEditViewModel.Items)
			{
				if (item2.Thickness == num)
				{
					item = item2;
				}
			}
			if (item == null && barThicknessEditViewModel.Items.Count > 0)
			{
				item = barThicknessEditViewModel.Items[barThicknessEditViewModel.Items.Count - 1];
			}
			barThicknessEditViewModel.editValue = item;
			barThicknessEditViewModel.OnPropertyChanged("Value");
			barThicknessEditViewModel.OnPropertyChanged("EditValue");
		}

		public BarThicknessEditViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, ChartModelElement source, string editValuePath, int startThickness, int step, int count, IValueConverter converter)
			: base(command)
		{
			this.converter = converter ?? (this as IValueConverter);
			converterParameter = command;
			ObservableCollection<Item> observableCollection = new ObservableCollection<Item>();
			int num = startThickness;
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				observableCollection.Add(new Item((num == 0) ? ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ThicknessNone) : num.ToString(), num));
				num += step;
			}
			Items = observableCollection;
			Binding binding = new Binding(editValuePath)
			{
				Source = source,
				Mode = BindingMode.OneWay,
				Converter = this.converter,
				ConverterParameter = converterParameter
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, ValueProperty, binding);
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartTreeCollectionModel : ChartTreeModel
	{
		public override bool IsSelectable => false;

		public ChartTreeCollectionModel(string name, ChartElementCollectionModelBase dataModel)
			: base(name, dataModel, isItemVisibleInTree: false)
		{
			dataModel.CollectionUpdated += ChartCollectionModelUpdated;
			foreach (ChartModelElement child in dataModel.Children)
			{
				AddChild(CreateSubnode(child));
			}
			base.IsItemVisibleInTree = true;
		}

		private void ChartCollectionModelUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			UpdateSubnodeCollection(args);
		}

		private void UpdateSubnodeCollection(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (args == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			if (args.RemovedItems != null)
			{
				foreach (ChartModelElement removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
				{
					RemoveChild(removedItem);
				}
			}
			if (args.AddedItems != null)
			{
				foreach (InsertedItem addedItem in args.AddedItems)
				{
					InsertChild(addedItem.Index, CreateSubnode(addedItem.Item));
				}
			}
			OnPropertyChanged("Children");
		}

		protected override string GetNameFromDataModel(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			int num = 0;
			foreach (ChartModelElement child in dataModel.Children)
			{
				num++;
			}
			return base.BaseName + " (" + num + ")";
		}

		protected abstract ChartTreeModel CreateSubnode(ChartModelElement dataModel);
	}

	public class ChartTreeSeriesCollectionModel : ChartTreeCollectionModel
	{
		private WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel;

		protected virtual Type SeriesTemplateModelType => typeof(ChartTreeSeriesTemplateModel);

		public override ICommand AddCommand => diagramModel.ChartModel.OpenAddSeriesDialogCommand;

		public ChartTreeSeriesCollectionModel(WpfChartSeriesCollectionModel dataModel, WpfChartDiagramModel diagramModel)
			: base(ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.TreeSeriesCollection), dataModel)
		{
			this.diagramModel = diagramModel;
			this.diagramModel.PropertyChanged += DiagramModelPropertyChanged;
			UpdateSeriesTemplateSubnode();
		}

		private void DiagramModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "SeriesTemplateModel")
			{
				UpdateSeriesTemplateSubnode();
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesTemplateSubnode()
		{
			SyncModelAddChildDelegate<WpfChartSeriesModel> addChildDelegate = delegate
			{
				ChartTreeModel item = CreateSeriesTemplateModel(diagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel);
				foreach (ChartTreeModel child in base.Children)
				{
					if (child is ChartTreeSeriesTemplateModel)
					{
						RemoveChild(child);
						break;
					}
				}
				return InsertChild(0, item);
			};
			SyncModel(diagramModel.SeriesTemplateModel, SeriesTemplateModelType, addChildDelegate);
		}

		protected virtual ChartTreeModel CreateSeriesTemplateModel(WpfChartSeriesModel seriesTemplateModel)
		{
			return new ChartTreeSeriesTemplateModel(seriesTemplateModel);
		}

		protected override ChartTreeModel CreateSubnode(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			return new ChartTreeSeriesModel((WpfChartSeriesModel)dataModel);
		}

		protected override string GetGlyph()
		{
			return "Tree/SeriesCollection";
		}
	}

		{
			WpfChartSeriesModel seriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)dataModel;
			bool flag = !((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.DataModel).IsAutoSeries;
			if (flag && !((WpfChartSeriesModel)base.DataModel).IsSeriesTemplate)
			{
				SyncModel(seriesModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel, (WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreeSeriesPointsModelBar(seriesModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel)));

			if (flag)
			{
				SyncModel(seriesModel.IndicatorCollectionModel, (WpfChartIndicatorCollectionModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreeIndicatorCollectionModelBar(seriesModel.IndicatorCollectionModel, seriesModel.Diagram.ChartModel)));
				SyncModel(seriesModel.TitleCollectionModel, (WpfChartTitleCollectionModel model) => AddChild(new ChartSeriesTitlesCollectionModelBar(seriesModel.TitleCollectionModel)));
				SyncModel(seriesModel.PieTotalLabelModel, (PieTotalLabelModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreePieTotalLabelModelBar(seriesModel.PieTotalLabelModel)));
			}
		}

		protected override string GetGlyph()
		{
			return null;
		}
	}

	public class ChartTreeModelItemSelector : IChildNodesSelector
	{
		public IEnumerable SelectChildren(object item)
		{
			return (item is ChartTreeModel) ? ((ChartTreeModel)item).Children : new ObservableCollection<ChartTreeModel>();
		}
	}
	public abstract class ChartTreeModel : ViewModelBase
	{
		protected delegate ChartTreeModel SyncModelAddChildDelegate<T>(T element);

		private const string DeleteItemGlyphPath = "TreeBar/Remove";

		private const string AddItemGlyphPath = "TreeBar/Add";

		private const string VisibleItemGlyphPath = "TreeBar/Show";

		private readonly string baseName;

		private ICommand removeElementCommand;

		private ChartTreeModel parent;

		private ObservableCollection<ChartTreeModel> children;

		private ChartModelElement dataModel;

		private string name;

		private ImageSource glyphSource;

		private string glyph;

		private bool isItemVisibleInTree;

		private ToggleVisibilityCommand toggleVisibilityCommand;

		private WpfChartModel ChartModel => dataModel.GetParent<WpfChartModel>();

		private ISupportVisibleModel SupportVisibleModel => dataModel.PropertyGridModel as ISupportVisibleModel;

		protected string BaseName => baseName;

		protected virtual bool CanDeleted => false;

		public string Name
		{
			get
			{
				return name;
			}
			set
			{
				if (name != value)
				{
					name = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Name");
				}
			}
		}

		public string Glyph
		{
			get
			{
				return glyph;
			}
			set
			{
				if (glyph != value)
				{
					glyph = value;
					if (isBarGlyph(glyph))
					{
						glyphSource = GlyphUtils.GetSvgGlyphByPath(glyph);
					}
					else
					{
						glyphSource = GlyphUtils.GetGlyphByPath(glyph);
					}
					OnPropertyChanged("Glyph");
					OnPropertyChanged("GlyphSource");
				}
			}
		}

		public ImageSource GlyphSource => glyphSource;

		public ImageSource DeleteItemGlyph => GlyphUtils.GetSvgGlyphByPath("TreeBar/Remove");

		public ImageSource AddItemGlyph => GlyphUtils.GetSvgGlyphByPath("TreeBar/Add");

		public ImageSource VisibleItemGlyph => GlyphUtils.GetSvgGlyphByPath("TreeBar/Show");

		public ObservableCollection<ChartTreeModel> Children => children;

		public ChartModelElement DataModel => dataModel;

		public bool IsItemVisibleInTree
		{
			get
			{
				return isItemVisibleInTree;
			}
			set
			{
				if (isItemVisibleInTree != value)
				{
					isItemVisibleInTree = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("IsItemVisibleInTree");
				}
			}
		}

		public object ChartElement => dataModel.ChartElement;

		public virtual bool NeedExpand => true;

		public virtual bool IsVisible
		{
			get
			{
				if (SupportVisibleModel != null)
				{
					return SupportVisibleModel.Visible;
				}
				return true;
			}
		}

		public virtual ICommand AddCommand => null;

		public virtual ICommand ToggleVisibleCommand => toggleVisibilityCommand;

		public ICommand DeleteCommand => removeElementCommand;

		public virtual bool IsSelectable => true;

		public ChartTreeModel(string name, ChartModelElement dataModel, bool isItemVisibleInTree)
		{
			baseName = name;
			Name = name;
			children = new ObservableCollection<ChartTreeModel>();
			this.dataModel = dataModel;
			if (this.dataModel != null)
			{
				this.dataModel.PropertyChanged += DataModelPropertyChanged;
			}
			Name = GetName(this.dataModel);
			Glyph = GetGlyph();
			UpdateChildrenCollection(this.dataModel);
			this.isItemVisibleInTree = isItemVisibleInTree;
			UpdateCommandsCore(ChartModel);
		}

		private void NotifyRootAboutChanges()
		{
			if (parent != null)
			{
				parent.NotifyRootAboutChanges();
			}
			else
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("Children");
			}
		}

		private bool isBarGlyph(string glyth)
		{
			return glyth.Contains("TreeBar");
		}

		private string GetName(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			string nameFromDataModel = GetNameFromDataModel(dataModel);
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(nameFromDataModel))
			{
				nameFromDataModel = BaseName;
			}
			return nameFromDataModel;
		}

		protected void SyncModel<T>(T dataModel, Type nodeType, SyncModelAddChildDelegate<T> addChildDelegate)
		{
			ChartTreeModel chartTreeModel = FindChild(typeof(T), nodeType);
			if (dataModel != null)
			{
				if (chartTreeModel != null && !object.Equals(chartTreeModel.DataModel, dataModel))
				{
					RemoveChild(chartTreeModel);
					addChildDelegate(dataModel);
				}
				else if (chartTreeModel == null)
				{
					addChildDelegate(dataModel);
				}
			}
			else if (chartTreeModel != null)
			{
				RemoveChild(chartTreeModel);
			}
		}

		protected void SyncModel<T>(T dataModel, SyncModelAddChildDelegate<T> addChildDelegate)
		{
			SyncModel(dataModel, null, addChildDelegate);
		}

		protected ChartTreeModel InsertChild(int index, ChartTreeModel item)
		{
			item.parent = this;
			Children.Insert(index, item);
			return item;
		}

		protected ChartTreeModel AddChild(ChartTreeModel item)
		{
			item.parent = this;
			Children.Add(item);
			return item;
		}

		protected ChartTreeModel RemoveChild(ChartModelElement model)
		{
			ChartTreeModel chartTreeModel = null;
			foreach (ChartTreeModel child in children)
			{
				if (child.DataModel == model)
				{
					chartTreeModel = child;
				}
			}
			RemoveChild(chartTreeModel);
			return chartTreeModel;
		}

		protected ChartTreeModel RemoveChild(ChartTreeModel item)
		{
			if (item != null)
			{
				children.Remove(item);
			}
			return item;
		}

		protected ChartTreeModel FindChild(Type modelType, Type nodeType)
		{
			if (modelType != null)
			{
				foreach (ChartTreeModel child in children)
				{
					if (child.DataModel.GetType() == modelType && (child.GetType() == nodeType || nodeType == null))
					{
						return child;
					}
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected ChartTreeModel FindRecursively(ChartModelElement model)
		{
			if (DataModel == model)
			{
				return this;
			}
			foreach (ChartTreeModel child in Children)
			{
				ChartTreeModel chartTreeModel = child.FindRecursively(model);
				if (chartTreeModel != null)
				{
					return chartTreeModel;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		protected void UpdateCommands()
		{
			UpdateCommandsCore(ChartModel);
		}

		protected virtual string GetGlyph()
		{
			return null;
		}

		protected virtual void DataModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			UpdateChildrenCollection(dataModel);
			NotifyRootAboutChanges();
			Name = GetName(dataModel);
			Glyph = GetGlyphFromDataModel(dataModel);
			if (SupportVisibleModel != null)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("IsVisible");
			}
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateChildrenCollection(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
		}

		protected virtual string GetNameFromDataModel(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			return BaseName;
		}

		protected virtual string GetGlyphFromDataModel(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			return glyph;
		}

		protected virtual void UpdateCommandsCore(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			if (CanDeleted)
			{
				removeElementCommand = new RemoveElementBarCommand(chartModel);
			}
			if (SupportVisibleModel != null)
			{
				toggleVisibilityCommand = new ToggleVisibilityCommand(dataModel.PropertyGridModel as ISupportVisibleModel);
			}
		}
	}
	public class ChartTreeRootModel : ChartTreeModel
	{
		private ChartTreeModel selection;

		private ChartTreeModel highlightItem;

		private ChangeHighlightItemCommand changeHighlightItemCommand;

		private WpfChartModel ChartModel => (WpfChartModel)base.DataModel;

		public ChartTreeModel Selection
		{
			get
			{
				return selection;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selection != value && (value == null || value.IsSelectable))
				{
					selection = value;
					if (selection != null)
					{
						ChartModel.SelectedModel = ((selection == null) ? null : selection.DataModel);
						OnPropertyChanged("Selection");
					}
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartTreeModel HighlightItem
		{
			get
			{
				return highlightItem;
			}
			set
			{
				if (highlightItem != value)
				{
					highlightItem = value;
					ChartModel.HighlightModel = ((highlightItem == null) ? null : highlightItem.DataModel);
				}
			}
		}

		public ICommand ChangeHighlightItemCommand => changeHighlightItemCommand;

		public ChartTreeRootModel(ChartModelElement dataModel)
			: base("ChartStructure", dataModel, isItemVisibleInTree: true)
		{
			selection = FindChild(typeof(WpfChartModel), typeof(ChartTreeChartModel));
			changeHighlightItemCommand = new ChangeHighlightItemCommand(this);
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildrenCollection(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			SyncModel((WpfChartModel)dataModel, (WpfChartModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreeChartModel(model)));
		}

		protected override void DataModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			base.DataModelPropertyChanged(sender, e);
			if (e.PropertyName == "SelectedModel")
			{
				selection = FindRecursively(ChartModel.SelectedModel);
				OnPropertyChanged("Selection");
			}
		}
	}

	public class ChartTreeAxisModel : ChartTreeModel
	{
		private readonly bool isPrimaryAxis;

		private readonly string glyph;

		private ToggleAxisVisibilityBarCommand toggleAxisVisibilityCommand;

		public override bool IsVisible => ((WpfChartAxisModel)base.DataModel).IsVisible;

		protected override bool CanDeleted => !isPrimaryAxis;

		public override ICommand ToggleVisibleCommand => toggleAxisVisibilityCommand;

		public ChartTreeAxisModel(string name, string glyph, bool isPrimaryAxis, WpfChartAxisModel dataModel)
			: base(name, dataModel, isItemVisibleInTree: true)
		{
			this.glyph = glyph;
			this.isPrimaryAxis = isPrimaryAxis;
			base.Glyph = GetGlyph();
			UpdateCommands();
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildrenCollection(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			WpfChartAxisModel axisModel = (WpfChartAxisModel)dataModel;
			SyncModel(axisModel.ConstantLinesCollectionModel, (WpfChartConstantLinesCollectionModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreeConstantLinesCollectionModel(axisModel.ConstantLinesCollectionModel)));
			SyncModel(axisModel.StripCollectionModel, (WpfChartStripCollectionModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreeStripCollectionModel(axisModel.StripCollectionModel)));
			SyncModel(axisModel.ScaleBreakCollectionModel, (WpfChartScaleBreakCollectionModel model) => AddChild(new ChartTreeScaleBreakCollectionModel(axisModel.ScaleBreakCollectionModel)));
		}

		protected override string GetNameFromDataModel(ChartModelElement dataModel)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(base.BaseName))
			{
				return ((WpfChartAxisModel)dataModel).Name;
			}
			return base.BaseName;
		}

		protected override string GetGlyph()
		{
			return glyph;
		}

		protected override void UpdateCommandsCore(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			base.UpdateCommandsCore(chartModel);
			AxisBase axis = ((WpfChartAxisModel)base.DataModel).Axis;
			if (axis is Axis2D || axis is CircularAxisY2D)
			{
				toggleAxisVisibilityCommand = new ToggleAxisVisibilityBarCommand(chartModel);
			}
		}
	}

	public class ChangeHighlightItemCommand : ICommand
	{
		private readonly ChartTreeRootModel treeRootModel;

		private event EventHandler canExecuteChanged;

		event EventHandler ICommand.CanExecuteChanged
		{
			add
			{
				canExecuteChanged += value;
			}
			remove
			{
				canExecuteChanged -= value;
			}
		}

		public ChangeHighlightItemCommand(ChartTreeRootModel treeRootModel)
		{
			this.treeRootModel = treeRootModel;
			if (this.canExecuteChanged != null)
			{
				this.canExecuteChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty);
			}
		}

		public bool CanExecute(object parameter)
		{
			return parameter is ChartTreeModel;
		}

		public void Execute(object parameter)
		{
			treeRootModel.HighlightItem = (ChartTreeModel)parameter;
		}
	}
	public class WpfChartSeriesCollectionModel : ChartElementCollectionModelBase
	{
		public WpfChartSeriesCollectionModel(ChartModelElement parent, SeriesCollection seriesCollection)
			: base(parent, seriesCollection)
		{
		}

		protected override ChartModelElement CreateModel(object chartElement, int index)
		{
			return new WpfChartSeriesModel(this, (Series)chartElement);
		}
	}

		public ComplexLabelPosition ComplexLabelPosition
		{
			get
			{
				if (Series != null && Series.LabelsVisibility)
				{
					if (Series is BarSideBySideSeries2D)
					{
						return FactToComplex(BarSideBySideSeries2D.GetLabelPosition(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is PieSeries2D)
					{
						return FactToComplex(PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is FunnelSeries2D)
					{
						return FactToComplex(FunnelSeries2D.GetLabelPosition(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is PieSeries3D)
					{
						return FactToComplex(PieSeries.GetLabelPosition(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is MarkerSeries3D)
					{
						return FactToComplex(MarkerSeries3D.GetLabelPosition(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is BubbleSeries2D)
					{
						return FactToComplex(BubbleSeries2D.GetLabelPosition(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is FinancialSeries2D)
					{
						return ComplexLabelPosition.FinancialEnabled;
					}
					if (Series is BarSeries3D)
					{
						return ComplexLabelPosition.Bar3DEnabled;
					}
					if (Series is AreaSeries3D)
					{
						return ComplexLabelPosition.Area3DEnabled;
					}
					if (Series is MarkerSeries2D)
					{
						return AngleToComplex(MarkerSeries2D.GetAngle(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is CircularSeries2D)
					{
						return AngleToComplex(CircularSeries2D.GetAngle(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is BarStackedSeries2D)
					{
						return ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DCenter;
					}
					if (Series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
					{
						return RangeAreaLabelKindToComplexLabelPosition(RangeAreaSeries2D.GetLabelKind(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is RangeBarSeries2D)
					{
						return RangeBarLabelKindToComplexLabelPosition(RangeBarSeries2D.GetLabelKind(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
					if (Series is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
					{
						return RangeAreaLabelKindToComplexLabelPosition(CircularRangeAreaSeries2D.GetLabelKind(Series.ActualLabel));
					}
				}
				return ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled;
			}
			set
			{
				if (ComplexLabelPosition != value)
				{
					SetComplexLabelPosition(Series, value);
					OnPropertyChanged("ComplexLabelPosition");
				}
			}
		}

				if (Series is NestedDonutSeries2D)
				{
					((NestedDonutSeries2D)Series).Weight = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Weight");
				}
				else
				{
					WriteUnsupportedPropertySetWarning("Weight", Series.GetType().Name);
				}
			}
		}

		public static object ComplexToFact(ComplexLabelPosition position)
		{
			return position switch
			{
				ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DCenter => Bar2DLabelPosition.Center, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DOutside => Bar2DLabelPosition.Outside, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DAuto => Bar2DLabelPosition.Auto, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.PieInside => PieLabelPosition.Inside, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.PieOutside => PieLabelPosition.Outside, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.PieTwoColumns => PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Bubble2DCenter => Bubble2DLabelPosition.Center, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Marker3DCenter => Marker3DLabelPosition.Center, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Marker3DTop => Marker3DLabelPosition.Top, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaMaxValueLabel => RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaMinValueLabel => RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaOneLabel => RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaTwoLabels => RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaValue1Label => RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaValue2Label => RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarMaxValueLabel => RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarMinValueLabel => RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarOneLabel => RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarTwoLabels => RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelCenter => Funnel2DLabelPosition.Center, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelLeft => Funnel2DLabelPosition.Left, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelRight => Funnel2DLabelPosition.Right, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelLeftColumn => Funnel2DLabelPosition.LeftColumn, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelRightColumn => Funnel2DLabelPosition.RightColumn, 
				_ => null, 
			};
		}

		public static double ComplexToAngle(ComplexLabelPosition complexLabelPosition)
		{
			return complexLabelPosition switch
			{
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle0 => 0.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle45 => 45.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle90 => 90.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle135 => 135.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle180 => 180.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle225 => 225.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle270 => 270.0, 
				ComplexLabelPosition.Angle315 => 315.0, 
				_ => double.NaN, 
			};
		}

		public static void SetComplexLabelPosition(Series series, ComplexLabelPosition complexLabelPosition)
		{
			if (complexLabelPosition == ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled)
			{
				series.LabelsVisibility = false;
				return;
			}
			series.LabelsVisibility = true;
			if (series is BarSideBySideSeries2D)
			{
				BarSideBySideSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, (Bar2DLabelPosition)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is PieSeries2D)
			{
				PieSeries.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, (PieLabelPosition)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is PieSeries3D)
			{
				PieSeries.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, (PieLabelPosition)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is FunnelSeries2D)
			{
				FunnelSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, (Funnel2DLabelPosition)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is MarkerSeries3D)
			{
				MarkerSeries3D.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, (Marker3DLabelPosition)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				object obj = ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition);
				if (obj != null)
				{
					BubbleSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, (Bubble2DLabelPosition)obj);
					return;
				}
				double num = ComplexToAngle(complexLabelPosition);
				if (!double.IsNaN(num))
				{
					BubbleSeries2D.SetLabelPosition(series.ActualLabel, Bubble2DLabelPosition.Outside);
					MarkerSeries2D.SetAngle(series.ActualLabel, num);
				}
			}
			else if (series is MarkerSeries2D)
			{
				MarkerSeries2D.SetAngle(series.ActualLabel, ComplexToAngle(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is CircularSeries2D)
			{
				CircularSeries2D.SetAngle(series.ActualLabel, ComplexToAngle(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				RangeAreaSeries2D.SetLabelKind(series.ActualLabel, (RangeAreaLabelKind)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				RangeBarSeries2D.SetLabelKind(series.ActualLabel, (RangeBarLabelKind)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
			else if (series is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				CircularRangeAreaSeries2D.SetLabelKind(series.ActualLabel, (RangeAreaLabelKind)ComplexToFact(complexLabelPosition));
			}
		}

		public WpfChartSeriesModel(ChartModelElement parent, Series series)
			: base(parent, series)
		{
			seriesPointCollectionModel = new WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel(this, series.Points);
			if (Series is PieSeries)
			{
				titleCollectionModel = new WpfChartTitleCollectionModel(this, ((PieSeries)series).Titles);
				UpdatePieTotalLabel();
			}
			if (Series is XYSeries2D)
			{
				indicatorCollectionModel = new WpfChartIndicatorCollectionModel(this, ((XYSeries2D)Series).Indicators);
				UpdatePane();
				UpdateAxes();
			}
			predefinedDataSource = series.DataSource;
			if (series.DataSource != null)
			{
				dataSource = series.DataSource;
			}
			else
			{
				UpdateDataMembers(series);
				if (series.DataSource == null && Diagram.ChartModel.DataSource != null && (IsSeriesTemplate || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ArgumentDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ValueDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(Value2DataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(WeightDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(LowValueDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(HighValueDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(OpenValueDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(CloseValueDataMember.DataMember) || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(ColorDataMember.DataMember)))
				{
					dataSource = Diagram.ChartModel.DataSource;
				}
			}
			UpdateDataMembers(series);
			base.PropertyGridModel = WpfChartSeriesPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForSeries(this, Diagram.ChartModel);
		}

		private ComplexLabelPosition RangeBarLabelKindToComplexLabelPosition(RangeBarLabelKind rangeBarLabelKind)
		{
			return rangeBarLabelKind switch
			{
				RangeBarLabelKind.MaxValueLabel => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarMaxValueLabel, 
				RangeBarLabelKind.MinValueLabel => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarMinValueLabel, 
				RangeBarLabelKind.OneLabel => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarOneLabel, 
				RangeBarLabelKind.TwoLabels => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeBarTwoLabels, 
				_ => throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown RangeBarLabelKind."), 
			};
		}

		private ComplexLabelPosition RangeAreaLabelKindToComplexLabelPosition(RangeAreaLabelKind rangeAreaLabelKind)
		{
			return rangeAreaLabelKind switch
			{
				RangeAreaLabelKind.MaxValueLabel => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaMaxValueLabel, 
				RangeAreaLabelKind.MinValueLabel => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaMinValueLabel, 
				RangeAreaLabelKind.OneLabel => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaOneLabel, 
				RangeAreaLabelKind.TwoLabels => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaTwoLabels, 
				RangeAreaLabelKind.Value1Label => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaValue1Label, 
				RangeAreaLabelKind.Value2Label => ComplexLabelPosition.RangeAreaValue2Label, 
				_ => throw new ChartDesignerException("Unknown RangeAreaLabelKind"), 
			};
		}

		private ComplexLabelPosition FactToComplex(object position)
		{
			if (position == null)
			{
				return ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled;
			}
			if (position.GetType() == typeof(Bar2DLabelPosition))
			{
				return (Bar2DLabelPosition)position switch
				{
					Bar2DLabelPosition.Center => ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DCenter, 
					Bar2DLabelPosition.Outside => ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DOutside, 
					Bar2DLabelPosition.Auto => ComplexLabelPosition.Bar2DAuto, 
					_ => ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled, 
				};
			}
			if (position.GetType() == typeof(PieLabelPosition))
			{
				return (PieLabelPosition)position switch
				{
					PieLabelPosition.Inside => ComplexLabelPosition.PieInside, 
					PieLabelPosition.Outside => ComplexLabelPosition.PieOutside, 
					PieLabelPosition.TwoColumns => ComplexLabelPosition.PieTwoColumns, 
					_ => ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled, 
				};
			}
			if (position.GetType() == typeof(Funnel2DLabelPosition))
			{
				return (Funnel2DLabelPosition)position switch
				{
					Funnel2DLabelPosition.Center => ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelCenter, 
					Funnel2DLabelPosition.Left => ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelLeft, 
					Funnel2DLabelPosition.LeftColumn => ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelLeftColumn, 
					Funnel2DLabelPosition.Right => ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelRight, 
					Funnel2DLabelPosition.RightColumn => ComplexLabelPosition.FunnelRightColumn, 
					_ => ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled, 
				};
			}
			if (position.GetType() == typeof(Marker3DLabelPosition))
			{
				return (Marker3DLabelPosition)position switch
				{
					Marker3DLabelPosition.Center => ComplexLabelPosition.Marker3DCenter, 
					Marker3DLabelPosition.Top => ComplexLabelPosition.Marker3DTop, 
					_ => ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled, 
				};
			}
			if (position.GetType() == typeof(Bubble2DLabelPosition))
			{
				return (Bubble2DLabelPosition)position switch
				{
					Bubble2DLabelPosition.Center => ComplexLabelPosition.Bubble2DCenter, 
					Bubble2DLabelPosition.Outside => AngleToComplex(MarkerSeries2D.GetAngle(Series.ActualLabel)), 
					_ => ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled, 
				};
			}
			return ComplexLabelPosition.Disabled;
		}

		private ComplexLabelPosition AngleToComplex(double angle)
		{
			return (int)Math.Floor(angle % 360.0 / 45.0) switch
			{
				0 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle0, 
				1 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle45, 
				2 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle90, 
				3 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle135, 
				4 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle180, 
				5 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle225, 
				6 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle270, 
				7 => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle315, 
				_ => ComplexLabelPosition.Angle0, 
			};
		}

		private void UpdatePane()
		{
			Pane pane = ((XYSeries2D)Series).Pane as Pane;
			WpfChartDiagramModel diagram = Diagram;
			if (pane == null || diagram.DefaultPaneModel.Pane == pane)
			{
				Pane = diagram.DefaultPaneModel;
			}
			else
			{
				if (diagram.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ChartModelElement item in diagram.PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
				{
					if (((WpfChartPaneModel)item).Pane == pane)
					{
						Pane = (WpfChartPaneModel)item;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxes()
		{
			SecondaryAxisX2D secondaryAxisX2D = ((XYSeries2D)Series).AxisX as SecondaryAxisX2D;
			WpfChartDiagramModel diagram = Diagram;
			if (secondaryAxisX2D == null)
			{
				AxisX = diagram.PrimaryAxisModelX;
			}
			else if (diagram.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection.Count > 0)
			{
				foreach (ChartModelElement item in diagram.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection)
				{
					if (((WpfChartAxisModel)item).Axis == secondaryAxisX2D)
					{
						AxisX = (WpfChartAxisModel)item;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
			if (!(((XYSeries2D)Series).AxisY is SecondaryAxisY2D secondaryAxisY2D))
			{
				AxisY = diagram.PrimaryAxisModelY;
			}
			else
			{
				if (diagram.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection.Count <= 0)
				{
					return;
				}
				foreach (ChartModelElement item2 in diagram.SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection)
				{
					if (((WpfChartAxisModel)item2).Axis == secondaryAxisY2D)
					{
						AxisY = (WpfChartAxisModel)item2;
						break;
					}
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateLegend()
		{
			if (Series.Legend == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			WpfChartDiagramModel diagram = Diagram;
			if (diagram.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection.Count <= 0)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (ChartModelElement item in diagram.ChartModel.LegendCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
			{
				if (((WpfChartLegendModel)item).Legend == Series.Legend)
				{
					Legend = (WpfChartLegendModel)item;
					break;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdatePieTotalLabel()
		{
			if (!(Series is PieSeries2D pieSeries2D))
			{
				return;
			}
			PieTotalLabelModel pieTotalLabelModel = this.pieTotalLabelModel;
			if (pieSeries2D.TotalLabel != null)
			{
				if (this.pieTotalLabelModel == null || pieSeries2D.TotalLabel != this.pieTotalLabelModel.TotalLabel)
				{
					this.pieTotalLabelModel = new PieTotalLabelModel(this, pieSeries2D.TotalLabel);
				}
			}
			else
			{
				this.pieTotalLabelModel = null;
			}
			if (this.pieTotalLabelModel != pieTotalLabelModel)
			{
				OnPropertyChanged("PieTotalLabelModel");
			}
		}

		private void UpdateDataMembers(Series series)
		{
			argumentDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, series.ArgumentDataMember), series.ArgumentDataMember);
			valueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, series.ValueDataMember), series.ValueDataMember);
			string empty = string.Empty;
			if (Series is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				empty = ((RangeBarSeries2D)Series).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (Series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				empty = ((RangeAreaSeries2D)Series).Value2DataMember;
			}
			if (Series is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				empty = ((CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)Series).Value2DataMember;
			}
			value2DataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty), empty);
			string empty2 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				empty2 = ((BubbleSeries2D)Series).WeightDataMember;
			}
			if (Series is BubbleSeries3D)
			{
				empty2 = ((BubbleSeries3D)Series).WeightDataMember;
			}
			weightDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty2), empty2);
			string empty3 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				empty3 = ((FinancialSeries2D)Series).LowValueDataMember;
			}
			lowValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty3), empty3);
			string empty4 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				empty4 = ((FinancialSeries2D)Series).HighValueDataMember;
			}
			highValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty4), empty4);
			string empty5 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				empty5 = ((FinancialSeries2D)Series).OpenValueDataMember;
			}
			openValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty5), empty5);
			string empty6 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is FinancialSeries2D)
			{
				empty6 = ((FinancialSeries2D)Series).CloseValueDataMember;
			}
			closeValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty6), empty6);
			string empty7 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty7 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).MinValueDataMember;
			}
			minValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty7), empty7);
			string empty8 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty8 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).Quartile1ValueDataMember;
			}
			quartile1ValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty8), empty8);
			string empty9 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty9 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).MedianValueDataMember;
			}
			medianValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty9), empty9);
			string empty10 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty10 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).MinValueDataMember;
			}
			quartile3ValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty10), empty10);
			string empty11 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty11 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).MaxValueDataMember;
			}
			maxValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty11), empty11);
			string empty12 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty12 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).MeanValueDataMember;
			}
			meanValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty12), empty12);
			string empty13 = string.Empty;
			if (Series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				empty13 = ((BoxPlotSeries2D)Series).OutlierValuesDataMember;
			}
			outlierValuesDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty13), empty13);
			closeValueDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, empty6), empty6);
			colorDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, series.ColorDataMember), series.ColorDataMember);
			toolTipHintDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(dataSource, series.ToolTipHintDataMember), series.ToolTipHintDataMember);
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			if (Series is XYSeries2D)
			{
				UpdatePane();
				UpdateAxes();
			}
			if (Series is PieSeries2D)
			{
				UpdatePieTotalLabel();
			}
			UpdateLegend();
		}

		public int GetSelfIndex()
		{
			if (!(base.Parent is WpfChartSeriesCollectionModel))
			{
				return -1;
			}
			return Diagram.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(Series);
		}

		public int GetSelfDesigntimeIndex()
		{
			if (base.Parent is WpfChartSeriesCollectionModel)
			{
				int num = 0;
				foreach (Series item in Diagram.Diagram.Series)
				{
					if (ChartDesignerPropertiesProvider.GetIsAutoSeries(item))
					{
						num++;
					}
				}
				return Diagram.Diagram.Series.IndexOf(Series) - num;
			}
			return -1;
		}

		[SkipOnPropertyChangedMethodCall]
		public void SetChartDataSource(object dataSource)
		{
			this.dataSource = dataSource;
			Series.DataSource = null;
			OnPropertyChanged("DataSource");
		}

		[SkipOnPropertyChangedMethodCall]
		public void SetSeriesDataSource()
		{
			dataSource = predefinedDataSource;
			Series.DataSource = predefinedDataSource;
			OnPropertyChanged("DataSource");
		}
	}

				if (Diagram is XYDiagram2D)

					return ((XYDiagram2D)Diagram).EnableAxisYNavigation;
				}
				return false;
			}
			set
			{

		public WpfChartDiagramModel(ChartModelElement parent, Diagram diagram)
			: base(parent, diagram)
		{
			seriesCollectionModel = new WpfChartSeriesCollectionModel(this, Diagram.Series);
			primaryAxisModelX = WpfChartAxisModelX.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
			primaryAxisModelY = WpfChartAxisModelY.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
			if (Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)Diagram;
				secondaryAxesCollectionModelX = new WpfChartSecondaryAxesCollectionModelX(this, xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesX);
				secondaryAxesCollectionModelY = new WpfChartSecondaryAxesCollectionModelY(this, xYDiagram2D.SecondaryAxesY);
				panesCollectionModel = new WpfChartPanesCollectionModel(this, xYDiagram2D.Panes);
				allPanes = new ObservableCollection<ChartModelElement>();
				allAxesX = new ObservableCollection<ChartModelElement>();
				allAxesY = new ObservableCollection<ChartModelElement>();
				UpdatePanes();
				UpdateAxes();
			}
			seriesDataMember = new DataMemberInfo(GetDataMemberName(ChartModel.DataSource, Diagram.SeriesDataMember), Diagram.SeriesDataMember);
			UpdateSeriesTemplate();
			base.PropertyGridModel = WpfChartDiagramPropertyGridModel.CreatePropertyGridModelForDiagram(this, ChartModel);
		}

		private void UpdatePanes()
		{
			XYDiagram2D xYDiagram2D = (XYDiagram2D)Diagram;
			if (defaultPaneModel == null || (defaultPaneModel.Pane != xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane && xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane != null))
			{
				defaultPaneModel = new WpfChartPaneModel(this, xYDiagram2D.ActualDefaultPane, ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DefaultPane));
				OnPropertyChanged("DefaultPane");
			}
			allPanes.Clear();
			allPanes.Add(defaultPaneModel);
			PanesCollectionModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			foreach (ChartModelElement item in PanesCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
			{
				allPanes.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateAxes()
		{
			allAxesX.Clear();
			allAxesX.Add(primaryAxisModelX);
			SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			foreach (ChartModelElement item in SecondaryAxesCollectionModelX.ModelCollection)
			{
				allAxesX.Add(item);
			}
			allAxesY.Clear();
			allAxesY.Add(primaryAxisModelY);
			SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			foreach (ChartModelElement item2 in SecondaryAxesCollectionModelY.ModelCollection)
			{
				allAxesY.Add(item2);
			}
		}

		private void UpdateSeriesTemplate()
		{
			if (Diagram.SeriesTemplate != null && (SeriesTemplateModel == null || SeriesTemplateModel.Series != Diagram.SeriesTemplate))
			{
				SeriesTemplateModel = new WpfChartSeriesModel(this, Diagram.SeriesTemplate);
			}
			else if (Diagram.SeriesTemplate == null)
			{
				SeriesTemplateModel = null;
			}
		}

		protected override void UpdateChildren()
		{
			if (Diagram is XYDiagram2D)
			{
				if (primaryAxisModelX.Axis != ((XYDiagram2D)Diagram).ActualAxisX)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelX = WpfChartAxisModelX.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
				if (primaryAxisModelY.Axis != ((XYDiagram2D)Diagram).ActualAxisY)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelY = WpfChartAxisModelY.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
				UpdatePanes();
				UpdateAxes();
			}
			if (Diagram is PolarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (primaryAxisModelX.Axis != ((PolarDiagram2D)Diagram).ActualAxisX)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelX = WpfChartAxisModelX.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
				if (primaryAxisModelY.Axis != ((PolarDiagram2D)Diagram).ActualAxisY)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelY = WpfChartAxisModelY.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
			}
			if (Diagram is RadarDiagram2D)
			{
				if (primaryAxisModelX.Axis != ((RadarDiagram2D)Diagram).ActualAxisX)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelX = WpfChartAxisModelX.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
				if (primaryAxisModelY.Axis != ((RadarDiagram2D)Diagram).ActualAxisY)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelY = WpfChartAxisModelY.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
			}
			if (Diagram is XYDiagram3D)
			{
				if (primaryAxisModelX.Axis != ((XYDiagram3D)Diagram).ActualAxisX)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelX = WpfChartAxisModelX.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
				if (primaryAxisModelY.Axis != ((XYDiagram3D)Diagram).ActualAxisY)
				{
					PrimaryAxisModelY = WpfChartAxisModelY.CreateForDiagramPrimaryAxis(this, Diagram);
				}
			}
			UpdateSeriesTemplate();
		}
	}
