	public sealed class BarItemTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		private ResourceDictionary itemsTemplateDictionary;

		private ResourceDictionary editItemsTemplateDictionary;

		private ResourceDictionary galleriesTemplateDictionary;

		public BarItemTemplateSelector()
		{
			string name = typeof(ChartDesigner).Assembly.GetName().Name;
			Uri source = new Uri("pack://application:,,,/" + name + ";component/Themes/RibbonElementTemplates/BarItems.xaml", UriKind.Absolute);
			itemsTemplateDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
			{
				Source = source
			};
			Uri source2 = new Uri("pack://application:,,,/" + name + ";component/Themes/RibbonElementTemplates/BarEditItems.xaml", UriKind.Absolute);
			editItemsTemplateDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
			{
				Source = source2
			};
			Uri source3 = new Uri("pack://application:,,,/" + name + ";component/Themes/RibbonElementTemplates/Galleries.xaml", UriKind.Absolute);
			galleriesTemplateDictionary = new ResourceDictionary
			{
				Source = source3
			};
		}

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			Type type = item.GetType();
			if (type == typeof(BarSplitButtonGalleryViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)galleriesTemplateDictionary["BarSplitButtonGalleryViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(InRibbonGalleryViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)galleriesTemplateDictionary["InRibbonGalleryViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)galleriesTemplateDictionary["BarDropDownButtonGalleryViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)galleriesTemplateDictionary["BarDropDownButtonGalleryWithComboViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarButtonViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)itemsTemplateDictionary["BarButtonViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarCheckButtonViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)itemsTemplateDictionary["BarCheckButtonViewModelViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarEditValueItemViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["TextEdit"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarCheckEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarCheckEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarFontFamilyEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarFontFamilyEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarComboBoxViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarComboBoxViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarDynamicComboBoxViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarDynamicComboBoxViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarSeparatorViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)itemsTemplateDictionary["BarItemSeparatorViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarStaticTextViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)itemsTemplateDictionary["BarStaticTextViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarColorEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarColorEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarThicknessEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarThicknessEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarSpinEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarSpinEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarDateTimeEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarDateTimeEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarPopupDataBrowserEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			if (type == typeof(BarDoubleEditViewModel))
			{
				return (DataTemplate)editItemsTemplateDictionary["BarDoubleEditViewModelTemplate"];
			}
			throw new ChartDesignerException("BarItemTemplateSelector can't give a DataTemplate for item: " + item);
		}
	}
	public static class GlyphUtils
	{
		public const string Series = "Series/";

		public const string BarItemImages = "BarItemImages/";

		public const string GalleryItemImages = "GalleryItemImages/";

		public const string TreeImages = "Tree/";

		public const string TreeBarImages = "TreeBar/";

		public const string ElementsPageImages = "BarItemImages/Elements/";

		public const string ToolBarImages = "ToolBarImages/";

		public const string DataTabImages = "DataTabImages/";

		private const string smallGlyphSuffix = "_16";

		private const string largeGlyphSuffix = "_32";

		private const string glyphExtension = ".png";

		private const string glyphExtensionSvg = ".svg";

		private static readonly string asmName;

		static GlyphUtils()
		{
			asmName = typeof(GlyphUtils).Assembly.GetName().Name;
		}

		private static string GetFullPath(string glyph)
		{
			return "pack://application:,,,/" + asmName + ";component/Images/" + glyph;
		}

		private static string GetBarFullPath(string glyph)
		{
			return "pack://application:,,,/" + asmName + ";component/ImagesBarDesigner/" + glyph;
		}

		public static string GetSeriesGlyph(Type seriesType)
		{
			return "Series/" + seriesType.Name;
		}

		public static ImageSource GetSvgGlyphByPath(string glyphPath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(glyphPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return WpfSvgRenderer.CreateImageSource(new Uri(GetFullPath(glyphPath) + ".svg", UriKind.Absolute), (Uri)null, (Size?)null, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (string)null, (bool?)null, true, true);
		}

		public static ImageSource GetGlyphByPath(string glyphPath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(glyphPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new BitmapImage(new Uri(GetFullPath(glyphPath) + "_16.png", UriKind.Absolute));
		}

		public static ImageSource GetLargeGlyphByPath(string glyphPath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(glyphPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new BitmapImage(new Uri(GetFullPath(glyphPath) + "_32.png", UriKind.Absolute));
		}

		public static ImageSource GetGalleryItemGlyphByPath(string glyphPath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(glyphPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new BitmapImage(new Uri(GetFullPath(glyphPath) + ".png", UriKind.Absolute));
		}

		public static string GetTreeDiagramTypeGlyph(Type diagramType)
		{
			return "Tree/" + diagramType.Name;
		}

		public static string GetTreeBarDiagramTypeGlyph(Type diagramType)
		{
			return "TreeBar/" + diagramType.Name;
		}

		public static ImageSource GetBarGlyphByPath(string glyphPath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(glyphPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return WpfSvgRenderer.CreateImageSource(new Uri(GetBarFullPath(glyphPath) + ".svg", UriKind.Absolute), (Uri)null, (Size?)null, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (string)null, (bool?)null, true, true);
		}

		public static ImageSource GetSeriesGalleryGlyph(Type seriesType)
		{
			try
			{
				return WpfSvgRenderer.CreateImageSource(new Uri(GetBarFullPath("Series/" + seriesType.Name) + ".svg", UriKind.Absolute), (Uri)null, (Size?)null, (WpfSvgPalette)null, (string)null, (bool?)null, true, true);
			}
			catch
			{
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static ImageSource GetBarImageByPath(string glyphPath)
		{
			if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(glyphPath))
			{
				return null;
			}
			return new BitmapImage(new Uri(GetBarFullPath(glyphPath) + ".png", UriKind.Absolute));
		}
	}
	public sealed class DesignerViewModelRibbon : ViewModelBase
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollection<RibbonPageCategoryViewModel> categories = new ObservableCollection<RibbonPageCategoryViewModel>();

		private readonly WpfChartModel chartModel;

		private readonly Captions captions = new Captions();

		private ChartTreeModel treeModelRoot;

		private string title = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartDesignerWindowTitle);

		private IEnumerable<RibbonPageCategoryViewModel> models;

		public string Title => title;

		public ObservableCollection<RibbonPageCategoryViewModel> RibbonPageCategories => categories;

		public ChartTreeModel TreeModelRoot
		{
			get
			{
				return treeModelRoot;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (treeModelRoot != value)
				{
					treeModelRoot = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("TreeModelRoot");
				}
			}
		}

		public Captions Captions => captions;

		public CommandManager CommandManager
		{
			get
			{
				if (ChartModel == null)
				{
					return null;
				}
				return ChartModel.CommandManager;
			}
		}

		public WpfChartModel ChartModel => chartModel;

		public DesignerViewModelRibbon(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			if (chartModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			RibbonPageCategories.Clear();
			models = chartModel.CreateCategoryModels();
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryViewModel model in models)
			{
				RibbonPageCategories.Add(model);
			}
			TreeModelRoot = new ChartTreeRootModel(chartModel);
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (RibbonPageCategoryViewModel model in models)
			{
				model.CleanUp();
			}
		}
	}
	internal class DesignChartControl : Control
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty ChartControlProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("ChartControl", typeof(ChartControl), typeof(DesignChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(ChartControlChanged));

		public static readonly DependencyProperty SelectedObjectProperty = DependencyPropertyManager.Register("SelectedObject", typeof(object), typeof(DesignChartControl), new PropertyMetadata(SelectedObjectChanged));

		public ChartControl ChartControl
		{
			get
			{
				return (ChartControl)GetValue(ChartControlProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(ChartControlProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public object SelectedObject
		{
			get
			{
				return GetValue(SelectedObjectProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(SelectedObjectProperty, value);
			}
		}

		private static void SelectedObjectChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DesignChartControl designChartControl)
			{
				designChartControl.SetNewSelectionInChart(e.OldValue as IInteractiveElement, e.NewValue as IInteractiveElement);
			}
		}

		private static void ChartControlChanged(DependencyObject d, DependencyPropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (d is DesignChartControl designChartControl)
			{
				designChartControl.SelectedObject = null;
			}
		}

		public DesignChartControl()
		{
			DefaultStyleKeyRegistrator.Set<DesignChartControl>(this);
		}

		private void SetNewSelectionInChart(IInteractiveElement oldSelectedObject, IInteractiveElement newSelectedObject)
		{
			if (oldSelectedObject != null)
			{
				oldSelectedObject.IsSelected = false;
			}
			if (newSelectedObject != null)
			{
				newSelectedObject.IsSelected = true;
			}
		}

		public override void OnApplyTemplate()
		{
			if (ChartControl != null)
			{
				ChartControl.SelectionMode = ElementSelectionMode.None;
			}
		}

		protected override void OnPreviewMouseDown(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
		{
			base.OnPreviewMouseDown(e);
			ChartHitInfo hitInfo = ChartControl.CalcHitInfo(e.GetPosition(ChartControl), 3.0);
			SelectedObject = HitTestingHelper.GetSelectedObject(hitInfo);
		}
	}

		public ICommand SetQuartile3Command => setQuartile3Command;

		public ICommand SetMaxCommand => setMaxCommand;

		public ICommand SetMeanCommand => setMeanCommand;

		public ICommand SetBrushCommand => setBrushCommand;

		public ICommand AddPointCommand => addPointCommand;

		public ICommand RemovePointCommand => removePointCommand;

		public ICommand ClearSeriesDataCommand => clearSeriesDataCommand;

		public WpfChartSeriesModel SeriesModel
		{
			get
			{
				return seriesModel;
			}
			set
			{
				if (seriesModel != value)
				{
					Subscribe(seriesModel, value);
					seriesModel = value;
					UpdateColumns();
					UpdateRows();
					OnPropertyChanged("SeriesModel");
					IsEnabled = GetEnabledStatus();
				}
			}
		}

		public ObservableCollection<ChartDataEditorGridColumn> GridColumns => gridColumns;

		public BindingList<ChartDataEditorPointModel> GridRows => gridRows;

		public ChartDataEditorPointModel SelectedRow
		{
			get
			{
				return selectedRow;
			}
			set
			{
				if (selectedRow != value)
				{
					selectedRow = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("SelectedRow");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool IsEnabled
		{
			get
			{
				return isEnabled;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (isEnabled != value)
				{
					isEnabled = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("IsEnabled");
				}
			}
		}

		public ChartDataEditorPointCollectionModel(WpfChartModel chartModel)
		{
			this.chartModel = chartModel;
			removePointCommand = new RemoveSeriesPointCommand(chartModel);
			addPointCommand = new AddSeriesPointCommand(chartModel);
			setArgumentCommand = new SetSeriesPointArgumentCommand(chartModel);
			setValueCommand = new SetSeriesPointValueCommand(chartModel);
			setValue2Command = new SetSeriesPointValue2Command(chartModel);
			setWeightCommand = new SetSeriesPointWeightCommand(chartModel);
			setOpenCommand = new SetSeriesPointOpenCommand(chartModel);
			setCloseCommand = new SetSeriesPointCloseCommand(chartModel);
			setHighCommand = new SetSeriesPointHighCommand(chartModel);
			setLowCommand = new SetSeriesPointLowCommand(chartModel);
			setMinCommand = new SetSeriesPointMinCommand(chartModel);
			setQuartile1Command = new SetSeriesPointQuartile1Command(chartModel);
			setMedianCommand = new SetSeriesPointMedianCommand(chartModel);
			setQuartile3Command = new SetSeriesPointQuartile3Command(chartModel);
			setMaxCommand = new SetSeriesPointMaxCommand(chartModel);
			setMeanCommand = new SetSeriesPointMeanCommand(chartModel);
			setBrushCommand = new SetSeriesPointBrushCommand(chartModel);
			clearSeriesDataCommand = new ClearSeriesDataCommand(chartModel);
			gridColumns = new ObservableCollection<ChartDataEditorGridColumn>();
			gridRows = new BindingList<ChartDataEditorPointModel>();
			gridRows.AddingNew += AddingNewPoint;
			chartModel.PropertyChanged += ChartModelPropertyChanged;
		}

		private bool GetEnabledStatus()
		{
			if (SeriesModel != null)
			{
				return SeriesModel.IsManual;
			}
			return false;
		}

		private void Subscribe(WpfChartSeriesModel oldModel, WpfChartSeriesModel newModel)
		{
			if (oldModel != null)
			{
				oldModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated -= SeriesPointCollectionModelUpdated;
			}
			if (newModel != null)
			{
				newModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel.CollectionUpdated += SeriesPointCollectionModelUpdated;
			}
		}

		private void ChartModelPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.PropertyName == "SelectedModel")
			{
				if (chartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel)
				{
					SeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)((WpfChartSeriesPointCollectionModel)chartModel.SelectedModel).Parent;
					IsEnabled = GetEnabledStatus();
				}
				else if (chartModel.SelectedModel is WpfChartSeriesModel)
				{
					SeriesModel = (WpfChartSeriesModel)chartModel.SelectedModel;
				}
				else
				{
					SeriesModel = null;
				}
			}
		}

		private void UpdateRows()
		{
			gridRows.Clear();
			if (seriesModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointModel item in seriesModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel.ModelCollection)
			{
				gridRows.Add(new ChartDataEditorPointModel(this, item));
			}
		}

		private void UpdateColumns()
		{
			gridColumns.Clear();
			if (seriesModel == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<ChartDataEditorGridColumn> list = DataEditorUtils.GenerateColumns(seriesModel.Series);
			foreach (ChartDataEditorGridColumn item in list)
			{
				gridColumns.Add(item);
			}
		}

		private int FindModel(WpfChartSeriesPointModel model)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < gridRows.Count; i++)
			{
				if (gridRows[i].SeriesPointModel == model)
				{
					return i;
				}
			}
			return -1;
		}

		private void InsertModel(int index, WpfChartSeriesPointModel model)
		{
			if (FindModel(model) < 0)
			{
				gridRows.Insert(index, new ChartDataEditorPointModel(this, model));
			}
		}

		private void RemoveModel(WpfChartSeriesPointModel model)
		{
			int num = FindModel(model);
			if (num >= 0)
			{
				gridRows.RemoveAt(num);
			}
		}

		private void SeriesPointCollectionModelUpdated(ChartCollectionUpdateEventArgs args)
		{
			if (addCommandExecuting)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (InsertedItem addedItem in args.AddedItems)
			{
				InsertModel(addedItem.Index, (WpfChartSeriesPointModel)addedItem.Item);
			}
			foreach (WpfChartSeriesPointModel removedItem in args.RemovedItems)
			{
				RemoveModel(removedItem);
			}
		}

		private void AddingNewPoint(object sender, AddingNewEventArgs e)
		{
			addCommandExecuting = true;
			if (AddPointCommand.CanExecute(SeriesModel))
			{
				AddPointCommand.Execute(SeriesModel);
			}
			e.NewObject = new ChartDataEditorPointModel(this, SeriesModel.SeriesPointCollectionModel.LastPointModel);
			addCommandExecuting = false;
		}
	}

		{

	public class ChartDataEditorColumnTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		public DataTemplate NumericTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate DateTimeTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate TimeSpanTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate TextTemplate { get; set; }

		public DataTemplate BrushTemplate { get; set; }

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			ChartDataEditorGridColumn chartDataEditorGridColumn = (ChartDataEditorGridColumn)item;
			return chartDataEditorGridColumn.Type switch
			{
				ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric => NumericTemplate, 
				ChartDataEditorColumnType.DateTime => DateTimeTemplate, 
				ChartDataEditorColumnType.TimeSpan => TimeSpanTemplate, 
				ChartDataEditorColumnType.Text => TextTemplate, 
				ChartDataEditorColumnType.Brush => BrushTemplate, 
				_ => TextTemplate, 
			};
		}
	}
	public class ChartPopupBrushEdit : PopupBrushEdit
	{
		protected override EditStrategyBase CreateEditStrategy()
		{
			return (EditStrategyBase)(object)new ChartPopupBrushEditStrategy((PopupBrushEditBase)(object)this);
		}
	}
	public class ChartPopupBrushEditSettings : PopupBrushEditSettings
	{
		public override IBaseEdit CreateEditor(bool assignEditorSettings, IDefaultEditorViewInfo defaultViewInfo, EditorOptimizationMode optimizationMode)
		{
			ChartPopupBrushEdit chartPopupBrushEdit = new ChartPopupBrushEdit();
			((BaseEditSettings)this).ApplyToEdit((IBaseEdit)(object)chartPopupBrushEdit, assignEditorSettings, defaultViewInfo);
			((IBaseEdit)chartPopupBrushEdit).ForceInitialize(false);
			return (IBaseEdit)(object)chartPopupBrushEdit;
		}
	}
	public class ChartPopupBrushEditStrategy : PopupBrushEditStrategy
	{
		public ChartPopupBrushEditStrategy(PopupBrushEditBase editor)
			: base(editor)
		{
		}

		public override PopupBrushValue GetPopupEditValue(BrushType brushType)
		{
			//IL_0012: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0017: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_001e: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_0026: Expected O, but got Unknown
			object brush = BrushConverter.ToBrushType(((EditStrategyBase)this).ValueContainer.EditValue, (BrushType)1);
			return (PopupBrushValue)new PopupSolidColorBrushValue
			{
				BrushType = (BrushType)1,
				Brush = brush
			};
		}
	}
	public static class DataEditorUtils
	{
		private static BoxPlotValueAccessor GetBoxPlotValueAccessor(ScaleType valueScaleType)
		{
			switch (valueScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				return new BoxPlotNumericalValueAccessor();
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				return new BoxPlotDateTimeValueAccessor();
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				return new BoxPlotTimeSpanValueAccessor();
			default:
				ChartDebug.WriteWarning(string.Concat("The DataEditorUtils.GetBoxPlotValueAccessor method can't return an accessor for the ", valueScaleType, " value scale type."));
				return null;
			}
		}

		public static void SetSeriesPointArgumentSafely(SeriesPoint point, object value)
		{
			if (value != null && value.GetType() == typeof(DateTime))
			{
				point.Argument = ((DateTime)value).ToString(CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
			}
			else if (value != null && value.GetType() == typeof(TimeSpan))
			{
				point.Argument = ((TimeSpan)value/*cast due to .constrained prefix*/).ToString();
			}
			else
			{
				point.Argument = (string)value;
			}
		}

		public static List<ChartDataEditorGridColumn> GenerateColumns(Series series)
		{
			List<ChartDataEditorGridColumn> list = new List<ChartDataEditorGridColumn>();
			ChartDataEditorColumnType type = ChartDataEditorColumnType.Text;
			switch (series.ArgumentScaleType)
			{
			case ScaleType.DateTime:
				type = ChartDataEditorColumnType.DateTime;
				break;
			case ScaleType.TimeSpan:
				type = ChartDataEditorColumnType.TimeSpan;
				break;
			case ScaleType.Numerical:
				type = ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric;
				break;
			}
			string header = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_ArgumentColumnHeader);
			string header2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_ValueColumnHeader);
			string header3 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_Value2ColumnHeader);
			string header4 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_WeightValueColumnHeader);
			string header5 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_BrushColumnHeader);
			list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Argument", header, type));
			if (series is BoxPlotSeries2D)
			{
				ChartDataEditorColumnType type2 = ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric;
				if (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
				{
					type2 = ChartDataEditorColumnType.DateTime;
				}
				else if (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
				{
					type2 = ChartDataEditorColumnType.TimeSpan;
				}
				string header6 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_MinColumnHeader);
				string header7 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_Quartile1ColumnHeader);
				string header8 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_MedianColumnHeader);
				string header9 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_Quartile3ColumnHeader);
				string header10 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_MaxColumnHeader);
				string header11 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_MeanColumnHeader);
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Min", header6, type2));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Quartile1", header7, type2));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Median", header8, type2));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Quartile3", header9, type2));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Max", header10, type2));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Mean", header11, type2));
			}
			else if (!(series is FinancialSeries2D))
			{
				ChartDataEditorColumnType type3 = ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric;
				if (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.DateTime)
				{
					type3 = ChartDataEditorColumnType.DateTime;
				}
				else if (series.ValueScaleType == ScaleType.TimeSpan)
				{
					type3 = ChartDataEditorColumnType.TimeSpan;
				}
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Value", header2, type3));
			}
			else
			{
				string header12 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_OpenValueColumnHeader);
				string header13 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_CloseValueColumnHeader);
				string header14 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_HighValueColumnHeader);
				string header15 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.DataEditor_LowValueColumnHeader);
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Open", header12, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Close", header13, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("High", header14, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric));
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Low", header15, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric));
			}
			if (series is RangeBarSeries2D || series is RangeAreaSeries2D || series is CircularRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Value2", header3, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric));
			}
			if (series is BubbleSeries3D || series is BubbleSeries2D)
			{
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Weight", header4, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Numeric));
			}
			if (!(series is FinancialSeries2D))
			{
				list.Add(new ChartDataEditorGridColumn("Brush", header5, ChartDataEditorColumnType.Brush));
			}
			return list;
		}

		public static double GetAttachedValue2(SeriesPoint seriesPoint)
		{
			Series series = seriesPoint.Series;
			if (series is RangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				return RangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(seriesPoint);
			}
			if (series is RadarRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				return RadarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(seriesPoint);
			}
			if (series is PolarRangeAreaSeries2D)
			{
				return PolarRangeAreaSeries2D.GetValue2(seriesPoint);
			}
			if (series is RangeBarSeries2D)
			{
				return RangeBarSeries2D.GetValue2(seriesPoint);
			}
			return double.NaN;
		}

		public static void SetAttachedQuartile1(SeriesPoint point, object value)
		{
			Series series = point.Series;
			BoxPlotValueAccessor boxPlotValueAccessor = GetBoxPlotValueAccessor(series.ValueScaleType);

	public class SplitButtonGalleryItemViewModel : BarButtonViewModel
	{
		private BarSplitButtonGalleryViewModel barButton;

		public SplitButtonGalleryItemViewModel(ChartCommandBase command, BarSplitButtonGalleryViewModel barButton)
			: base(command)
		{
			this.barButton = barButton;
			if (this.barButton.BarItem == null && base.Command.CanExecute(null))
			{
				barButton.BarItem = new BarButtonViewModel((ChartCommandBase)base.Command);
			}
			((ChartCommandBase)base.Command).CommandExecuted += OnCommandExecuted;
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			if (base.Command != null)
			{
				((ChartCommandBase)base.Command).CommandExecuted -= OnCommandExecuted;
			}
			base.CleanUp();
		}

		private void OnCommandExecuted(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			barButton.BarItem = new BarButtonViewModel((ChartCommandBase)base.Command);
		}
	}

	public static class ChartDesignerHelper
	{
		public static void ApplyCommands(ChartDesigner designer, CommandManager commandManager, bool shouldClearCommands)
		{
			if (designer.IsDesignTime)
			{
				commandManager.ApplyAllCommands(designer);
			}
			else
			{
				commandManager.ApplyAllCommands(designer.UserChart);
			}
			if (shouldClearCommands)
			{
				commandManager.Commands.Clear();
			}
		}

		public static void PrepareDesignerChart(ChartDesigner designer)
		{
			designer.PrepareChart();
		}
	}

		public ChartDesignerRibbonWindow(ChartDesigner designer, bool designTime, Theme forceTheme)
		{
			commandManager.HistoryItemAdded += OnHistoryItemAdded;
			this.designer = designer;
			InitializeComponent();
			layout = new DesignerWindowLayout();
			InitializeFormByLayout();
			ChartModel = new WpfChartModel(designer.DesignerChart, commandManager, DesignerBehavior.Ribbon);
			ChartModel.RecursivelyUpdateChildren();
			designerViewModel = new DesignerViewModelRibbon(ChartModel);
			((FrameworkElement)(object)this).DataContext = designerViewModel;
			DesignerProperties.SetIsInDesignMode(gridSeriesData, value: false);
			DesignerProperties.SetIsInDesignMode(chartStructureTree, value: false);
			if (forceTheme == null)
			{
				if (designTime)
				{
					try
					{
						ActualTheme = defaultTheme;
						ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, ActualTheme);
						return;
					}
					catch (Exception ex)
					{
						ChartDebug.WriteWarning("Unable to set the MetropolisLight theme. Exception occurred: " + ex.Message);
						return;
					}
				}
				try
				{
					ActualTheme = ThemeManager.GetTheme((DependencyObject)designer.UserChart);
					ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, ActualTheme);
					return;
				}
				catch (Exception)
				{
					return;
				}
			}
			ActualTheme = forceTheme;
			ThemeManager.SetTheme((DependencyObject)(object)this, ActualTheme);
		}

		private void OnHistoryItemAdded(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((ContentElement)(object)btnUndo).IsEnabled = true;
		}

		private void window_Initialized(object sender, EventArgs e)
		{
			((ContentElement)(object)btnRedo).IsEnabled = false;
			((ContentElement)(object)btnUndo).IsEnabled = false;
		}

		private void InitializeFormByLayout()
		{
			if (layout.Size != Size.Empty)
			{
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Width = layout.Size.Width;
				((FrameworkElement)(object)this).Height = layout.Size.Height;
			}
			((Window)(object)this).WindowState = (layout.Maximized ? WindowState.Maximized : WindowState.Normal);
		}

		private void OnDXRibbonWindowLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			dockLayoutManager.DockController.Hide(layoutPanelForChartTree);
			dockLayoutManager.DockController.Hide(layoutPanelForSeriesData);
		}

		private void CommandDeleteElement_Executed(object sender, ExecutedRoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			ChartModel.DeleteSelectedObject();
		}

		private void ChartDesignerWindowClosing(object sender, CancelEventArgs e)
		{
			if (commandManager.Commands.Count != 0 && showSaveDialog)
			{
				string text = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.ChartDesignerWindowTitle);
				string text2 = ChartDesignerLocalizer.GetString(ChartDesignerStringIDs.SaveAndExitWindowText);
				MessageBoxResult messageBoxResult = CompatibilityMessageBox.Show((FrameworkElement)(object)this, text2, text, MessageBoxButton.YesNoCancel);
				if (messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Yes)
				{
					ChartDesignerHelper.ApplyCommands(designer, commandManager, shouldClearCommands: false);
					((Window)(object)this).DialogResult = true;
				}
				e.Cancel = messageBoxResult == MessageBoxResult.Cancel;
			}
			if (!e.Cancel)
			{
				layout.Size = ((Window)(object)this).RestoreBounds.Size;
				designerViewModel.CleanUp();
			}
		}

		private void btnUndo_ItemClick(object sender, ItemClickEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = commandManager.Undo();
			((ContentElement)(object)btnRedo).IsEnabled = true;
			if (!flag)
			{
				((ContentElement)(object)btnUndo).IsEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		private void btnRedo_ItemClick(object sender, ItemClickEventArgs e)
		{
			bool flag = commandManager.Redo();
			((ContentElement)(object)btnUndo).IsEnabled = true;
			if (!flag)
			{
				((ContentElement)(object)btnRedo).IsEnabled = false;
			}
		}

		private void btnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			commandManager.Commands.Clear();
			((Window)(object)this).Close();
		}

		private void btnSaveAndExit_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
		{
			bool value = false;
			if (commandManager.Commands.Count > 0)
			{
				value = true;
			}
			ChartDesignerHelper.ApplyCommands(designer, commandManager, shouldClearCommands: true);
			((Window)(object)this).DialogResult = value;
			((Window)(object)this).Close();
		}

		internal void CloseWithoutDialog()
		{
			showSaveDialog = false;
			((Window)(object)this).Close();
			showSaveDialog = true;
		}

		public void SaveLayoutToRegistry()
		{
			layout.Maximized = ((Window)(object)this).WindowState == WindowState.Maximized;
			layout.SaveLayoutToRegistry();
		}

	public class ExecuteCommandInfo
	{
		private readonly object parameter;

		private readonly object additionalInfo;

		private readonly Dictionary<string, int> pathIndexes = new Dictionary<string, int>();

		public Dictionary<string, int> IndexByNameDictionary => pathIndexes;

		public object Parameter => parameter;

		public bool IsValidPath => pathIndexes.Count != 0;

		public object AdditionalInfo => additionalInfo;

		public ExecuteCommandInfo(object parameter)
			: this(parameter, (ElementIndexItem[])null)
		{
		}

		public ExecuteCommandInfo(object parameter, params ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes)
			: this(parameter, null, pathIndexes)
		{
		}

		public ExecuteCommandInfo(object parameter, object additionalInfo, params ElementIndexItem[] pathIndexes)
		{
			this.parameter = parameter;
			this.additionalInfo = additionalInfo;
			if (pathIndexes != null)
			{
				foreach (ElementIndexItem elementIndexItem in pathIndexes)
				{
					this.pathIndexes.Add(elementIndexItem.ElementName, elementIndexItem.Index);
				}
			}
		}
	}

	public class CompositeHistoryItem : IHistoryItem
	{
		private List<IHistoryItem> historyItems = new List<IHistoryItem>();

		public List<IHistoryItem> HistoryItems => historyItems;

		public IEnumerable<IHistoryItem> UndoHistoryItems
		{
			get
			{
				for (int i = historyItems.Count - 1; i >= 0; i--)
				{
					yield return historyItems[i];
				}
			}
		}

		void IHistoryItem.Undo()
		{
			foreach (IHistoryItem undoHistoryItem in UndoHistoryItems)
			{
				undoHistoryItem.Undo();
			}
		}

		void IHistoryItem.Redo()
		{
			foreach (IHistoryItem historyItem in HistoryItems)
			{
				historyItem.Redo();
			}
		}

		void IHistoryItem.Apply(ChartControl chartControl)
		{
			foreach (IHistoryItem historyItem in HistoryItems)
			{
				historyItem.Apply(chartControl);
			}
		}

		void IHistoryItem.DesigntimeApply(IModelItem chartModelItem, IDesignTimeProvider designTimeProvider)
		{
			foreach (IHistoryItem historyItem in HistoryItems)
			{
				historyItem.DesigntimeApply(chartModelItem, designTimeProvider);
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder("CompositeHistoryItem (");
			bool flag = false;
			foreach (IHistoryItem historyItem in historyItems)
			{
				if (flag)
				{
					stringBuilder.Append(",");
				}
				stringBuilder.Append(historyItem.ToString());
				flag = true;
			}
			stringBuilder.Append(")");
			return stringBuilder.ToString();
		}
	}
	public class CommandManager : NotifyPropertyChangedObject
	{
		private readonly ObservableCollection<IHistoryItem> commands = new ObservableCollection<IHistoryItem>();

		private int queuePosition = -1;

		public ObservableCollection<IHistoryItem> Commands => commands;

		public int QueuePosition
		{
			get
			{
				return queuePosition;
			}
			private set
			{
				if (queuePosition != value)
				{
					queuePosition = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("QueuePosition");
				}
			}
		}

		public event EventHandler<EventArgs> HistoryItemAdded;

		private void PushItem(IHistoryItem info)
		{
			if (commands.Count > queuePosition + 1)
			{
				int count = commands.Count;
				for (int num = count - 1; num > queuePosition; num--)
				{
					commands.RemoveAt(num);
				}
			}
			commands.Add(info);
			QueuePosition++;
		}

		private IHistoryItem GetUndoItem()
		{
			IHistoryItem result = null;
			if (commands.Count > 0 && queuePosition > -1)
			{
				result = commands[queuePosition];
				QueuePosition--;
				if (queuePosition < -1)
				{
					queuePosition = -1;
				}
			}
			return result;
		}

		private IHistoryItem GetRedoItem()
		{
			IHistoryItem result = null;
			if (queuePosition < commands.Count - 1)
			{
				QueuePosition++;
				result = commands[queuePosition];
			}
			return result;
		}

		public void AddHistoryItem(IHistoryItem item)
		{
			PushItem(item);
			if (this.HistoryItemAdded != null)
			{
				this.HistoryItemAdded(this, new EventArgs());
			}
		}

		public bool Undo()
		{
			GetUndoItem()?.Undo();
			return QueuePosition > -1;
		}

		public bool Redo()
		{
			GetRedoItem()?.Redo();
			return QueuePosition < commands.Count - 1;
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void ApplyAllCommands(ChartControl chartControl)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= QueuePosition; i++)
			{
				commands[i].Apply(chartControl);
			}
		}

		[SecuritySafeCritical]
		public void ApplyAllCommands(ChartDesigner designer)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i <= QueuePosition; i++)
			{
				commands[i].DesigntimeApply(designer.ChartModelItem, designer.DesignTimeProvider);
			}
		}
	}
	[Serializable]
	public class ChartDesignerException : Exception
	{
		public ChartDesignerException()
		{
		}

		public ChartDesignerException(string message)
			: base(message)
		{
		}

		public ChartDesignerException(string message, Exception innerException)
			: base(message, innerException)
		{
		}

		public ChartDesignerException(SerializationInfo serializationInfo, StreamingContext streamingContext)
			: base(serializationInfo, streamingContext)
		{
		}
	}
	public sealed class RibbonPageCategoryTemplateSelector : DataTemplateSelector
	{
		private const string CategoryTemplatesDictionaryPath = ";component/Themes/RibbonElementTemplates/RibbonPageCategories.xaml";

		private ResourceDictionary categoryTemplatesDictionary = new ResourceDictionary();

		public RibbonPageCategoryTemplateSelector()
		{
			string name = typeof(ChartDesigner).Assembly.GetName().Name;
			Uri source = new Uri("pack://application:,,,/" + name + ";component/Themes/RibbonElementTemplates/RibbonPageCategories.xaml", UriKind.Absolute);
			categoryTemplatesDictionary.Source = source;
		}

		private object SelectTemplateInternal(object item)
		{
			if (!(item is RibbonPageCategoryViewModel ribbonPageCategoryViewModel))
			{
				return null;
			}
			if (ribbonPageCategoryViewModel.IsDefaultCategory)
			{
				return categoryTemplatesDictionary["ribbonDefaultPageCategory"];
			}
			return categoryTemplatesDictionary["ribbonPageCategory"];
		}

		public override DataTemplate SelectTemplate(object item, DependencyObject container)
		{
			DataTemplate dataTemplate = (DataTemplate)SelectTemplateInternal(item);
			if (dataTemplate == null)
			{
				string message = GetType().Name + " can not give a template for " + item.GetType().Name + " in the " + container.GetType().Name + ".";
				throw new ChartDesignerException(message);
			}
			return dataTemplate;
		}
	}

	public abstract class NotifyPropertyChangedObject : INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}
	}
	[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Method, AllowMultiple = false)]
	public class SkipOnPropertyChangedMethodCall : Attribute
	{
	}
	public sealed class RibbonPageCategoryViewModel : RibbonItemViewModelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty VisibleProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("Visible", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonPageCategoryViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		private readonly bool isDefaultCategory;

		private ObservableCollection<RibbonPageViewModel> pages = new ObservableCollection<RibbonPageViewModel>();

		public ObservableCollection<RibbonPageViewModel> Pages => pages;

		public bool IsDefaultCategory => isDefaultCategory;

		public bool Visible
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(VisibleProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(VisibleProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryViewModel(WpfChartModel chartModel)
			: this(chartModel, null)
		{
		}

		public RibbonPageCategoryViewModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, Type selectedModelType, string stringParameter = "")
		{
			if (selectedModelType == null)
			{
				isDefaultCategory = true;
				Visible = true;
				return;
			}
			isDefaultCategory = false;
			Binding binding = new Binding("SelectedModel")
			{
				Source = chartModel,
				Converter = new PageCategoryVisibleConverter(),
				ConverterParameter = new VisibilityConverterParameter
				{
					TypeParameter = selectedModelType,
					StringParameter = stringParameter
				}
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, VisibleProperty, binding);
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (RibbonPageViewModel page in Pages)
			{
				page.CleanUp();
			}
		}
	}
	public class VisibilityConverterParameter
	{
		public Type TypeParameter { get; set; }

		public string StringParameter { get; set; }
	}

		public const string ConstantLineOptionsPage = "ConstantLineOptionsPage";

	}
	public class RibbonPageViewModel : RibbonItemViewModelBase
	{
		public static readonly DependencyProperty IsSelectedProperty = DependencyProperty.Register("IsSelected", typeof(bool), typeof(RibbonPageViewModel), new PropertyMetadata(false));

		private string name;

		private ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroupViewModel> groups = new ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroupViewModel>();

		public ObservableCollection<RibbonPageGroupViewModel> Groups => groups;

		public bool IsSelected
		{
			get
			{
				return (bool)GetValue(IsSelectedProperty);
			}
			set
			{
				SetValue(IsSelectedProperty, value);
			}
		}

		public string Name => name;

		public RibbonPageViewModel(WpfChartModel chartModel, string name)
		{
			this.name = name;
			Binding binding = new Binding("SelectedPageName")
			{
				Source = chartModel,
				Mode = BindingMode.TwoWay,
				Converter = new PageSelectedConverter(),
				ConverterParameter = name
			};
			BindingOperations.SetBinding(this, IsSelectedProperty, binding);
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (RibbonPageGroupViewModel group in Groups)
			{
				group.CleanUp();
			}
		}
	}
	public sealed class RibbonPageGroupViewModel : RibbonItemViewModelBase
	{
		private ObservableCollection<RibbonItemViewModelBase> barItems = new ObservableCollection<RibbonItemViewModelBase>();

		private ImageSource image32x32;

		private bool allowCollapse;

		private bool hideGroupIfAllCommandsAreDisabled;

		private bool inInitialization;

		public ObservableCollection<RibbonItemViewModelBase> BarItems => barItems;

		public ImageSource Image32x32
		{
			get
			{
				return image32x32;
			}
			set
			{
				if (image32x32 != value)
				{
					image32x32 = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("Image32x32");
				}
			}
		}

		public bool AllowCollapse
		{
			get
			{
				return allowCollapse;
			}
			set
			{
				if (allowCollapse != value)
				{
					allowCollapse = value;
					OnPropertyChanged("AllowCollapse");
				}
			}
		}

		public RibbonPageGroupViewModel(bool hideGroupIfAllCommandsAreDisabled = false)
		{
			this.hideGroupIfAllCommandsAreDisabled = hideGroupIfAllCommandsAreDisabled;
			barItems.CollectionChanged += OnBarItemsCollectionChanged;
		}

		private void UpdateGroupVisibilityByItemsEnabledAndVisibility()
		{
			bool flag = false;
			bool flag2 = false;
			int num = -1;
			foreach (RibbonItemViewModelBase barItem in barItems)
			{
				num++;
				if (barItem.IsVisible && !(barItem is BarStaticTextViewModel) && !(barItem is BarSeparatorViewModel))
				{
					flag = true;
				}
				if (barItem.IsEnabled && !(barItem is BarStaticTextViewModel) && !(barItem is BarSeparatorViewModel))
				{
					flag2 = true;
				}
				bool flag3 = false;
				if (barItem is BarSeparatorViewModel || barItem is BarStaticTextViewModel)
				{
					flag3 = AreAllItemsAfterSeparatorInvisible(barItems, num);
				}
				if (flag3)
				{
					HideStaticTextsAndSeparators(barItems, num);
				}
				else
				{
					ShowStaticTextsAndSeparators(barItems, num);
				}
			}
			if (hideGroupIfAllCommandsAreDisabled)
			{
				base.IsVisible = flag2;
			}
			else
			{
				base.IsVisible = flag;
			}
		}

		private void HideStaticTextsAndSeparators(ObservableCollection<RibbonItemViewModelBase> barItems, int itemIndex)
		{
			inInitialization = true;
			for (int i = itemIndex; i < barItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (barItems[i] is BarStaticTextViewModel || barItems[i] is BarSeparatorViewModel)
				{
					barItems[i].IsVisible = false;
				}
			}
			inInitialization = false;
		}

		private void ShowStaticTextsAndSeparators(ObservableCollection<RibbonItemViewModelBase> barItems, int itemIndex)
		{
			inInitialization = true;
			for (int i = itemIndex; i < barItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (barItems[i] is BarStaticTextViewModel || barItems[i] is BarSeparatorViewModel)
				{
					barItems[i].IsVisible = true;
				}
			}
			inInitialization = false;
		}

		private bool AreAllItemsAfterSeparatorInvisible(ObservableCollection<RibbonItemViewModelBase> barItems, int itemIndex)
		{
			bool flag = false;
			for (int i = itemIndex; i < barItems.Count; i++)
			{
				if (!(barItems[i] is BarStaticTextViewModel) && !(barItems[i] is BarSeparatorViewModel))
				{
					flag |= barItems[i].IsVisible;
				}
			}
			return !flag;
		}

		private void OnBarItemsCollectionChanged(object sender, NotifyCollectionChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (e.NewItems != null)
			{
				foreach (RibbonItemViewModelBase newItem in e.NewItems)
				{
					newItem.PropertyChanged += OnItemPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			if (e.OldItems != null)
			{
				foreach (RibbonItemViewModelBase oldItem in e.OldItems)
				{
					oldItem.PropertyChanged -= OnItemPropertyChanged;
				}
			}
			UpdateGroupVisibilityByItemsEnabledAndVisibility();
		}

		private void OnItemPropertyChanged(object sender, PropertyChangedEventArgs e)
		{
			if (!inInitialization && (e.PropertyName == "IsEnabled" || e.PropertyName == "IsVisible"))
			{
				UpdateGroupVisibilityByItemsEnabledAndVisibility();
			}
		}

		public override void CleanUp()
		{
			base.CleanUp();
			foreach (RibbonItemViewModelBase barItem in BarItems)
			{
				barItem.CleanUp();
			}
		}

		public override string ToString()
		{
			string text = base.Caption ?? string.Empty;
			return GetType().Name + "[" + text + "]";
		}
	}
	public abstract class ViewModelBase : DependencyObject, INotifyPropertyChanged
	{
		public event PropertyChangedEventHandler PropertyChanged;

		protected void OnPropertyChanged(string propertyName)
		{
			if (this.PropertyChanged != null)
			{
				this.PropertyChanged(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
			}
		}

		public virtual void CleanUp()
		{
		}
	}
